verses.sa:
स्वादि॑ष्ठया॒ मदि॑ष्ठया॒ पव॑स्व सोम॒ धार॑या ।
इन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे सु॒तः ॥
verses.rom:
svadishthaya madishthaya pavasva soma dharaya |
indraya patave sutah ||
verses.en:
In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way,
Pressed out for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa:
र॒क्षो॒हा वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिर॒भि योनि॒मयो॑हतम्!
द्रुणा॑ सधस्थमासदत् ॥
verses.rom:
rakshoha vishvacharshanirabhi yonimayohatam!
druna sadhasthamasadat ||
verses.en:
Fiend-queller, Friend of all men, he hath with the wood attained unto
His place, his iron-fashioned home.

verses.sa:
वरिवोधातमो भव मंहिष्ठो वृत्रहन्तमः ।
पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
varivodhatamo bhava mamhishtho vritrahantamah |
parshi radho maghonam ||
verses.en:
Be thou best Vrtra-slayer, best granter of bliss, most liberal:
Promote our wealthy princes' gifts.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्ष महानां देवानां वीतिमन्धसा ।
अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarsha mahanam devanam vitimandhasa |
abhi vajamuta shravah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward with thy juice unto the banquet of the Mighty Gods:
Flow hither for our strength and fame.

verses.sa:
त्वामच्छा चरामसि तदिदर्थं दिवेदिवे ।
इन्दो त्वे न आशसः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamachchha charamasi tadidartham divedive |
indo tve na ashasah ||
verses.en:
O Indu, we draw nigh to thee, with this one object day by day:
To thee alone our prayers are said

verses.sa:
पुनाति ते परिस्रुतं सोमं सूर्यस्य दुहिता ।
वारेण शश्वता तना ॥
verses.rom:
punati te parisrutam somam suryasya duhita |
varena shashvata tana ||
verses.en:
By means of this eternal fleece may Surya's Daughter purify
Thy Soma that is foaming forth.

verses.sa:
तमीमण्वीः समर्य आ गृभ्णन्ति योषणो दश ।
स्वसारः पार्ये दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
tamimanvih samarya a gribhnanti yoshano dasha |
svasarah parye divi ||
verses.en:
Ten sister maids of slender form seize him within the press and hold
Him firmly on the final day.

verses.sa:
तमीं हिन्वन्त्यग्रुवो धमन्ति बाकुरं दृतिम् ।
त्रिधातु वारणं मधु ॥
verses.rom:
tamim hinvantyagruvo dhamanti bakuram dritim |
tridhatu varanam madhu ||
verses.en:
The virgins send him forth: they blow the the skin musician-like and fuse
The triple foe-repelling meath.

verses.sa:
अभीममघ्न्या उत श्रीणन्ति धेनवः शिशुम् ।
सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ॥
verses.rom:
abhimamaghnya uta shrinanti dhenavah shishum |
somamindraya patave ||
verses.en:
Inviolable milch-kine round about him blend for Indra's drink,
The fresh young Soma with their milk.

verses.sa:
अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा विश्वा वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ।
शूरो मघा च मंहते ॥
verses.rom:
asyedindro madeshva vishva vritrani jighnate |
shuro magha cha mamhate ||
verses.en:
In the wild raptures of this draught, Indra slays all the Vrtras: he,
The Hero, pours his wealth on us.

verses.sa:
पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रं सोम रंह्या ।
इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva devavirati pavitram soma ramhya |
indramindo vrisha visha ||
verses.en:
Soma, flow on, inviting Gods, speed to the purifying cloth:
Pass into Indra, as a Bull.

verses.sa:
आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेन्दो द्युम्नवत्तमः ।
आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः ॥
verses.rom:
a vachyasva mahi psaro vrishendo dyumnavattamah |
a yonim dharnasih sadah ||
verses.en:
As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid Steer:
Sit in thy place as one with strength.

verses.sa:
अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः ।
अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
adhukshata priyam madhu dhara sutasya vedhasah |
apo vasishta sukratuh ||
verses.en:
The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice
ne Sage drew waters to himself.

verses.sa:
महान्तं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः ।
यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
mahantam tva mahiranvapo arshanti sindhavah |
yadgobhirvasayishyase ||
verses.en:
The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee Mighty One,
When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.

verses.sa:
समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः ।
सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
samudro apsu mamrije vishtambho dharuno divah |
somah pavitre asmayuh ||
verses.en:
The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our Friend, heaven's prop and stay,
Falls on the purifying cloth.

verses.sa:
अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः ।
सं सूर्येण रोचते ॥
verses.rom:
achikradadvrisha harirmahanmitro na darshatah |
sam suryena rochate ||
verses.en:
The tawny Bull hath bellowed, fair as mighty Mitra to behold:
He shines together with the Sun.

verses.sa:
गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः ।
याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे ॥
verses.rom:
girasta inda ojasa marmrijyante apasyuvah |
yabhirmadaya shumbhase ||
verses.en:
Songs, Indu, active in their might are beautified for thee, wherewith
Thou deckest thee for our delight.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे ।
तव प्रशस्तयो महीः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva madaya ghrishvaya u lokakritnumimahe |
tava prashastayo mahih ||
verses.en:
To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the joyous draught:
Great are the praise due to thee.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यमिन्दविन्द्रयुर्मध्वः पवस्व धारया ।
पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyamindavindrayurmadhvah pavasva dharaya |
parjanyo vrishtiman iva ||
verses.en:
Indu as, Indra's Friend, on us pour with a stream of sweetness, like
Parjanya sender of the rain.

verses.sa:
गोषा इन्दो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत ।
आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ॥
verses.rom:
gosha indo nrisha asyashvasa vajasa uta |
atma yajnasya purvyah ||
verses.en:
Winner of kine, Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and strength
Primeval Soul of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयति ।
अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha devo amartyah parnaviriva diyati |
abhi dronanyasadam ||
verses.en:
HERE present this Immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings,
To settle in the vats of wood.

verses.sa:
एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वरांसि धावति ।
पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
esha devo vipa krito'ti hvaramsi dhavati |
pavamano adabhyah ||
verses.en:
This God, made ready with the hymn, runs swiftly through the winding ways,
Inviolable as he flows.

verses.sa:
एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः ।
हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते ॥
verses.rom:
esha devo vipanyubhih pavamana ritayubhih |
harirvajaya mrijyate ||
verses.en:
This God while flowing is adorned, like a bay steed for war, by men
Devout and skilled in holy songs.

verses.sa:
एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः ।
पवमानः सिषासति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vishvani varya shuro yanniva satvabhih |
pavamanah sishasati ||
verses.en:
He, like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along
Is fain to win all precious boons.

verses.sa:
एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दशस्यति ।
आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha devo ratharyati pavamano dashasyati |
avishkrinoti vagvanum ||
verses.en:
This God, as he is flowing on, speeds like a car and gives his gifts:
He lets his voice be heard of all

verses.sa:
एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते ।
दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
esha viprairabhishtuto'po devo vi gahate |
dadhadratnani dashushe ||
verses.en:
Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows
Rich gifts upon the worshipper.

verses.sa:
एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजांसि धारया ।
पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
esha divam vi dhavati tiro rajamsi dharaya |
pavamanah kanikradat ||
verses.en:
Away he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven,
And roars as he is flowing on.

verses.sa:
एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतः ।
पवमानः स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
esha divam vyasarattiro rajamsyaspritah |
pavamanah svadhvarah ||
verses.en:
While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven across
The regions, irresistible.

verses.sa:
एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।
हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
esha pratnena janmana devo devebhyah sutah |
harih pavitre arshati ||
verses.en:
After the 'way of ancient time, this God, pressed out for Deities,
Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः ।
धारया पवते सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
esha u sya puruvrato jajnano janayannishah |
dharaya pavate sutah ||
verses.en:
This Lord of many Holy Laws, even at his birth engendering strength,
Effused, flows onward in a stream.

verses.sa:
सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sana cha soma jeshi cha pavamana mahi shravah |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
O Soma flowing on thy way, win thou and conquer high renown;
And make us better than we are.

verses.sa:
सना ज्योतिः सना स्वर्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sana jyotih sana svarvishva cha soma saubhaga |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities;
And make us better than we are.

verses.sa:
सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sana dakshamuta kratumapa soma mridho jahi |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
Win skillful strength and mental power. O Soma, drive away our foes;
And make us better than we are.

verses.sa:
पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
pavitarah punitana somamindraya patave |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink:
Make thou us better than we are.

verses.sa:
त्वं सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam surye na a bhaja tava kratva tavotibhih |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids;
And make us better than we are.

verses.sa:
तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यम् ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tava kratva tavotibhirjyokpashyema suryam |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
Through thine own mental power and aid long may we look upon the Sun;
Make thou us better than we are.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarsha svayudha soma dvibarhasam rayim |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
Well-weaponed Soma, pour to us a stream of riches doubly great;
And make us better than we are.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्षानपच्युतो रयिं समत्सु सासहिः ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarshanapachyuto rayim samatsu sasahih |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
As one victorious unsubdued in battle pour forth wealth to us;
And make us better than we are.

verses.sa:
त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam yajnairavivridhanpavamana vidharmani |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
By worship, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee to prop the Law:
Make thou us better than we are.

verses.sa:
रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिन्दो विश्वायुमा भर ।
अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
rayim nashchitramashvinamindo vishvayuma bhara |
atha no vasyasaskridhi ||
verses.en:
O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds, manifold. quickening all life;
And mate us better than we are.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो विश्वतस्पतिः पवमानो वि राजति ।
प्रीणन्वृषा कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho vishvataspatih pavamano vi rajati |
prinanvrisha kanikradat ||
verses.en:
ENKINDLED, Pavamana, Lord, sends forth his light on, every side
In friendly show, the bellowing Bull.

verses.sa:
तनूनपात्पवमानः शृङ्गे शिशानो अर्षति ।
अन्तरिक्षेण रारजत् ॥
verses.rom:
tanunapatpavamanah shringe shishano arshati |
antarikshena rarajat ||
verses.en:
He, Pavamana, Self-produced, speeds onward sharpening his horns:
He glitters through the firmament.

verses.sa:
ईळेन्यः पवमानो रयिर्वि राजति द्युमान् ।
मधोर्धाराभिरोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
ilenyah pavamano rayirvi rajati dyuman |
madhordharabhirojasa ||
verses.en:
Brilliant like wealth, adorable, with splendour Pavamana shines,
Mightily with the streams of meath.

verses.sa:
बर्हिः प्राचीनमोजसा पवमान स्तृणन्हरिः ।
देवेषु देव ईयते ॥
verses.rom:
barhih prachinamojasa pavamana strinanharih |
deveshu deva iyate ||
verses.en:
The tawny Pavamana, who strews from of old the grass with might,
Is worshipped, God amid the Gods.

verses.sa:
उदातैर्जिहते बृहद्द्वारो देवीर्हिरण्ययीः ।
पवमानेन सुष्टुताः ॥
verses.rom:
udatairjihate brihaddvaro devirhiranyayih |
pavamanena sushtutah ||
verses.en:
The golden, the Celestial Doors are lifted with their frames on high,
By Pavamana glorified.

verses.sa:
सुशिल्पे बृहती मही पवमानो वृषण्यति ।
नक्तोषासा न दर्शते ॥
verses.rom:
sushilpe brihati mahi pavamano vrishanyati |
naktoshasa na darshate ||
verses.en:
With passion Pavamana longs for the great lofty pair, well-formed
Like beauteous maidens, Night and Dawn

verses.sa:
उभा देवा नृचक्षसा होतारा दैव्या हुवे ।
पवमान इन्द्रो वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
ubha deva nrichakshasa hotara daivya huve |
pavamana indro vrisha ||
verses.en:
Both Gods who look on men I call, Celestial Heralds: Indra's Self
Is Pavamana, yea, the Bull.

verses.sa:
भारती पवमानस्य सरस्वतीळा मही ।
इमं नो यज्ञमा गमन्तिस्रो देवीः सुपेशसः ॥
verses.rom:
bharati pavamanasya sarasvatila mahi |
imam no yajnama gamantisro devih supeshasah ||
verses.en:
This, Pavamana's sacrifice, shall the three beauteous Goddesses,
Sarasvati and Bharati and Ila, Mighty One, attend.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टारमग्रजां गोपां पुरोयावानमा हुवे ।
इन्दुरिन्द्रो वृषा हरिः पवमानः प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvashtaramagrajam gopam puroyavanama huve |
indurindro vrisha harih pavamanah prajapatih ||
verses.en:
1 summon Tvastar hither, our protector, champion, earliest-born,
Indu is Indra, tawny Steer; Pavamana is Prajapati.

verses.sa:
वनस्पतिं पवमान मध्वा समङ्ग्धि धारया ।
सहस्रवल्शं हरितं भ्राजमानं हिरण्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspatim pavamana madhva samangdhi dharaya |
sahasravalsham haritam bhrajamanam hiranyayam ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, with the meath in streams anoint Vanaspati,
The ever-green. the golden-hued, refulgent, with a thousand boughs.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवाः स्वाहाकृतिं पवमानस्या गत ।
वायुर्बृहस्पतिः सूर्योऽग्निरिन्द्रः सजोषसः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve devah svahakritim pavamanasya gata |
vayurbrihaspatih suryo'gnirindrah sajoshasah ||
verses.en:
Come to the consecrating rite of Pavamana, all ye Gods,-
Vayu, Surya, Brhaspati, Indra, and Agni, in accord.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रया सोम धारया वृषा पवस्व देवयुः ।
अव्यो वारेष्वस्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
mandraya soma dharaya vrisha pavasva devayuh |
avyo vareshvasmayuh ||
verses.en:
SOMA, flow on with pleasant stream, a Bull devoted to the Gods,
Our Friend, unto the woolen sieve.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं मद्यं मदमिन्दविन्द्र इति क्षर ।
अभि वाजिनो अर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tyam madyam madamindavindra iti kshara |
abhi vajino arvatah ||
verses.en:
Pour hitherward, as Indra's Self, Indu, that gladdening stream of thine,
And send us coursers full of strength.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं पूर्व्यं मदं सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ ।
अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tyam purvyam madam suvano arsha pavitra a |
abhi vajamuta shravah ||
verses.en:
Flow to the filter hitherward, pouring that ancient gladdening juice,
Streaming forth power and high renown.

verses.sa:
अनु द्रप्सास इन्दव आपो न प्रवतासरन् ।
पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
verses.rom:
anu drapsasa indava apo na pravatasaran |
punana indramashata ||
verses.en:
Hither the sparkling drops have flowed, like waters down a steep descent
They have reached Indra purified.

verses.sa:
यमत्यमिव वाजिनं मृजन्ति योषणो दश ।
वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamatyamiva vajinam mrijanti yoshano dasha |
vane krilantamatyavim ||
verses.en:
Whom, having passed the filter, ten dames cleanse, as 'twere a vigorous steed,
While he disports him in the wood,-

verses.sa:
तं गोभिर्वृषणं रसं मदाय देववीतये ।
सुतं भराय सं सृज ॥
verses.rom:
tam gobhirvrishanam rasam madaya devavitaye |
sutam bharaya sam srija ||
verses.en:
The steer-strong juice with milk pour forth, for feast and service of the Gods,
To him who bears away the draught.

verses.sa:
देवो देवाय धारयेन्द्राय पवते सुतः ।
पयो यदस्य पीपयत् ॥
verses.rom:
devo devaya dharayendraya pavate sutah |
payo yadasya pipayat ||
verses.en:
Effused, the God flows onward with his stream to Indra, to the God,
So that his milk may strengthen him.

verses.sa:
आत्मा यज्ञस्य रंह्या सुष्वाणः पवते सुतः ।
प्रत्नं नि पाति काव्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
atma yajnasya ramhya sushvanah pavate sutah |
pratnam ni pati kavyam ||
verses.en:
Soul of the sacrifice, the juice effused flows quickly on: he keeps
His ancient wisdom of a Sage.

verses.sa:
एवा पुनान इन्द्रयुर्मदं मदिष्ठ वीतये ।
गुहा चिद्दधिषे गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
eva punana indrayurmadam madishtha vitaye |
guha chiddadhishe girah ||
verses.en:
So pouring forth, as Indra's Friend, strong drink, best Gladdener! for the feast,
Thou, even in secret, storest hymns.

verses.sa:
असृग्रमिन्दवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः ।
विदाना अस्य योजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
asrigramindavah patha dharmannritasya sushriyah |
vidana asya yojanam ||

verses.sa:
प्र धारा मध्वो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते ।
हविर्हविष्षु वन्द्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pra dhara madhvo agriyo mahirapo vi gahate |
havirhavishshu vandyah ||

verses.sa:
प्र युजो वाचो अग्रियो वृषाव चक्रदद्वने ।
सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yujo vacho agriyo vrishava chakradadvane |
sadmabhi satyo adhvarah ||

verses.sa:
परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा वसानो अर्षति ।
स्वर्वाजी सिषासति ॥
verses.rom:
pari yatkavya kavirnrimna vasano arshati |
svarvaji sishasati ||

verses.sa:
पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति ।
यदीमृण्वन्ति वेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano abhi spridho visho rajeva sidati |
yadimrinvanti vedhasah ||

verses.sa:
अव्यो वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति ।
रेभो वनुष्यते मती ॥
verses.rom:
avyo vare pari priyo harirvaneshu sidati |
rebho vanushyate mati ||

verses.sa:
स वायुमिन्द्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति ।
रणा यो अस्य धर्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa vayumindramashvina sakam madena gachchhati |
rana yo asya dharmabhih ||

verses.sa:
आ मित्रावरुणा भगं मध्वः पवन्त ऊर्मयः ।
विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a mitravaruna bhagam madhvah pavanta urmayah |
vidana asya shakmabhih ||

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये ।
श्रवो वसूनि सं जितम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyam rodasi rayim madhvo vajasya sataye |
shravo vasuni sam jitam ||

prose.en:
1. FORTH on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law,
Knowing this sacrifice's course.

2. Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of meath, most excellent,
Oblation best of all in worth.

3. About the holy place, the Steer true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth
Continuous voices in the wood.

4. When, clothed in manly strength, the Sage flows in celestial wisdom round,
The Strong would win the light of heaven.

5. When purified, he sits as King above the hosts, among his folk,
What time the sages bring him nigh.

6. Dear, golden-coloured, in the fleece he sinks and settles in the wood:
The Singer shows his zeal in hymns.

7. He goes to Indra, Vayu, to the Asvins, as his custom is,
With gladdening juice which gives them joy.

8. Tle streams of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra-Varuna,-
Well-knowing through his mighty powers.
Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth:
Gain for us treasures and renown.

verses.sa:
एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् ।
वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ete soma abhi priyamindrasya kamamaksharan |
vardhanto asya viryam ||
verses.en:
OBEYING Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth,
Increasing his heroic might.

verses.sa:
पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छन्तो वायुमश्विना ।
ते नो धान्तु सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
punanasashchamushado gachchhanto vayumashvina |
te no dhantu suviryam ||
verses.en:
Laid in the bowl, pure-flowing on to Vayu and the Asvins, may
These give us great heroic strength.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय ।
ऋतस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya soma radhase punano hardi chodaya |
ritasya yonimasadam ||
verses.en:
Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart,
To sit in place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
मृजन्ति त्वा दश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः ।
अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
mrijanti tva dasha kshipo hinvanti sapta dhitayah |
anu vipra amadishuh ||
verses.en:
The ten swift fingers deck thee forth, seven ministers impel thee on:
The sages have rejoiced in thee.

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कं सृजानमति मेष्यः ।
सं गोभिर्वासयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
devebhyastva madaya kam srijanamati meshyah |
sam gobhirvasayamasi ||
verses.en:
When through the filter thou art poured, we clothe thee with a robe of milk
To be a gladdening draught for Gods.

verses.sa:
पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः ।
परि गव्यान्यव्यत ॥
verses.rom:
punanah kalasheshva vastranyarusho harih |
pari gavyanyavyata ||
verses.en:
When purified within the jars, Soma, bright red and golden-hued,
Hath clothed him with a robe of milk.

verses.sa:
मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः ।
इन्दो सखायमा विश ॥
verses.rom:
maghona a pavasva no jahi vishva apa dvishah |
indo sakhayama visha ||
verses.en:
Flow on to us and make us rich. Drive all our enemies away.
O Indu, flow into thy Friend.

verses.sa:
वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि ।
सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishtim divah pari srava dyumnam prithivya adhi |
saho nah soma pritsu dhah ||
verses.en:
Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us,
O Soma, victory in war.

verses.sa:
नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतं स्वर्विदम् ।
भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
nrichakshasam tva vayamindrapitam svarvidam |
bhakshimahi prajamisham ||
verses.en:
May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light,
Gain thee, and progeny and food.

verses.sa:
परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयांसि नप्त्योर्हितः ।
सुवानो याति कविक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
pari priya divah kavirvayamsi naptyorhitah |
suvano yati kavikratuh ||
verses.en:
THE Sage of Heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands and pressed,
Sends us delightful powers of life.

verses.sa:
प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहे ।
वीत्यर्ष चनिष्ठया ॥
verses.rom:
prapra kshayaya panyase janaya jushto adruhe |
vityarsha chanishthaya ||
verses.en:
On, onward to a glorious home; dear to the people void of guile,
With excellent enjoyment, flow.

verses.sa:
स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् ।
महान्मही ऋतावृधा ॥
verses.rom:
sa sunurmatara shuchirjato jate arochayat |
mahanmahi ritavridha ||
verses.en:
He, the bright Son, when born illumed his Parents who had sprung to life,
Great Son great Strengtheners of Law.

verses.sa:
स सप्त धीतिभिर्हितो नद्यो अजिन्वदद्रुहः ।
या एकमक्षि वावृधुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa sapta dhitibhirhito nadyo ajinvadadruhah |
ya ekamakshi vavridhuh ||
verses.en:
Urged by the seven devotions he hath stirred the guileless rivers which
Have magnified the Single Eye.

verses.sa:
ता अभि सन्तमस्तृतं महे युवानमा दधुः ।
इन्दुमिन्द्र तव व्रते ॥
verses.rom:
ta abhi santamastritam mahe yuvanama dadhuh |
indumindra tava vrate ||
verses.en:
These helped to might the Youthful One, high over all, invincible,
Even Indu, Indra! in thy law.

verses.sa:
अभि वह्निरमर्त्यः सप्त पश्यति वावहिः ।
क्रिविर्देवीरतर्पयत् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vahniramartyah sapta pashyati vavahih |
krivirdeviratarpayat ||
verses.en:
The immortal Courser, good to draw, looks down upon the Seven: the fount
Hath satisfied the Goddesses

verses.sa:
अवा कल्पेषु नः पुमस्तमांसि सोम योध्या ।
तानि पुनान जङ्घनः ॥
verses.rom:
ava kalpeshu nah pumastamamsi soma yodhya |
tani punana janghanah ||
verses.en:
Aid us in holy rites, O Man: O Pavamana, drive away
Dark shades that must be met in fight.

verses.sa:
नू नव्यसे नवीयसे सूक्ताय साधया पथः ।
प्रत्नवद्रोचया रुचः ॥
verses.rom:
nu navyase naviyase suktaya sadhaya pathah |
pratnavadrochaya ruchah ||
verses.en:
Make the paths ready for a hymn newer and newer evermore:
Make the lights shine as erst they shone.

verses.sa:
पवमान महि श्रवो गामश्वं रासि वीरवत् ।
सना मेधां सना स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana mahi shravo gamashvam rasi viravat |
sana medham sana svah ||
verses.en:
Give, Pavamana, high renown, give kine and steeds and hero sons:
Win for us wisdom, win the light.

verses.sa:
प्र स्वानासो रथा इवार्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः ।
सोमासो राये अक्रमुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra svanaso ratha ivarvanto na shravasyavah |
somaso raye akramuh ||
verses.en:
LIKE cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown,
Have Soma-drops flowed forth for wealth.

verses.sa:
हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ।
भरासः कारिणामिव ॥
verses.rom:
hinvanaso ratha iva dadhanvire gabhastyoh |
bharasah karinamiva ||
verses.en:
Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed,
Like joyful songs of singing-men.

verses.sa:
राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरञ्जते ।
यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः ॥
verses.rom:
rajano na prashastibhih somaso gobhiranjate |
yajno na sapta dhatribhih ||
verses.en:
The Somas deck themselves with milk, as Kings are graced with eulogies,
And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
परि सुवानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा ।
सुता अर्षन्ति धारया ॥
verses.rom:
pari suvanasa indavo madaya barhana gira |
suta arshanti dharaya ||
verses.en:
Pressed for the gladdening draught, the drops flow forth abundantly with song,
The Soma juices in a stream.

verses.sa:
आपानासो विवस्वतो जनन्त उषसो भगम् ।
सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
apanaso vivasvato jananta ushaso bhagam |
sura anvam vi tanvate ||
verses.en:
Winning Vivasvan's glory and producing Morning's light, the Suns
Pass through the openings of the cloth.

verses.sa:
अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वन्ति कारवः ।
वृष्णो हरस आयवः ॥
verses.rom:
apa dvara matinam pratna rinvanti karavah |
vrishno harasa ayavah ||
verses.en:
The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs,-
Men, for the mighty to accept.

verses.sa:
समीचीनास आसते होतारः सप्तजामयः ।
पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः ॥
verses.rom:
samichinasa asate hotarah saptajamayah |
padamekasya pipratah ||
verses.en:
Combined in close society sit the seven priests, the brother-hood,
Filling the station of the One.

verses.sa:
नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुश्चित्सूर्ये सचा ।
कवेरपत्यमा दुहे ॥
verses.rom:
nabha nabhim na a dade chakshushchitsurye sacha |
kaverapatyama duhe ||
verses.en:
He gives us kinship with the Gods, and with the Sun unites our eye:
The Sage's offspring hath appeared.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितम् ।
सूरः पश्यति चक्षसा ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priya divaspadamadhvaryubhirguha hitam |
surah pashyati chakshasa ||
verses.en:
The Sun with his dear eye beholds that quarter of the heavens which priests
Have placed within the sacred cell.

verses.sa:
उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे ।
अभि देवाँ इयक्षते ॥
verses.rom:
upasmai gayata narah pavamanayendave |
abhi devan iyakshate ||
verses.en:
SING forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who is purified,
Fain to pay worship to the Gods.

verses.sa:
अभि ते मधुना पयोऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः ।
देवं देवाय देवयु ॥
verses.rom:
abhi te madhuna payo'tharvano ashishrayuh |
devam devaya devayu ||
verses.en:
Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled milk,
Divine, devoted to the God.

verses.sa:
स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शमर्वते ।
शं राजन्नोषधीभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah pavasva sham gave sham janaya shamarvate |
sham rajannoshadhibhyah ||
verses.en:
Bring, by thy flowing, weal to kine, weal to the people, weal to steeds.
Weal, O thou King, to growing plants

verses.sa:
बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे ।
सोमाय गाथमर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
babhrave nu svatavase'runaya divisprishe |
somaya gathamarchata ||
verses.en:
Sing a praise-song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might.
The Red, who reaches up to heaven.

verses.sa:
हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पुनीतन ।
मधावा धावता मधु ॥
verses.rom:
hastachyutebhiradribhih sutam somam punitana |
madhava dhavata madhu ||
verses.en:
Purify Soma when effused with stones which bands move rapidly,
And pour the sweet milk in the meath.

verses.sa:
नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन ।
इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन ॥
verses.rom:
namasedupa sidata dadhnedabhi shrinitana |
indumindre dadhatana ||
verses.en:
With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds:
To Indra offer Indu up.

verses.sa:
अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे ।
देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत् ॥
verses.rom:
amitraha vicharshanih pavasva soma sham gave |
devebhyo anukamakrit ||
verses.en:
Soma, foe-que chief o'er men, doing the will of pour forth
Prosperity upon our kine.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे ।
मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma patave madaya pari shichyase |
manashchinmanasaspatih ||
verses.en:
Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused,
O Soma, that Indra may drink thee and rejoice.

verses.sa:
पवमान सुवीर्यं रयिं सोम रिरीहि नः ।
इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana suviryam rayim soma ririhi nah |
indavindrena no yuja ||
verses.en:
O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength,-
Indu! with. Indra for ally.

verses.sa:
सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य सादने ।
इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः ॥
verses.rom:
soma asrigramindavah suta ritasya sadane |
indraya madhumattamah ||
verses.en:
To Indra have the Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, been poured,
Shed in the seat of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न मातरः ।
इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vipra anushata gavo vatsam na matarah |
indram somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
As mother kine low to their calves, to Indra have the sages called,
Called him to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् ।
सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
madachyutksheti sadane sindhorurma vipashchit |
somo gauri adhi shritah ||
verses.en:
In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his seat,
Resting upon a wiId-cow's hide.

verses.sa:
दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्यो वारे महीयते ।
सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः ॥
verses.rom:
divo nabha vichakshano'vyo vare mahiyate |
somo yah sukratuh kavih ||
verses.en:
Far-sighted Soma, Sage and Seer, is worshipped in the central point
Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.

verses.sa:
यः सोमः कलशेष्वाँ अन्तः पवित्र आहितः ।
तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे ॥
verses.rom:
yah somah kalasheshvan antah pavitra ahitah |
taminduh pari shasvaje ||
verses.en:
In close embraces Indu holds Soma when poured within the jars.
And on the. purifying sieve.

verses.sa:
प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि ।
जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vachamindurishyati samudrasyadhi vishtapi |
jinvankosham madhushchutam ||
verses.en:
Indu sends forth a voice on high to regions of the sea of air,
Shaking the vase that drops with meath.

verses.sa:
नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धीनामन्तः सबर्दुघः ।
हिन्वानो मानुषा युगा ॥
verses.rom:
nityastotro vanaspatirdhinamantah sabardughah |
hinvano manusha yuga ||
verses.en:
The Tree whose praises never fail yields heavenly milk among our hymns,
Urging men's generations on.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदा सोमो हिन्वानो अर्षति ।
विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priya divaspada somo hinvano arshati |
viprasya dharaya kavih ||
verses.en:
The Wise One, with the Sage's stream, the Soma urged to speed, flows on
To the dear places of the sky.

verses.sa:
आ पवमान धारय रयिं सहस्रवर्चसम् ।
अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
a pavamana dharaya rayim sahasravarchasam |
asme indo svabhuvam ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours. Yea.
O Indu, give us ready help.

verses.sa:
सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः ।
वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
somah punano arshati sahasradharo atyavih |
vayorindrasya nishkritam ||
verses.en:
PASSED through, the fleece in thousand streams the Soma, purified, flows on
To Indra's, Viyu's special place.

verses.sa:
पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत ।
सुष्वाणं देववीतये ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanamavasyavo vipramabhi pra gayata |
sushvanam devavitaye ||
verses.en:
Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage,
Effused to entertain the Gods.

verses.sa:
पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ।
गृणाना देववीतये ॥
verses.rom:
pavante vajasataye somah sahasrapajasah |
grinana devavitaye ||
verses.en:
The Soma-drops with thousand powers are purified for victory,
Hymned to become the feast of Gods.

verses.sa:
उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः ।
द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta no vajasataye pavasva brihatirishah |
dyumadindo suviryam ||
verses.en:
Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win the spoil
Indu, bring splendid manly might.

verses.sa:
ते नः सहस्रिणं रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् ।
सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
te nah sahasrinam rayim pavantama suviryam |
suvana devasa indavah ||
verses.en:
May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,-
These Godlike Soma-drops effused.

verses.sa:
अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये ।
वि वारमव्यमाशवः ॥
verses.rom:
atya hiyana na hetribhirasrigram vajasataye |
vi varamavyamashavah ||
verses.en:
Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, for victory,
Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवोऽभि वत्सं न धेनवः ।
दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.rom:
vashra arshantindavo'bhi vatsam na dhenavah |
dadhanvire gabhastyoh ||
verses.en:
Noisily flow the Soma-drops, like milch-kine lowing to their calves:
They have run forth from both the hands.

verses.sa:
जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् ।
विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
jushta indraya matsarah pavamana kanikradat |
vishva apa dvisho jahi ||
verses.en:
As Gladdener whom Indra loves, O Pavamana, with a roar
Drive all our enemies away.

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः ।
योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
verses.rom:
apaghnanto aravnah pavamanah svardrishah |
yonavritasya sidata ||
verses.en:
O Pavamamas, driving off the godless, looking on the light,
Sit in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
परि प्रासिष्यदत्कविः सिन्धोरूर्मावधि श्रितः ।
कारं बिभ्रत्पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
pari prasishyadatkavih sindhorurmavadhi shritah |
karam bibhratpuruspriham ||
verses.en:
REPOSING on the river's wave the Sage hath widely flowed around,
Bearing the hymn which many love.

verses.sa:
गिरा यदी सबन्धवः पञ्च व्राता अपस्यवः ।
परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिम् ॥
verses.rom:
gira yadi sabandhavah pancha vrata apasyavah |
parishkrinvanti dharnasim ||
verses.en:
When the Five kindred Companies, active in duty, with the song
Establish him, the Powerful,

verses.sa:
आदस्य शुष्मिणो रसे विश्वे देवा अमत्सत ।
यदी गोभिर्वसायते ॥
verses.rom:
adasya shushmino rase vishve deva amatsata |
yadi gobhirvasayate ||
verses.en:
Then in his juice whose strength is great, have all the Gods rejoiced themselves,
When he hath clothed him in the milk.

verses.sa:
निरिणानो वि धावति जहच्छर्याणि तान्वा ।
अत्रा सं जिघ्नते युजा ॥
verses.rom:
nirinano vi dhavati jahachchharyani tanva |
atra sam jighnate yuja ||
verses.en:
Freeing himself he flows away, leaving his body's severed limbs,
And meets his own Companion here.

verses.sa:
नप्तीभिर्यो विवस्वतः शुभ्रो न मामृजे युवा ।
गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजम् ॥
verses.rom:
naptibhiryo vivasvatah shubhro na mamrije yuva |
gah krinvano na nirnijam ||
verses.en:
He by the daughters of the priest, like a fair youth, hath been adorned,
Making the milk, as 'twere, his robe.

verses.sa:
अति श्रिती तिरश्चता गव्या जिगात्यण्व्या ।
वग्नुमियर्ति यं विदे ॥
verses.rom:
ati shriti tirashchata gavya jigatyanvya |
vagnumiyarti yam vide ||
verses.en:
O'er the fine fingers, through desire of milk, in winding course he goes,
And utters voice which he hath found.

verses.sa:
अभि क्षिपः समग्मत मर्जयन्तीरिषस्पतिम् ।
पृष्ठा गृभ्णत वाजिनः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi kshipah samagmata marjayantirishaspatim |
prishtha gribhnata vajinah ||
verses.en:
The nimble fingers have approached, adorning him the Lord of Strength:
They grasp the vigorous Courser's back.

verses.sa:
परि दिव्यानि मर्मृशद्विश्वानि सोम पार्थिवा ।
वसूनि याह्यस्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
pari divyani marmrishadvishvani soma parthiva |
vasuni yahyasmayuh ||
verses.en:
Comprising all the treasures that are in the heavens and on the earth,
Come, Soma, as our faithful Friend.

verses.sa:
एष धिया यात्यण्व्या शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः ।
गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha dhiya yatyanvya shuro rathebhirashubhih |
gachchhannindrasya nishkritam ||
verses.en:
THROUGH the fine fingers, with the song, this Hero comes with rapid ears,
Going to Indra's special place.

verses.sa:
एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये ।
यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
verses.rom:
esha puru dhiyayate brihate devatataye |
yatramritasa asate ||
verses.en:
In holy thought he ponders much for the great worship of the Gods.
Where the Immortals have their seat.

verses.sa:
एष हितो वि नीयतेऽन्तः शुभ्रावता पथा ।
यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
verses.rom:
esha hito vi niyate'ntah shubhravata patha |
yadi tunjanti bhurnayah ||
verses.en:
Like a good horse is he led out, when on the path that shines with light
The mettled steeds exert their strength.

verses.sa:
एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो वृषा ।
नृम्णा दधान ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
esha shringani dodhuvachchhishite yuthyo vrisha |
nrimna dadhana ojasa ||
verses.en:
He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them Bull who leads the herd,
Doing with might heroic deeds.

verses.sa:
एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजी शुभ्रेभिरंशुभिः ।
पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन् ॥
verses.rom:
esha rukmibhiriyate vaji shubhrebhiramshubhih |
patih sindhunam bhavan ||
verses.en:
He moves, a vigorous Steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold,
Becoming Sovran of the streams.

verses.sa:
एष वसूनि पिब्दना परुषा ययिवाँ अति ।
अव शादेषु गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vasuni pibdana parusha yayivan ati |
ava shadeshu gachchhati ||
verses.en:
He, over places rough to pass, bringing rich treasures closely packed.
Descends into the reservoirs.

verses.sa:
एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः ।
प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
etam mrijanti marjyamupa droneshvayavah |
prachakranam mahirishah ||
verses.en:
Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified,
Him who brings forth abundant food.

verses.sa:
एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सप्त धीतयः ।
स्वायुधं मदिन्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
etamu tyam dasha kshipo mrijanti sapta dhitayah |
svayudham madintamam ||
verses.en:
Him, even him, the fingers ten and the seven songs make beautiful,
Well-weaponed, best of gladdeners.

verses.sa:
प्र ते सोतार ओण्यो रसं मदाय घृष्वये ।
सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः ॥
verses.rom:
pra te sotara onyo rasam madaya ghrishvaye |
sargo na taktyetashah ||
verses.en:
THE pressers from the Soma-press send forth thy juice for rapturous joy
The speckled sap runs like a flood.

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा दक्षस्य रथ्यमपो वसानमन्धसा ।
गोषामण्वेषु सश्चिम ॥
verses.rom:
kratva dakshasya rathyamapo vasanamandhasa |
goshamanveshu sashchima ||
verses.en:
With strength we follow through the sieve him who brings might and wins the kine,
Enrobed in water with his juice.

verses.sa:
अनप्तमप्सु दुष्टरं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज ।
पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
verses.rom:
anaptamapsu dushtaram somam pavitra a srija |
punihindraya patave ||
verses.en:
Pour on the sieve the Soma, ne'er subdued in waters, waterless,
And make it pure for Indra's drink.

verses.sa:
प्र पुनानस्य चेतसा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति ।
क्रत्वा सधस्थमासदत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra punanasya chetasa somah pavitre arshati |
kratva sadhasthamasadat ||
verses.en:
Moved by the purifier's thought, the Soma flows into the sieve:
By wisdom it hath gained its home.

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा नमोभिरिन्दव इन्द्र सोमा असृक्षत ।
महे भराय कारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
pra tva namobhirindava indra soma asrikshata |
mahe bharaya karinah ||
verses.en:
With humble homage, Indra, have the Soma-drops flowed forth to thee,
Contending for the glorious prize.

verses.sa:
पुनानो रूपे अव्यये विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः ।
शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
verses.rom:
punano rupe avyaye vishva arshannabhi shriyah |
shuro na goshu tishthati ||
verses.en:
Purified in his fleecy garb, attaining every beauty, he
Stands, hero-like, amid the kine.

verses.sa:
दिवो न सानु पिप्युषी धारा सुतस्य वेधसः ।
वृथा पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
divo na sanu pipyushi dhara sutasya vedhasah |
vritha pavitre arshati ||
verses.en:
Swelling, as 'twere, to heights of heaven, the stream of the creative juice
Falls lightly on the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम विपश्चितं तना पुनान आयुषु ।
अव्यो वारं वि धावसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma vipashchitam tana punana ayushu |
avyo varam vi dhavasi ||
verses.en:
Thus, Soma, purifying him who knoweth song mid living men,
Thou wanderest through the cloth of wool.

verses.sa:
प्र निम्नेनेव सिन्धवो घ्नन्तो वृत्राणि भूर्णयः ।
सोमा असृग्रमाशवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra nimneneva sindhavo ghnanto vritrani bhurnayah |
soma asrigramashavah ||
verses.en:
LIKE rivers down a steep descent, slaying the Vrtras, full of zeal,
The rapid Soma-streams have flowed.

verses.sa:
अभि सुवानास इन्दवो वृष्टयः पृथिवीमिव ।
इन्द्रं सोमासो अक्षरन् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi suvanasa indavo vrishtayah prithivimiva |
indram somaso aksharan ||
verses.en:
The drops of Soma juice effused fall like the rain upon the earth:
To Indra flow the Soma-streams.

verses.sa:
अत्यूर्मिर्मत्सरो मदः सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति ।
विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
verses.rom:
atyurmirmatsaro madah somah pavitre arshati |
vighnanrakshamsi devayuh ||
verses.en:
With swelling wave the gladdening drink, the Soma, flows into the sieve,
Loving the Gods and slaying fiends.

verses.sa:
आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परि षिच्यते ।
उक्थैर्यज्ञेषु वर्धते ॥
verses.rom:
a kalasheshu dhavati pavitre pari shichyate |
ukthairyajneshu vardhate ||
verses.en:
It hastens to the pitchers, poured upon the sieve it waxes strong
At sacrifices through the lauds.

verses.sa:
अति त्री सोम रोचना रोहन्न भ्राजसे दिवम् ।
इष्णन्सूर्यं न चोदयः ॥
verses.rom:
ati tri soma rochana rohanna bhrajase divam |
ishnansuryam na chodayah ||
verses.en:
Soma, thou shinest mounting heaven as 'twere above light's triple realm,
And moving secm'st to speed the Sun.

verses.sa:
अभि विप्रा अनूषत मूर्धन्यज्ञस्य कारवः ।
दधानाश्चक्षसि प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vipra anushata murdhanyajnasya karavah |
dadhanashchakshasi priyam ||
verses.en:
To him, the head of sacrifice, singers and bards have sung their songs,
Offering what he loves to see.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा वाजिनं नरो धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः ।
मृजन्ति देवतातये ॥
verses.rom:
tamu tva vajinam naro dhibhirvipra avasyavah |
mrijanti devatataye ||
verses.en:
The men, the sages with their hymns, eager for help, deck thee strong steed,
Deck thee for service of the Gods.

verses.sa:
मधोर्धारामनु क्षर तीव्रः सधस्थमासदः ।
चारुरृताय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
madhordharamanu kshara tivrah sadhasthamasadah |
charurritaya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Flow onward to the stream of meath rest efficacious in thy home,
Fair, to be drunk at sacrifice.

verses.sa:
परि सुवानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षाः ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
pari suvano girishthah pavitre somo akshah |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en:
THOU, Soma, dweller on the hills, effused, hast flowed into the sieve,:
All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमन्धसः ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam viprastvam kavirmadhu pra jatamandhasah |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en:
Thou art a sacred Bard, a Sage; the meath is offspring of thy sap:
All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
तव विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
tava vishve sajoshaso devasah pitimashata |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en:
All Deities of one accord have come that they may drink of thee:
All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
आ यो विश्वानि वार्या वसूनि हस्तयोर्दधे ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
a yo vishvani varya vasuni hastayordadhe |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en:
He who containeth in his hands all treasures much to be desired:
All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
य इमे रोदसी मही सं मातरेव दोहते ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
ya ime rodasi mahi sam matareva dohate |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en:
Who milketh out this mighty Pair, the Earth and Heaven, like mother kine
All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
परि यो रोदसी उभे सद्यो वाजेभिरर्षति ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
pari yo rodasi ubhe sadyo vajebhirarshati |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en:
Who in a moment mightily floweth around these two world-halves:
All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
स शुष्मी कलशेष्वा पुनानो अचिक्रदत् ।
मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
sa shushmi kalasheshva punano achikradat |
madeshu sarvadha asi ||
verses.en:
The Strong One, being purified, hath in the pitchers cried aloud:
All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa:
यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु ।
तन्नः पुनान आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
yatsoma chitramukthyam divyam parthivam vasu |
tannah punana a bhara ||
verses.en:
O SOMA, being purified bring us the wondrous treasure, meet
For lauds, that is in earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
युवं हि स्थः स्वर्पती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती ।
ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam hi sthah svarpati indrashcha soma gopati |
ishana pipyatam dhiyah ||
verses.en:
For ye Twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of the light, Lords of the kine:
Great Rulers, prosper ye our songs.

verses.sa:
वृषा पुनान आयुषु स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि ।
हरिः सन्योनिमासदत् ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha punana ayushu stanayannadhi barhishi |
harih sanyonimasadat ||
verses.en:
The tawny Steer, while cleansed among the living, bellowing on the grass,
Hath sunk and settled in his home.

verses.sa:
अवावशन्त धीतयो वृषभस्याधि रेतसि ।
सूनोर्वत्सस्य मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
avavashanta dhitayo vrishabhasyadhi retasi |
sunorvatsasya matarah ||
verses.en:
Over the Steer's productive flow the sacred songs were resonant,
The mothers of the darling Son.

verses.sa:
कुविद्वृषण्यन्तीभ्यः पुनानो गर्भमादधत् ।
याः शुक्रं दुहते पयः ॥
verses.rom:
kuvidvrishanyantibhyah punano garbhamadadhat |
yah shukram duhate payah ||
verses.en:
Hath he not, purified, impregned the kine who long to meet their Lord,
The kine who yield the shining milk?

verses.sa:
उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रुषु ।
पवमान विदा रयिम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa shikshapatasthusho bhiyasama dhehi shatrushu |
pavamana vida rayim ||
verses.en:
Bring near us those who stand aloof strike fear into our enemies:
O Pavamana, find us wealth.

verses.sa:
नि शत्रोः सोम वृष्ण्यं नि शुष्मं नि वयस्तिर ।
दूरे वा सतो अन्ति वा ॥
verses.rom:
ni shatroh soma vrishnyam ni shushmam ni vayastira |
dure va sato anti va ||
verses.en:
Soma, bring down the foeman's might, his vigorous strength and vital powe'r,
Whether he be afar or near.

verses.sa:
प्र कविर्देववीतयेऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति ।
साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः ॥
verses.rom:
pra kavirdevavitaye'vyo varebhirarshati |
sahvanvishva abhi spridhah ||
verses.en:
FORTH through the straining-cloth the Sage flows to the banquet of the Gods,
Subduing all our enemies.

verses.sa:
स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति ।
पवमानः सहस्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi shma jaritribhya a vajam gomantaminvati |
pavamanah sahasrinam ||
verses.en:
For he, as Pavamana, sends thousand fold treasure in the shape
Of cattle to the singing-men.

verses.sa:
परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृशसे पवसे मती ।
स नः सोम श्रवो विदः ॥
verses.rom:
pari vishvani chetasa mrishase pavase mati |
sa nah soma shravo vidah ||
verses.en:
Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts
As such, O Soma, find us fame.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं रयिम् ।
इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarsha brihadyasho maghavadbhyo dhruvam rayim |
isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
Pour lofty glory on us, send sure riches to our liberal lords,
Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
त्वं राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमा विवेशिथ ।
पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत ॥
verses.rom:
tvam rajeva suvrato girah soma viveshitha |
punano vahne adbhuta ||
verses.en:
As thou art cleansed, O Wondrous Steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like
A pious King, into the songs.

verses.sa:
स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः ।
सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ॥
verses.rom:
sa vahnirapsu dushtaro mrijyamano gabhastyoh |
somashchamushu sidati ||
verses.en:
He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made clean
With hands, is resting in the jars.

verses.sa:
क्रीळुर्मखो न मंहयुः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि ।
दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
krilurmakho na mamhayuh pavitram soma gachchhasi |
dadhatstotre suviryam ||
verses.en:
Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest, Soma, to the sieve,
Lending the laud a Hero's strength.

verses.sa:
एते धावन्तीन्दवः सोमा इन्द्राय घृष्वयः ।
मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
ete dhavantindavah soma indraya ghrishvayah |
matsarasah svarvidah ||
verses.en:
To Indra flow these running drops, these Somas frolicsome in mood.
Exhilarating, finding light;

verses.sa:
प्रवृण्वन्तो अभियुजः सुष्वये वरिवोविदः ।
स्वयं स्तोत्रे वयस्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
pravrinvanto abhiyujah sushvaye varivovidah |
svayam stotre vayaskritah ||
verses.en:
Driving off foes, bestowing room upon the presser, willingly
Bringing their praiser vital force.

verses.sa:
वृथा क्रीळन्त इन्दवः सधस्थमभ्येकमित् ।
सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरन् ॥
verses.rom:
vritha krilanta indavah sadhasthamabhyekamit |
sindhorurma vyaksharan ||
verses.en:
Lightly disporting them, the drops flow to one common reservoir,
And fall into the river's wave.

verses.sa:
एते विश्वानि वार्या पवमानास आशत ।
हिता न सप्तयो रथे ॥
verses.rom:
ete vishvani varya pavamanasa ashata |
hita na saptayo rathe ||
verses.en:
These Pavamanas have obtained all blessings much to be desired,
Like coursers harnessed to a car.

verses.sa:
आस्मिन्पिशङ्गमिन्दवो दधाता वेनमादिशे ।
यो अस्मभ्यमरावा ॥
verses.rom:
asminpishangamindavo dadhata venamadishe |
yo asmabhyamarava ||
verses.en:
With view to us, O Soma-drops, bestow his manifold desire
On him who yet hath given us naught.

verses.sa:
ऋभुर्न रथ्यं नवं दधाता केतमादिशे ।
शुक्राः पवध्वमर्णसा ॥
verses.rom:
ribhurna rathyam navam dadhata ketamadishe |
shukrah pavadhvamarnasa ||
verses.en:
Bring us our wish with this design, as a wright brings his new-wrought wheel:
Flow pure and shining with the stream.

verses.sa:
एत उ त्ये अवीवशन्काष्ठां वाजिनो अक्रत ।
सतः प्रासाविषुर्मतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
eta u tye avivashankashtham vajino akrata |
satah prasavishurmatim ||
verses.en:
These drops have cried with resonant voice: like swift steeds they have run the course,
And roused the good man's hymn to life.

verses.sa:
एते सोमास आशवो रथा इव प्र वाजिनः ।
सर्गाः सृष्टा अहेषत ॥
verses.rom:
ete somasa ashavo ratha iva pra vajinah |
sargah srishta aheshata ||
verses.en:
THESE rapid Soma-streams have stirred themselves to motion like strong steeds,
Like cars, like armies hurried forth.

verses.sa:
एते वाता इवोरवः पर्जन्यस्येव वृष्टयः ।
अग्नेरिव भ्रमा वृथा ॥
verses.rom:
ete vata ivoravah parjanyasyeva vrishtayah |
agneriva bhrama vritha ||
verses.en:
Swift as wide winds they lightly move, like rain-storms of Parjanya, like
The flickering flames of burning fire.

verses.sa:
एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।
विपा व्यानशुर्धियः ॥
verses.rom:
ete puta vipashchitah somaso dadhyashirah |
vipa vyanashurdhiyah ||
verses.en:
These Soma juices, blent with curds, purified, skilled in sacred hymns,
Have gained by song their hearts' desire.

verses.sa:
एते मृष्टा अमर्त्याः ससृवांसो न शश्रमुः ।
इयक्षन्तः पथो रजः ॥
verses.rom:
ete mrishta amartyah sasrivamso na shashramuh |
iyakshantah patho rajah ||
verses.en:
Immortal, cleansed, these drops, since first they flowed, have never wearied, fain
To reach the regions and their paths.

verses.sa:
एते पृष्ठानि रोदसोर्विप्रयन्तो व्यानशुः ।
उतेदमुत्तमं रजः ॥
verses.rom:
ete prishthani rodasorviprayanto vyanashuh |
utedamuttamam rajah ||
verses.en:
Advancing they have travelled o'er the ridges of the earth and heaven,
And this the highest realm of all.

verses.sa:
तन्तुं तन्वानमुत्तममनु प्रवत आशत ।
उतेदमुत्तमाय्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tantum tanvanamuttamamanu pravata ashata |
utedamuttamayyam ||
verses.en:
Over the heights have they attained the highest thread that is spun out,
And this which must be deemed most high.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम पणिभ्य आ वसु गव्यानि धारयः ।
ततं तन्तुमचिक्रदः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma panibhya a vasu gavyani dharayah |
tatam tantumachikradah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Soma, boldest wealth in kine which thou hast seized from niggard churls:
Thou calledst forth the out spun thread.

verses.sa:
सोमा असृग्रमाशवो मधोर्मदस्य धारया ।
अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
verses.rom:
soma asrigramashavo madhormadasya dharaya |
abhi vishvani kavya ||
verses.en:
SWIFT Soma drops have been effused in streams of meath, the gladdening drink,
For sacred lore of every kind.

verses.sa:
अनु प्रत्नास आयवः पदं नवीयो अक्रमुः ।
रुचे जनन्त सूर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
anu pratnasa ayavah padam naviyo akramuh |
ruche jananta suryam ||
verses.en:
Hither to newer. resting-place the ancient Living Ones are come.
They made the Sun that he might shine.

verses.sa:
आ पवमान नो भरार्यो अदाशुषो गयम् ।
कृधि प्रजावतीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
a pavamana no bhararyo adashusho gayam |
kridhi prajavatirishah ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, bring to us the unsacrificing foeman's wealth,
And give us food with progeny.

verses.sa:
अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् ।
अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi somasa ayavah pavante madyam madam |
abhi kosham madhushchutam ||
verses.en:
The living Somas being cleansed diffuse exhilarating drink,
Turned to the vat which drips with meath.

verses.sa:
सोमो अर्षति धर्णसिर्दधान इन्द्रियं रसम् ।
सुवीरो अभिशस्तिपाः ॥
verses.rom:
somo arshati dharnasirdadhana indriyam rasam |
suviro abhishastipah ||
verses.en:
Soma grows on intelligent, possessing sap and mighty strength,
Brave Hero who repels the curse.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम पवसे देवेभ्यः सधमाद्यः ।
इन्दो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma pavase devebhyah sadhamadyah |
indo vajam sishasasi ||
verses.en:
For Indra, Soma! thou art cleansed, a feast-companion for the Gods:
Indu, thou fain wilt win us strength

verses.sa:
अस्य पीत्वा मदानामिन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रति ।
जघान जघनच्च नु ॥
verses.rom:
asya pitva madanamindro vritranyaprati |
jaghana jaghanachcha nu ||
verses.en:
When he had drunken draughts of this, Indra smote down resistless foes:
Yea, smote them, and shall smite them still.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः ।
श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत ॥
verses.rom:
pra somaso adhanvishuh pavamanasa indavah |
shrinana apsu mrinjata ||
verses.en:
HITHERWARD have the Soma streamed, the drops while they are purified:
When blent, in waters they are rinsed.

verses.sa:
अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः ।
पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gavo adhanvishurapo na pravata yatih |
punana indramashata ||
verses.en:
The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice:
They come to Indra, being cleansed.

verses.sa:
प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय पातवे ।
नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ॥
verses.rom:
pra pavamana dhanvasi somendraya patave |
nribhiryato vi niyase ||
verses.en:
O Soma Pavamana, thou art flowing to be Indra's drink:
The men have seized and lead thee forth.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीसहे ।
सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma nrimadanah pavasva charshanisahe |
sasniryo anumadyah ||
verses.en:
Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow, delighting men,
To him who ruleth o'er mankind.

verses.sa:
इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिधावसि ।
अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
verses.rom:
indo yadadribhih sutah pavitram paridhavasi |
aramindrasya dhamne ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indu, when, effused by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art,
Ready for Indra's high decree.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वृत्रहन्तमोक्थेभिरनुमाद्यः ।
शुचिः पावको अद्भुतः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vritrahantamokthebhiranumadyah |
shuchih pavako adbhutah ||
verses.en:
Flow on, best Vrtra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds.
Pure, purifying, wonderful.

verses.sa:
शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतस्य मध्वः ।
देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.rom:
shuchih pavaka uchyate somah sutasya madhvah |
devaviraghashamsaha ||
verses.en:
Pure, purifying is he called the Soma of the meath effused,
Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

verses.sa:
पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे ।
मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva dakshasadhano devebhyah pitaye hare |
marudbhyo vayave madah ||
verses.en:
GREEN-HUED! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught
For Vayu and the Marut host.

verses.sa:
पवमान धिया हितोऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ।
धर्मणा वायुमा विश ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana dhiya hito'bhi yonim kanikradat |
dharmana vayuma visha ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, sent by song, roaring about thy dwelling-place,
Pass into Vayu as Law bids.

verses.sa:
सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः ।
वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
verses.rom:
sam devaih shobhate vrisha kaviryonavadhi priyah |
vritraha devavitamah ||
verses.en:
The Steer shines with the Deities, dear Sage in his appointed home,
Foe-Slayer, most beloved by Gods.

verses.sa:
विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन्पुनानो याति हर्यतः ।
यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
verses.rom:
vishva rupanyavishanpunano yati haryatah |
yatramritasa asate ||
verses.en:
Taking each beauteous form, he goes, desirable, while purified,
Thither where the Immortals sit.

verses.sa:
अरुषो जनयन्गिरः सोमः पवत आयुषक् ।
इन्द्रं गच्छन्कविक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
arusho janayangirah somah pavata ayushak |
indram gachchhankavikratuh ||
verses.en:
To Indra Soma flows, the Red, engendering song, exceeding wise,
The visitor of living men.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे ।
अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva madintama pavitram dharaya kave |
arkasya yonimasadam ||
verses.en:
Flow, best exhilarator, Sage, flow to the filter in a stream
To seat thee in the place of song.

verses.sa:
तममृक्षन्त वाजिनमुपस्थे अदितेरधि ।
विप्रासो अण्व्या धिया ॥
verses.rom:
tamamrikshanta vajinamupasthe aditeradhi |
vipraso anvya dhiya ||
verses.en:
THE sages with the fingers' art have dressed and decked that vigorous Steed
Upon the lap of Aditi,

verses.sa:
तं गावो अभ्यनूषत सहस्रधारमक्षितम् ।
इन्दुं धर्तारमा दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
tam gavo abhyanushata sahasradharamakshitam |
indum dhartarama divah ||
verses.en:
The kine have called aloud to him exhaustless with a thousand streams,
To Indu who supporteth heaven.

verses.sa:
तं वेधां मेधयाह्यन्पवमानमधि द्यवि ।
धर्णसिं भूरिधायसम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam vedham medhayahyanpavamanamadhi dyavi |
dharnasim bhuridhayasam ||
verses.en:
Him, nourisher of many, Sage, creative Pavamana, they
Have sent, by wisdom, to the sky.

verses.sa:
तमह्यन्भुरिजोर्धिया संवसानं विवस्वतः ।
पतिं वाचो अदाभ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamahyanbhurijordhiya samvasanam vivasvatah |
patim vacho adabhyam ||
verses.en:
Him, dweller with Vivasvan, they with use of both arms have sent forth,
The Lord of Speech infallible.

verses.sa:
तं सानावधि जामयो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
हर्यतं भूरिचक्षसम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam sanavadhi jamayo harim hinvantyadribhih |
haryatam bhurichakshasam ||
verses.en:
Him, green, beloved, many eyed, the Sisters with prosing stones
Send down to ridges of the sieve.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा हिन्वन्ति वेधसः पवमान गिरावृधम् ।
इन्दविन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva hinvanti vedhasah pavamana giravridham |
indavindraya matsaram ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, Indu, priests hurry thee on to Indra, thee
Who aidest song and cheerest him.

verses.sa:
एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते ।
पुनानो घ्नन्नप स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
esha kavirabhishtutah pavitre adhi toshate |
punano ghnannapa sridhah ||
verses.en:
THIS Sage, exalted by our lauds, flows to the purifying cloth,
Scattering foes as he is cleansed.

verses.sa:
एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते ।
पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः ॥
verses.rom:
esha indraya vayave svarjitpari shichyate |
pavitre dakshasadhanah ||
verses.en:
As giving power and winning light, for Indra and for Vayu he
Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.

verses.sa:
एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः ।
सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित् ॥
verses.rom:
esha nribhirvi niyate divo murdha vrisha sutah |
somo vaneshu vishvavit ||
verses.en:
The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, Omniscient, and the Head of Heaven,
Effused into the vats of wood.

verses.sa:
एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः ।
इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः ॥
verses.rom:
esha gavyurachikradatpavamano hiranyayuh |
induh satrajidastritah ||
verses.en:
Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana lowed,
Still Conqueror, never overcome.

verses.sa:
एष सूर्येण हासते पवमानो अधि द्यवि ।
पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः ॥
verses.rom:
esha suryena hasate pavamano adhi dyavi |
pavitre matsaro madah ||
verses.en:
This Pavamana, gladdening draught, drops on the filtering cloth, and then
Mounts up with Surya to the sky.

verses.sa:
एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः ।
पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥
verses.rom:
esha shushmyasishyadadantarikshe vrisha harih |
punana indurindrama ||
verses.en:
To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed,
This Indu, being purified.

verses.sa:
एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः ।
अव्यो वारं वि धावति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vaji hito nribhirvishvavinmanasaspatih |
avyo varam vi dhavati ||
verses.en:
URGED by the men, this vigorous Steed, Lord of the mind, Omniscient,
Runs to the woolen straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।
विश्वा धामान्याविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
esha pavitre aksharatsomo devebhyah sutah |
vishva dhamanyavishan ||
verses.en:
Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused,
Entering all their essences.

verses.sa:
एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः ।
वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
verses.rom:
esha devah shubhayate'dhi yonavamartyah |
vritraha devavitamah ||
verses.en:
He shines in beauty there, this God Immortal in his dwelling-place,
Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.

verses.sa:
एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः ।
अभि द्रोणानि धावति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vrisha kanikradaddashabhirjamibhiryatah |
abhi dronani dhavati ||
verses.en:
Directed by the Sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer
Runs onward to the wooden vats.

verses.sa:
एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो विचर्षणिः ।
विश्वा धामानि विश्ववित् ॥
verses.rom:
esha suryamarochayatpavamano vicharshanih |
vishva dhamani vishvavit ||
verses.en:
This Pavamana, swift and strong, Omniscient, gave splendour to
The Sun and all his forms of light.

verses.sa:
एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ।
देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.rom:
esha shushmyadabhyah somah punano arshati |
devaviraghashamsaha ||
verses.en:
This Soma being purified, flows mighty and infallible,
Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

verses.sa:
प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा ।
देवाँ अनु प्रभूषतः ॥
verses.rom:
prasya dhara aksharanvrishnah sutasyaujasa |
devan anu prabhushatah ||
verses.en:
FORWARD with mighty force have flowed the currents of this Steer effused,
Of him who sets him by the Gods.

verses.sa:
सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा ।
ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
saptim mrijanti vedhaso grinantah karavo gira |
jyotirjajnanamukthyam ||
verses.en:
The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the Steed,
Brought forth as light that merits laud.

verses.sa:
सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो ।
वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sushaha soma tani te punanaya prabhuvaso |
vardha samudramukthyam ||
verses.en:
These things thou winnest lightly while purified, Soma, Lord of wealth:
Fill full the sea that claims our praise.

verses.sa:
विश्वा वसूनि संजयन्पवस्व सोम धारया ।
इनु द्वेषांसि सध्र्यक् ॥
verses.rom:
vishva vasuni samjayanpavasva soma dharaya |
inu dveshamsi sadhryak ||
verses.en:
Winning all precious things at once, flow on, O Soma, with thy stream
Drive to one place our enemies.

verses.sa:
रक्षा सु नो अररुषः स्वनात्समस्य कस्य चित् ।
निदो यत्र मुमुच्महे ॥
verses.rom:
raksha su no ararushah svanatsamasya kasya chit |
nido yatra mumuchmahe ||
verses.en:
Preserve us from the godless, from ill-omened voice of one and all,
That so we may be freed from blame.

verses.sa:
एन्दो पार्थिवं रयिं दिव्यं पवस्व धारया ।
द्युमन्तं शुष्ममा भर ॥
verses.rom:
endo parthivam rayim divyam pavasva dharaya |
dyumantam shushmama bhara ||
verses.en:
O Indu, as thou flowest on bring us the wealth of earth and heaven,
And splendid vigour, in thy stream.

verses.sa:
प्र धारा अस्य शुष्मिणो वृथा पवित्रे अक्षरन् ।
पुनानो वाचमिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
pra dhara asya shushmino vritha pavitre aksharan |
punano vachamishyati ||
verses.en:
STREAMS of this Potent One have flowed easily to the straining-cloth:
While he is cleansed he lifts his voice.

verses.sa:
इन्दुर्हियानः सोतृभिर्मृज्यमानः कनिक्रदत् ।
इयर्ति वग्नुमिन्द्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
indurhiyanah sotribhirmrijyamanah kanikradat |
iyarti vagnumindriyam ||
verses.en:
Indu, by pressers urged to speed, bellowing out while beautified.
Sends forth a very mighty sound.

verses.sa:
आ नः शुष्मं नृषाह्यं वीरवन्तं पुरुस्पृहम् ।
पवस्व सोम धारया ॥
verses.rom:
a nah shushmam nrishahyam viravantam puruspriham |
pavasva soma dharaya ||
verses.en:
Pour on us, Soma, with thy stream man conquering might which many crave,
Accompanied with hero sons.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमो अति धारया पवमानो असिष्यदत् ।
अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra somo ati dharaya pavamano asishyadat |
abhi dronanyasadam ||
verses.en:
Hither hath Pavamana flowed, Soma flowed hither in a stream,
To settle in the vats of wood.

verses.sa:
अप्सु त्वा मधुमत्तमं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
apsu tva madhumattamam harim hinvantyadribhih |
indavindraya pitaye ||
verses.en:
To waters with the stones they drive thee tawny-hued, most rich in sweets,
O Indu, to be Indra's drink.

verses.sa:
सुनोता मधुमत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
चारुं शर्धाय मत्सरम् ॥
verses.rom:
sunota madhumattamam somamindraya vajrine |
charum shardhaya matsaram ||
verses.en:
For Indra, for the Thunderer press the Soma very rich in sweets,
Lovely, inspiriting, for strength.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमासः स्वाध्यः पवमानासो अक्रमुः ।
रयिं कृण्वन्ति चेतनम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra somasah svadhyah pavamanaso akramuh |
rayim krinvanti chetanam ||
verses.en:
THE, Soma-drops, benevolent, come forth as they are purified,
Bestowing wealth which all may see.

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्या अधि भवेन्दो द्युम्नवर्धनः ।
भवा वाजानां पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
divasprithivya adhi bhavendo dyumnavardhanah |
bhava vajanam patih ||
verses.en:
O Indu, high o'er heaven and earth be thou, increaser of our might:
The Master of all strength be thou.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं वाता अभिप्रियस्तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः ।
सोम वर्धन्ति ते महः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam vata abhipriyastubhyamarshanti sindhavah |
soma vardhanti te mahah ||
verses.en:
The winds are gracious in their love to thee, the rivers flow to thee
Soma, they multiply thy power.

verses.sa:
आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् ।
भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
verses.rom:
a pyayasva sametu te vishvatah soma vrishnyam |
bhava vajasya samgathe ||
verses.en:
Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee:
Be in the gathering-Place of strength.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं गावो घृतं पयो बभ्रो दुदुह्रे अक्षितम् ।
वर्षिष्ठे अधि सानवि ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam gavo ghritam payo babhro duduhre akshitam |
varshishthe adhi sanavi ||
verses.en:
For thee, brown-hued! the kine have poured imperishable oil and milk.
Aloft on the sublimest height.

verses.sa:
स्वायुधस्य ते सतो भुवनस्य पते वयम् ।
इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
svayudhasya te sato bhuvanasya pate vayam |
indo sakhitvamushmasi ||
verses.en:
Friendship, O Indu, we desire with thee who bearest noble arms,
With thee, O Lord of all that is.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनः ।
सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra somaso madachyutah shravase no maghonah |
suta vidathe akramuh ||
verses.en:
THE rapture-shedding Soma-drops, effused in our assembly, have
Flowed forth to glorify our prince.

verses.sa:
आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
adim tritasya yoshano harim hinvantyadribhih |
indumindraya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Then Trita's Maidens onward urge the Tawny-coloured with the stones,
Indu for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa:
आदीं हंसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिम् ।
अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते ॥
verses.rom:
adim hamso yatha ganam vishvasyavivashanmatim |
atyo na gobhirajyate ||
verses.en:
Now like a swan he maketh all the company sing each his hymn:
He, like a steed, is bathed in milk.

verses.sa:
उभे सोमावचाकशन्मृगो न तक्तो अर्षसि ।
सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe somavachakashanmrigo na takto arshasi |
sidannritasya yonima ||
verses.en:
O Soma, viewing heaven and earth, thou runnest like a darting deer
Set in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अभि गावो अनूषत योषा जारमिव प्रियम् ।
अगन्नाजिं यथा हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gavo anushata yosha jaramiva priyam |
agannajim yatha hitam ||
verses.en:
The cows have sung with joy to him, even as a woman to her love
He came as to a settled race.

verses.sa:
अस्मे धेहि द्युमद्यशो मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च ।
सनिं मेधामुत श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
asme dhehi dyumadyasho maghavadbhyashcha mahyam cha |
sanim medhamuta shravah ||
verses.en:
Bestow illustrious fame on us, both on our liberal lords and me,
Glory, intelligence, and wealth.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपां न यन्त्यूर्मयः ।
वनानि महिषा इव ॥
verses.rom:
pra somaso vipashchito'pam na yantyurmayah |
vanani mahisha iva ||
verses.en:
LIKE waves of waters, skilled in song the juices of the Soma speed
Onward, as buffaloes to woods.

verses.sa:
अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया ।
वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi dronani babhravah shukra ritasya dharaya |
vajam gomantamaksharan ||
verses.en:
With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store
Of kine into the wooden vats.

verses.sa:
सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।
सोमा अर्षन्ति विष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
suta indraya vayave varunaya marudbhyah |
soma arshanti vishnave ||
verses.en:
To Indra, Vayu, Varuna, to Visnu, and the Maruts, flow
The drops of Soma juice effused.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः ।
हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
tisro vacha udirate gavo mimanti dhenavah |
harireti kanikradat ||
verses.en:
Three several words are uttered: kine are ]owing, cows who give their milk:
The Tawny-hued goes bellowing on.

verses.sa:
अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीरृतस्य मातरः ।
मर्मृज्यन्ते दिवः शिशुम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi brahmiranushata yahvirritasya matarah |
marmrijyante divah shishum ||
verses.en:
The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise:
They decorate the Child of Heaven.

verses.sa:
रायः समुद्राँश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।
आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
rayah samudranshchaturo'smabhyam soma vishvatah |
a pavasva sahasrinah ||
verses.en:
From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas
Filled full of riches thousand fold.

verses.sa:
प्र सुवानो धारया तनेन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति ।
रुजद्दृळ्हा व्योजसा ॥
verses.rom:
pra suvano dharaya tanendurhinvano arshati |
rujaddrilha vyojasa ||
verses.en:
THE drop of Soma juice effused flows onward with this stream impelled.
Rending strong places with its might.

verses.sa:
सुत इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।
सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
suta indraya vayave varunaya marudbhyah |
somo arshati vishnave ||
verses.en:
Poured forth to Indra, Varuna, to Vayu and the Marut hosts,
To Visnu, flows the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
वृषाणं वृषभिर्यतं सुन्वन्ति सोममद्रिभिः ।
दुहन्ति शक्मना पयः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishanam vrishabhiryatam sunvanti somamadribhih |
duhanti shakmana payah ||
verses.en:
With stones they press the Soma forth, the Strong conducted by the strong:
They milk the liquor out with skill.

verses.sa:
भुवत्त्रितस्य मर्ज्यो भुवदिन्द्राय मत्सरः ।
सं रूपैरज्यते हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvattritasya marjyo bhuvadindraya matsarah |
sam rupairajyate harih ||
verses.en:
'Tis he whom Trita must refine, 'tis he who shall make Indra glad:
The Tawny One is decked with tints.

verses.sa:
अभीमृतस्य विष्टपं दुहते पृश्निमातरः ।
चारु प्रियतमं हविः ॥
verses.rom:
abhimritasya vishtapam duhate prishnimatarah |
charu priyatamam havih ||
verses.en:
Him do the Sons of Prsni milk, the dwelling-place of sacrifice,
Oblation lovely and most dear.

verses.sa:
समेनमह्रुता इमा गिरो अर्षन्ति सस्रुतः ।
धेनूर्वाश्रो अवीवशत् ॥
verses.rom:
samenamahruta ima giro arshanti sasrutah |
dhenurvashro avivashat ||
verses.en:
To him in one united stream these songs flow on straight forward. he,
Loud voiced, hath made the milch-kine low.

verses.sa:
आ नः पवस्व धारया पवमान रयिं पृथुम् ।
यया ज्योतिर्विदासि नः ॥
verses.rom:
a nah pavasva dharaya pavamana rayim prithum |
yaya jyotirvidasi nah ||
verses.en:
Pour forth on us abundant wealth, O Pavamana, with thy stream.
Wherewith thou mayest find us light

verses.sa:
इन्दो समुद्रमीङ्खय पवस्व विश्वमेजय ।
रायो धर्ता न ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
indo samudraminkhaya pavasva vishvamejaya |
rayo dharta na ojasa ||
verses.en:
O Indu, swayer of the sea, shaker of all things, flow thou on,
Bearer of wealth to us with might.

verses.sa:
त्वया वीरेण वीरवोऽभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः ।
क्षरा णो अभि वार्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya virena viravo'bhi shyama pritanyatah |
kshara no abhi varyam ||
verses.en:
With thee for Hero, Valiant One! may we subdue our enemies:
Let what is precious flow to us.

verses.sa:
प्र वाजमिन्दुरिष्यति सिषासन्वाजसा ऋषिः ।
व्रता विदान आयुधा ॥
verses.rom:
pra vajamindurishyati sishasanvajasa rishih |
vrata vidana ayudha ||
verses.en:
Indu arouses strength the Sage who strives for victory, winning power,
Discovering holy works and means.

verses.sa:
तं गीर्भिर्वाचमीङ्खयं पुनानं वासयामसि ।
सोमं जनस्य गोपतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam girbhirvachaminkhayam punanam vasayamasi |
somam janasya gopatim ||
verses.en:
Mover of speech, we robe him with our songs as he is purified
Soma, the Guardian of the folk;

verses.sa:
विश्वो यस्य व्रते जनो दाधार धर्मणस्पतेः ।
पुनानस्य प्रभूवसोः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvo yasya vrate jano dadhara dharmanaspateh |
punanasya prabhuvasoh ||
verses.en:
On whose way, Lord of Holy Law, most rich as he is purified.
The people all have set their hearts.

verses.sa:
असर्जि रथ्यो यथा पवित्रे चम्वोः सुतः ।
कार्ष्मन्वाजी न्यक्रमीत् ॥
verses.rom:
asarji rathyo yatha pavitre chamvoh sutah |
karshmanvaji nyakramit ||
verses.en:
FORTH from the mortar is the juice sent, like a car-horse, to the sieve:
The Steed steps forward to the goal.

verses.sa:
स वह्निः सोम जागृविः पवस्व देववीरति ।
अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vahnih soma jagrivih pavasva devavirati |
abhi kosham madhushchutam ||
verses.en:
Thus, Soma, watchful, bearing well, cheering the Gods, flow past the sieve,
Turned to the vat that drops with meath.

verses.sa:
स नो ज्योतींषि पूर्व्य पवमान वि रोचय ।
क्रत्वे दक्षाय नो हिनु ॥
verses.rom:
sa no jyotimshi purvya pavamana vi rochaya |
kratve dakshaya no hinu ||
verses.en:
Excellent Pavamana, make the lights shine brightly out for us.
Speed us to mental power and skill.

verses.sa:
शुम्भमान ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः ।
पवते वारे अव्यये ॥
verses.rom:
shumbhamana ritayubhirmrijyamano gabhastyoh |
pavate vare avyaye ||
verses.en:
He, beautified by pious men, and coming from their hands adorned,
Flows through the fleecy straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
स विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमो दिव्यानि पार्थिवा ।
पवतामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥
verses.rom:
sa vishva dashushe vasu somo divyani parthiva |
pavatamantarikshya ||
verses.en:
May Soma pour all treasures of the heavens, the earth, the firmament
Upon the liberal worshipper.

verses.sa:
आ दिवस्पृष्ठमश्वयुर्गव्ययुः सोम रोहसि ।
वीरयुः शवसस्पते ॥
verses.rom:
a divasprishthamashvayurgavyayuh soma rohasi |
virayuh shavasaspate ||
verses.en:
Thou mountest to the height of heaven, O Soma, seeking steeds and kine,
And seeking heroes, Lord of Strength!

verses.sa:
स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति ।
विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa sutah pitaye vrisha somah pavitre arshati |
vighnanrakshamsi devayuh ||
verses.en:
SOMA, the Steer, effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve,
Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

verses.sa:
स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः ।
अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavitre vichakshano harirarshati dharnasih |
abhi yonim kanikradat ||
verses.en:
Far-sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve, intelligent,
Bellowing, to his place of rest.

verses.sa:
स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति ।
रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vaji rochana divah pavamano vi dhavati |
rakshoha varamavyayam ||
verses.en:
This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven,
Fiend-slayer, through the fleecy sieve.

verses.sa:
स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् ।
जामिभिः सूर्यं सह ॥
verses.rom:
sa tritasyadhi sanavi pavamano arochayat |
jamibhih suryam saha ||
verses.en:
This Payamana up above Trita's high ridge hath made the Sun,
Together with the Sisters, shine.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः ।
सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vritraha vrisha suto varivovidadabhyah |
somo vajamivasarat ||
verses.en:
This Vrtra-slaying Steer, effused, Soma room-giver, ne'er deceived,
Hath gone, as 'twere, to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
स देवः कविनेषितोऽभि द्रोणानि धावति ।
इन्दुरिन्द्राय मंहना ॥
verses.rom:
sa devah kavineshito'bhi dronani dhavati |
indurindraya mamhana ||
verses.en:
Urged onward by the sage, the God speeds forward to the casks of wood,
Indu to Indra willingly.

verses.sa:
एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति ।
गच्छन्वाजं सहस्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha u sya vrisha ratho'vyo varebhirarshati |
gachchhanvajam sahasrinam ||
verses.en:
THIS Steer, this Chariot, rushes through the woolen filter, as he goes
To war that wins a thousand spoils.

verses.sa:
एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
etam tritasya yoshano harim hinvantyadribhih |
indumindraya pitaye ||
verses.en:
The Dames of Trita with the stones onward impel this Tawny One
Indu to Indra for his drink.

verses.sa:
एतं त्यं हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः ।
याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते ॥
verses.rom:
etam tyam harito dasha marmrijyante apasyuvah |
yabhirmadaya shumbhate ||
verses.en:
Ten active fingers carefully adorn him here; they make him bright
And beauteous for the gladdening draught.

verses.sa:
एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति ।
गच्छञ्जारो न योषितम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya manushishva shyeno na vikshu sidati |
gachchhanjaro na yoshitam ||
verses.en:
He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men.
Speeding like lover to his love.

verses.sa:
एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः ।
य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत् ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya madyo raso'va chashte divah shishuh |
ya indurvaramavishat ||
verses.en:
This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven,
This Soma-drop that pierced the sieve.

verses.sa:
एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः ।
क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya pitaye suto harirarshati dharnasih |
krandanyonimabhi priyam ||
verses.en:
Poured for the draught, this tawny juice flows forth, intelligent, crying out,
Unto the well-beloved place.

verses.sa:
आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना ।
यत्र देवा इति ब्रवन् ॥
verses.rom:
ashurarsha brihanmate pari priyena dhamna |
yatra deva iti bravan ||
verses.en:
FLOW On, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form,
Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.

verses.sa:
परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः ।
वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
parishkrinvannanishkritam janaya yatayannishah |
vrishtim divah pari srava ||
verses.en:
Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man,
Make thou the rain descend from heaven.

verses.sa:
सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा ।
विचक्षाणो विरोचयन् ॥
verses.rom:
suta eti pavitra a tvishim dadhana ojasa |
vichakshano virochayan ||
verses.en:
With might, bestowing power, the juice enters the purifying sieve,
Far-seeing, sending forth its light.

verses.sa:
अयं स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ ।
सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sa yo divaspari raghuyama pavitra a |
sindhorurma vyaksharat ||
verses.en:
This is it which in rapid course hath with the river's wave flowed down
From heaven upon the straining cloth.

verses.sa:
आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः ।
इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु ॥
verses.rom:
avivasanparavato atho arvavatah sutah |
indraya sichyate madhu ||
verses.en:
Inviting him from far away, and even from near at hand, the juice
For Indra is poured forth as meath.

verses.sa:
समीचीना अनूषत हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
verses.rom:
samichina anushata harim hinvantyadribhih |
yonavritasya sidata ||
verses.en:
In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the Tawny One.
Sit in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः ।
शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
punano akramidabhi vishva mridho vicharshanih |
shumbhanti vipram dhitibhih ||
verses.en:
THE Very Active hath assailed, while purified, all enemies:
They deck the Sage with holy songs.

verses.sa:
आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिन्द्रं वृषा सुतः ।
ध्रुवे सदसि सीदति ॥
verses.rom:
a yonimaruno ruhadgamadindram vrisha sutah |
dhruve sadasi sidati ||
verses.en:
The Red hath mounted to his place; to India, goes the mighty juice:
He settles in his firm abode.

verses.sa:
नू नो रयिं महामिन्दोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।
आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
nu no rayim mahamindo'smabhyam soma vishvatah |
a pavasva sahasrinam ||
verses.en:
O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side,
Pour on us treasures thousand fold.

verses.sa:
विश्वा सोम पवमान द्युम्नानीन्दवा भर ।
