विदाः सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
vishva soma pavamana dyumnanindava bhara |
vidah sahasrinirishah ||
verses.en:
O Soma Pavamana, bring, Indu, all splendours hitherward:
Find for us food in boundless store.

verses.sa:
स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ।
जरितुर्वर्धया गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah punana a bhara rayim stotre suviryam |
jariturvardhaya girah ||
verses.en:
As thou art cleansed, bring hero strength and riches to thy worshipper,
And prosper thou the singer's hymns.

verses.sa:
पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् ।
वृषन्निन्दो न उक्थ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
punana indava bhara soma dvibarhasam rayim |
vrishannindo na ukthyam ||
verses.en:
O Indu, Soma, being cleansed, bring hither riches doubly piled,
Wealth, mighty Indu, meet for lauds.

verses.sa:
प्र ये गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः ।
घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye gavo na bhurnayastvesha ayaso akramuh |
ghnantah krishnamapa tvacham ||
verses.en:
ACTIVE and bright have they come forth, impetuous in speed like bulls,
Driving the black skin far away.

verses.sa:
सुवितस्य मनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराव्यम् ।
साह्वांसो दस्युमव्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
suvitasya manamahe'ti setum duravyam |
sahvamso dasyumavratam ||
verses.en:
Quelling the riteless Dasyu, may we think upon the bridge of bliss,
Leaving the bridge of woe behind.

verses.sa:
शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः ।
चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
shrinve vrishteriva svanah pavamanasya shushminah |
charanti vidyuto divi ||
verses.en:
The mighty Pavamana's roar is heard as 'twere the rush of rain
Lightnings are flashing to the sky.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् ।
अश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva mahimisham gomadindo hiranyavat |
ashvavadvajavatsutah ||
verses.en:
Pour out on us abundant food, when thou art pressed, O Indu wealth
In kine and gold and steeds and spoil.

verses.sa:
स पवस्व विचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण ।
उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavasva vicharshana a mahi rodasi prina |
ushah suryo na rashmibhih ||
verses.en:
Flow on thy way, Most Active, thou. fill full the mighty heavens and earth,
As Dawn, as Surya with his beams.

verses.sa:
परि णः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः ।
सरा रसेव विष्टपम् ॥
verses.rom:
pari nah sharmayantya dharaya soma vishvatah |
sara raseva vishtapam ||
verses.en:
On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream,
As Rasa flows around the world.

verses.sa:
जनयन्रोचना दिवो जनयन्नप्सु सूर्यम् ।
वसानो गा अपो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
janayanrochana divo janayannapsu suryam |
vasano ga apo harih ||
verses.en:
ENGENDERING the Sun in floods, engendering heaven's lights, green-hued,
Robed in the waters and the milk,

verses.sa:
एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि ।
धारया पवते सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
esha pratnena manmana devo devebhyaspari |
dharaya pavate sutah ||
verses.en:
According to primeval plan this Soma, with his stream, effused
Flows purely on, a God for Gods.

verses.sa:
वावृधानाय तूर्वये पवन्ते वाजसातये ।
सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ॥
verses.rom:
vavridhanaya turvaye pavante vajasataye |
somah sahasrapajasah ||
verses.en:
For him victorious, waxen great, the juices with a thousand powers
Are purified for winning spoil.

verses.sa:
दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यते ।
क्रन्दन्देवाँ अजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
duhanah pratnamitpayah pavitre pari shichyate |
krandandevan ajijanat ||
verses.en:
Shedding the ancient fluid he is poured into the cleansing sieve:
He, thundering, hath produced the Gods.

verses.sa:
अभि विश्वानि वार्याभि देवाँ ऋतावृधः ।
सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vishvani varyabhi devan ritavridhah |
somah punano arshati ||
verses.en:
Soma, while purifying, sends hither all things to be desired,
He sends the Gods who strengthen Law.

verses.sa:
गोमन्नः सोम वीरवदश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः ।
पवस्व बृहतीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
gomannah soma viravadashvavadvajavatsutah |
pavasva brihatirishah ||
verses.en:
Soma, effused, pour on us wealth in kine, in heroes, steeds, and spoil,
Send us abundant store of food.

verses.sa:
यो अत्य इव मृज्यते गोभिर्मदाय हर्यतः ।
तं गीर्भिर्वासयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yo atya iva mrijyate gobhirmadaya haryatah |
tam girbhirvasayamasi ||
verses.en:
WE will enrobe with sacred song the Lovely One who, as a Steed,
Is decked with milk for rapturous joy.

verses.sa:
तं नो विश्वा अवस्युवो गिरः शुम्भन्ति पूर्वथा ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
tam no vishva avasyuvo girah shumbhanti purvatha |
indumindraya pitaye ||
verses.en:
All songs of ours desiring grace adorn him in the ancient way,
Indu for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa:
पुनानो याति हर्यतः सोमो गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः ।
विप्रस्य मेध्यातिथेः ॥
verses.rom:
punano yati haryatah somo girbhih parishkritah |
viprasya medhyatitheh ||
verses.en:
Soma flows on when purified, beloved and adorned with songs,
Songs of the sage Medhyatithi.

verses.sa:
पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम सुश्रियम् ।
इन्दो सहस्रवर्चसम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana vida rayimasmabhyam soma sushriyam |
indo sahasravarchasam ||
verses.en:
O Soma Pavamana, find exceeding glorious wealth for us,
Wealth, Indu, fraught with boundless might.

verses.sa:
इन्दुरत्यो न वाजसृत्कनिक्रन्ति पवित्र आ ।
यदक्षारति देवयुः ॥
verses.rom:
induratyo na vajasritkanikranti pavitra a |
yadaksharati devayuh ||
verses.en:
Like courser racing to the prize Indu, the lover of the Gods,
Roars, as he passes, in the sieve.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वाजसातये विप्रस्य गृणतो वृधे ।
सोम रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vajasataye viprasya grinato vridhe |
soma rasva suviryam ||
verses.en:
Flow on thy way to win us strength, to speed the sage who praises thee:
Soma, bestow heroic power.

verses.sa:
प्र ण इन्दो महे तन ऊर्मिं न बिभ्रदर्षसि ।
अभि देवाँ अयास्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pra na indo mahe tana urmim na bibhradarshasi |
abhi devan ayasyah ||
verses.en:
INDU, to us for this great rite, bearing as 'twere thy wave to Gods,
Unwearied, thou art flowing forth.

verses.sa:
मती जुष्टो धिया हितः सोमो हिन्वे परावति ।
विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
verses.rom:
mati jushto dhiya hitah somo hinve paravati |
viprasya dharaya kavih ||
verses.en:
Pleased with the hymn, impelled by prayer, Soma is hurried far away,
The Wise One in the Singer's stream.,

verses.sa:
अयं देवेषु जागृविः सुत एति पवित्र आ ।
सोमो याति विचर्षणिः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam deveshu jagrivih suta eti pavitra a |
somo yati vicharshanih ||
verses.en:
Watchful among the. gods, this juice advances to the cleansing sieve
Soma, most active, travels on.

verses.sa:
स नः पवस्व वाजयुश्चक्राणश्चारुमध्वरम् ।
बर्हिष्माँ आ विवासति ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah pavasva vajayushchakranashcharumadhvaram |
barhishman a vivasati ||
verses.en:
Flow onward, seeking strength for us, embellishing the sacrifice:
The priest with trimmed grass calleth thee.

verses.sa:
स नो भगाय वायवे विप्रवीरः सदावृधः ।
सोमो देवेष्वा यमत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no bhagaya vayave vipravirah sadavridhah |
somo deveshva yamat ||
verses.en:
May Soma, ever bringing power to Bhaga and to Vayu, Sage
And Hero, lead us to the Gods.

verses.sa:
स नो अद्य वसुत्तये क्रतुविद्गातुवित्तमः ।
वाजं जेषि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no adya vasuttaye kratuvidgatuvittamah |
vajam jeshi shravo brihat ||
verses.en:
So, to increase our wealth to-day, Inspirer, best of Furtherers,
Win for us strength and high renown.

verses.sa:
स पवस्व मदाय कं नृचक्षा देववीतये ।
इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavasva madaya kam nrichaksha devavitaye |
indavindraya pitaye ||
verses.en:
FLOW, thou who viewest men, to give delight, to entertain the Gods,
Indu, to Indra for his drink.

verses.sa:
स नो अर्षाभि दूत्यं त्वमिन्द्राय तोशसे ।
देवान्सखिभ्य आ वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no arshabhi dutyam tvamindraya toshase |
devansakhibhya a varam ||
verses.en:
Stream to thine embassy for us: thou hastenest, for Indra, to
The Gods, O better than our friends.

verses.sa:
उत त्वामरुणं वयं गोभिरञ्ज्मो मदाय कम् ।
वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
verses.rom:
uta tvamarunam vayam gobhiranjmo madaya kam |
vi no raye duro vridhi ||
verses.en:
We balm thee, red of hue, with milk to fit thee for the rapturous joy:
Unbar for us the doors of wealth.

verses.sa:
अत्यू पवित्रमक्रमीद्वाजी धुरं न यामनि ।
इन्दुर्देवेषु पत्यते ॥
verses.rom:
atyu pavitramakramidvaji dhuram na yamani |
indurdeveshu patyate ||
verses.en:
He through the sieve hath passed, as comes a courser to the pole, to run
Indu belongs unto the Gods.

verses.sa:
समी सखायो अस्वरन्वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् ।
इन्दुं नावा अनूषत ॥
verses.rom:
sami sakhayo asvaranvane krilantamatyavim |
indum nava anushata ||
verses.en:
All friends have lauded him as he sports in the wood, beyond the fleece:
Singers have chanted Indu's praise.

verses.sa:
तया पवस्व धारया यया पीतो विचक्षसे ।
इन्दो स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
taya pavasva dharaya yaya pito vichakshase |
indo stotre suviryam ||
verses.en:
Flow, Indu, with that stream wherein steeped thou announcest to the man
Who worships thee heroic strength.

verses.sa:
असृग्रन्देववीतयेऽत्यासः कृत्व्या इव ।
क्षरन्तः पर्वतावृधः ॥
verses.rom:
asrigrandevavitaye'tyasah kritvya iva |
ksharantah parvatavridhah ||
verses.en:
LIKE able coursers they have been sent forth to be the feast of Gods,
joying in mountains, flowing on.

verses.sa:
परिष्कृतास इन्दवो योषेव पित्र्यावती ।
वायुं सोमा असृक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
parishkritasa indavo yosheva pitryavati |
vayum soma asrikshata ||
verses.en:
To Vayu flow the Soma-streams, the drops of juice made beautiful
Like a bride dowered by her sire.

verses.sa:
एते सोमास इन्दवः प्रयस्वन्तश्चमू सुताः ।
इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति कर्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ete somasa indavah prayasvantashchamu sutah |
indram vardhanti karmabhih ||
verses.en:
Pressed in the mortar, these, the drops of juice, the Somas rich in food,
Give strength to Indra with their work.

verses.sa:
आ धावता सुहस्त्यः शुक्रा गृभ्णीत मन्थिना ।
गोभिः श्रीणीत मत्सरम् ॥
verses.rom:
a dhavata suhastyah shukra gribhnita manthina |
gobhih shrinita matsaram ||
verses.en:
Deft-handed men, run hither, seize the brilliant juices blent with meal,
And cook with milk the gladdening draught.

verses.sa:
स पवस्व धनंजय प्रयन्ता राधसो महः ।
अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavasva dhanamjaya prayanta radhaso mahah |
asmabhyam soma gatuvit ||
verses.en:
Thus, Soma, Conqueror of wealth! flow, finding furtherance for us,
Giver of ample opulence.

verses.sa:
एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं पवमानं दश क्षिपः ।
इन्द्राय मत्सरं मदम् ॥
verses.rom:
etam mrijanti marjyam pavamanam dasha kshipah |
indraya matsaram madam ||
verses.en:
This Pavamana, meet to be adorned, the fingers ten adorn,
The draught that shall make Indra glad.

verses.sa:
अया सोमः सुकृत्यया महश्चिदभ्यवर्धत ।
मन्दान उद्वृषायते ॥
verses.rom:
aya somah sukrityaya mahashchidabhyavardhata |
mandana udvrishayate ||
verses.en:
GREAT as he was, Soma hath gained strength by this high solemnity:
joyous he riseth like a bull.

verses.sa:
कृतानीदस्य कर्त्वा चेतन्ते दस्युतर्हणा ।
ऋणा च धृष्णुश्चयते ॥
verses.rom:
kritanidasya kartva chetante dasyutarhana |
rina cha dhrishnushchayate ||
verses.en:
His task is done: his crushings of the Dasyus are made manifest:
He sternly reckoneth their debts.

verses.sa:
आत्सोम इन्द्रियो रसो वज्रः सहस्रसा भुवत् ।
उक्थं यदस्य जायते ॥
verses.rom:
atsoma indriyo raso vajrah sahasrasa bhuvat |
uktham yadasya jayate ||
verses.en:
Soon as his song of praise is born, the Soma, Indra's juice, becomes
A thousand-winning thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
स्वयं कविर्विधर्तरि विप्राय रत्नमिच्छति ।
यदी मर्मृज्यते धियः ॥
verses.rom:
svayam kavirvidhartari vipraya ratnamichchhati |
yadi marmrijyate dhiyah ||
verses.en:
Seer and Sustainer, he himself desireth riches for the sage
When he embellisheth his songs.

verses.sa:
सिषासतू रयीणां वाजेष्वर्वतामिव ।
भरेषु जिग्युषामसि ॥
verses.rom:
sishasatu rayinam vajeshvarvatamiva |
bhareshu jigyushamasi ||
verses.en:
Fain would they both win riches as in races of the steeds. In war
Thou art upon the conquerors' side.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतं सधस्थेषु महो दिवः ।
चारुं सुकृत्ययेमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva nrimnani bibhratam sadhastheshu maho divah |
charum sukrityayemahe ||
verses.en:
WITH sacrifice we seek to thee kind Cherisher of manly might
In mansions of the lofty heavens;

verses.sa:
संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम् ।
शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम् ॥
verses.rom:
samvriktadhrishnumukthyam mahamahivratam madam |
shatam puro rurukshanim ||
verses.en:
Gladdening crusher of the bold, ruling with very mighty sway,
Destroyer of a hundred forts.

verses.sa:
अतस्त्वा रयिमभि राजानं सुक्रतो दिवः ।
सुपर्णो अव्यथिर्भरत् ॥
verses.rom:
atastva rayimabhi rajanam sukrato divah |
suparno avyathirbharat ||
verses.en:
Hence, Sapient One! the Falcon, strong of wing, unwearied, brought thee down,
Lord over riches, from the sky.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणं रजस्तुरम् ।
गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasma itsvardrishe sadharanam rajasturam |
gopamritasya virbharat ||
verses.en:
That each may see the light, the Bird brought us the guard of Law, the Friend
Of all, the speeder through the air.

verses.sa:
अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे ।
अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः ॥
verses.rom:
adha hinvana indriyam jyayo mahitvamanashe |
abhishtikridvicharshanih ||
verses.en:
And now, sent forth, it hath attained to mighty power and majesty,
Most active, ready to assist.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि ।
अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vrishtima su no'pamurmim divaspari |
ayakshma brihatirishah ||
verses.en:
Pour down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky,
And plenteous store of wholesome food.

verses.sa:
तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् ।
जन्यास उप नो गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
taya pavasva dharaya yaya gava ihagaman |
janyasa upa no griham ||
verses.en:
Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us,
The kine of strangers to our home.

verses.sa:
घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः ।
अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव ॥
verses.rom:
ghritam pavasva dharaya yajneshu devavitamah |
asmabhyam vrishtima pava ||
verses.en:
Chief Friend of Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream,
Pour down on us a flood of rain.

verses.sa:
स न ऊर्जे व्यव्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया ।
देवासः शृणवन्हि कम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa na urje vyavyayam pavitram dhava dharaya |
devasah shrinavanhi kam ||
verses.en:
To give us vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth
For verily the Gods will bear.

verses.sa:
पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षांस्यपजङ्घनत् ।
प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano asishyadadrakshamsyapajanghanat |
pratnavadrochayanruchah ||
verses.en:
Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Raksasas,
Flashing out splendour as of old.

verses.sa:
उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः ।
वाणस्य चोदया पविम् ॥
verses.rom:
utte shushmasa irate sindhorurmeriva svanah |
vanasya chodaya pavim ||
verses.en:
LOUD as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves:
Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point.

verses.sa:
प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः ।
यदव्य एषि सानवि ॥
verses.rom:
prasave ta udirate tisro vacho makhasyuvah |
yadavya eshi sanavi ||
verses.en:
At thine effusion upward rise three voices full of joy, when thou
Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.

verses.sa:
अव्यो वारे परि प्रियं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
avyo vare pari priyam harim hinvantyadribhih |
pavamanam madhushchutam ||
verses.en:
On to the fleece they urge with stone the tawny well-beloved One,
Even Pavamana, dropping meath.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे ।
अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva madintama pavitram dharaya kave |
arkasya yonimasadam ||
verses.en:
Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage most powerful to cheer,
To seat thee in the place of song.

verses.sa:
स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः ।
इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavasva madintama gobhiranjano aktubhih |
indavindraya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Flow, Most Exhilarating! flow anointed with the milk for balm,
Indu, for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज ।
पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryo adribhih sutam somam pavitra a srija |
punihindraya patave ||
verses.en:
ADHVARYU, on the filter pour the Soma juice expressed with stones,
And make it pure for Indra's drink.

verses.sa:
दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
सुनोता मधुमत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
divah piyushamuttamam somamindraya vajrine |
sunota madhumattamam ||
verses.en:
Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven,, the Soma's juice,
Most excellent, most rich in sweets.

verses.sa:
तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्यश्नते ।
पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tya indo andhaso deva madhorvyashnate |
pavamanasya marutah ||
verses.en:
These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu enjoy this juice of thine,
This Pavamana's flowing meath.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि सोम वर्धयन्सुतो मदाय भूर्णये ।
वृषन्स्तोतारमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi soma vardhayansuto madaya bhurnaye |
vrishanstotaramutaye ||
verses.en:
For, Soma, thou hast been effused, strengthening for the wild carouse,
O Steer, the singer, for our help.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्ष विचक्षण पवित्रं धारया सुतः ।
अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarsha vichakshana pavitram dharaya sutah |
abhi vajamuta shravah ||
verses.en:
Flow with thy stream, Far-sighted One, effused, into the cleansing sieve:
Flow on to give us strength and fame.

verses.sa:
परि द्युक्षः सनद्रयिर्भरद्वाजं नो अन्धसा ।
सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ ॥
verses.rom:
pari dyukshah sanadrayirbharadvajam no andhasa |
suvano arsha pavitra a ||
verses.en:
WEALTH-WINNER, dwelling in the sky, bringing us vigour with the juice,
Flow to the filter when effused.

verses.sa:
तव प्रत्नेभिरध्वभिरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः ।
सहस्रधारो यात्तना ॥
verses.rom:
tava pratnebhiradhvabhiravyo vare pari priyah |
sahasradharo yattana ||
verses.en:
So, in thine ancient ways, may he, beloved, with a thousand streams
Run o'er the fleecy straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
चरुर्न यस्तमीङ्खयेन्दो न दानमीङ्खय ।
वधैर्वधस्नवीङ्खय ॥
verses.rom:
charurna yastaminkhayendo na danaminkhaya |
vadhairvadhasnavinkhaya ||
verses.en:
Him who is like a caldron shake: O Indu, shake thy gift to us
Shake it, armed Warrior! with thine arms.

verses.sa:
नि शुष्ममिन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् ।
यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति ॥
verses.rom:
ni shushmamindavesham puruhuta jananam |
yo asman adideshati ||
verses.en:
Indu, invoked with many a prayer, bring down the vigour of these men,
Of him who threatens us with war.

verses.sa:
शतं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सहस्रं वा शुचीनाम् ।
पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
verses.rom:
shatam na inda utibhih sahasram va shuchinam |
pavasva mamhayadrayih ||
verses.en:
Indu, Wealth-giver, with thine help pour out for us a hundred, yea,
A thousand of thy pure bright streams.

verses.sa:
उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः ।
नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः ॥
verses.rom:
utte shushmaso asthu raksho bhindanto adrivah |
nudasva yah parispridhah ||
verses.en:
O THOU with stones for arms, thy powers, crushing the fiends, have raised themselves:
Chase thou the foes who compass us.

verses.sa:
अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसंगे धने हिते ।
स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा ॥
verses.rom:
aya nijaghnirojasa rathasamge dhane hite |
stava abibhyusha hrida ||
verses.en:
Thou conquerest thus with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked:
With fearless heart will I sing praise.

verses.sa:
अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या ।
रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति ॥
verses.rom:
asya vratani nadhrishe pavamanasya dudhya |
ruja yastva pritanyati ||
verses.en:
No one with evil thought assails this Pavamana's holy laws:
Crush him who fain would fight with thee.

verses.sa:
तं हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतं हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam hinvanti madachyutam harim nadishu vajinam |
indumindraya matsaram ||
verses.en:
For Indra to the streams they drive the tawny rapture-dropping Steed,
Indu the bringer of delight.

verses.sa:
अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतं शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः ।
पयः सहस्रसामृषिम् ॥
verses.rom:
asya pratnamanu dyutam shukram duduhre ahrayah |
payah sahasrasamrishim ||
verses.en:
AFTER his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from
The Sage who wins a thousand gifts.

verses.sa:
अयं सूर्य इवोपदृगयं सरांसि धावति ।
सप्त प्रवत आ दिवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam surya ivopadrigayam saramsi dhavati |
sapta pravata a divam ||
verses.en:
In aspect he is like the Sun; he runneth forward to the lakes,
Seven currents flowing through the sky.

verses.sa:
अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि ।
सोमो देवो न सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vishvani tishthati punano bhuvanopari |
somo devo na suryah ||
verses.en:
He, shining in his splendour, stands high over all things that exist-
Soma, a God as Surya is.

verses.sa:
परि णो देववीतये वाजाँ अर्षसि गोमतः ।
पुनान इन्दविन्द्रयुः ॥
verses.rom:
pari no devavitaye vajan arshasi gomatah |
punana indavindrayuh ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indu, in thy brilliancy, pourest on us, as Indra's Friend,
Wealth from the kine to feast the Gods.

verses.sa:
यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टम्पुष्टं परि स्रव ।
सोम विश्वा च सौभगा ॥
verses.rom:
yavamyavam no andhasa pushtampushtam pari srava |
soma vishva cha saubhaga ||
verses.en:
POUR on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment,
And, Soma, all felicities.

verses.sa:
इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः ।
नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः ॥
verses.rom:
indo yatha tava stavo yatha te jatamandhasah |
ni barhishi priye sadah ||
verses.en:
As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from the juice,
Seat thee on the dear sacred grass.

verses.sa:
उत नो गोविदश्ववित्पवस्व सोमान्धसा ।
मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः ॥
verses.rom:
uta no govidashvavitpavasva somandhasa |
makshutamebhirahabhih ||
verses.en:
And, finding for us kine and steeds, O Soma, with thy juice flow on
Through days that fly most rapidly.

verses.sa:
यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य ।
स पवस्व सहस्रजित् ॥
verses.rom:
yo jinati na jiyate hanti shatrumabhitya |
sa pavasva sahasrajit ||
verses.en:
As one who conquers, ne'er subdued, attacks and stays the enemy,
Thus, Vanquisher of thousands! flow.

verses.sa:
परि सोम ऋतं बृहदाशुः पवित्रे अर्षति ।
विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
verses.rom:
pari soma ritam brihadashuh pavitre arshati |
vighnanrakshamsi devayuh ||
verses.en:
SWIFT to the purifying sieve flows Soma as exalted Law,
Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

verses.sa:
यत्सोमो वाजमर्षति शतं धारा अपस्युवः ।
इन्द्रस्य सख्यमाविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
yatsomo vajamarshati shatam dhara apasyuvah |
indrasya sakhyamavishan ||
verses.en:
When Soma pours the strengthening food a hundred ever-active streams
To Indra's friendship win their way.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा योषणो दश जारं न कन्यानूषत ।
मृज्यसे सोम सातये ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva yoshano dasha jaram na kanyanushata |
mrijyase soma sataye ||
verses.en:
Ten Dames have sung to welcome thee, even as a maiden greets her love:
O Soma, thou art decked to win.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्राय विष्णवे स्वादुरिन्दो परि स्रव ।
नॄन्स्तोतॄन्पाह्यंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindraya vishnave svadurindo pari srava |
nrinstotrinpahyamhasah ||
verses.en:
Flow hitherward, O Indu, sweet to Indra and to Visnu: guard
The men, the singers, from distress.

verses.sa:
प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः ।
अच्छा वाजं सहस्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra te dhara asashchato divo na yanti vrishtayah |
achchha vajam sahasrinam ||
verses.en:
THY streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven,
To bring a thousand stores of strength.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति ।
हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priyani kavya vishva chakshano arshati |
haristunjana ayudha ||
verses.en:
He flows beholding on his way all well beloved sacred lore,
Green-tinted, brandishing his, arms.

verses.sa:
स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः ।
श्येनो न वंसु षीदति ॥
verses.rom:
sa marmrijana ayubhiribho rajeva suvratah |
shyeno na vamsu shidati ||
verses.en:
He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants.
Sits as a falcon in the, wood.

verses.sa:
स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि ।
पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vishva divo vasuto prithivya adhi |
punana indava bhara ||
verses.en:
So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified,
All treasures both of heaven and earth.

verses.sa:
तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः ।
तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
verses.rom:
taratsa mandi dhavati dhara sutasyandhasah |
taratsa mandi dhavati ||
verses.en:
SWIFT runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice:
Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa:
उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्तस्य देव्यवसः ।
तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
verses.rom:
usra veda vasunam martasya devyavasah |
taratsa mandi dhavati ||
verses.en:
The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man:
Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa:
ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे ।
तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
verses.rom:
dhvasrayoh purushantyora sahasrani dadmahe |
taratsa mandi dhavati ||
verses.en:
We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Purusanti's hands:
Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa:
आ ययोस्त्रिंशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे ।
तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
verses.rom:
a yayostrimshatam tana sahasrani cha dadmahe |
taratsa mandi dhavati ||
verses.en:
From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three times ten beside:
Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa:
पवस्व गोजिदश्वजिद्विश्वजित्सोम रण्यजित् ।
प्रजावद्रत्नमा भर ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva gojidashvajidvishvajitsoma ranyajit |
prajavadratnama bhara ||
verses.en:
FLOW onward, Soma, winning kine, and steeds, and all that gives delight:
Bring hither wealth with progeny.

verses.sa:
पवस्वाद्भ्यो अदाभ्यः पवस्वौषधीभ्यः ।
पवस्व धिषणाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasvadbhyo adabhyah pavasvaushadhibhyah |
pavasva dhishanabhyah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward from the waters, flow, inviolable, from the plants:
Flow onward from the pressing-boards.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम पवमानो विश्वानि दुरिता तर ।
कविः सीद नि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma pavamano vishvani durita tara |
kavih sida ni barhishi ||
verses.en:
Soma, as Pavamana, pass over all trouble and distress:
Sit on the sacred grass, a Sage.

verses.sa:
पवमान स्वर्विदो जायमानोऽभवो महान् ।
इन्दो विश्वाँ अभीदसि ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana svarvido jayamano'bhavo mahan |
indo vishvan abhidasi ||
verses.en:
Thou, Pavamana, foundest light; thou at thy birth becamest great:
O Indu, thou art over all.

verses.sa:
प्र गायत्रेण गायत पवमानं विचर्षणिम् ।
इन्दुं सहस्रचक्षसम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra gayatrena gayata pavamanam vicharshanim |
indum sahasrachakshasam ||
verses.en:
SING forth and laud with sacred song most active Pavamana, laud
Indu who sees with thousand eyes.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा सहस्रचक्षसमथो सहस्रभर्णसम् ।
अति वारमपाविषुः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva sahasrachakshasamatho sahasrabharnasam |
ati varamapavishuh ||
verses.en:
Thee who hast thousand eyes to see, bearer of thousand burthens, they
Have filtered through the fleecy cloth.

verses.sa:
अति वारान्पवमानो असिष्यदत्कलशाँ अभि धावति ।
इन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
ati varanpavamano asishyadatkalashan abhi dhavati |
indrasya hardyavishan ||
verses.en:
He, Pavamana, hath streamed through the fleece then: he runs into the jars,
Finding his way to Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे शं पवस्व विचर्षणे ।
प्रजावद्रेत आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya soma radhase sham pavasva vicharshane |
prajavadreta a bhara ||
verses.en:
That Indra may be bounteous, flow, most active Soma, for our weal:
Bring genial seed with progeny.

verses.sa:
अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा ।
अवाहन्नवतीर्नव ॥
verses.rom:
aya viti pari srava yasta indo madeshva |
avahannavatirnava ||
verses.en:
FLOW onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delight
Battered the nine-and-ninety down,

verses.sa:
पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शम्बरम् ।
अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥
verses.rom:
purah sadya itthadhiye divodasaya shambaram |
adha tyam turvasham yadum ||
verses.en:
Smote swiftly forts, and Sambara, then Yadu and that Turvaga,
For pious Divodasa's sake.

verses.sa:
परि णो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् ।
क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
pari no ashvamashvavidgomadindo hiranyavat |
kshara sahasrinirishah ||
verses.en:
Finder of horses, pour on us horses and wealth in kine and gold,
And, Indu, food in boundless store.

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः ।
सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya te vayam pavitramabhyundatah |
sakhitvama vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamana's flowing o'er
The limit of the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयोऽभिक्षरन्ति धारया ।
तेभिर्नः सोम मृळय ॥
verses.rom:
ye te pavitramurmayo'bhiksharanti dharaya |
tebhirnah soma mrilaya ||
verses.en:
With those same waves which in their stream oyerflow the purifying sieve,
Soma; be gracious unto us.

verses.sa:
स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् ।
ईशानः सोम विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah punana a bhara rayim viravatimisham |
ishanah soma vishvatah ||
verses.en:
O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides, for thou canst,
Riches and food with hero sons.

verses.sa:
एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सिन्धुमातरम् ।
समादित्येभिरख्यत ॥
verses.rom:
etamu tyam dasha kshipo mrijanti sindhumataram |
samadityebhirakhyata ||
verses.en:
Him here, the Child whom streams have borne, the ten swift fingers beautify
With the Adityas is he seen.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ ।
सं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
samindrenota vayuna suta eti pavitra a |
sam suryasya rashmibhih ||
verses.en:
With Indra and with Vayu he, effused, flows onward with, the beams
Of Surya to the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान् ।
चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च ॥
verses.rom:
sa no bhagaya vayave pushne pavasva madhuman |
charurmitre varune cha ||
verses.en:
Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vayu, Pusan flow
For Mitra and for Varuna.

verses.sa:
उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि षद्भूम्या ददे ।
उग्रं शर्म महि श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
uchcha te jatamandhaso divi shadbhumya dade |
ugram sharma mahi shravah ||
verses.en:
High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained
Strong sheltering power and great renown.

verses.sa:
एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणाम् ।
सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ena vishvanyarya a dyumnani manushanam |
sishasanto vanamahe ||
verses.en:
Striving to win, with him we gain all wealth from the ungodly man,
Yea, all the glories of mankind.

verses.sa:
स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।
वरिवोवित्परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
sa na indraya yajyave varunaya marudbhyah |
varivovitpari srava ||
verses.en:
Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore,
For Varuna and the Marut host.

verses.sa:
उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् ।
इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
upo shu jatamapturam gobhirbhangam parishkritam |
indum deva ayasishuh ||
verses.en:
The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk,
The active crusher of the foe.

verses.sa:
तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव ।
य इन्द्रस्य हृदंसनिः ॥
verses.rom:
tamidvardhantu no giro vatsam samshishvaririva |
ya indrasya hridamsanih ||
verses.en:
Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him,
Yea, him who winneth Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
अर्षा णः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् ।
वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
arsha nah soma sham gave dhukshasva pipyushimisham |
vardha samudramukthyam ||
verses.en:
Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milk
Increase the sea that merits laud.

verses.sa:
पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम् ।
ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano ajijanaddivashchitram na tanyatum |
jyotirvaishvanaram brihat ||
verses.en:
From heaven hath Pavamana made, as 'twere, the marvellous thunder, and
The lofty light of all mankind.

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य ते रसो मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः ।
वि वारमव्यमर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya te raso mado rajannaduchchhunah |
vi varamavyamarshati ||
verses.en:
The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, of Pavamana, King!
Flows o'er the woollen straining-cloth.

verses.sa:
पवमान रसस्तव दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् ।
ज्योतिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana rasastava daksho vi rajati dyuman |
jyotirvishvam svardrishe ||
verses.en:
Thy juice, O Pavamana, sends its rays abroad like splendid skill,
Like lustre, all heaven's light, to see.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा ।
देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
verses.rom:
yaste mado varenyastena pavasvandhasa |
devaviraghashamsaha ||
verses.en:
Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight,
Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods.

verses.sa:
जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियं सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे ।
गोषा उ अश्वसा असि ॥
verses.rom:
jaghnirvritramamitriyam sasnirvajam divedive |
gosha u ashvasa asi ||
verses.en:
Killing the foeman and his hate, and winning booty every day,
Gainer art thou of steeds and kine.

verses.sa:
सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भव सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभिः ।
सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
sammishlo arusho bhava supasthabhirna dhenubhih |
sidanchhyeno na yonima ||
verses.en:
Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast,
Falcon-like resting in thine home.

verses.sa:
स पवस्व य आविथेन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे ।
वव्रिवांसं महीरपः ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavasva ya avithendram vritraya hantave |
vavrivamsam mahirapah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward thou who strengthenedst Indra to slaughter Vrtra who
Compassed and stayed the mighty floods.

verses.sa:
सुवीरासो वयं धना जयेम सोम मीढ्वः ।
पुनानो वर्ध नो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
suviraso vayam dhana jayema soma midhvah |
punano vardha no girah ||
verses.en:
Soma who rainest gifts, may we win riches with our hero sons:
Strengthen, as thou art cleansed, our hymns.

verses.sa:
त्वोतासस्तवावसा स्याम वन्वन्त आमुरः ।
सोम व्रतेषु जागृहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvotasastavavasa syama vanvanta amurah |
soma vrateshu jagrihi ||
verses.en:
Aided by thee, and through thy grace, may we be slayers when we war:
Watch, Soma, at our solemn rites.

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः ।
गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
apaghnanpavate mridho'pa somo aravnah |
gachchhannindrasya nishkritam ||
verses.en:
Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma floweth on,
Going to Indra's special place.

verses.sa:
महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः ।
रास्वेन्दो वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.rom:
maho no raya a bhara pavamana jahi mridhah |
rasvendo viravadyashah ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes:
O Indu, grant heroic fame.

verses.sa:
न त्वा शतं चन ह्रुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन् ।
यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
na tva shatam chana hruto radho ditsantama minan |
yatpunano makhasyase ||
verses.en:
A hundred obstacles have ne'er checked thee when fain to give thy boons,
When, being cleansed, thou combatest.

verses.sa:
पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने ।
विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
pavasvendo vrisha sutah kridhi no yashaso jane |
vishva apa dvisho jahi ||
verses.en:
Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk:
Drive all our enemies away.

verses.sa:
अस्य ते सख्ये वयं तवेन्दो द्युम्न उत्तमे ।
सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
asya te sakhye vayam tavendo dyumna uttame |
sasahyama pritanyatah ||
verses.en:
Indu, in this thy friendship most lofty and glorious may we
Subdue all those who war with us.

verses.sa:
या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे ।
रक्षा समस्य नो निदः ॥
verses.rom:
ya te bhimanyayudha tigmani santi dhurvane |
raksha samasya no nidah ||
verses.en:
Those awful weapons that thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down-
Guard us therewith from every foe.

verses.sa:
एते असृग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः ।
विश्वान्यभि सौभगा ॥
verses.rom:
ete asrigramindavastirah pavitramashavah |
vishvanyabhi saubhaga ||
verses.en:
THESE rapid Soma-drops have been poured through the purifying sieve
To bring us all felicities.

verses.sa:
विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः ।
तना कृण्वन्तो अर्वते ॥
verses.rom:
vighnanto durita puru suga tokaya vajinah |
tana krinvanto arvate ||
verses.en:
Dispelling manifold mishap, giving the courser's progeny,
Yea, and the warrior steed, success.

verses.sa:
कृण्वन्तो वरिवो गवेऽभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिम् ।
इळामस्मभ्यं संयतम् ॥
verses.rom:
krinvanto varivo gave'bhyarshanti sushtutim |
ilamasmabhyam samyatam ||
verses.en:
Bringing prosperity to kine, they make perpetual Ila flow
To us for noble eulogy.

verses.sa:
असाव्यंशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः ।
श्येनो न योनिमासदत् ॥
verses.rom:
asavyamshurmadayapsu daksho girishthah |
shyeno na yonimasadat ||
verses.en:
Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been pressed in the streams for rapturous joy:
Hawk-like he settles in his home.

verses.sa:
शुभ्रमन्धो देववातमप्सु धूतो नृभिः सुतः ।
स्वदन्ति गावः पयोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
shubhramandho devavatamapsu dhuto nribhih sutah |
svadanti gavah payobhih ||
verses.en:
Fair is the God-loved juice; the plant is washed in waters, pressed by men
The milch-kine sweeten it with milk.

verses.sa:
आदीमश्वं न हेतारोऽशूशुभन्नमृताय ।
मध्वो रसं सधमादे ॥
verses.rom:
adimashvam na hetaro'shushubhannamritaya |
madhvo rasam sadhamade ||
verses.en:
As drivers deck a courser, so have they adorned the meath's juice for
Ambrosia, for the festival.

verses.sa:
यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतोऽसृग्रमिन्द ऊतये ।
ताभिः पवित्रमासदः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste dhara madhushchuto'srigraminda utaye |
tabhih pavitramasadah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for help,
Hast settled in the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
सो अर्षेन्द्राय पीतये तिरो रोमाण्यव्यया ।
सीदन्योना वनेष्वा ॥
verses.rom:
so arshendraya pitaye tiro romanyavyaya |
sidanyona vaneshva ||
verses.en:
So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow, to be his drink,
Finding thine home in vats of wood.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्दो परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अङ्गिरोभ्यः ।
वरिवोविद्घृतं पयः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindo pari srava svadishtho angirobhyah |
varivovidghritam payah ||
verses.en:
As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk,
O Indu, for the Angirases.

verses.sa:
अयं विचर्षणिर्हितः पवमानः स चेतति ।
हिन्वान आप्यं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vicharshanirhitah pavamanah sa chetati |
hinvana apyam brihat ||
verses.en:
Most active and benevolent, this Pavamana, sent to us
For lofty friendship, meditates.

verses.sa:
एष वृषा वृषव्रतः पवमानो अशस्तिहा ।
करद्वसूनि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
esha vrisha vrishavratah pavamano ashastiha |
karadvasuni dashushe ||
verses.en:
Queller of curses, mighty, with strong sway, this Pavamana shall
Bring treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् ।
पुरुश्चन्द्रं पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva sahasrinam rayim gomantamashvinam |
purushchandram puruspriham ||
verses.en:
Pour thou upon us thousand fold possessions, both of kine and steeds,
Exceeding glorious, much-desired.

verses.sa:
एष स्य परि षिच्यते मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः ।
उरुगायः कविक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya pari shichyate marmrijyamana ayubhih |
urugayah kavikratuh ||
verses.en:
Wandering far, with wise designs, the juice here present is effused,
Made beautiful by living men.

verses.sa:
सहस्रोतिः शतामघो विमानो रजसः कविः ।
इन्द्राय पवते मदः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrotih shatamagho vimano rajasah kavih |
indraya pavate madah ||
verses.en:
For Indra flows the gladdening drink, the measurer of the region, Sage,
With countless wealth and endless help.

verses.sa:
गिरा जात इह स्तुत इन्दुरिन्द्राय धीयते ।
विर्योना वसताविव ॥
verses.rom:
gira jata iha stuta indurindraya dhiyate |
viryona vasataviva ||
verses.en:
Born on the mountain, lauded here, Indu for Indra is set down,
As in her sheltering nest a bird.

verses.sa:
पवमानः सुतो नृभिः सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ।
चमूषु शक्मनासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanah suto nribhih somo vajamivasarat |
chamushu shakmanasadam ||
verses.en:
Pressed by the men, as 'twere to war hath Soma Pavamana sped,
To test with might within the vats.

verses.sa:
तं त्रिपृष्ठे त्रिवन्धुरे रथे युञ्जन्ति यातवे ।
ऋषीणां सप्त धीतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tam triprishthe trivandhure rathe yunjanti yatave |
rishinam sapta dhitibhih ||
verses.en:
That he may move, they yoke him to the three-backed triple-seated car
By the Seven Rsis' holy songs.

verses.sa:
तं सोतारो धनस्पृतमाशुं वाजाय यातवे ।
हरिं हिनोत वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam sotaro dhanaspritamashum vajaya yatave |
harim hinota vajinam ||
verses.en:
Drive ye that Tawny Courser, O ye pressers, on his way to war,
Swift Steed who carries off the spoil.

verses.sa:
आविशन्कलशं सुतो विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः ।
शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
verses.rom:
avishankalasham suto vishva arshannabhi shriyah |
shuro na goshu tishthati ||
verses.en:
Pouring all glories hither, he, effused and entering the jar,
Stands like a hero mid the kine.

verses.sa:
आ त इन्दो मदाय कं पयो दुहन्त्यायवः ।
देवा देवेभ्यो मधु ॥
verses.rom:
a ta indo madaya kam payo duhantyayavah |
deva devebhyo madhu ||
verses.en:
Indu, the living men milk out the juice to make the rapturous draught:
Gods for the Gods milk out the meath.

verses.sa:
आ नः सोमं पवित्र आ सृजता मधुमत्तमम् ।
देवेभ्यो देवश्रुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
a nah somam pavitra a srijata madhumattamam |
devebhyo devashruttamam ||
verses.en:
Pour for the Gods into the sieve our Soma very rich in sweets,
Him whom the Gods most gladly hear.

verses.sa:
एते सोमा असृक्षत गृणानाः श्रवसे महे ।
मदिन्तमस्य धारया ॥
verses.rom:
ete soma asrikshata grinanah shravase mahe |
madintamasya dharaya ||
verses.en:
Into his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured,
Lauded with songs for lofty fame.

verses.sa:
अभि गव्यानि वीतये नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षसि ।
सनद्वाजः परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gavyani vitaye nrimna punano arshasi |
sanadvajah pari srava ||
verses.en:
Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being cleansed:
Winning the spoil flow hitherward.

verses.sa:
उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः ।
गृणानो जमदग्निना ॥
verses.rom:
uta no gomatirisho vishva arsha parishtubhah |
grinano jamadagnina ||
verses.en:
And, hymned by Jamadagnis, let all nourishment that kine supply,
And general praises, flow to us.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः ।
अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vacho agriyah soma chitrabhirutibhih |
abhi vishvani kavya ||
verses.en:
Soma, as leader of the song flow onward with thy wondrous aids,
For holy lore of every kind.

verses.sa:
त्वं समुद्रिया अपोऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् ।
पवस्व विश्वमेजय ॥
verses.rom:
tvam samudriya apo'griyo vacha irayan |
pavasva vishvamejaya ||
verses.en:
Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea,
Flow onward, thou who movest all.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे ।
तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyema bhuvana kave mahimne soma tasthire |
tubhyamarshanti sindhavah ||
verses.en:
O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to attest thy might:
For thy behoof the rivers flow.

verses.sa:
प्र ते दिवो न वृष्टयो धारा यन्त्यसश्चतः ।
अभि शुक्रामुपस्तिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra te divo na vrishtayo dhara yantyasashchatah |
abhi shukramupastiram ||
verses.en:
Like showers of rain that fall from heaven thy streams perpetually flow
To the bright fleece spread under them.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रायेन्दुं पुनीतनोग्रं दक्षाय साधनम् ।
ईशानं वीतिराधसम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrayendum punitanogram dakshaya sadhanam |
ishanam vitiradhasam ||
verses.en:
For potent Indra purify Indu effectual and strong,
Enjoyment-giver, Mighty Lord.

verses.sa:
पवमान ऋतः कविः सोमः पवित्रमासदत् ।
दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana ritah kavih somah pavitramasadat |
dadhatstotre suviryam ||
verses.en:
Soma, true, Pavamana, Sage, is seated in the cleansing sieve,
Giving his praiser hero strength.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं सोम सुवीर्यम् ।
अस्मे श्रवांसि धारय ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva sahasrinam rayim soma suviryam |
asme shravamsi dharaya ||
verses.en:
POUR hitherward, O Soma, wealth in thousands and heroic strength,
And keep renown secure for us.

verses.sa:
इषमूर्जं च पिन्वस इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमः ।
चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ॥
verses.rom:
ishamurjam cha pinvasa indraya matsarintamah |
chamushva ni shidasi ||
verses.en:
Thou makest food and vigour swell for Indra, best of gladdeners!
Within the cups thou seatest thee.

verses.sa:
सुत इन्द्राय विष्णवे सोमः कलशे अक्षरत् ।
मधुमाँ अस्तु वायवे ॥
verses.rom:
suta indraya vishnave somah kalashe aksharat |
madhuman astu vayave ||
verses.en:
For Indra and for Visnu poured, Soma hath flowed into the jar:
May Vayu find it rich in sweets.

verses.sa:
एते असृग्रमाशवोऽति ह्वरांसि बभ्रवः ।
सोमा ऋतस्य धारया ॥
verses.rom:
ete asrigramashavo'ti hvaramsi babhravah |
soma ritasya dharaya ||
verses.en:
These Somas swift and brown of hue, in stream of solemn sacrifice
Have flowed through twisted obstacles,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वर्धन्तो अप्तुरः कृण्वन्तो विश्वमार्यम् ।
अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः ॥
verses.rom:
indram vardhanto apturah krinvanto vishvamaryam |
apaghnanto aravnah ||
verses.en:
Performing every noble work, active, augmenting Indra's strength,
Driving away the godless ones.

verses.sa:
सुता अनु स्वमा रजोऽभ्यर्षन्ति बभ्रवः ।
इन्द्रं गच्छन्त इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
suta anu svama rajo'bhyarshanti babhravah |
indram gachchhanta indavah ||
verses.en:
Brown Soma-drops, effused that seek Indra, to their appropriate place
Flow through the region hitherward.

verses.sa:
अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः ।
हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः ॥
verses.rom:
aya pavasva dharaya yaya suryamarochayah |
hinvano manushirapah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward with that stream of thine wherewith thou gavest Surya light,
Urging on waters good to men.

verses.sa:
अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि ।
अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
verses.rom:
ayukta sura etasham pavamano manavadhi |
antarikshena yatave ||
verses.en:
He, Pavamana, high o'er man yoked the Sun's courser Etasa
To travel through the realm of air.

verses.sa:
उत त्या हरितो दश सूरो अयुक्त यातवे ।
इन्दुरिन्द्र इति ब्रुवन् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tya harito dasha suro ayukta yatave |
indurindra iti bruvan ||
verses.en:
And those ten Coursers, tawny-hued, he harnessed that the Sun might come
Indu, he said, is Indra's self.

verses.sa:
परीतो वायवे सुतं गिर इन्द्राय मत्सरम् ।
अव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत ॥
verses.rom:
parito vayave sutam gira indraya matsaram |
avyo vareshu sinchata ||
verses.en:
Hence, singers, pour the gladdening juice to Vayu and to Indra, pour
The drops upon the fleecy cloth.

verses.sa:
पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम दुष्टरम् ।
यो दूणाशो वनुष्यता ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana vida rayimasmabhyam soma dushtaram |
yo dunasho vanushyata ||
verses.en:
O Soma Pavamana, find wealth for us not to be assailed,
Wealth which the foeman may not win.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्ष सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् ।
अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarsha sahasrinam rayim gomantamashvinam |
abhi vajamuta shravah ||
verses.en:
Send riches hither with thy stream in thousands, both of steeds and kine,
Send spoil of war and high renown.

verses.sa:
सोमो देवो न सूर्योऽद्रिभिः पवते सुतः ।
दधानः कलशे रसम् ॥
verses.rom:
somo devo na suryo'dribhih pavate sutah |
dadhanah kalashe rasam ||
verses.en:
Soma the God, expressed with stones, like Surya, floweth on his way,
Pouring the juice within the jar.

verses.sa:
एते धामान्यार्या शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया ।
वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥
verses.rom:
ete dhamanyarya shukra ritasya dharaya |
vajam gomantamaksharan ||
verses.en:
These brilliant drops have poured for us, in stream of solemn sacrifice,
Worshipful laws and strength in kine.

verses.sa:
सुता इन्द्राय वज्रिणे सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।
पवित्रमत्यक्षरन् ॥
verses.rom:
suta indraya vajrine somaso dadhyashirah |
pavitramatyaksharan ||
verses.en:
Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Somas, blent with curdled milk,
Effused for Indra Thunder-armed.

verses.sa:
प्र सोम मधुमत्तमो राये अर्ष पवित्र आ ।
मदो यो देववीतमः ॥
verses.rom:
pra soma madhumattamo raye arsha pavitra a |
mado yo devavitamah ||
verses.en:
Soma, do thou most rich in sweets, a gladdening drink most dear to Gods,
Flow to the sieve to bring us wealth.

verses.sa:
तमी मृजन्त्यायवो हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tami mrijantyayavo harim nadishu vajinam |
indumindraya matsaram ||
verses.en:
For Indra, living men adorn the Tawny Courser in the streams,
Indu, the giver of delight.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व हिरण्यवदश्वावत्सोम वीरवत् ।
वाजं गोमन्तमा भर ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva hiranyavadashvavatsoma viravat |
vajam gomantama bhara ||
verses.en:
Pour for us, Soma, wealth in gold, in horses and heroic sons,
Bring hither strength in herds of kine.

verses.sa:
परि वाजे न वाजयुमव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत ।
इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
pari vaje na vajayumavyo vareshu sinchata |
indraya madhumattamam ||
verses.en:
For Indra pour ye on the fleece him very sweet to taste, who longs.
For battle as it were in war.

verses.sa:
कविं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः ।
वृषा कनिक्रदर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
kavim mrijanti marjyam dhibhirvipra avasyavah |
vrisha kanikradarshati ||
verses.en:
The singers, seeking help, adorn the Sage who must be decked with songs:
Loud bellowing the Steer comes on,

verses.sa:
वृषणं धीभिरप्तुरं सोममृतस्य धारया ।
मती विप्राः समस्वरन् ॥
verses.rom:
vrishanam dhibhirapturam somamritasya dharaya |
mati viprah samasvaran ||
verses.en:
The singers with their thoughts and hymns have, in the stream of sacrifice,
Caused Soma, active Steer, to roar.

verses.sa:
पवस्व देवायुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः ।
वायुमा रोह धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva devayushagindram gachchhatu te madah |
vayuma roha dharmana ||
verses.en:
God, working with mankind, flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice:
To Vayu mount as Law commands

verses.sa:
पवमान नि तोशसे रयिं सोम श्रवाय्यम् ।
प्रियः समुद्रमा विश ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana ni toshase rayim soma shravayyam |
priyah samudrama visha ||
verses.en:
O Soma, Pavamana, thou pourest out wealth that brings renown:
Enter the lake, as one we love.

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः ।
नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
apaghnanpavase mridhah kratuvitsoma matsarah |
nudasvadevayum janam ||
verses.en:
Soma thou flowest chasing foes and bringing wisdom and delight:
Drive off the folk who love not Gods.

verses.sa:
पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः ।
अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana asrikshata somah shukrasa indavah |
abhi vishvani kavya ||
verses.en:
The Pavamanas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice,
For holy lore of every kind.

verses.sa:
पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिन्दवः ।
घ्नन्तो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasa ashavah shubhra asrigramindavah |
ghnanto vishva apa dvishah ||
verses.en:
The Pavamanas have been shed, the beautiful swift Soma-drops,
Driving all enemies afar.

verses.sa:
पवमाना दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षादसृक्षत ।
पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana divasparyantarikshadasrikshata |
prithivya adhi sanavi ||
verses.en:
From, heaven, from out the firmament, hath Pavamana been effused
Upon the summit of the earth.

verses.sa:
पुनानः सोम धारयेन्दो विश्वा अप स्रिधः ।
जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो ॥
verses.rom:
punanah soma dharayendo vishva apa sridhah |
jahi rakshamsi sukrato ||
verses.en:
O Soma, Indu, very wise, drive, being purified, with thy stream
All foes, all Raksasas away.

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्सोम रक्षसोऽभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् ।
द्युमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
apaghnansoma rakshaso'bhyarsha kanikradat |
dyumantam shushmamuttamam ||
verses.en:
Driving the Raksasas afar, O Soma, bellowing, pour for us
Most excellent and splendid strength.

verses.sa:
अस्मे वसूनि धारय सोम दिव्यानि पार्थिवा ।
इन्दो विश्वानि वार्या ॥
verses.rom:
asme vasuni dharaya soma divyani parthiva |
indo vishvani varya ||
verses.en:
Soma, do thou secure for us the treasures of the earth and heaven,
Indu, all boons to be desired.

verses.sa:
वृषा सोम द्युमाँ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः ।
वृषा धर्माणि दधिषे ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha soma dyuman asi vrisha deva vrishavratah |
vrisha dharmani dadhishe ||
verses.en:
Soma, thou art a splendid Steer, a Steer, O God, with steer like sway:
Thou as a Steer ordainest laws.

verses.sa:
वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यं शवो वृषा वनं वृषा मदः ।
सत्यं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
verses.rom:
vrishnaste vrishnyam shavo vrisha vanam vrisha madah |
satyam vrishanvrishedasi ||
verses.en:
Steer-strong thy might is as a steer's, steer strong thy wood, steer-like thy drink
A Steer indeed, O Steer, art thou.

verses.sa:
अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः ।
वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
verses.rom:
ashvo na chakrado vrisha sam ga indo samarvatah |
vi no raye duro vridhi ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine:
Unbar for us the doors to wealth.

verses.sa:
असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया ।
शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः ॥
verses.rom:
asrikshata pra vajino gavya somaso ashvaya |
shukraso virayashavah ||
verses.en:
Out of desire of cows and steeds and horses. potent Soma-drops,
Brilliant and swift, have been effused.

verses.sa:
शुम्भमाना ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमाना गभस्त्योः ।
पवन्ते वारे अव्यये ॥
verses.rom:
shumbhamana ritayubhirmrijyamana gabhastyoh |
pavante vare avyaye ||
verses.en:
They purified in both the hands, made beautiful by holy men,
Flow onward to the fleecy cloth.

verses.sa:
ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा ।
पवन्तामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥
verses.rom:
te vishva dashushe vasu soma divyani parthiva |
pavantamantarikshya ||
verses.en:
These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipper
From heaven and earth and firmament.

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य विश्ववित्प्र ते सर्गा असृक्षत ।
सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya vishvavitpra te sarga asrikshata |
suryasyeva na rashmayah ||
verses.en:
The streams of Pavamana, thine, Finder of all, have been effused,
Even as Surya's rays of light.

verses.sa:
केतुं कृण्वन्दिवस्परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि ।
समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे ॥
verses.rom:
ketum krinvandivaspari vishva rupabhyarshasi |
samudrah soma pinvase ||
verses.en:
Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form
Soma, thou swellest like a sea.

verses.sa:
हिन्वानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि ।
अक्रान्देवो न सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
hinvano vachamishyasi pavamana vidharmani |
akrandevo na suryah ||
verses.en:
Urged on thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamana; thou hast moved,
Like the God Surya, to the sieve.

verses.sa:
इन्दुः पविष्ट चेतनः प्रियः कवीनां मती ।
सृजदश्वं रथीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
induh pavishta chetanah priyah kavinam mati |
srijadashvam rathiriva ||
verses.en:
Indu, Enlightener, Friend, hath been purified by the sages' hymns:
So starts the charioteer his steed-

verses.sa:
ऊर्मिर्यस्ते पवित्र आ देवावीः पर्यक्षरत् ।
सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
urmiryaste pavitra a devavih paryaksharat |
sidannritasya yonima ||
verses.en:
Thy God-delighting wave which hath flowed to purifying seive,
Alighting in the home of Law.

verses.sa:
स नो अर्ष पवित्र आ मदो यो देववीतमः ।
इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
sa no arsha pavitra a mado yo devavitamah |
indavindraya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Flow to our sieve, a gladdening draught that hath most intercourse with Gods,
Indu, to Indra for his drink.

verses.sa:
इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः ।
इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि ॥
verses.rom:
ishe pavasva dharaya mrijyamano manishibhih |
indo ruchabhi ga ihi ||
verses.en:
Flow onward with a stream for food, made beautiful by sapient men:
Indu with sheen approach the milk.

verses.sa:
पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः ।
हरे सृजान आशिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
punano varivaskridhyurjam janaya girvanah |
hare srijana ashiram ||
verses.en:
While thou art cleansed, Song-Lover, bring comfort and vigour to the folk,
Poured, Tawny One! on milk and curds.

verses.sa:
पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्कृतम् ।
द्युतानो वाजिभिर्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
punano devavitaya indrasya yahi nishkritam |
dyutano vajibhiryatah ||
verses.en:
Purified for the feast of Gods, go thou to Indra's special place,
Resplendent, guided by the strong.

verses.sa:
प्र हिन्वानास इन्दवोऽच्छा समुद्रमाशवः ।
धिया जूता असृक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
pra hinvanasa indavo'chchha samudramashavah |
dhiya juta asrikshata ||
verses.en:
Accelerated by the hymn, the rapid drops of Soma juice
Have flowed, urged onward, to the lake.

verses.sa:
मर्मृजानास आयवो वृथा समुद्रमिन्दवः ।
अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
marmrijanasa ayavo vritha samudramindavah |
agmannritasya yonima ||
verses.en:
Easily have the living drops, made beautiful, approached the lake,
Yea, to the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
परि णो याह्यस्मयुर्विश्वा वसून्योजसा ।
पाहि नः शर्म वीरवत् ॥
verses.rom:
pari no yahyasmayurvishva vasunyojasa |
pahi nah sharma viravat ||
verses.en:
Compass about, our faithful Friend, all our possessions with thy might:
Guard, hero like, our sheltering home.

verses.sa:
मिमाति वह्निरेतशः पदं युजान ऋक्वभिः ।
प्र यत्समुद्र आहितः ॥
verses.rom:
mimati vahniretashah padam yujana rikvabhih |
pra yatsamudra ahitah ||
verses.en:
Loud neighs the Courser Etasa, with singers, harnessed for the place,
Guided for travel to the lake.

verses.sa:
आ यद्योनिं हिरण्ययमाशुरृतस्य सीदति ।
जहात्यप्रचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
a yadyonim hiranyayamashurritasya sidati |
jahatyaprachetasah ||
verses.en:
What time the Swift One resteth in the golden place of sacrifice,
He leaves the foolish far away.

verses.sa:
अभि वेना अनूषतेयक्षन्ति प्रचेतसः ।
मज्जन्त्यविचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vena anushateyakshanti prachetasah |
majjantyavichetasah ||
verses.en:
The friends have sung in unison, the prudent wish to sacrifice:
Down sink the unintelligent.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः ।
ऋतस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrayendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamah |
ritasya yonimasadam ||
verses.en:
For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in sweets,
To sit in place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परि ष्कृण्वन्ति वेधसः ।
सं त्वा मृजन्त्यायवः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva vipra vachovidah pari shkrinvanti vedhasah |
sam tva mrijantyayavah ||
verses.en:
Controlling priests and sages skilled in holy song adorn thee well:
The living make thee beautiful.

verses.sa:
रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्ति वरुणः कवे ।
पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
verses.rom:
rasam te mitro aryama pibanti varunah kave |
pavamanasya marutah ||
verses.en:
Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna drink Pavamana's juice, yea, thine:
O Sage, the Maruts drink thereof.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम विपश्चितं पुनानो वाचमिष्यसि ।
इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma vipashchitam punano vachamishyasi |
indo sahasrabharnasam ||
verses.en:
O Soma, Indu, thou while thou art purified urgest onward speech.
Thousand fold, with the lore of hymns.

verses.sa:
उतो सहस्रभर्णसं वाचं सोम मखस्युवम् ।
पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥
verses.rom:
uto sahasrabharnasam vacham soma makhasyuvam |
punana indava bhara ||
verses.en:
Yea, Soma, Indu, while thou art purified do thou bring to us
Speech thousand fold that longs for war.

verses.sa:
पुनान इन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् ।
प्रियः समुद्रमा विश ॥
verses.rom:
punana indavesham puruhuta jananam |
priyah samudrama visha ||
verses.en:
O Indu, Much-invoked, while thou art purifying, as the Friend.
Of these men enter thou the lake.

verses.sa:
दविद्युतत्या रुचा परिष्टोभन्त्या कृपा ।
सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः ॥
verses.rom:
davidyutatya rucha parishtobhantya kripa |
somah shukra gavashirah ||
verses.en:
Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly.
And form that utters loud acclaim.

verses.sa:
हिन्वानो हेतृभिर्यत आ वाजं वाज्यक्रमीत् ।
सीदन्तो वनुषो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
hinvano hetribhiryata a vajam vajyakramit |
sidanto vanusho yatha ||
verses.en:
Led by his drivers, and sent forth, the Strong Steed hath come nigh for spoil,
Like warriors when they stand arrayed.

verses.sa:
ऋधक्सोम स्वस्तये संजग्मानो दिवः कविः ।
पवस्व सूर्यो दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
ridhaksoma svastaye samjagmano divah kavih |
pavasva suryo drishe ||
verses.en:
Specially, Soma, coming as a Sage from heaven to prosper us,
Flow like the Sun for us to see.

verses.sa:
हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिम् ।
महामिन्दुं महीयुवः ॥
verses.rom:
hinvanti suramusrayah svasaro jamayaspatim |
mahamindum mahiyuvah ||
verses.en:
THE, glittering maids send Sura forth, the glorious sisters, close-allied,
Send Indu forth, their mighty Lord.

verses.sa:
पवमान रुचारुचा देवो देवेभ्यस्परि ।
विश्वा वसून्या विश ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana rucharucha devo devebhyaspari |
vishva vasunya visha ||
verses.en:
Pervade, O Pavamana, all our treasures with repeated light,
God, coming hither from the Gods.

verses.sa:
आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः ।
इषे पवस्व संयतम् ॥
verses.rom:
a pavamana sushtutim vrishtim devebhyo duvah |
ishe pavasva samyatam ||
verses.en:
Pour on us, Pavamana, rain, as service and rain praise for Gods:
Pour all to be our nourishment.

verses.sa:
वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे ।
पवमान स्वाध्यः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha hyasi bhanuna dyumantam tva havamahe |
pavamana svadhyah ||
verses.en:
Thou art a Steer by lustre: we, O Pavamana, faithfully
Call upon thee the Splendid One.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः स्वायुध ।
इहो ष्विन्दवा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva suviryam mandamanah svayudha |
iho shvindava gahi ||
verses.en:
Do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength:
O Indu, come thou bitherward.

verses.sa:
यदद्भिः परिषिच्यसे मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः ।
द्रुणा सधस्थमश्नुषे ॥
verses.rom:
yadadbhih parishichyase mrijyamano gabhastyoh |
druna sadhasthamashnushe ||
verses.en:
When thou art cleansed with both the hands and dipped in waters, with the wood.
Thou comest to the gathering-place.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमाय व्यश्ववत्पवमानाय गायत ।
महे सहस्रचक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
pra somaya vyashvavatpavamanaya gayata |
mahe sahasrachakshase ||
verses.en:
Sing forth your songs, as Vyasva sang, to Soma Pavamana, to,
The Mighty One with thousand eyes;

verses.sa:
यस्य वर्णं मधुश्चुतं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
yasya varnam madhushchutam harim hinvantyadribhih |
indumindraya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Whose coloured sap they drive with stones, the yellow meath-distilling juice,
Indu for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa:
तस्य ते वाजिनो वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः ।
सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tasya te vajino vayam vishva dhanani jigyushah |
sakhitvama vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
We seek to gain the friendly love of thee that Strong and Mighty One,
Of thee the winner of all wealth.

verses.sa:
वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः ।
विश्वा दधान ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha pavasva dharaya marutvate cha matsarah |
vishva dadhana ojasa ||
verses.en:
Flow onward with thy stream, a Steer, inspiriting the Maruts' Lord,
Winning all riches by thy might.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा धर्तारमोण्योः पवमान स्वर्दृशम् ।
हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva dhartaramonyoh pavamana svardrisham |
hinve vajeshu vajinam ||
verses.en:
I send thee forth to battle from the press, O Pavamana, Strong,
Sustainer, looker on the light.

verses.sa:
अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया ।
युजं वाजेषु चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
aya chitto vipanaya harih pavasva dharaya |
yujam vajeshu chodaya ||
verses.en:
Acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawny-coloured, with thy stream
Incite to battle thine ally.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्दो महीमिषं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः ।
अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
verses.rom:
a na indo mahimisham pavasva vishvadarshatah |
asmabhyam soma gatuvit ||
verses.en:
O Indu, visible to all pour out for us abundant food:
Soma, be thou our prosperer.

verses.sa:
आ कलशा अनूषतेन्दो धाराभिरोजसा ।
एन्द्रस्य पीतये विश ॥
verses.rom:
a kalasha anushatendo dharabhirojasa |
endrasya pitaye visha ||
verses.en:
The pitchers, Indu, with thy streams have sung aloud in vigorous might
Enter them, and let Indra drink.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते मद्यं रसं तीव्रं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
स पवस्वाभिमातिहा ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te madyam rasam tivram duhantyadribhih |
sa pavasvabhimatiha ||
verses.en:
O thou whose potent gladdening juice they milk out with the stones, flow on,
Destroyer of our enemies.

verses.sa:
राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि ।
अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
verses.rom:
raja medhabhiriyate pavamano manavadhi |
antarikshena yatave ||
verses.en:
King Pavamana is implored with holy songs, on man's behalf,
To travel through the firmament.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यम् ।
वहा भगत्तिमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
a na indo shatagvinam gavam posham svashvyam |
vaha bhagattimutaye ||
verses.en:
Bring us, O Indu, hundredfold increase of kine, and noble steeds,
The gift of fortune for our help.

verses.sa:
आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर ।
सुष्वाणो देववीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a nah soma saho juvo rupam na varchase bhara |
sushvano devavitaye ||
verses.en:
Pressed for the banquet of the Gods, O Soma, bring us might, and speed,
Like beauty for a brilliant show.

verses.sa:
अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमोऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् ।
सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
arsha soma dyumattamo'bhi dronani roruvat |
sidanchhyeno na yonima ||
verses.en:
Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the wooden vats,
Falcon-like resting in thine home.

verses.sa:
अप्सा इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः ।
सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
apsa indraya vayave varunaya marudbhyah |
somo arshati vishnave ||
verses.en:
Soma, the Water-winner flows to Indra, Vayu, Varuna,
To Visnu and the Marut host.

verses.sa:
इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः ।
आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
isham tokaya no dadhadasmabhyam soma vishvatah |
a pavasva sahasrinam ||
verses.en:
Soma , bestowing food upon our progeny, from every sides,
Pour on us riches thousand fold

verses.sa:
ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे ।
ये वादः शर्यणावति ॥
verses.rom:
ye somasah paravati ye arvavati sunvire |
ye vadah sharyanavati ||
verses.en:
The Soma juices which have been expressed afar or near at hand,
Or there on Saryanavan's bank,

verses.sa:
य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानाम् ।
ये वा जनेषु पञ्चसु ॥
verses.rom:
ya arjikeshu kritvasu ye madhye pastyanam |
ye va janeshu panchasu ||
verses.en:
Those pressed among Arjikas, pressed among the active, in men's homes,
Or pressed among the Races Five-

verses.sa:
ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् ।
सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
te no vrishtim divaspari pavantama suviryam |
suvana devasa indavah ||
verses.en:
May these celestial drops, expressed, pour forth upon us, as they flow,
Rain from the heavens apd hero strength.

verses.sa:
पवते हर्यतो हरिर्गृणानो जमदग्निना ।
हिन्वानो गोरधि त्वचि ॥
verses.rom:
pavate haryato harirgrinano jamadagnina |
hinvano goradhi tvachi ||
verses.en:
Urged forward o'er the ox-hide flows the Lovely One of tawny hue,
Lauded by Jamadagni's song.

verses.sa:
प्र शुक्रासो वयोजुवो हिन्वानासो न सप्तयः ।
श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत ॥
verses.rom:
pra shukraso vayojuvo hinvanaso na saptayah |
shrinana apsu mrinjata ||
verses.en:
Like horses urged to speed, the drops, bright, stirring vital power, when blent
With milk, are beautified in streams.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा सुतेष्वाभुवो हिन्विरे देवतातये ।
स पवस्वानया रुचा ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva suteshvabhuvo hinvire devatataye |
sa pavasvanaya rucha ||
verses.en:
So they who toil with juices send thee forward for the Gods' repast:
So with this splendour flow thou on.

verses.sa:
आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे ।
पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
a te daksham mayobhuvam vahnimadya vrinimahe |
pantama puruspriham ||
verses.en:
We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the Strong, that brings us bliss,
The Guardian, the desire of all,

verses.sa:
आ मन्द्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणम् ।
पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
a mandrama varenyama viprama manishinam |
pantama puruspriham ||
verses.en:
The Excellent, the Gladdener, the Sage with heart that understands,
The Guardian, the desire of all;

verses.sa:
आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा ।
पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
a rayima suchetunama sukrato tanushva |
pantama puruspriham ||
verses.en:
Who for ourselves, O thou Most Wise, is wealth and fair intelligence,
The Guardian, the desire of all.

verses.sa:
पवस्व विश्वचर्षणेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या ।
सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vishvacharshane'bhi vishvani kavya |
sakha sakhibhya idyah ||
verses.en:
FOR holy lore of every sort, flow onward thou whom all men love.
A Friend to be besought by friends.

verses.sa:
ताभ्यां विश्वस्य राजसि ये पवमान धामनी ।
प्रतीची सोम तस्थतुः ॥
verses.rom:
tabhyam vishvasya rajasi ye pavamana dhamani |
pratichi soma tasthatuh ||
verses.en:
O'er all thou rulest with these Two which, Soma Pavamana, stand,
Turned, as thy stations, hitherward.

verses.sa:
परि धामानि यानि ते त्वं सोमासि विश्वतः ।
पवमान ऋतुभिः कवे ॥
verses.rom:
pari dhamani yani te tvam somasi vishvatah |
pavamana ritubhih kave ||
verses.en:
Wise Soma Pavamana, thou encompassest on every side
Thy stations as the seasons come.

verses.sa:
पवस्व जनयन्निषोऽभि विश्वानि वार्या ।
सखा सखिभ्य ऊतये ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva janayannisho'bhi vishvani varya |
sakha sakhibhya utaye ||
verses.en:
Flow onward, generating food, for precious boons of every kind,
A Friend for friends, to be our help.

verses.sa:
तव शुक्रासो अर्चयो दिवस्पृष्ठे वि तन्वते ।
पवित्रं सोम धामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tava shukraso archayo divasprishthe vi tanvate |
pavitram soma dhamabhih ||
verses.en:
Upon the lofty ridge of heaven thy bright rays with their essences,
Soma, spread purifying power.

verses.sa:
तवेमे सप्त सिन्धवः प्रशिषं सोम सिस्रते ।
तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः ॥
verses.rom:
taveme sapta sindhavah prashisham soma sisrate |
tubhyam dhavanti dhenavah ||
verses.en:
O Soma, these Seven Rivers flow, as being thine, to give command:
The Streams of milk run forth to thee.

verses.sa:
प्र सोम याहि धारया सुत इन्द्राय मत्सरः ।
दधानो अक्षिति श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra soma yahi dharaya suta indraya matsarah |
dadhano akshiti shravah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward, Soma in a stream, effused to gladden Indra's heart,
Bringing imperishable fame.

verses.sa:
समु त्वा धीभिरस्वरन्हिन्वतीः सप्त जामयः ।
विप्रमाजा विवस्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
samu tva dhibhirasvaranhinvatih sapta jamayah |
vipramaja vivasvatah ||
verses.en:
Driving thee in Vivasvan's course, the Seven Sisters with their hymns
Made melody round thee the Sage.

verses.sa:
मृजन्ति त्वा समग्रुवोऽव्ये जीरावधि ष्वणि ।
रेभो यदज्यसे वने ॥
verses.rom:
mrijanti tva samagruvo'vye jiravadhi shvani |
rebho yadajyase vane ||
verses.en:
The virgins deck thee o'er fresh streams to drive thee to the sieve when thou,
A singer, bathest in the wood.

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन् त्सर्गा असृक्षत ।
अर्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya te kave vajin tsarga asrikshata |
arvanto na shravasyavah ||
verses.en:
The streams of Pavamana, thine, Sage, Mighty One, have pouredthem forth.
Like coursers eager for renown.

verses.sa:
अच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतमसृग्रं वारे अव्यये ।
अवावशन्त धीतयः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha kosham madhushchutamasrigram vare avyaye |
avavashanta dhitayah ||
verses.en:
They have been poured upon the fleece towards the meath-distilling vat:
The holy songs have sounded forth.

verses.sa:
अच्छा समुद्रमिन्दवोऽस्तं गावो न धेनवः ।
अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
verses.rom:
achchha samudramindavo'stam gavo na dhenavah |
agmannritasya yonima ||
verses.en:
Like milch-kine coming home, the drops of Soma juice have reached the lake,
Have reached the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
प्र ण इन्दो महे रण आपो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः ।
यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
pra na indo mahe rana apo arshanti sindhavah |
yadgobhirvasayishyase ||
verses.en:
O Indu, to our great delight the running waters flow to us,
When thou wilt robe thyself in milk.

verses.sa:
अस्य ते सख्ये वयमियक्षन्तस्त्वोतयः ।
इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
asya te sakhye vayamiyakshantastvotayah |
indo sakhitvamushmasi ||
verses.en:
In this thy friendship, and with thee to help us, fain to sacrifice,
Indu, we crave thy friendly love.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व गविष्टये महे सोम नृचक्षसे ।
एन्द्रस्य जठरे विश ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva gavishtaye mahe soma nrichakshase |
endrasya jathare visha ||
verses.en:
Flow on, O Soma, for the great Viewer of men, for gain of Idne
Enter thou into Indra's throat.

verses.sa:
महाँ असि सोम ज्येष्ठ उग्राणामिन्द ओजिष्ठः ।
युध्वा सञ्छश्वज्जिगेथ ॥
verses.rom:
mahan asi soma jyeshtha ugranaminda ojishthah |
yudhva sanchhashvajjigetha ||
verses.en:
Best art thou, Soma, of the great, Strongest of strong ones, Indu: thou
As Warrior ever hast prevailed.

verses.sa:
य उग्रेभ्यश्चिदोजीयाञ्छूरेभ्यश्चिच्छूरतरः ।
भूरिदाभ्यश्चिन्मंहीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
ya ugrebhyashchidojiyanchhurebhyashchichchhuratarah |
bhuridabhyashchinmamhiyan ||
verses.en:
Mightier even than the strong, more valiant even than the brave,
More liberal than the bountiful,

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम सूर एषस्तोकस्य साता तनूनाम् ।
वृणीमहे सख्याय वृणीमहे युज्याय ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma sura eshastokasya sata tanunam |
vrinimahe sakhyaya vrinimahe yujyaya ||
verses.en:
Soma, as Sura, bring us food, win offspring of our bodies: we
Elect thee for our friendship, we elect thee for companionship.

verses.sa:
अग्न आयूंषि पवस आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः ।
आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agna ayumshi pavasa a suvorjamisham cha nah |
are badhasva duchchhunam ||
verses.en:
Agni, thou pourest life; send down upon us food and vigorous strength;
Drive thou misfortune far away,

verses.sa:
अग्निर्ऋषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः ।
तमीमहे महागयम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirrishih pavamanah panchajanyah purohitah |
tamimahe mahagayam ||
verses.en:
Agni is Pavamana, Sage, Chief Priest of all the Races Five:
To him whose wealth is great we pray.

verses.sa:
अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम् ।
दधद्रयिं मयि पोषम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne pavasva svapa asme varchah suviryam |
dadhadrayim mayi posham ||
verses.en:
Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour splendour with hero strength on us,
Granting me wealth that nourishes.

verses.sa:
पवमानो अति स्रिधोऽभ्यर्षति सुष्टुतिम् ।
सूरो न विश्वदर्शतः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano ati sridho'bhyarshati sushtutim |
suro na vishvadarshatah ||
verses.en:
Beyond his enemies away to sweet praise Pavamana flows,
Like Surya visible to all.

verses.sa:
स मर्मृजान आयुभिः प्रयस्वान्प्रयसे हितः ।
इन्दुरत्यो विचक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
sa marmrijana ayubhih prayasvanprayase hitah |
induratyo vichakshanah ||
verses.en:
Adorned by living men, set forth for entertainment, rich in food,
Far-sighted Indu is a Steed.

verses.sa:
पवमान ऋतं बृहच्छुक्रं ज्योतिरजीजनत् ।
कृष्णा तमांसि जङ्घनत् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana ritam brihachchhukram jyotirajijanat |
krishna tamamsi janghanat ||
verses.en:
He, Pavamana, hath produced the lofty Law, the brilliant light,
Destroying darkness black of hue.

verses.sa:
पवमानस्य जङ्घ्नतो हरेश्चन्द्रा असृक्षत ।
जीरा अजिरशोचिषः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasya janghnato hareshchandra asrikshata |
jira ajirashochishah ||
verses.en:
From tawny Pavamana, the Destroyer, radiant streams have sprung,
Quick streams from him whose gleams are swift.

verses.sa:
पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः ।
हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano rathitamah shubhrebhih shubhrashastamah |
harishchandro marudganah ||
verses.en:
Best rider of the chariot, praised with fairest praise mid beauteous ones,
Gold-gleaming with the Marut host,

verses.sa:
पवमानो व्यश्नवद्रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः ।
दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano vyashnavadrashmibhirvajasatamah |
dadhatstotre suviryam ||
verses.en:
May Pavamana, best to win the booty, penetrate with rays,
Giving the singer hero strength.

verses.sa:
प्र सुवान इन्दुरक्षाः पवित्रमत्यव्ययम् ।
पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥
verses.rom:
pra suvana indurakshah pavitramatyavyayam |
punana indurindrama ||
verses.en:
Over the fleecy sieve hath flowed the drop effused: to Indra comes
Indu while he is purified

verses.sa:
एष सोमो अधि त्वचि गवां क्रीळत्यद्रिभिः ।
इन्द्रं मदाय जोहुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
esha somo adhi tvachi gavam krilatyadribhih |
indram madaya johuvat ||
verses.en:
This Soma, through the pressing-stones, is sporting on the oxhide, and
Summoning Indra to the draught.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते द्युम्नवत्पयः पवमानाभृतं दिवः ।
तेन नो मृळ जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te dyumnavatpayah pavamanabhritam divah |
tena no mrila jivase ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, bless us, so that we may live, with that bright milk
Of thine which hath been brought from heaven.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे ।
पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam somasi dharayurmandra ojishtho adhvare |
pavasva mamhayadrayih ||
verses.en:
THOU, Soma, hast a running stream, joyous, most strong at sacrifice:
Flow bounteously bestowing wealth.

verses.sa:
त्वं सुतो नृमादनो दधन्वान्मत्सरिन्तमः ।
इन्द्राय सूरिरन्धसा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam suto nrimadano dadhanvanmatsarintamah |
indraya surirandhasa ||
verses.en:
Effused as cheerer of the men, flowing best gladdener, thou art
A Prince to Indra with thy juice.

verses.sa:
त्वं सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् ।
द्युमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam sushvano adribhirabhyarsha kanikradat |
dyumantam shushmamuttamam ||
verses.en:
Poured forth by pressing-stones, do thou with loud roar send us in a stream
Most excellent illustrious might.

verses.sa:
इन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति तिरो वाराण्यव्यया ।
हरिर्वाजमचिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
indurhinvano arshati tiro varanyavyaya |
harirvajamachikradat ||
verses.en:
Indu, urged forward, floweth through the fleecy cloth: the Tawny One
With his loud roar hath brought as strength.

verses.sa:
इन्दो व्यव्यमर्षसि वि श्रवांसि वि सौभगा ।
वि वाजान्सोम गोमतः ॥
verses.rom:
indo vyavyamarshasi vi shravamsi vi saubhaga |
vi vajansoma gomatah ||
verses.en:
Indu, thou flowest through the fleece, bringing felicities and fame,
And, Soma, spoil and wealth in kine.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् ।
भरा सोम सहस्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
a na indo shatagvinam rayim gomantamashvinam |
bhara soma sahasrinam ||
verses.en:
Hither, O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds and cattle hundredfold:
Bring wealth, O Soma, thousand fold.

verses.sa:
पवमानास इन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः ।
इन्द्रं यामेभिराशत ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanasa indavastirah pavitramashavah |
indram yamebhirashata ||
verses.en:
In purifying, through the sieve the rapid drops of'Soma juice
Come nigh to Indra in their course.

verses.sa:
ककुहः सोम्यो रस इन्दुरिन्द्राय पूर्व्यः ।
आयुः पवत आयवे ॥
verses.rom:
kakuhah somyo rasa indurindraya purvyah |
ayuh pavata ayave ||
verses.en:
For Indra floweth excellent Indu, the noblest Soma juice
The Living for the Living One.

verses.sa:
हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् ।
अभि गिरा समस्वरन् ॥
verses.rom:
hinvanti suramusrayah pavamanam madhushchutam |
abhi gira samasvaran ||
verses.en:
The glittering maids send Sura forth they with their song have sung aloud
To Pavamana dropping meath.

verses.sa:
अविता नो अजाश्वः पूषा यामनियामनि ।
आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
verses.rom:
avita no ajashvah pusha yamaniyamani |
a bhakshatkanyasu nah ||
verses.en:
May Pusan, drawn by goats, be our protector, and on all his paths
Bestow on us our share of maids.

verses.sa:
अयं सोमः कपर्दिने घृतं न पवते मधु ।
आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam somah kapardine ghritam na pavate madhu |
a bhakshatkanyasu nah ||
verses.en:
This Soma flows like gladdening oil for him who wears the braided locks:
He shall give us our share of maids.

verses.sa:
अयं त आघृणे सुतो घृतं न पवते शुचि ।
आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam ta aghrine suto ghritam na pavate shuchi |
a bhakshatkanyasu nah ||
verses.en:
This Soma juice, O glowing God, flows like pure oil, effused for thee:
He shall give us our share of maids.

verses.sa:
वाचो जन्तुः कवीनां पवस्व सोम धारया ।
देवेषु रत्नधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
vacho jantuh kavinam pavasva soma dharaya |
deveshu ratnadha asi ||
verses.en:
Flow onward, Soma, in thy stream, begetter of the sages' speech:
Wealth-giver among Gods art thou.

verses.sa:
आ कलशेषु धावति श्येनो वर्म वि गाहते ।
अभि द्रोणा कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
a kalasheshu dhavati shyeno varma vi gahate |
abhi drona kanikradat ||
verses.en:
The Falcon dips within the jars: he wrap him in his robe and goes
Loud roaring to the vats of wood.

verses.sa:
परि प्र सोम ते रसोऽसर्जि कलशे सुतः ।
श्येनो न तक्तो अर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
pari pra soma te raso'sarji kalashe sutah |
shyeno na takto arshati ||
verses.en:
Soma, thy juice hath been effused and poured into the pitcher: like
A rapid hawk it rushes on.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम मन्दयन्निन्द्राय मधुमत्तमः ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma mandayannindraya madhumattamah ||
verses.en: For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight.

verses.sa: असृग्रन्देववीतये वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥
verses.rom: asrigrandevavitaye vajayanto ratha iva ||
verses.en: They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots that display their strength.

verses.sa: ते सुतासो मदिन्तमाः शुक्रा वायुमसृक्षत ॥
verses.rom: te sutaso madintamah shukra vayumasrikshata ||
verses.en: Brilliant, best givers of delight, these juices have sent Vayu forth.

verses.sa:
ग्राव्णा तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि ।
दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
