gravna tunno abhishtutah pavitram soma gachchhasi |
dadhatstotre suviryam ||
verses.en:
Bruised by the press-stones and extolled, Soma, thou goest to the sieve,
Giving the worshipper hero strength.

verses.sa:
एष तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रमति गाहते ।
रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha tunno abhishtutah pavitramati gahate |
rakshoha varamavyayam ||
verses.en:
This juice bruised by the pressing-stones and lauded passes through the sieve,
Slayer of demons, through the fleece.

verses.sa:
यदन्ति यच्च दूरके भयं विन्दति मामिह ।
पवमान वि तज्जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yadanti yachcha durake bhayam vindati mamiha |
pavamana vi tajjahi ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, drive away the danger, whether near at hand
Or far remote, that finds me here.

verses.sa:
पवमानः सो अद्य नः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः ।
यः पोता स पुनातु नः ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanah so adya nah pavitrena vicharshanih |
yah pota sa punatu nah ||
verses.en:
This day may Pavamana cleanse us with his purifying power,
Most active purifying Priest.

verses.sa:
यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिष्यग्ने विततमन्तरा ।
ब्रह्म तेन पुनीहि नः ॥
verses.rom:
yatte pavitramarchishyagne vitatamantara |
brahma tena punihi nah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, with the cleansing light diffused through all thy fiery glow,
Purify thou this prayer of ours.

verses.sa:
यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिवदग्ने तेन पुनीहि नः ।
ब्रह्मसवैः पुनीहि नः ॥
verses.rom:
yatte pavitramarchivadagne tena punihi nah |
brahmasavaih punihi nah ||
verses.en:
Cleanse us with thine own cleansing power, O Agni, that is bright with flame,
And by libations poured to thee.

verses.sa:
उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च ।
मां पुनीहि विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
ubhabhyam deva savitah pavitrena savena cha |
mam punihi vishvatah ||
verses.en:
Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power,
Purify me on every side.

verses.sa:
त्रिभिष्ट्वं देव सवितर्वर्षिष्ठैः सोम धामभिः ।
अग्ने दक्षैः पुनीहि नः ॥
verses.rom:
tribhishtvam deva savitarvarshishthaih soma dhamabhih |
agne dakshaih punihi nah ||
verses.en:
Cleanse us, God Savitar, with Three, O Soma, with sublimest forms,
Agni, with forms of power and might.

verses.sa:
पुनन्तु मां देवजनाः पुनन्तु वसवो धिया ।
विश्वे देवाः पुनीत मा जातवेदः पुनीहि मा ॥
verses.rom:
punantu mam devajanah punantu vasavo dhiya |
vishve devah punita ma jatavedah punihi ma ||
verses.en:
May the Gods' company make me clean, and Vasus make rue pure by song.
Purify me, ye General Gods; O Jatavedas, make me pure.

verses.sa:
प्र प्यायस्व प्र स्यन्दस्व सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः ।
देवेभ्य उत्तमं हविः ॥
verses.rom:
pra pyayasva pra syandasva soma vishvebhiramshubhih |
devebhya uttamam havih ||
verses.en:
Fill thyself full of juice, flow forth, O Soma, thou with all thy stalks,
The best oblation to the Gods.

verses.sa:
उप प्रियं पनिप्नतं युवानमाहुतीवृधम् ।
अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमः ॥
verses.rom:
upa priyam panipnatam yuvanamahutivridham |
aganma bibhrato namah ||
verses.en:
We with our homage have approached the Friend who seeks our wondering praise,
Young, strengthener of the solemn rite.

verses.sa:
अलाय्यस्य परशुर्ननाश तमा पवस्व देव सोम ।
आखुं चिदेव देव सोम ॥
verses.rom:
alayyasya parashurnanasha tama pavasva deva soma |
akhum chideva deva soma ||
verses.en:
Lost is Alayya's axe. O Soma, God do thou send it back hither in thy flow
Even, Soma, God, if 'twere a mole.

verses.sa:
यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसम् ।
सर्वं स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना ॥
verses.rom:
yah pavamaniradhyetyrishibhih sambhritam rasam |
sarvam sa putamashnati svaditam matarishvana ||
verses.en:
The man who reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamani hymns,
Tastes food completely purified, made sweet by Matarisvan's touch.

verses.sa:
पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसम् ।
तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरं सर्पिर्मधूदकम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamaniryo adhyetyrishibhih sambhritam rasam |
tasmai sarasvati duhe kshiram sarpirmadhudakam ||
verses.en:
Whoever reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamani hymns,
Sarasvati draws forth for him water and butter, milk and meath.

verses.sa:
प्र देवमच्छा मधुमन्त इन्दवोऽसिष्यदन्त गाव आ न धेनवः ।
बर्हिषदो वचनावन्त ऊधभिः परिस्रुतमुस्रिया निर्णिजं धिरे ॥
verses.rom:
pra devamachchha madhumanta indavo'sishyadanta gava a na dhenavah |
barhishado vachanavanta udhabhih parisrutamusriya nirnijam dhire ||
verses.en:
THE drops of Soma juice like cows who yield their milk have flowed forth, rich in meath, unto the Shining One,
And, seated on the grass, raising their voice, assumed the milk, the covering robe wherewith the udders stream.

verses.sa:
स रोरुवदभि पूर्वा अचिक्रददुपारुहः श्रथयन्स्वादते हरिः ।
तिरः पवित्रं परियन्नुरु ज्रयो नि शर्याणि दधते देव आ वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa roruvadabhi purva achikradaduparuhah shrathayansvadate harih |
tirah pavitram pariyannuru jrayo ni sharyani dadhate deva a varam ||
verses.en:
He bellows with a roar around the highest twigs: the Tawny One is sweetened as he breaks them up.
Then passing through the sieve into the ample room, the God throws off the dregs according to his wish.

verses.sa:
वि यो ममे यम्या संयती मदः साकंवृधा पयसा पिन्वदक्षिता ।
मही अपारे रजसी विवेविददभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाज आ ददे ॥
verses.rom:
vi yo mame yamya samyati madah sakamvridha payasa pinvadakshita |
mahi apare rajasi vivevidadabhivrajannakshitam paja a dade ||
verses.en:
The gladdening drink that measured out the meeting Twins fills full with milk the Eternal Ever-waxing Pair.
Bringing to light the Two great Regions limitless, moving above them he gained sheen that never fades.

verses.sa:
स मातरा विचरन्वाजयन्नपः प्र मेधिरः स्वधया पिन्वते पदम् ।
अंशुर्यवेन पिपिशे यतो नृभिः सं जामिभिर्नसते रक्षते शिरः ॥
verses.rom:
sa matara vicharanvajayannapah pra medhirah svadhaya pinvate padam |
amshuryavena pipishe yato nribhih sam jamibhirnasate rakshate shirah ||
verses.en:
Wandering through, the Parents, strengthening the floods, the Sage makes his place swell with his own native might.
The stalk is mixed with grain: he comes led by the men together with the sisters, and preserves the Head.

verses.sa:
सं दक्षेण मनसा जायते कविरृतस्य गर्भो निहितो यमा परः ।
यूना ह सन्ता प्रथमं वि जज्ञतुर्गुहा हितं जनिम नेममुद्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam dakshena manasa jayate kavirritasya garbho nihito yama parah |
yuna ha santa prathamam vi jajnaturguha hitam janima nemamudyatam ||
verses.en:
With energetic intellect the Sage is born, deposited as germ of Law, far from the Twins.
They being young at first showed visibly distinct the Creature that is half-concealed and half-exposed.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रस्य रूपं विविदुर्मनीषिणः श्येनो यदन्धो अभरत्परावतः ।
तं मर्जयन्त सुवृधं नदीष्वाँ उशन्तमंशुं परियन्तमृग्मियम् ॥
verses.rom:
mandrasya rupam vividurmanishinah shyeno yadandho abharatparavatah |
tam marjayanta suvridham nadishvan ushantamamshum pariyantamrigmiyam ||
verses.en:
The sages knew the form of him the Gladdener, what time the Falcon brought the plant from far away.
Him who assures success they beautified in streams, the stalk who yearned therefor, mighty and meet for praise.

verses.sa:
त्वां मृजन्ति दश योषणः सुतं सोम ऋषिभिर्मतिभिर्धीतिभिर्हितम् ।
अव्यो वारेभिरुत देवहूतिभिर्नृभिर्यतो वाजमा दर्षि सातये ॥
verses.rom:
tvam mrijanti dasha yoshanah sutam soma rishibhirmatibhirdhitibhirhitam |
avyo varebhiruta devahutibhirnribhiryato vajama darshi sataye ||
verses.en:
Together with the Rsis, with their prayers and hymns ten women deck thee, Soma, friendly when effused.
Led by the men, with invocations of the Gods, through the fleece, thou hast given us strength to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
परिप्रयन्तं वय्यं सुषंसदं सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत स्तुभः ।
यो धारया मधुमाँ ऊर्मिणा दिव इयर्ति वाचं रयिषाळमर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pariprayantam vayyam sushamsadam somam manisha abhyanushata stubhah |
yo dharaya madhuman urmina diva iyarti vacham rayishalamartyah ||
verses.en:
Songs resonant with praise have celebrated him. Soma, Friend, springing forth with his fair company.
Even him who rich in meath, with undulating stream, Winnner of Wealth, Immortal, sends his voice from heaven,

verses.sa:
अयं दिव इयर्ति विश्वमा रजः सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति ।
अद्भिर्गोभिर्मृज्यते अद्रिभिः सुतः पुनान इन्दुर्वरिवो विदत्प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam diva iyarti vishvama rajah somah punanah kalasheshu sidati |
adbhirgobhirmrijyate adribhih sutah punana indurvarivo vidatpriyam ||
verses.en:
He sends it into all the region forth from heaven. Soma, while he is filtered, settles in the jars.
With milk and waters is he decked when pressed with stones: Indu, when purified, shall find sweet rest and room.

verses.sa:
एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमानो वयो दधच्चित्रतमं पवस्व ।
अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva nah soma parishichyamano vayo dadhachchitratamam pavasva |
adveshe dyavaprithivi huvema deva dhatta rayimasme suviram ||
verses.en:
Even thus poured forth How on thy way, O Soma, vouchsafing us most manifold lively vigour.
We will invoke benevolent Earth and Heaven. Give us, ye Gods, riches with noble heroes.

verses.sa:
इषुर्न धन्वन्प्रति धीयते मतिर्वत्सो न मातुरुप सर्ज्यूधनि ।
उरुधारेव दुहे अग्र आयत्यस्य व्रतेष्वपि सोम इष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ishurna dhanvanprati dhiyate matirvatso na maturupa sarjyudhani |
urudhareva duhe agra ayatyasya vrateshvapi soma ishyate ||
verses.en:
LAID like an arrow on the bow the hymn hath been loosed like a young calf to the udder of its dam.
As one who cometh first with full stream she is milked the Soma is impelled to this man's holy rites.

verses.sa:
उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि ।
पवमानः संतनिः प्रघ्नतामिव मधुमान्द्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
upo matih prichyate sichyate madhu mandrajani chodate antarasani |
pavamanah samtanih praghnatamiva madhumandrapsah pari varamarshati ||
verses.en:
The thought is deeply fixed; the savoury juice is shed; the tongue with joyous sound is stirring in the mouth;
And Pavamana, like the shout of combatants, the drop rising in sweet juice, is flowing through the fleece.

verses.sa:
अव्ये वधूयुः पवते परि त्वचि श्रथ्नीते नप्तीरदितेरृतं यते ।
हरिरक्रान्यजतः संयतो मदो नृम्णा शिशानो महिषो न शोभते ॥
verses.rom:
avye vadhuyuh pavate pari tvachi shrathnite naptiraditerritam yate |
harirakranyajatah samyato mado nrimna shishano mahisho na shobhate ||
verses.en:
He flows about the sheep-skin, longing for a bride: he looses Aditi's Daughters for the worshipper.
The sacred drink hath come, gold-tinted, well-restrained: like a strong Bull he shines, whetting his manly might.

verses.sa:
उक्षा मिमाति प्रति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्कृतम् ।
अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत ॥
verses.rom:
uksha mimati prati yanti dhenavo devasya devirupa yanti nishkritam |
atyakramidarjunam varamavyayamatkam na niktam pari somo avyata ||
verses.en:
The Bull is bellowing; the Cows are coming nigh: the Goddesses approach the God's own resting-place.
Onward hath Soma passed through the sheep's fair bright fleece, and hath, as 'twere, endued a garment newly washed.

verses.sa:
अमृक्तेन रुशता वाससा हरिरमर्त्यो निर्णिजानः परि व्यत ।
दिवस्पृष्ठं बर्हणा निर्णिजे कृतोपस्तरणं चम्वोर्नभस्मयम् ॥
verses.rom:
amriktena rushata vasasa hariramartyo nirnijanah pari vyata |
divasprishtham barhana nirnije kritopastaranam chamvornabhasmayam ||
verses.en:
The golden-hued, Immortal, newly bathed, puts on a brightly shining vesture that is never harmed.
He made the ridge of heaven to be his radiant robe, by sprinkling of the bowls from moisture of the sky.

verses.sa:
सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुपः साकमीरते ।
तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन ॥
verses.rom:
suryasyeva rashmayo dravayitnavo matsarasah prasupah sakamirate |
tantum tatam pari sargasa ashavo nendradrite pavate dhama kim chana ||
verses.en:
Even as the beams of Surya, urging men to speed, that cheer and send to sleep, together rush they forth,
These swift outpourings in long course of holy rites: no form save only Indra shows itself so pure.

verses.sa:
सिन्धोरिव प्रवणे निम्न आशवो वृषच्युता मदासो गातुमाशत ।
शं नो निवेशे द्विपदे चतुष्पदेऽस्मे वाजाः सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
sindhoriva pravane nimna ashavo vrishachyuta madaso gatumashata |
sham no niveshe dvipade chatushpade'sme vajah soma tishthantu krishtayah ||
verses.en:
As down the steep slope of a river to the vale, drawn from the Steer the swift strong draughts have found a way.
Well be it with the men and cattle in our home. May powers, O Soma, may the people stay with us.

verses.sa:
आ नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवदश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत्सुवीर्यम् ।
यूयं हि सोम पितरो मम स्थन दिवो मूर्धानः प्रस्थिता वयस्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
a nah pavasva vasumaddhiranyavadashvavadgomadyavamatsuviryam |
yuyam hi soma pitaro mama sthana divo murdhanah prasthita vayaskritah ||
verses.en:
Pour out upon us wealth in goods, in gold, in steeds, in cattle and in corn, and great heroic strength.
Ye, Soma, are my Fathers, lifted up on high as heads of heaven and makers of the strength of life.

verses.sa:
एते सोमाः पवमानास इन्द्रं रथा इव प्र ययुः सातिमच्छ ।
सुताः पवित्रमति यन्त्यव्यं हित्वी वव्रिं हरितो वृष्टिमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
ete somah pavamanasa indram ratha iva pra yayuh satimachchha |
sutah pavitramati yantyavyam hitvi vavrim harito vrishtimachchha ||
verses.en:
These Pavamanas here, these drops of Soma, to Indra have sped forth like cars to booty.
Effused, they pass the cleansing fleece, while, gold-hued, they cast their covering off to pour the rain down.

verses.sa:
इन्दविन्द्राय बृहते पवस्व सुमृळीको अनवद्यो रिशादाः ।
भरा चन्द्राणि गृणते वसूनि देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः ॥
verses.rom:
indavindraya brihate pavasva sumriliko anavadyo rishadah |
bhara chandrani grinate vasuni devairdyavaprithivi pravatam nah ||
verses.en:
O Indu, flow thou on for lofty Indra, flow blameless, very gracious, foe-destroyer.
Bring splendid treasures to the man who lauds thee. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods protect us.

verses.sa:
त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रे सत्यामाशिरं पूर्व्ये व्योमनि ।
चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत ॥
verses.rom:
trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhre satyamashiram purvye vyomani |
chatvaryanya bhuvanani nirnije charuni chakre yadritairavardhata ||
verses.en:
THE three times seven Milch-kine in the eastern heaven have for this Soma poured the genuine milky draught.
Four other beauteous Creatures hath he made for his adornment, when he waxed in strength through holy rites.

verses.sa:
स भिक्षमाणो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे द्यावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे ।
तेजिष्ठा अपो मंहना परि व्यत यदी देवस्य श्रवसा सदो विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa bhikshamano amritasya charuna ubhe dyava kavyena vi shashrathe |
tejishtha apo mamhana pari vyata yadi devasya shravasa sado viduh ||
verses.en:
Longing for lovely Amrta, by his wisdom he divided, each apart from other, earth and heaven.
He gladly wrapped himself in the most lucid floods, when through their glory they found the God's resting-place.

verses.sa:
ते अस्य सन्तु केतवोऽमृत्यवोऽदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु ।
येभिर्नृम्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद्राजानं मनना अगृभ्णत ॥
verses.rom:
te asya santu ketavo'mrityavo'dabhyaso janushi ubhe anu |
yebhirnrimna cha devya cha punata adidrajanam manana agribhnata ||
verses.en:
May those his brilliant rays he ever free from death, inviolate, for both classes of created things,-
Rays wherewith powers of men and Gods are purified. Yea, even for this have sages welcomed him as King.

verses.sa:
स मृज्यमानो दशभिः सुकर्मभिः प्र मध्यमासु मातृषु प्रमे सचा ।
व्रतानि पानो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे नृचक्षा अनु पश्यते विशौ ॥
verses.rom:
sa mrijyamano dashabhih sukarmabhih pra madhyamasu matrishu prame sacha |
vratani pano amritasya charuna ubhe nrichaksha anu pashyate vishau ||
verses.en:
He, while he is adorned by the ten skillful ones, that he too in the Midmost Mothers may create,
While he is watching o'er the lovely Amrta's ways, looks on both races as Beholder of mankind.

verses.sa:
स मर्मृजान इन्द्रियाय धायस ओभे अन्ता रोदसी हर्षते हितः ।
वृषा शुष्मेण बाधते वि दुर्मतीरादेदिशानः शर्यहेव शुरुधः ॥
verses.rom:
sa marmrijana indriyaya dhayasa obhe anta rodasi harshate hitah |
vrisha shushmena badhate vi durmatiradedishanah sharyaheva shurudhah ||
verses.en:
He, while he is adorned to stream forth mighty strength, rejoices in his place between the earth and heaven.
The Steer dispels the evil-hearted with his might, aiming at offerings as an archer at the game.

verses.sa:
स मातरा न ददृशान उस्रियो नानददेति मरुतामिव स्वनः ।
जानन्नृतं प्रथमं यत्स्वर्णरं प्रशस्तये कमवृणीत सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa matara na dadrishana usriyo nanadadeti marutamiva svanah |
janannritam prathamam yatsvarnaram prashastaye kamavrinita sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Beholding, as it were, Two Mother Cows, the Steer goes roaring on his way even as the Maruts roar.
Knowing Eternal Law, the earliest light of heaven, he, passing wise, was chosen out to tell it forth.

verses.sa:
रुवति भीमो वृषभस्तविष्यया शृङ्गे शिशानो हरिणी विचक्षणः ।
आ योनिं सोमः सुकृतं नि षीदति गव्ययी त्वग्भवति निर्णिगव्ययी ॥
verses.rom:
ruvati bhimo vrishabhastavishyaya shringe shishano harini vichakshanah |
a yonim somah sukritam ni shidati gavyayi tvagbhavati nirnigavyayi ||
verses.en:
The fearful Bull is bellowing with violent might, far-sighted, sharpening his yellow coloured horns.
Soma assumes his seat in the well-fashioned place: the cowhide and the sheepskin are his ornament.

verses.sa:
शुचिः पुनानस्तन्वमरेपसमव्ये हरिर्न्यधाविष्ट सानवि ।
जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे त्रिधातु मधु क्रियते सुकर्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
shuchih punanastanvamarepasamavye harirnyadhavishta sanavi |
jushto mitraya varunaya vayave tridhatu madhu kriyate sukarmabhih ||
verses.en:
Bright, making pure his body free from spot and stain, on the sheep's back the Golden-coloured hath flowed down.
Acceptable to Mitra, Vayu, Varuna, he is prepared as threefold meal by skillful men.

verses.sa:
पवस्व सोम देववीतये वृषेन्द्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश ।
पुरा नो बाधाद्दुरिताति पारय क्षेत्रविद्धि दिश आहा विपृच्छते ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva soma devavitaye vrishendrasya hardi somadhanama visha |
pura no badhadduritati paraya kshetraviddhi disha aha viprichchhate ||
verses.en:
Flow on for the God's banquet, Soma, as a Steer, and enter Indra's heart, the Soma's reservoir.
Bear us beyond misfortune ere we be oppressed. the man who knows the land directs the man who asks.

verses.sa:
हितो न सप्तिरभि वाजमर्षेन्द्रस्येन्दो जठरमा पवस्व ।
नावा न सिन्धुमति पर्षि विद्वाञ्छूरो न युध्यन्नव नो निद स्पः ॥
verses.rom:
hito na saptirabhi vajamarshendrasyendo jatharama pavasva |
nava na sindhumati parshi vidvanchhuro na yudhyannava no nida spah ||
verses.en:
Urged like a car-steed flow to strength, O Soma: Indu, flow onward to the throat of Indra.
Skilled, bear us past, as in a boat o'er water: as battling Hero save us from the foeman.

verses.sa:
आ दक्षिणा सृज्यते शुष्म्यासदं वेति द्रुहो रक्षसः पाति जागृविः ।
हरिरोपशं कृणुते नभस्पय उपस्तिरे चम्वोर्ब्रह्म निर्णिजे ॥
verses.rom:
a dakshina srijyate shushmyasadam veti druho rakshasah pati jagrivih |
hariropasham krinute nabhaspaya upastire chamvorbrahma nirnije ||
verses.en:
THE guerdon is bestowed: the Mighty takes his Seat, and, ever-Watchful, guards from fiend and evil sprite.
Gold-hued, he makes the cloud his diadem, the milk his carpet in both worlds, and prayer his robe of state.

verses.sa:
प्र कृष्टिहेव शूष एति रोरुवदसुर्यं वर्णं नि रिणीते अस्य तम् ।
जहाति वव्रिं पितुरेति निष्कृतमुपप्रुतं कृणुते निर्णिजं तना ॥
verses.rom:
pra krishtiheva shusha eti roruvadasuryam varnam ni rinite asya tam |
jahati vavrim pitureti nishkritamupaprutam krinute nirnijam tana ||
verses.en:
Strong, bellowing, he goes, like one who slays the folk; he lets this hue of Asuras flow off from him,
Throws off his covering, seeks his father's meeting-place, and thus makes for himself the bright robe he assumes.

verses.sa:
अद्रिभिः सुतः पवते गभस्त्योर्वृषायते नभसा वेपते मती ।
स मोदते नसते साधते गिरा नेनिक्ते अप्सु यजते परीमणि ॥
verses.rom:
adribhih sutah pavate gabhastyorvrishayate nabhasa vepate mati |
sa modate nasate sadhate gira nenikte apsu yajate parimani ||
verses.en:
Onward he flows, from both the hands, pressed out with stones: excited by the prayer, the water makes him wild.
He frolics and draws near, completes his work with song, and bathes in streams to satisfy the worshipper.

verses.sa:
परि द्युक्षं सहसः पर्वतावृधं मध्वः सिञ्चन्ति हर्म्यस्य सक्षणिम् ।
आ यस्मिन्गावः सुहुताद ऊधनि मूर्धञ्छ्रीणन्त्यग्रियं वरीमभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pari dyuksham sahasah parvatavridham madhvah sinchanti harmyasya sakshanim |
a yasmingavah suhutada udhani murdhanchhrinantyagriyam varimabhih ||
verses.en:
They pour out meath around the Master of the house, Celestial Strengthener of the mountain that gives might;
In whom, through his great powers, oblation-eating cows in their uplifted udder mix their choicest milk.

verses.sa:
समी रथं न भुरिजोरहेषत दश स्वसारो अदितेरुपस्थ आ ।
जिगादुप ज्रयति गोरपीच्यं पदं यदस्य मतुथा अजीजनन् ॥
verses.rom:
sami ratham na bhurijoraheshata dasha svasaro aditerupastha a |
jigadupa jrayati gorapichyam padam yadasya matutha ajijanan ||
verses.en:
They, the ten sisters, on the lap of Aditi, have sent him forward like a car from both the arms.
He wanders and comes near the Cow's mysterious place, even the place which his inventions have produced.

verses.sa:
श्येनो न योनिं सदनं धिया कृतं हिरण्ययमासदं देव एषति ।
ए रिणन्ति बर्हिषि प्रियं गिराश्वो न देवाँ अप्येति यज्ञियः ॥
verses.rom:
shyeno na yonim sadanam dhiya kritam hiranyayamasadam deva eshati |
e rinanti barhishi priyam girashvo na devan apyeti yajniyah ||
verses.en:
Like as a falcon to his home, so speeds the God to his own golden wisely-fashioned place to rest.
With song they urge the darling to the sacred grass: the Holy One goes like a courser to the Gods.

verses.sa:
परा व्यक्तो अरुषो दिवः कविर्वृषा त्रिपृष्ठो अनविष्ट गा अभि ।
सहस्रणीतिर्यतिः परायती रेभो न पूर्वीरुषसो वि राजति ॥
verses.rom:
para vyakto arusho divah kavirvrisha triprishtho anavishta ga abhi |
sahasranitiryatih parayati rebho na purvirushaso vi rajati ||
verses.en:
From far away, from heaven, the red hued noted Sage, Steer of the triple height, hath sung unto the kine.
With thousand guidings he, leading this way and that, shines, as a singer, splendidly through many a morn.

verses.sa:
त्वेषं रूपं कृणुते वर्णो अस्य स यत्राशयत्समृता सेधति स्रिधः ।
अप्सा याति स्वधया दैव्यं जनं सं सुष्टुती नसते सं गोअग्रया ॥
verses.rom:
tvesham rupam krinute varno asya sa yatrashayatsamrita sedhati sridhah |
apsa yati svadhaya daivyam janam sam sushtuti nasate sam goagraya ||
verses.en:
His covering assumes a radiant hue; where'er he comes into the fight he drives the foe afar.
The Winner of the Floods, with food he seeks the host of heaven, he comes to praises glorified with milk.

verses.sa:
उक्षेव यूथा परियन्नरावीदधि त्विषीरधित सूर्यस्य ।
दिव्यः सुपर्णोऽव चक्षत क्षां सोमः परि क्रतुना पश्यते जाः ॥
verses.rom:
uksheva yutha pariyannaravidadhi tvishiradhita suryasya |
divyah suparno'va chakshata ksham somah pari kratuna pashyate jah ||
verses.en:
Like a bull roaming round the herds he bellows: he hath assumed the brilliancy of Surya.
Down to the earth hath looked the heavenly Falcon: Soma with wisdom views all living creatures.

verses.sa:
हरिं मृजन्त्यरुषो न युज्यते सं धेनुभिः कलशे सोमो अज्यते ।
उद्वाचमीरयति हिन्वते मती पुरुष्टुतस्य कति चित्परिप्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
harim mrijantyarusho na yujyate sam dhenubhih kalashe somo ajyate |
udvachamirayati hinvate mati purushtutasya kati chitparipriyah ||
verses.en:
THEY cleanse the Gold-hued: like a red Steed is he yoked, and Soma in the jar is mingled with the milk.
He sendeth out his voice, and many loving friends of him the highly lauded hasten with their songs.

verses.sa:
साकं वदन्ति बहवो मनीषिण इन्द्रस्य सोमं जठरे यदादुहुः ।
यदी मृजन्ति सुगभस्तयो नरः सनीळाभिर्दशभिः काम्यं मधु ॥
verses.rom:
sakam vadanti bahavo manishina indrasya somam jathare yadaduhuh |
yadi mrijanti sugabhastayo narah sanilabhirdashabhih kamyam madhu ||
verses.en:
The many sages utter words in unison, while into Indra's throat they pour the Soma juice,
When, with the ten that dwell together closely joined, the men whose hands are skillful cleanse the lovely meath.

verses.sa:
अरममाणो अत्येति गा अभि सूर्यस्य प्रियं दुहितुस्तिरो रवम् ।
अन्वस्मै जोषमभरद्विनंगृसः सं द्वयीभिः स्वसृभिः क्षेति जामिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
aramamano atyeti ga abhi suryasya priyam duhitustiro ravam |
anvasmai joshamabharadvinamgrisah sam dvayibhih svasribhih ksheti jamibhih ||
verses.en:
He goes upon his way, unresting, to the cows, over the roaring sound which Sarya's Daughter loves.
The Falcon brought it to him for his own delight: now with the twofold kindred sisters is his home.

verses.sa:
नृधूतो अद्रिषुतो बर्हिषि प्रियः पतिर्गवां प्रदिव इन्दुरृत्वियः ।
पुरंधिवान्मनुषो यज्ञसाधनः शुचिर्धिया पवते सोम इन्द्र ते ॥
verses.rom:
nridhuto adrishuto barhishi priyah patirgavam pradiva indurritviyah |
puramdhivanmanusho yajnasadhanah shuchirdhiya pavate soma indra te ||
verses.en:
Washed by the men, stone-pressed, dear on the holy grass, faithful to seasons, Lord of cattle from of old,
Most liberal, completing sacrifice for men, O Indra, pure bright Soma, Indu, flows for thee.

verses.sa:
नृबाहुभ्यां चोदितो धारया सुतोऽनुष्वधं पवते सोम इन्द्र ते ।
आप्राः क्रतून्समजैरध्वरे मतीर्वेर्न द्रुषच्चम्वोरासदद्धरिः ॥
verses.rom:
nribahubhyam chodito dharaya suto'nushvadham pavate soma indra te |
aprah kratunsamajairadhvare matirverna drushachchamvorasadaddharih ||
verses.en:
O Indra, urged by arms of men and poured in streams, Soma flows on for thee after his Godlike kind.
Plans thou fulfillest, gatherest thoughts for sacrifice: in the bowls sits the Gold-hued like a roosting bird.

verses.sa:
अंशुं दुहन्ति स्तनयन्तमक्षितं कविं कवयोऽपसो मनीषिणः ।
समी गावो मतयो यन्ति संयत ऋतस्य योना सदने पुनर्भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
amshum duhanti stanayantamakshitam kavim kavayo'paso manishinah |
sami gavo matayo yanti samyata ritasya yona sadane punarbhuvah ||
verses.en:
Sages well-skilled in work, intelligent, drain out the stalk that roars, the Sage, the Everlasting One.
The milk, the hymns unite them with him in the place of sacrifice, his seat who is produced anew.

verses.sa:
नाभा पृथिव्या धरुणो महो दिवोऽपामूर्मौ सिन्धुष्वन्तरुक्षितः ।
इन्द्रस्य वज्रो वृषभो विभूवसुः सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः ॥
verses.rom:
nabha prithivya dharuno maho divo'pamurmau sindhushvantarukshitah |
indrasya vajro vrishabho vibhuvasuh somo hride pavate charu matsarah ||
verses.en:
Earth's central point, sustainer of the mighty heavens, distilled into the streams, into the waters' wave,
As Indra's thunderbolt, Steer with far spreading wealth, Soma is flowing on to make the heart rejoice.

verses.sa:
स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रज स्तोत्रे शिक्षन्नाधून्वते च सुक्रतो ।
मा नो निर्भाग्वसुनः सादनस्पृशो रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं वसीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu pavasva pari parthivam raja stotre shikshannadhunvate cha sukrato |
ma no nirbhagvasunah sadanasprisho rayim pishangam bahulam vasimahi ||
verses.en:
Over the earthly region flow thou on thy way, helping the praiser and the pourer, thou Most Wise.
Let us not lack rich treasure reaching to our home, and may we clothe ourselves in manifold bright wealth.

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्दो शतदात्वश्व्यं सहस्रदातु पशुमद्धिरण्यवत् ।
उप मास्व बृहती रेवतीरिषोऽधि स्तोत्रस्य पवमान नो गहि ॥
verses.rom:
a tu na indo shatadatvashvyam sahasradatu pashumaddhiranyavat |
upa masva brihati revatirisho'dhi stotrasya pavamana no gahi ||
verses.en:
Hither, O Indu, unto us a hundred gifts of steeds, a thousand gifts of cattle and of gold,
Measure thou forth, yea, splendid ample strengthening food do thou, O Pavamana, heed this laud of ours.

verses.sa:
स्रक्वे द्रप्सस्य धमतः समस्वरन्नृतस्य योना समरन्त नाभयः ।
त्रीन्स मूर्ध्नो असुरश्चक्र आरभे सत्यस्य नावः सुकृतमपीपरन् ॥
verses.rom:
srakve drapsasya dhamatah samasvarannritasya yona samaranta nabhayah |
trinsa murdhno asurashchakra arabhe satyasya navah sukritamapiparan ||
verses.en:
THEY from the spouting drop have sounded at the rim: naves speed together to the place of sacrifice.
That Asura hath formed, to seize, three lofty heights. The ships of truth have borne the pious man across.

verses.sa:
सम्यक्सम्यञ्चो महिषा अहेषत सिन्धोरूर्मावधि वेना अवीविपन् ।
मधोर्धाराभिर्जनयन्तो अर्कमित्प्रियामिन्द्रस्य तन्वमवीवृधन् ॥
verses.rom:
samyaksamyancho mahisha aheshata sindhorurmavadhi vena avivipan |
madhordharabhirjanayanto arkamitpriyamindrasya tanvamavivridhan ||
verses.en:
The strong Steers, gathering, have duly stirred themselves, and over the stream's wave the friends sent forth the song.
Engendering the hymn, with flowing streams of meath, Indra's dear body have they caused to wax in strength.

verses.sa:
पवित्रवन्तः परि वाचमासते पितैषां प्रत्नो अभि रक्षति व्रतम् ।
महः समुद्रं वरुणस्तिरो दधे धीरा इच्छेकुर्धरुणेष्वारभम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavitravantah pari vachamasate pitaisham pratno abhi rakshati vratam |
mahah samudram varunastiro dadhe dhira ichchhekurdharuneshvarabham ||
verses.en:
With sanctifying gear they sit around the song: their ancient Father guards their holy work from harm.
Varuna hath o'erspread the mighty sea of air. Sages had power to hold him in sustaining floods.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारेऽव ते समस्वरन्दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतः ।
अस्य स्पशो न नि मिषन्ति भूर्णयः पदेपदे पाशिनः सन्ति सेतवः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradhare'va te samasvarandivo nake madhujihva asashchatah |
asya spasho na ni mishanti bhurnayah padepade pashinah santi setavah ||
verses.en:
Sweet-tongued, exhaustless, they have sent their voices down together, in heaven's vault that pours a thousand streams.
His wildly-restless warders never close an eye: in every place are found the bonds that bind man last.

verses.sa:
पितुर्मातुरध्या ये समस्वरन्नृचा शोचन्तः संदहन्तो अव्रतान् ।
इन्द्रद्विष्टामप धमन्ति मायया त्वचमसिक्नीं भूमनो दिवस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
piturmaturadhya ye samasvarannricha shochantah samdahanto avratan |
indradvishtamapa dhamanti mayaya tvachamasiknim bhumano divaspari ||
verses.en:
O'er Sire and Mother they have roared in unison bright with the verse of praise, burning up riteless men,
Blowing away with supernatural might from earth and from the heavens the swarthy skin which Indra hates.

verses.sa:
प्रत्नान्मानादध्या ये समस्वरञ्छ्लोकयन्त्रासो रभसस्य मन्तवः ।
अपानक्षासो बधिरा अहासत ऋतस्य पन्थां न तरन्ति दुष्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
pratnanmanadadhya ye samasvaranchhlokayantraso rabhasasya mantavah |
apanakshaso badhira ahasata ritasya pantham na taranti dushkritah ||
verses.en:
Those which, as guides of song and counsellors of speed, were manifested from their ancient dwelling place,-
From these the eyeless and the deaf have turned aside: the wicked travel not the pathway of the Law.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारे वितते पवित्र आ वाचं पुनन्ति कवयो मनीषिणः ।
रुद्रास एषामिषिरासो अद्रुह स्पशः स्वञ्चः सुदृशो नृचक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradhare vitate pavitra a vacham punanti kavayo manishinah |
rudrasa eshamishiraso adruha spashah svanchah sudrisho nrichakshasah ||
verses.en:
What time the filter with a thousand streams is stretched, the thoughtful sages purify their song therein.
Bright-coloured are their spies, vigorous, void of guile, excellent, fair to see, beholders of mankind.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य गोपा न दभाय सुक्रतुस्त्री ष पवित्रा हृद्यन्तरा दधे ।
विद्वान्स विश्वा भुवनाभि पश्यत्यवाजुष्टान्विध्यति कर्ते अव्रतान् ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya gopa na dabhaya sukratustri sha pavitra hridyantara dadhe |
vidvansa vishva bhuvanabhi pashyatyavajushtanvidhyati karte avratan ||
verses.en:
Guardian of Law, most wise, he may not be deceived: three Purifiers hath he set within his heart.
With wisdom he beholds all creatures that exist: he drives into the pit the hated riteless ones.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य तन्तुर्विततः पवित्र आ जिह्वाया अग्रे वरुणस्य मायया ।
धीराश्चित्तत्समिनक्षन्त आशतात्रा कर्तमव पदात्यप्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya tanturvitatah pavitra a jihvaya agre varunasya mayaya |
dhirashchittatsaminakshanta ashatatra kartamava padatyaprabhuh ||
verses.en:
The thread of sacrifice spun in the cleansing sieve, on Varuna's tongue-tip, by supernatural might,-
This, by their striving, have the prudent ones attained: he who hath not this power shall sink into the pit.

verses.sa:
शिशुर्न जातोऽव चक्रदद्वने स्वर्यद्वाज्यरुषः सिषासति ।
दिवो रेतसा सचते पयोवृधा तमीमहे सुमती शर्म सप्रथः ॥
verses.rom:
shishurna jato'va chakradadvane svaryadvajyarushah sishasati |
divo retasa sachate payovridha tamimahe sumati sharma saprathah ||
verses.en:
BORN like a youngling he hath clamoured in the wood, when he, the Red, the Strong, would win the light of heaven.
He comes with heavenly seed that makes the water swell: him for wide-spreading shelter we implore with prayer.

verses.sa:
दिवो य स्कम्भो धरुणः स्वातत आपूर्णो अंशुः पर्येति विश्वतः ।
सेमे मही रोदसी यक्षदावृता समीचीने दाधार समिषः कविः ॥
verses.rom:
divo ya skambho dharunah svatata apurno amshuh paryeti vishvatah |
seme mahi rodasi yakshadavrita samichine dadhara samishah kavih ||
verses.en:
A far-extended pillar that supports the sky the Soma-stalk, filled full, moves itself every way.
He shall bring both these great worlds while the rite proceeds: the Sage holds these who move! together and all food.

verses.sa:
महि प्सरः सुकृतं सोम्यं मधूर्वी गव्यूतिरदितेरृतं यते ।
ईशे यो वृष्टेरित उस्रियो वृषापां नेता य इतऊतिरृग्मियः ॥
verses.rom:
mahi psarah sukritam somyam madhurvi gavyutiraditerritam yate |
ishe yo vrishterita usriyo vrishapam neta ya itautirrigmiyah ||
verses.en:
Wide space hath he who follows Aditi's right path, and mighty, well-made food, meath blent with Soma juice;
He who from hence commands the rain, Steer of the kine, Leader of floods, who helps us hence, who claims our laud.

verses.sa:
आत्मन्वन्नभो दुह्यते घृतं पय ऋतस्य नाभिरमृतं वि जायते ।
समीचीनाः सुदानवः प्रीणन्ति तं नरो हितमव मेहन्ति पेरवः ॥
verses.rom:
atmanvannabho duhyate ghritam paya ritasya nabhiramritam vi jayate |
samichinah sudanavah prinanti tam naro hitamava mehanti peravah ||
verses.en:
Butter and milk are drawn from animated cloud; thence Amrta is produced, centre of sacrifice.
Him the Most Bounteous Ones, ever united, love; him as our Friend the Men who make all swell rain down.

verses.sa:
अरावीदंशुः सचमान ऊर्मिणा देवाव्यं मनुषे पिन्वति त्वचम् ।
दधाति गर्भमदितेरुपस्थ आ येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ॥
verses.rom:
aravidamshuh sachamana urmina devavyam manushe pinvati tvacham |
dadhati garbhamaditerupastha a yena tokam cha tanayam cha dhamahe ||
verses.en:
The Soma-stalk hath roared, following with the wave: he swells with sap for man the skin which Gods enjoy.
Upon the lap of Aditi he lays the germ, by means whereof we gain children and progeny.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारेऽव ता असश्चतस्तृतीये सन्तु रजसि प्रजावतीः ।
चतस्रो नाभो निहिता अवो दिवो हविर्भरन्त्यमृतं घृतश्चुतः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradhare'va ta asashchatastritiye santu rajasi prajavatih |
chatasro nabho nihita avo divo havirbharantyamritam ghritashchutah ||
verses.en:
In the third region which distils a thousand streams, may the Exhaustless Ones descend with procreant power.
The kindred Four have been sent downward from the heavens: dropping with oil they bring Amrta and sacred gifts.

verses.sa:
श्वेतं रूपं कृणुते यत्सिषासति सोमो मीढ्वाँ असुरो वेद भूमनः ।
धिया शमी सचते सेमभि प्रवद्दिवस्कवन्धमव दर्षदुद्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
shvetam rupam krinute yatsishasati somo midhvan asuro veda bhumanah |
dhiya shami sachate semabhi pravaddivaskavandhamava darshadudrinam ||
verses.en:
Soma assumes white colour when he strives to gain: the bounteous Asura knows full many a precious boon.
Down the steep slope, through song, he comes to sacrifice, and he will burst the water-holding cask of heaven,

verses.sa:
अध श्वेतं कलशं गोभिरक्तं कार्ष्मन्ना वाज्यक्रमीत्ससवान् ।
आ हिन्विरे मनसा देवयन्तः कक्षीवते शतहिमाय गोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
adha shvetam kalasham gobhiraktam karshmanna vajyakramitsasavan |
a hinvire manasa devayantah kakshivate shatahimaya gonam ||
verses.en:
Yea, to the shining milk-anointed beaker, as to his goal, hath stepped the conquering Courser.
Pious-souled men have sent their gift of cattle unto Kaksivan of the hundred winters.

verses.sa:
अद्भिः सोम पपृचानस्य ते रसोऽव्यो वारं वि पवमान धावति ।
स मृज्यमानः कविभिर्मदिन्तम स्वदस्वेन्द्राय पवमान पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
adbhih soma paprichanasya te raso'vyo varam vi pavamana dhavati |
sa mrijyamanah kavibhirmadintama svadasvendraya pavamana pitaye ||
verses.en:
Soma, thy juice when thou art blended with the streams, flows, Pavamana, through the long wool of the sheep.
So, cleansed by sages. O best giver of delight, grow sweet for Indra, Pavamana! for his drink.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रियाणि पवते चनोहितो नामानि यह्वो अधि येषु वर्धते ।
आ सूर्यस्य बृहतो बृहन्नधि रथं विष्वञ्चमरुहद्विचक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priyani pavate chanohito namani yahvo adhi yeshu vardhate |
a suryasya brihato brihannadhi ratham vishvanchamaruhadvichakshanah ||
verses.en:
GRACIOUSLY-MINDED he is flowing on his way to win dear names o'er which the Youthful One grows great.
The Mighty and Far-seeing One hath mounted now the mighty Surya's car which moves to every side.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य जिह्वा पवते मधु प्रियं वक्ता पतिर्धियो अस्या अदाभ्यः ।
दधाति पुत्रः पित्रोरपीच्यं नाम तृतीयमधि रोचने दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya jihva pavate madhu priyam vakta patirdhiyo asya adabhyah |
dadhati putrah pitrorapichyam nama tritiyamadhi rochane divah ||
verses.en:
The Speaker, unassailable Master of this hymn, the Tongue of sacrifice pours forth the pleasant meath.
Within the lustrous region of the heavens the Son makes the third secret name of Mother and of Sire.

verses.sa:
अव द्युतानः कलशाँ अचिक्रदन्नृभिर्येमानः कोश आ हिरण्यये ।
अभीमृतस्य दोहना अनूषताधि त्रिपृष्ठ उषसो वि राजति ॥
verses.rom:
ava dyutanah kalashan achikradannribhiryemanah kosha a hiranyaye |
abhimritasya dohana anushatadhi triprishtha ushaso vi rajati ||
verses.en:
Sending forth flashes he hath bellowed to the jars, led by the men into the golden reservoir.
The milky streams of sacrifice have sung to him: he of the triple height shines brightly through the morns.

verses.sa:
अद्रिभिः सुतो मतिभिश्चनोहितः प्ररोचयन्रोदसी मातरा शुचिः ।
रोमाण्यव्या समया वि धावति मधोर्धारा पिन्वमाना दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
adribhih suto matibhishchanohitah prarochayanrodasi matara shuchih |
romanyavya samaya vi dhavati madhordhara pinvamana divedive ||
verses.en:
Pressed by the stones, with hymns, and graciously inclined, illuminating both the Parents, Heaven and Earth,
He flows in ordered season onward through the flee, a current of sweet juice still swelling day by day.

verses.sa:
परि सोम प्र धन्वा स्वस्तये नृभिः पुनानो अभि वासयाशिरम् ।
ये ते मदा आहनसो विहायसस्तेभिरिन्द्रं चोदय दातवे मघम् ॥
verses.rom:
pari soma pra dhanva svastaye nribhih punano abhi vasayashiram |
ye te mada ahanaso vihayasastebhirindram chodaya datave magham ||
verses.en:
Flow onward, Soma, flow to bring prosperity: cleansed by the men, invest thee with the milky draught.
What gladdening drinks thou hast, foaming, exceeding strong, even with these incite Indra to give us wealth.

verses.sa:
धर्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नृभिः ।
हरिः सृजानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्वृथा पाजांसि कृणुते नदीष्वा ॥
verses.rom:
dharta divah pavate kritvyo raso daksho devanamanumadyo nribhih |
harih srijano atyo na satvabhirvritha pajamsi krinute nadishva ||
verses.en:
ON flows the potent juice, sustainer of the heavens, the strength of Gods, whom men must hail with shouts of joy.
The Gold-hued, started like a courser by brave men, impetuously winneth splendour in the streams.

verses.sa:
शूरो न धत्त आयुधा गभस्त्योः स्वः सिषासन्रथिरो गविष्टिषु ।
इन्द्रस्य शुष्ममीरयन्नपस्युभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते मनीषिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
shuro na dhatta ayudha gabhastyoh svah sishasanrathiro gavishtishu |
indrasya shushmamirayannapasyubhirindurhinvano ajyate manishibhih ||
verses.en:
He takes his weapons, like a hero, in his hands, fain to win light, car-borne, in forays for the kine.
Indu, while stimulating India's might, is urged forward and balmed by sages skillful in their task.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य सोम पवमान ऊर्मिणा तविष्यमाणो जठरेष्वा विश ।
प्र णः पिन्व विद्युदभ्रेव रोदसी धिया न वाजाँ उप मासि शश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya soma pavamana urmina tavishyamano jathareshva visha |
pra nah pinva vidyudabhreva rodasi dhiya na vajan upa masi shashvatah ||
verses.en:
Soma, as thou art purified with flowing wave, exhibiting thy strength enter thou Indra's throat.
Make both worlds stream for us, as lightning doth the clouds: mete out exhaustless powers for us, as 'twere through song.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य राजा पवते स्वर्दृश ऋतस्य धीतिमृषिषाळवीवशत् ।
यः सूर्यस्यासिरेण मृज्यते पिता मतीनामसमष्टकाव्यः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasya raja pavate svardrisha ritasya dhitimrishishalavivashat |
yah suryasyasirena mrijyate pita matinamasamashtakavyah ||
verses.en:
Onward he flows, the King of all that sees the light: the Rsis' Lord hath raised the song of sacrifice;
Even he who is adorned with Surya's arrowy beam, Father of hymns, whose wisdom is beyond our reach.

verses.sa:
वृषेव यूथा परि कोशमर्षस्यपामुपस्थे वृषभः कनिक्रदत् ।
स इन्द्राय पवसे मत्सरिन्तमो यथा जेषाम समिथे त्वोतयः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisheva yutha pari koshamarshasyapamupasthe vrishabhah kanikradat |
sa indraya pavase matsarintamo yatha jeshama samithe tvotayah ||
verses.en:
Like as a bull to herds, thou flowest to the pail, bellowing as a steer upon the water's lap.
So, best of Cheerers, thou for Indra flowest on that we, with thy protection, may o'ercome in fight.

verses.sa:
एष प्र कोशे मधुमाँ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य वज्रो वपुषो वपुष्टरः ।
अभीमृतस्य सुदुघा घृतश्चुतो वाश्रा अर्षन्ति पयसेव धेनवः ॥
verses.rom:
esha pra koshe madhuman achikradadindrasya vajro vapusho vapushtarah |
abhimritasya sudugha ghritashchuto vashra arshanti payaseva dhenavah ||
verses.en:
MORE beauteous than the beautiful, as Indra's bolt, this Soma, rich in sweets, hath clamoured in the vat.
Dropping with oil, abundant, streams of sacrifice flow unto him like milch-kine, lowing, with their milk.

verses.sa:
स पूर्व्यः पवते यं दिवस्परि श्येनो मथायदिषितस्तिरो रजः ।
स मध्व आ युवते वेविजान इत्कृशानोरस्तुर्मनसाह बिभ्युषा ॥
verses.rom:
sa purvyah pavate yam divaspari shyeno mathayadishitastiro rajah |
sa madhva a yuvate vevijana itkrishanorasturmanasaha bibhyusha ||
verses.en:
On flows that Ancient One whom, hitherward, from heaven, sped through the region of the air, the Falcon snatched.
He, quivering with alarm and terrified in heart before bow-armed Krsanu, holdeth fast the sweet.

verses.sa:
ते नः पूर्वास उपरास इन्दवो महे वाजाय धन्वन्तु गोमते ।
ईक्षेण्यासो अह्यो न चारवो ब्रह्मब्रह्म ये जुजुषुर्हविर्हविः ॥
verses.rom:
te nah purvasa uparasa indavo mahe vajaya dhanvantu gomate |
ikshenyaso ahyo na charavo brahmabrahma ye jujushurhavirhavih ||
verses.en:
May those first freshest drops of Soma juice effused flow on, their way to bring us mighty strength in kine.
Beauteous as serpents, worthy to be looked upon, they whom each sacred gift and all our prayers have pleased.

verses.sa:
अयं नो विद्वान्वनवद्वनुष्यत इन्दुः सत्राचा मनसा पुरुष्टुतः ।
इनस्य यः सदने गर्भमादधे गवामुरुब्जमभ्यर्षति व्रजम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam no vidvanvanavadvanushyata induh satracha manasa purushtutah |
inasya yah sadane garbhamadadhe gavamurubjamabhyarshati vrajam ||
verses.en:
May that much-lauded Indu, with a heart inclined to us, well-knowing, fight against our enemies.
He who hath brought the germ beside the Strong One's seat moves onward to the widely-opened stall of kine.

verses.sa:
चक्रिर्दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो महाँ अदब्धो वरुणो हुरुग्यते ।
असावि मित्रो वृजनेषु यज्ञियोऽत्यो न यूथे वृषयुः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
chakrirdivah pavate kritvyo raso mahan adabdho varuno hurugyate |
asavi mitro vrijaneshu yajniyo'tyo na yuthe vrishayuh kanikradat ||
verses.en:
The active potent juice of heaven is flowing on, great Varuna whom the forward man can ne'er deceive.
Mitra, the Holy, hath been pressed for troubled times, neighing like an impatient horse amid the herd.

verses.sa:
प्र राजा वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यददपो वसानो अभि गा इयक्षति ।
गृभ्णाति रिप्रमविरस्य तान्वा शुद्धो देवानामुप याति निष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra raja vacham janayannasishyadadapo vasano abhi ga iyakshati |
gribhnati ripramavirasya tanva shuddho devanamupa yati nishkritam ||
verses.en:
RAISING his voice the King hath flowed upon his way: invested with the waters he would win the kine.
The fleece retains his solid parts as though impure, and bright and cleansed he seeks the special place of Gods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम परि षिच्यसे नृभिर्नृचक्षा ऊर्मिः कविरज्यसे वने ।
पूर्वीर्हि ते स्रुतयः सन्ति यातवे सहस्रमश्वा हरयश्चमूषदः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma pari shichyase nribhirnrichaksha urmih kavirajyase vane |
purvirhi te srutayah santi yatave sahasramashva harayashchamushadah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Soma, art effused for Indra by the men, balmed in the wood as wave, Sage, Viewer of mankind.
Full many are the paths whereon thou mayest go: a thousand bay steeds hast thou resting in the bowls.

verses.sa:
समुद्रिया अप्सरसो मनीषिणमासीना अन्तरभि सोममक्षरन् ।
ता ईं हिन्वन्ति हर्म्यस्य सक्षणिं याचन्ते सुम्नं पवमानमक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
samudriya apsaraso manishinamasina antarabhi somamaksharan |
ta im hinvanti harmyasya sakshanim yachante sumnam pavamanamakshitam ||
verses.en:
Apsarases who dwell in waters of the sea, sitting within, have flowed to Soma wise of heart.
They urge the Master of the house upon his way, and to the Eternal Pavamana pray for bliss.

verses.sa:
गोजिन्नः सोमो रथजिद्धिरण्यजित्स्वर्जिदब्जित्पवते सहस्रजित् ।
यं देवासश्चक्रिरे पीतये मदं स्वादिष्ठं द्रप्समरुणं मयोभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
gojinnah somo rathajiddhiranyajitsvarjidabjitpavate sahasrajit |
yam devasashchakrire pitaye madam svadishtham drapsamarunam mayobhuvam ||
verses.en:
Soma flows on for u's as winner of the kine, winner of thousands, cars, water, and light, and gold;
He whom the Gods have made a gladdening draught to drink, the drop most sweet to taste, weal-bringing, red of hue.

verses.sa:
एतानि सोम पवमानो अस्मयुः सत्यानि कृण्वन्द्रविणान्यर्षसि ।
जहि शत्रुमन्तिके दूरके च य उर्वीं गव्यूतिमभयं च नस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
etani soma pavamano asmayuh satyani krinvandravinanyarshasi |
jahi shatrumantike durake cha ya urvim gavyutimabhayam cha naskridhi ||
verses.en:
Soma, as Pavamana thou, our faithful Friend, making for us these real treasures, flowest on.
Slay thou the enemy both near and far away: grant us security and ample pasturage.

verses.sa:
अचोदसो नो धन्वन्त्विन्दवः प्र सुवानासो बृहद्दिवेषु हरयः ।
वि च नशन्न इषो अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त सनिषन्त नो धियः ॥
verses.rom:
achodaso no dhanvantvindavah pra suvanaso brihaddiveshu harayah |
vi cha nashanna isho aratayo'ryo nashanta sanishanta no dhiyah ||
verses.en:
SPONTANEOUS let our drops of Soma juice flow on, pressed, golden-hued, among the Gods of lofty heaven.
Perish among us they who give no gifts of food! perish the godless! May our prayers obtain success.

verses.sa:
प्र णो धन्वन्त्विन्दवो मदच्युतो धना वा येभिरर्वतो जुनीमसि ।
तिरो मर्तस्य कस्य चित्परिह्वृतिं वयं धनानि विश्वधा भरेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
pra no dhanvantvindavo madachyuto dhana va yebhirarvato junimasi |
tiro martasya kasya chitparihvritim vayam dhanani vishvadha bharemahi ||
verses.en:
Forward to us the drops, distilling meath, shall flow, like riches for whose sake we urge the horses on.
Beyond the crafty hindering of all mortal men may we continually bear precious wealth away.

verses.sa:
उत स्वस्या अरात्या अरिर्हि ष उतान्यस्या अरात्या वृको हि षः ।
धन्वन्न तृष्णा समरीत ताँ अभि सोम जहि पवमान दुराध्यः ॥
verses.rom:
uta svasya aratya arirhi sha utanyasya aratya vriko hi shah |
dhanvanna trishna samarita tan abhi soma jahi pavamana duradhyah ||
verses.en:
Yea, verily, foe of hate shown to himself is he, yea, verity, destroyer too of other hate.
As thirst subdueth in the desert, conquer thou, O Soma Pavarnana, men of evil thoughts.

verses.sa:
दिवि ते नाभा परमो य आददे पृथिव्यास्ते रुरुहुः सानवि क्षिपः ।
अद्रयस्त्वा बप्सति गोरधि त्वच्यप्सु त्वा हस्तैर्दुदुहुर्मनीषिणः ॥
verses.rom:
divi te nabha paramo ya adade prithivyaste ruruhuh sanavi kshipah |
adrayastva bapsati goradhi tvachyapsu tva hastairduduhurmanishinah ||
verses.en:
Near kin to thee is he, raised loftiest in the heavens: upon the earth's high ridge thy scions have grown forth.
The press-stones chew and crunch thee on the ox's hide: sages have milked thee with their hands into the streams.

verses.sa:
एवा त इन्दो सुभ्वं सुपेशसं रसं तुञ्जन्ति प्रथमा अभिश्रियः ।
निदंनिदं पवमान नि तारिष आविस्ते शुष्मो भवतु प्रियो मदः ॥
verses.rom:
eva ta indo subhvam supeshasam rasam tunjanti prathama abhishriyah |
nidamnidam pavamana ni tarisha aviste shushmo bhavatu priyo madah ||
verses.en:
So do they hurry on thy strong and beauteous juice, O Indu, as the first ingredient of the draught.
Bring low, thou Pavamana, every single foe, and be thy might shown forth as sweet and gladdening drink.

verses.sa:
सोमस्य धारा पवते नृचक्षस ऋतेन देवान्हवते दिवस्परि ।
बृहस्पते रवथेना वि दिद्युते समुद्रासो न सवनानि विव्यचुः ॥
verses.rom:
somasya dhara pavate nrichakshasa ritena devanhavate divaspari |
brihaspate ravathena vi didyute samudraso na savanani vivyachuh ||
verses.en:
ON flows the stream of Soma who beholds mankind: by everlasting Law he calls the Gods from heaven.
He lightens with the roaring of Br aspati: h the lakes have not contained the pourings of juice.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा वाजिन्नघ्न्या अभ्यनूषतायोहतं योनिमा रोहसि द्युमान् ।
मघोनामायुः प्रतिरन्महि श्रव इन्द्राय सोम पवसे वृषा मदः ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva vajinnaghnya abhyanushatayohatam yonima rohasi dyuman |
maghonamayuh pratiranmahi shrava indraya soma pavase vrisha madah ||
verses.en:
Thou, powerful Soma, thou to whom the cows have -lowed, ascendest bright with sheen, thine iron-fashioned home.
Thou, lengthening our princes' life and high renown, flowest for Indra as his might to gladdening drink.

verses.sa:
एन्द्रस्य कुक्षा पवते मदिन्तम ऊर्जं वसानः श्रवसे सुमङ्गलः ।
प्रत्यङ्स विश्वा भुवनाभि पप्रथे क्रीळन्हरिरत्यः स्यन्दते वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
endrasya kuksha pavate madintama urjam vasanah shravase sumangalah |
pratyansa vishva bhuvanabhi paprathe krilanhariratyah syandate vrisha ||
verses.en:
Best giver of delight, he flows to Indra's throat, robing himself in might, Auspicious One, for fame.
He spreads himself abroad to meet all things that be: the vigorous Tawny Steed flows sporting on his way.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमं नरः सहस्रधारं दुहते दश क्षिपः ।
नृभिः सोम प्रच्युतो ग्रावभिः सुतो विश्वान्देवाँ आ पवस्वा सहस्रजित् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva devebhyo madhumattamam narah sahasradharam duhate dasha kshipah |
nribhih soma prachyuto gravabhih suto vishvandevan a pavasva sahasrajit ||
verses.en:
The men, the ten swift fingers, milk thee out for Gods, even thee most rich in meath, with thousand flowing streams.
Soma who winnest thousands, driven by the men, expressed with stones, bring, as thou flowest, all the Gods.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा हस्तिनो मधुमन्तमद्रिभिर्दुहन्त्यप्सु वृषभं दश क्षिपः ।
इन्द्रं सोम मादयन्दैव्यं जनं सिन्धोरिवोर्मिः पवमानो अर्षसि ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva hastino madhumantamadribhirduhantyapsu vrishabham dasha kshipah |
indram soma madayandaivyam janam sindhorivormih pavamano arshasi ||
verses.en:
Deft-handed men with stones, the ten swift fingers, drain thee into waters, thee, the Steer enriched with sweets.
Thou, Soma, gladdening Indra, and the Heavenly Host, flowest as Pavamana like a river's wave.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमस्य पवमानस्योर्मय इन्द्रस्य यन्ति जठरं सुपेशसः ।
दध्ना यदीमुन्नीता यशसा गवां दानाय शूरमुदमन्दिषुः सुताः ॥
verses.rom:
pra somasya pavamanasyormaya indrasya yanti jatharam supeshasah |
dadhna yadimunnita yashasa gavam danaya shuramudamandishuh sutah ||
verses.en:
ONWARD to Indra's throat move, beauteously adorned, the waves of Soma as he purifies himself,
When they, brought forward with the lovely curd of kine, effused, have cheered the Hero to bestow his gifts.

verses.sa:
अच्छा हि सोमः कलशाँ असिष्यददत्यो न वोळ्हा रघुवर्तनिर्वृषा ।
अथा देवानामुभयस्य जन्मनो विद्वाँ अश्नोत्यमुत इतश्च यत् ॥
verses.rom:
achchha hi somah kalashan asishyadadatyo na volha raghuvartanirvrisha |
atha devanamubhayasya janmano vidvan ashnotyamuta itashcha yat ||
verses.en:
Hither hath Soma flowed unto the beakers, like a chariot-horse, a stallion swift upon his way.
Thus, knowing both the generations, he obtains the rights and dues of Gods from yonder and from hence.

verses.sa:
आ नः सोम पवमानः किरा वस्विन्दो भव मघवा राधसो महः ।
शिक्षा वयोधो वसवे सु चेतुना मा नो गयमारे अस्मत्परा सिचः ॥
verses.rom:
a nah soma pavamanah kira vasvindo bhava maghava radhaso mahah |
shiksha vayodho vasave su chetuna ma no gayamare asmatpara sichah ||
verses.en:
While thou art cleansed, O Soma, scatter wealth on us; Indu, bestow great bounty as a liberal Prince.
Giver of life, with wisdom help to opulence; strew not our home possessions far away from us.

verses.sa:
आ नः पूषा पवमानः सुरातयो मित्रो गच्छन्तु वरुणः सजोषसः ।
बृहस्पतिर्मरुतो वायुरश्विना त्वष्टा सविता सुयमा सरस्वती ॥
verses.rom:
a nah pusha pavamanah suratayo mitro gachchhantu varunah sajoshasah |
brihaspatirmaruto vayurashvina tvashta savita suyama sarasvati ||
verses.en:
Hither let Pusan Pavamana come to us, Varuna, Mitra, bountiful, of one accord,
The Maruts, Asvins, Vayu, and Brhaspati, Savitar, Tvastar, tractable Sarasvati.

verses.sa:
उभे द्यावापृथिवी विश्वमिन्वे अर्यमा देवो अदितिर्विधाता ।
भगो नृशंस उर्वन्तरिक्षं विश्वे देवाः पवमानं जुषन्त ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe dyavaprithivi vishvaminve aryama devo aditirvidhata |
bhago nrishamsa urvantariksham vishve devah pavamanam jushanta ||
verses.en:
Both Heaven and Earth, the all-invigorating Pair, Vidhatar, Aditi, and Aryaman the God,
Bhaga who blesses men, the spacious Firmament,-let all the Gods in Pavamana take delight.

verses.sa:
असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् ।
पुनानो वारं पर्येत्यव्ययं श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तमासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
asavi somo arusho vrisha hari rajeva dasmo abhi ga achikradat |
punano varam paryetyavyayam shyeno na yonim ghritavantamasadam ||
verses.en:
EVEN as a King hath Soma, red and tawny Bull, been pressed: the Wondrous One hath bellowed to the kine.
While purified he passes through the filtering fleece to seat him hawk-like on the place that drops with oil.

verses.sa:
कविर्वेधस्या पर्येषि माहिनमत्यो न मृष्टो अभि वाजमर्षसि ।
अपसेधन्दुरिता सोम मृळय घृतं वसानः परि यासि निर्णिजम् ॥
verses.rom:
kavirvedhasya paryeshi mahinamatyo na mrishto abhi vajamarshasi |
apasedhandurita soma mrilaya ghritam vasanah pari yasi nirnijam ||
verses.en:
To glory goest thou, Sage with disposing skill, like a groomed steed thou rushest forward to the prize.
O Soma, be thou gracious, driving off distress: thou goest, clothed in butter, to a robe of state.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्यः पिता महिषस्य पर्णिनो नाभा पृथिव्या गिरिषु क्षयं दधे ।
स्वसार आपो अभि गा उतासरन्सं ग्रावभिर्नसते वीते अध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
parjanyah pita mahishasya parnino nabha prithivya girishu kshayam dadhe |
svasara apo abhi ga utasaransam gravabhirnasate vite adhvare ||
verses.en:
Parjanya is the Father of the Mighty Bird: on mountains, in earth's centre hath he made his home.
The waters too have flowed, the Sisters, to the kine: he meets the pressing-stones at the beloved rite.

verses.sa:
जायेव पत्यावधि शेव मंहसे पज्राया गर्भ शृणुहि ब्रवीमि ते ।
अन्तर्वाणीषु प्र चरा सु जीवसेऽनिन्द्यो वृजने सोम जागृहि ॥
verses.rom:
jayeva patyavadhi sheva mamhase pajraya garbha shrinuhi bravimi te |
antarvanishu pra chara su jivase'nindyo vrijane soma jagrihi ||
verses.en:
Thou givest pleasure as a wife delights her lord. Listen, O Child of Pajri, for to thee I speak.
Amid the holy songs go on that we may live: in time of trouble, Soma, watch thou free from blame.

verses.sa:
यथा पूर्वेभ्यः शतसा अमृध्रः सहस्रसाः पर्यया वाजमिन्दो ।
एवा पवस्व सुविताय नव्यसे तव व्रतमन्वापः सचन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
yatha purvebhyah shatasa amridhrah sahasrasah paryaya vajamindo |
eva pavasva suvitaya navyase tava vratamanvapah sachante ||
verses.en:
As to the men of old thou camest, Indu unharmed, to strengthen, winning hundreds, thousands,
So now for new felicity flow onward: the waters follow as thy law ordaineth.

verses.sa:
पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः ।
अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तस्तत्समाशत ॥
verses.rom:
pavitram te vitatam brahmanaspate prabhurgatrani paryeshi vishvatah |
ataptatanurna tadamo ashnute shritasa idvahantastatsamashata ||
verses.en:
SPREAD is thy cleansing filter, Brahmanaspati: as Prince, thou enterest its limbs from every side.
The raw, whose mass hath not been heated gains not this: they only which are dressed, which bear, attain to it.

verses.sa:
तपोष्पवित्रं विततं दिवस्पदे शोचन्तो अस्य तन्तवो व्यस्थिरन् ।
अवन्त्यस्य पवीतारमाशवो दिवस्पृष्ठमधि तिष्ठन्ति चेतसा ॥
verses.rom:
taposhpavitram vitatam divaspade shochanto asya tantavo vyasthiran |
avantyasya pavitaramashavo divasprishthamadhi tishthanti chetasa ||
verses.en:
High in the seat of heaven is spread the Scorcher's sieve: its threads are standing separate, glittering with light.
The Swift Ones favour him who purifieth this: with consciousness they stand upon the height of heaven.

verses.sa:
अरूरुचदुषसः पृश्निरग्रिय उक्षा बिभर्ति भुवनानि वाजयुः ।
मायाविनो ममिरे अस्य मायया नृचक्षसः पितरो गर्भमा दधुः ॥
verses.rom:
aruruchadushasah prishniragriya uksha bibharti bhuvanani vajayuh |
mayavino mamire asya mayaya nrichakshasah pitaro garbhama dadhuh ||
verses.en:
The foremost spotted Steer hath made the Mornings shine, and yearning after strength sustains all things that be.
By his high wisdom have the mighty Sages wrought: the Fathers who behold mankind laid down the germ,

verses.sa:
गन्धर्व इत्था पदमस्य रक्षति पाति देवानां जनिमान्यद्भुतः ।
गृभ्णाति रिपुं निधया निधापतिः सुकृत्तमा मधुनो भक्षमाशत ॥
verses.rom:
gandharva ittha padamasya rakshati pati devanam janimanyadbhutah |
gribhnati ripum nidhaya nidhapatih sukrittama madhuno bhakshamashata ||
verses.en:
Gandharva verily protects his dwelling place; Wondrous, he guards the generations of the Gods.
Lord of the snare, he takes the foeman with the snare: those who are most devout have gained a share of meath.

verses.sa:
हविर्हविष्मो महि सद्म दैव्यं नभो वसानः परि यास्यध्वरम् ।
राजा पवित्ररथो वाजमारुहः सहस्रभृष्टिर्जयसि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
havirhavishmo mahi sadma daivyam nabho vasanah pari yasyadhvaram |
raja pavitraratho vajamaruhah sahasrabhrishtirjayasi shravo brihat ||
verses.en:
Rich in oblations! robed in cloud, thou compassest oblation, sacrifice, the mighty seat of Gods.
King, on thy chariot-sieve thou goest up to war, and with a thousand weapons winnest lofty fame.

verses.sa:
पवस्व देवमादनो विचर्षणिरप्सा इन्द्राय वरुणाय वायवे ।
कृधी नो अद्य वरिवः स्वस्तिमदुरुक्षितौ गृणीहि दैव्यं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva devamadano vicharshanirapsa indraya varunaya vayave |
kridhi no adya varivah svastimadurukshitau grinihi daivyam janam ||
verses.en:
FLOW, cheering Gods, most active, winner of the flood, for Indra, and for Vayu, and for Varuna.
Bestow on us to-day wide room with happiness, and in thine ample dwelling laud the Host of Heaven.

verses.sa:
आ यस्तस्थौ भुवनान्यमर्त्यो विश्वानि सोमः परि तान्यर्षति ।
कृण्वन्संचृतं विचृतमभिष्टय इन्दुः सिषक्त्युषसं न सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
a yastasthau bhuvananyamartyo vishvani somah pari tanyarshati |
krinvansamchritam vichritamabhishtaya induh sishaktyushasam na suryah ||
verses.en:
He who hath come anear to creatures that have life, Immortal Soma flows onward to all of them.
Effecting, for our aid, both union and release, Indu, like Surya, follows closely after Dawn.

verses.sa:
आ यो गोभिः सृज्यत ओषधीष्वा देवानां सुम्न इषयन्नुपावसुः ।
आ विद्युता पवते धारया सुत इन्द्रं सोमो मादयन्दैव्यं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
a yo gobhih srijyata oshadhishva devanam sumna ishayannupavasuh |
a vidyuta pavate dharaya suta indram somo madayandaivyam janam ||
verses.en:
He who is poured with milk, he who within the plants hastes bringing treasure for the happiness of Gods,
He, poured forth in a stream flows with the lightning's flash, Soma who gladdens Indra and the Host of Heaven.

verses.sa:
एष स्य सोमः पवते सहस्रजिद्धिन्वानो वाचमिषिरामुषर्बुधम् ।
इन्दुः समुद्रमुदियर्ति वायुभिरेन्द्रस्य हार्दि कलशेषु सीदति ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya somah pavate sahasrajiddhinvano vachamishiramusharbudham |
induh samudramudiyarti vayubhirendrasya hardi kalasheshu sidati ||
verses.en:
Winner of thousands, he, this Soma, flows along, raising a vigorous voice that wakens with the dawn.
Indu with winds drives on the ocean of the air, he sinks within the jars, he rests in Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं गावः पयसा पयोवृधं सोमं श्रीणन्ति मतिभिः स्वर्विदम् ।
धनंजयः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो विप्रः कविः काव्येना स्वर्चनाः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tyam gavah payasa payovridham somam shrinanti matibhih svarvidam |
dhanamjayah pavate kritvyo raso viprah kavih kavyena svarchanah ||
verses.en:
The kine with milk dress him who makes the milk increase, Soma, amid the songs, who finds the light of heaven.
Winner of wealth, the effectual juice is flowing on, Singer and Sage by wisdom, dear as heaven itself.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम सुषुतः परि स्रवापामीवा भवतु रक्षसा सह ।
मा ते रसस्य मत्सत द्वयाविनो द्रविणस्वन्त इह सन्त्विन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma sushutah pari sravapamiva bhavatu rakshasa saha |
ma te rasasya matsata dvayavino dravinasvanta iha santvindavah ||
verses.en:
FLOW on to Indra, Soma, carefully effused: let sickness stay afar together with the fiends.
Let not the double-tongued delight them with thy juice. here be thy flowing drops laden with opulence.

verses.sa:
अस्मान्समर्ये पवमान चोदय दक्षो देवानामसि हि प्रियो मदः ।
जहि शत्रूँरभ्या भन्दनायतः पिबेन्द्र सोममव नो मृधो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
asmansamarye pavamana chodaya daksho devanamasi hi priyo madah |
jahi shatrunrabhya bhandanayatah pibendra somamava no mridho jahi ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, urge us forward in the fight thou art the vigour of the Gods, the well-loved drink.
Smite thou our enemies who raise the shout of joy: Indra, drink Soma juice, and drive away our foes.

verses.sa:
अदब्ध इन्दो पवसे मदिन्तम आत्मेन्द्रस्य भवसि धासिरुत्तमः ।
अभि स्वरन्ति बहवो मनीषिणो राजानमस्य भुवनस्य निंसते ॥
verses.rom:
adabdha indo pavase madintama atmendrasya bhavasi dhasiruttamah |
abhi svaranti bahavo manishino rajanamasya bhuvanasya nimsate ||
verses.en:
Unharmed, best Cheerer, thou, O Indu, flowest on: thou, even thou thyself, art Indra's noblest food.
Full many a wise man lifts to thee the song of praise, and hails thee with a kiss as Sovran of this world.

verses.sa:
सहस्रणीथः शतधारो अद्भुत इन्द्रायेन्दुः पवते काम्यं मधु ।
जयन्क्षेत्रमभ्यर्षा जयन्नप उरुं नो गातुं कृणु सोम मीढ्वः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasranithah shatadharo adbhuta indrayenduh pavate kamyam madhu |
jayankshetramabhyarsha jayannapa urum no gatum krinu soma midhvah ||
verses.en:
Wondrous, with hundred streams, hymned in a thousand songs, Indu pours out for Indra his delightful meath.
Winning us land and waters, flow thou hitherward: Rainer of bounties, Soma, make broad way for us.

verses.sa:
कनिक्रदत्कलशे गोभिरज्यसे व्यव्ययं समया वारमर्षसि ।
मर्मृज्यमानो अत्यो न सानसिरिन्द्रस्य सोम जठरे समक्षरः ॥
verses.rom:
kanikradatkalashe gobhirajyase vyavyayam samaya varamarshasi |
marmrijyamano atyo na sanasirindrasya soma jathare samaksharah ||
verses.en:
Roaring within the beaker thou art balmed with milk: thou passest through the fleecy filter all at once.
Carefully cleansed and decked like a prizewinning steed, O Soma, thou hast flowed down within Indra's throat.

verses.sa:
स्वादुः पवस्व दिव्याय जन्मने स्वादुरिन्द्राय सुहवीतुनाम्ने ।
स्वादुर्मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे बृहस्पतये मधुमाँ अदाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
svaduh pavasva divyaya janmane svadurindraya suhavitunamne |
svadurmitraya varunaya vayave brihaspataye madhuman adabhyah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward sweet of flavour for the Heavenly Race, for Indra sweet, whose name is easily invoked:
Flow sweet for Mitra, Varuna, and Vayu, rich in meath, inviolable for Brhaspati.

verses.sa:
अत्यं मृजन्ति कलशे दश क्षिपः प्र विप्राणां मतयो वाच ईरते ।
पवमाना अभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिमेन्द्रं विशन्ति मदिरास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
atyam mrijanti kalashe dasha kshipah pra vipranam matayo vacha irate |
pavamana abhyarshanti sushtutimendram vishanti madirasa indavah ||
verses.en:
Ten rapid fingers deck the Courser in the jar: with hymns the holy singers send their voices forth.
The filtering juices hasten to their eulogy, the drops that gladden find their way to Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
पवमानो अभ्यर्षा सुवीर्यमुर्वीं गव्यूतिं महि शर्म सप्रथः ।
माकिर्नो अस्य परिषूतिरीशतेन्दो जयेम त्वया धनंधनम् ॥
verses.rom:
pavamano abhyarsha suviryamurvim gavyutim mahi sharma saprathah |
makirno asya parishutirishatendo jayema tvaya dhanamdhanam ||
verses.en:
While thou art purified pour on us hero strength, great, far-extended shelter, spacious pasturage.
Let no oppression master this our holy work: may we, O Indu, gain all opulence through thee.

verses.sa:
अधि द्यामस्थाद्वृषभो विचक्षणोऽरूरुचद्वि दिवो रोचना कविः ।
राजा पवित्रमत्येति रोरुवद्दिवः पीयूषं दुहते नृचक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
adhi dyamasthadvrishabho vichakshano'ruruchadvi divo rochana kavih |
raja pavitramatyeti roruvaddivah piyusham duhate nrichakshasah ||
verses.en:
The Steer who sees afar hath risen above the sky: the Sage hath caused the lights of heaven to give their shine.
The. King is passing through the filter with a roar: they drain the milk of heaven from him who looks on men.

verses.sa:
दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतो वेना दुहन्त्युक्षणं गिरिष्ठाम् ।
अप्सु द्रप्सं वावृधानं समुद्र आ सिन्धोरूर्मा मधुमन्तं पवित्र आ ॥
verses.rom:
divo nake madhujihva asashchato vena duhantyukshanam girishtham |
apsu drapsam vavridhanam samudra a sindhorurma madhumantam pavitra a ||
verses.en:
High in the vault of heaven, unceasing, honey-tongued, the Loving Ones drain out the mountain-haunting Steer,-
The drop that hath grown great in waters, in the lake meath-rich, in the stream's wave and in the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
नाके सुपर्णमुपपप्तिवांसं गिरो वेनानामकृपन्त पूर्वीः ।
शिशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतं हिरण्ययं शकुनं क्षामणि स्थाम् ॥
verses.rom:
nake suparnamupapaptivamsam giro venanamakripanta purvih |
shishum rihanti matayah panipnatam hiranyayam shakunam kshamani stham ||
verses.en:
The Loving Ones besought with many voices the Eagle who had flown away to heaven.
Hymns kiss the Youngling worthy of laudation, resting on earth, the Bird of golden colour.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थाद्विश्वा रूपा प्रतिचक्षाणो अस्य ।
भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा व्यद्यौत्प्रारूरुचद्रोदसी मातरा शुचिः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo gandharvo adhi nake asthadvishva rupa pratichakshano asya |
bhanuh shukrena shochisha vyadyautpraruruchadrodasi matara shuchih ||
verses.en:
High to heaven's vault hath the Gandharva risen, beholding all his varied forms and figures.
His ray hath shone abroad with gleaming splendour: pure, he hath lighted both the worlds, the Parents.

verses.sa:
प्र त आशवः पवमान धीजवो मदा अर्षन्ति रघुजा इव त्मना ।
दिव्याः सुपर्णा मधुमन्त इन्दवो मदिन्तमासः परि कोशमासते ॥
verses.rom:
pra ta ashavah pavamana dhijavo mada arshanti raghuja iva tmana |
divyah suparna madhumanta indavo madintamasah pari koshamasate ||
verses.en:
THY gladdening draughts, O Pavamana, urged by song flow swiftly of themselves like sons of fleet-foot mares.
The drops of Soma juice, those eagles of the heavens, most cheering, rich in meath, rest in the reservoir.

verses.sa:
प्र ते मदासो मदिरास आशवोऽसृक्षत रथ्यासो यथा पृथक् ।
धेनुर्न वत्सं पयसाभि वज्रिणमिन्द्रमिन्दवो मधुमन्त ऊर्मयः ॥
verses.rom:
pra te madaso madirasa ashavo'srikshata rathyaso yatha prithak |
dhenurna vatsam payasabhi vajrinamindramindavo madhumanta urmayah ||
verses.en:
As rapid chariot-steeds, so turned in several ways have thine exhilarating juices darted forth,
Soma-drops rich in meath, waves, to the Thunder-armed, to Indra, like milch-kine who seek their calf with milk.

verses.sa:
अत्यो न हियानो अभि वाजमर्ष स्वर्वित्कोशं दिवो अद्रिमातरम् ।
वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्यये सोमः पुनान इन्द्रियाय धायसे ॥
verses.rom:
atyo na hiyano abhi vajamarsha svarvitkosham divo adrimataram |
vrisha pavitre adhi sano avyaye somah punana indriyaya dhayase ||
verses.en:
Like a steed urged to battle, finder of the light; speed onward to the cloud-born reservoir of heaven,
A Steer that o'er the woolly surface seeks the sieve, Soma while purified for Indra's nourishment.

verses.sa:
प्र त आश्विनीः पवमान धीजुवो दिव्या असृग्रन्पयसा धरीमणि ।
प्रान्तरृषय स्थाविरीरसृक्षत ये त्वा मृजन्त्यृषिषाण वेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ta ashvinih pavamana dhijuvo divya asrigranpayasa dharimani |
prantarrishaya sthavirirasrikshata ye tva mrijantyrishishana vedhasah ||
verses.en:
Fleet as swift steeds, thy drops, divine, thought-swift, have been, O Pavamana, poured with milk into the vat.
The Rsis have poured in continuous Soma drops, ordainers who adorn thee, Friend whom Rsis love.

verses.sa:
विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष ऋभ्वसः प्रभोस्ते सतः परि यन्ति केतवः ।
व्यानशिः पवसे सोम धर्मभिः पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
vishva dhamani vishvachaksha ribhvasah prabhoste satah pari yanti ketavah |
vyanashih pavase soma dharmabhih patirvishvasya bhuvanasya rajasi ||
verses.en:
O thou who seest all things, Sovran as thou art and passing strong, thy rays encompass all abodes.
Pervading with thy natural powers thou flowest on, and as the whole world's Lord, O Soma, thou art King.

verses.sa:
उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो ध्रुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः ।
यदी पवित्रे अधि मृज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योना कलशेषु सीदति ॥
verses.rom:
ubhayatah pavamanasya rashmayo dhruvasya satah pari yanti ketavah |
yadi pavitre adhi mrijyate harih satta ni yona kalasheshu sidati ||
verses.en:
The beams of Pavamana, sent from earth and heaven, his ensigns who is ever steadfast, travel round.
When on the sieve the Golden-hued is cleansed, he rests within the vats as one who seats him in his place.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य केतुः पवते स्वध्वरः सोमो देवानामुप याति निष्कृतम् ।
सहस्रधारः परि कोशमर्षति वृषा पवित्रमत्येति रोरुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya ketuh pavate svadhvarah somo devanamupa yati nishkritam |
sahasradharah pari koshamarshati vrisha pavitramatyeti roruvat ||
verses.en:
Served with fair rites he flows, ensign of sacrifice: Soma advances to the special place of Gods.
He speeds with thousand currents to the reservoir, and passes through the filter bellowing as a bull.

verses.sa:
राजा समुद्रं नद्यो वि गाहतेऽपामूर्मिं सचते सिन्धुषु श्रितः ।
अध्यस्थात्सानु पवमानो अव्ययं नाभा पृथिव्या धरुणो महो दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
raja samudram nadyo vi gahate'pamurmim sachate sindhushu shritah |
adhyasthatsanu pavamano avyayam nabha prithivya dharuno maho divah ||
verses.en:
The Sovran dips him in the sea in and the streams, and set in rivers with the waters' wave moves on.
High heaven's Sustainer at the central point of earth, raised on the fleecy surface Pavamana stands.

verses.sa:
दिवो न सानु स्तनयन्नचिक्रदद्द्यौश्च यस्य पृथिवी च धर्मभिः ।
इन्द्रस्य सख्यं पवते विवेविदत्सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति ॥
verses.rom:
divo na sanu stanayannachikradaddyaushcha yasya prithivi cha dharmabhih |
indrasya sakhyam pavate vivevidatsomah punanah kalasheshu sidati ||
verses.en:
He on whose high decree the heavens and earth depend hath roared and thundered like the summit of the sky.
Soma flows on obtaining Indra's friendly love, and, as they purify him, settles in the jars.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिर्यज्ञस्य पवते मधु प्रियं पिता देवानां जनिता विभूवसुः ।
दधाति रत्नं स्वधयोरपीच्यं मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रियो रसः ॥
verses.rom:
jyotiryajnasya pavate madhu priyam pita devanam janita vibhuvasuh |
dadhati ratnam svadhayorapichyam madintamo matsara indriyo rasah ||
verses.en:
He, light of sacrifice distils delicious meath, most wealthy, Father and begetter of the Gods.
He, gladdening, best of Cheerers, juice hat Indra loves, enriches with mysterious treasure earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
अभिक्रन्दन्कलशं वाज्यर्षति पतिर्दिवः शतधारो विचक्षणः ।
हरिर्मित्रस्य सदनेषु सीदति मर्मृजानोऽविभिः सिन्धुभिर्वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
abhikrandankalasham vajyarshati patirdivah shatadharo vichakshanah |
harirmitrasya sadaneshu sidati marmrijano'vibhih sindhubhirvrisha ||
verses.en:
The vigorous and far-seeing one, the Lord of heaven, flows, shouting to the beaker, with his thousand streams.
Coloured like gold he rests in seats where Mitra dwells, the Steer made beautiful by rivers and by sheep.

verses.sa:
अग्रे सिन्धूनां पवमानो अर्षत्यग्रे वाचो अग्रियो गोषु गच्छति ।
अग्रे वाजस्य भजते महाधनं स्वायुधः सोतृभिः पूयते वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
agre sindhunam pavamano arshatyagre vacho agriyo goshu gachchhati |
agre vajasya bhajate mahadhanam svayudhah sotribhih puyate vrisha ||
verses.en:
In forefront of the rivers Pavamana speeds, in forefront of the hymn, foremost among the kine.
He shares the mighty booty in the van of war: the well-armed Steer is purified by worshippers.

verses.sa:
अयं मतवाञ्छकुनो यथा हितोऽव्ये ससार पवमान ऊर्मिणा ।
तव क्रत्वा रोदसी अन्तरा कवे शुचिर्धिया पवते सोम इन्द्र ते ॥
verses.rom:
ayam matavanchhakuno yatha hito'vye sasara pavamana urmina |
tava kratva rodasi antara kave shuchirdhiya pavate soma indra te ||
verses.en:
This heedful Pavamana, like a bird sent forth, hath with his wave flowed onward to the fleecy sieve.
O Indra, through thy wisdom, b thy thought, O Sage, Soma flows bright and pure between the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
द्रापिं वसानो यजतो दिविस्पृशमन्तरिक्षप्रा भुवनेष्वर्पितः ।
स्वर्जज्ञानो नभसाभ्यक्रमीत्प्रत्नमस्य पितरमा विवासति ॥
verses.rom:
drapim vasano yajato divisprishamantarikshapra bhuvaneshvarpitah |
svarjajnano nabhasabhyakramitpratnamasya pitarama vivasati ||
verses.en:
He, clad in mail that reaches heaven, the Holy One, filling the firmament stationed amid the worlds,
Knowing. the realm of light, hath come to us in rain: he summons to himself his own primeval Sire.

verses.sa:
सो अस्य विशे महि शर्म यच्छति यो अस्य धाम प्रथमं व्यानशे ।
पदं यदस्य परमे व्योमन्यतो विश्वा अभि सं याति संयतः ॥
verses.rom:
so asya vishe mahi sharma yachchhati yo asya dhama prathamam vyanashe |
padam yadasya parame vyomanyato vishva abhi sam yati samyatah ||
verses.en:
He who was first of all to penetrate his form bestowed upon his race wide shelter and defense.
From that high station which he hath in loftiest heaven he comes victorious to all encounters here.

verses.sa:
प्रो अयासीदिन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतं सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति संगिरम् ।
मर्य इव युवतिभिः समर्षति सोमः कलशे शतयाम्ना पथा ॥
verses.rom:
pro ayasidindurindrasya nishkritam sakha sakhyurna pra minati samgiram |
marya iva yuvatibhih samarshati somah kalashe shatayamna patha ||
verses.en:
Indu hath started for Indra's special place and slights not as a Friend the promise of his Friend.
Soma speeds onward like a youth to youthful maids, and gains the beaker by a course of hundred paths.

verses.sa:
प्र वो धियो मन्द्रयुवो विपन्युवः पनस्युवः संवसनेष्वक्रमुः ।
सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत स्तुभोऽभि धेनवः पयसेमशिश्रयुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo dhiyo mandrayuvo vipanyuvah panasyuvah samvasaneshvakramuh |
somam manisha abhyanushata stubho'bhi dhenavah payasemashishrayuh ||
verses.en:
Your songs, exhilarating, tuneful, uttering praise, are come into the plains where the people meet.
Worshippers have exalted Soma with their hymns, and milch kine have come near to meet him with their milk.

verses.sa:
आ नः सोम संयतं पिप्युषीमिषमिन्दो पवस्व पवमानो अस्रिधम् ।
या नो दोहते त्रिरहन्नसश्चुषी क्षुमद्वाजवन्मधुमत्सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
a nah soma samyatam pipyushimishamindo pavasva pavamano asridham |
ya no dohate trirahannasashchushi kshumadvajavanmadhumatsuviryam ||
verses.en:
O Soma, Indu, while they cleanse thee, pour on us accumulateds Plentiful, nutritious food,
Which, ceaseless, thrice a day shall yield us hero power enriched with store of nourishment, and strength, and Meath.

verses.sa:
वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नः प्रतरीतोषसो दिवः ।
क्राणा सिन्धूनां कलशाँ अवीवशदिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्मनीषिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha matinam pavate vichakshanah somo ahnah prataritoshaso divah |
krana sindhunam kalashan avivashadindrasya hardyavishanmanishibhih ||
verses.en:
Far-seeing Soma flows, the Steer, the Lord of hymns, the Furtherer of day, of morning, and of heaven.
Mixt with the streams he caused the beakers to resound, and with the singers' aid they entered Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
मनीषिभिः पवते पूर्व्यः कविर्नृभिर्यतः परि कोशाँ अचिक्रदत् ।
त्रितस्य नाम जनयन्मधु क्षरदिन्द्रस्य वायोः सख्याय कर्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
manishibhih pavate purvyah kavirnribhiryatah pari koshan achikradat |
tritasya nama janayanmadhu ksharadindrasya vayoh sakhyaya kartave ||
verses.en:
On, with the prudent singers, flows the ancient Sage and guided by the men hath roared about the vats.
Producing Trita's name, may he pour forth the meath, that Vayu and that Indra may become his Friends.

verses.sa:
अयं पुनान उषसो वि रोचयदयं सिन्धुभ्यो अभवदु लोककृत् ।
अयं त्रिः सप्त दुदुहान आशिरं सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam punana ushaso vi rochayadayam sindhubhyo abhavadu lokakrit |
ayam trih sapta duduhana ashiram somo hride pavate charu matsarah ||
verses.en:
He, being purified, hath made the Mornings shine: this, even this is he who gave the rivers room.
He made the Three Times Seven pour out the milky flow: Soma, the Cheerer, yields whate'er the heart finds sweet.

verses.sa:
पवस्व सोम दिव्येषु धामसु सृजान इन्दो कलशे पवित्र आ ।
सीदन्निन्द्रस्य जठरे कनिक्रदन्नृभिर्यतः सूर्यमारोहयो दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva soma divyeshu dhamasu srijana indo kalashe pavitra a |
sidannindrasya jathare kanikradannribhiryatah suryamarohayo divi ||
verses.en:
Flow, onward, Soma, in thine own celestial forms, flow, Indu, poured within the beaker and the sieve.
Sinking into the throat of Indra with a roar, led by the men thou madest Surya mount to heaven.

verses.sa:
अद्रिभिः सुतः पवसे पवित्र आँ इन्दविन्द्रस्य जठरेष्वाविशन् ।
त्वं नृचक्षा अभवो विचक्षण सोम गोत्रमङ्गिरोभ्योऽवृणोरप ॥
verses.rom:
adribhih sutah pavase pavitra an indavindrasya jathareshvavishan |
tvam nrichaksha abhavo vichakshana soma gotramangirobhyo'vrinorapa ||
verses.en:
Pressed out with stones thou flowest onward to the sieve, O Indu, entering the depths of Indra's throat.
Far-sighted Soma, now thou lookest on mankind: thou didst unbar the cowstall for the Angirases.

verses.sa:
त्वां सोम पवमानं स्वाध्योऽनु विप्रासो अमदन्नवस्यवः ।
त्वां सुपर्ण आभरद्दिवस्परीन्दो विश्वाभिर्मतिभिः परिष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma pavamanam svadhyo'nu vipraso amadannavasyavah |
tvam suparna abharaddivasparindo vishvabhirmatibhih parishkritam ||
verses.en:
In thee, O Soma, while thou purifitedst thee, high-thoughted sages, seeking favour, have rejoiced.
Down from the heavens the Falcon brought thee hitherward, even thee, O Indu, thee whom all our hymns adorn.

verses.sa:
अव्ये पुनानं परि वार ऊर्मिणा हरिं नवन्ते अभि सप्त धेनवः ।
अपामुपस्थे अध्यायवः कविमृतस्य योना महिषा अहेषत ॥
verses.rom:
avye punanam pari vara urmina harim navante abhi sapta dhenavah |
apamupasthe adhyayavah kavimritasya yona mahisha aheshata ||
verses.en:
Seven Milch-kine glorify the Tawny-coloured One while with his wave in wool he purifies himself.
The living men, the mighty, have impelled the Sage into the waters' lap, the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इन्दुः पुनानो अति गाहते मृधो विश्वानि कृण्वन्सुपथानि यज्यवे ।
गाः कृण्वानो निर्णिजं हर्यतः कविरत्यो न क्रीळन्परि वारमर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
induh punano ati gahate mridho vishvani krinvansupathani yajyave |
gah krinvano nirnijam haryatah kaviratyo na krilanpari varamarshati ||
verses.en:
Indu, attaining purity, plunges through the foe, making his ways all easy for the pious man.
Making the kine his mantle, he, the lovely Sage, runs like a sporting courser onward through the fleece.

verses.sa:
असश्चतः शतधारा अभिश्रियो हरिं नवन्तेऽव ता उदन्युवः ।
क्षिपो मृजन्ति परि गोभिरावृतं तृतीये पृष्ठे अधि रोचने दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
asashchatah shatadhara abhishriyo harim navante'va ta udanyuvah |
kshipo mrijanti pari gobhiravritam tritiye prishthe adhi rochane divah ||
verses.en:
The ceaseless watery fountains with their hundred streams sing, as they hasten near, to him the Golden-hued
Him, clad in robes of milk, swift fingers beautify on the third height and in the luminous realm of heaven.

verses.sa:
तवेमाः प्रजा दिव्यस्य रेतसस्त्वं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि ।
अथेदं विश्वं पवमान ते वशे त्वमिन्दो प्रथमो धामधा असि ॥
verses.rom:
