tavemah praja divyasya retasastvam vishvasya bhuvanasya rajasi |
athedam vishvam pavamana te vashe tvamindo prathamo dhamadha asi ||
verses.en:
These are thy generations of celestial seed thou art the Sovran Lord of all the world of life.
This universe, O Pavamana, owns thy sway; thou, Indu, art the first establisher of Law.

verses.sa:
त्वं समुद्रो असि विश्ववित्कवे तवेमाः पञ्च प्रदिशो विधर्मणि ।
त्वं द्यां च पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे तव ज्योतींषि पवमान सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam samudro asi vishvavitkave tavemah pancha pradisho vidharmani |
tvam dyam cha prithivim chati jabhrishe tava jyotimshi pavamana suryah ||
verses.en:
Thou art the sea, O Sage who bringest all to light: under thy Law are these five regions of the world.
Tlou reachest out beyond the earth, beyond the heavens: thine are the lights, O Pavamana, thine the Sun.

verses.sa:
त्वं पवित्रे रजसो विधर्मणि देवेभ्यः सोम पवमान पूयसे ।
त्वामुशिजः प्रथमा अगृभ्णत तुभ्येमा विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam pavitre rajaso vidharmani devebhyah soma pavamana puyase |
tvamushijah prathama agribhnata tubhyema vishva bhuvanani yemire ||
verses.en:
Thou in the filter, Soma Pavamana, art purified to support the region for the Gods.
The chief, the longing ones have sought to hold thee fast, and all these living creatures have been turned to thee.

verses.sa:
प्र रेभ एत्यति वारमव्ययं वृषा वनेष्वव चक्रदद्धरिः ।
सं धीतयो वावशाना अनूषत शिशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra rebha etyati varamavyayam vrisha vaneshvava chakradaddharih |
sam dhitayo vavashana anushata shishum rihanti matayah panipnatam ||
verses.en:
Onward the Singer travels o'er the fleecy sieve. the Tawny Steer hath bellowed in the wooden vats.
Hymns have been sung aloud in resonant harmony, and holy songs kiss him, the Child who claims our praise.

verses.sa:
स सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः परि व्यत तन्तुं तन्वानस्त्रिवृतं यथा विदे ।
नयन्नृतस्य प्रशिषो नवीयसीः पतिर्जनीनामुप याति निष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa suryasya rashmibhih pari vyata tantum tanvanastrivritam yatha vide |
nayannritasya prashisho naviyasih patirjaninamupa yati nishkritam ||
verses.en:
He hath assumed the rays of Surya for his robe, spinning, as he knows bow, the triply-twisted thread.
He, guiding to the newest rules of Holy Law, comes as the Women's Consort to the special place.

verses.sa:
राजा सिन्धूनां पवते पतिर्दिव ऋतस्य याति पथिभिः कनिक्रदत् ।
सहस्रधारः परि षिच्यते हरिः पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नुपावसुः ॥
verses.rom:
raja sindhunam pavate patirdiva ritasya yati pathibhih kanikradat |
sahasradharah pari shichyate harih punano vacham janayannupavasuh ||
verses.en:
On flows the King of rivers and the Lord of heaven: he follows with a shout the paths of Holy Law.
The Golden-hued is poured forth, with his hundred streams, Wealth-bringer, lifting up his voice while purified.

verses.sa:
पवमान मह्यर्णो वि धावसि सूरो न चित्रो अव्ययानि पव्यया ।
गभस्तिपूतो नृभिरद्रिभिः सुतो महे वाजाय धन्याय धन्वसि ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana mahyarno vi dhavasi suro na chitro avyayani pavyaya |
gabhastiputo nribhiradribhih suto mahe vajaya dhanyaya dhanvasi ||
verses.en:
Fain to be cleansed, thou, Pavamana, pourest out, like wondrous Surya, through the fleece, an ample sea.
Purified with the hands, pressed by the men with stones, thou speedest on to mighty booty-bringing war.

verses.sa:
इषमूर्जं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि श्येनो न वंसु कलशेषु सीदसि ।
इन्द्राय मद्वा मद्यो मदः सुतो दिवो विष्टम्भ उपमो विचक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
ishamurjam pavamanabhyarshasi shyeno na vamsu kalasheshu sidasi |
indraya madva madyo madah suto divo vishtambha upamo vichakshanah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Pavamana, sendest food and power in streams. thou sittest in the beakers as a hawk on trees,
For Indra poured as cheering juice to make him glad, as nearest and farseeing bearer-up of heaven.

verses.sa:
सप्त स्वसारो अभि मातरः शिशुं नवं जज्ञानं जेन्यं विपश्चितम् ।
अपां गन्धर्वं दिव्यं नृचक्षसं सोमं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसे ॥
verses.rom:
sapta svasaro abhi matarah shishum navam jajnanam jenyam vipashchitam |
apam gandharvam divyam nrichakshasam somam vishvasya bhuvanasya rajase ||
verses.en:
The Sisters Seven, the Mothers, stand around the Babe, the noble, new-born Infant, skilled in holy song,
Gandharva of the floods, divine, beholding men, Soma, that he may reign as King of all the world.

verses.sa:
ईशान इमा भुवनानि वीयसे युजान इन्दो हरितः सुपर्ण्यः ।
तास्ते क्षरन्तु मधुमद्घृतं पयस्तव व्रते सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
ishana ima bhuvanani viyase yujana indo haritah suparnyah |
taste ksharantu madhumadghritam payastava vrate soma tishthantu krishtayah ||
verses.en:
As Sovran Lord thereof thou Passest through these worlds, O Indu, harnessing thy tawny well-winged Mares.
May they pour forth for thee milk and oil rich in sweets: O Soma, let the folk abide in thy decree.

verses.sa:
त्वं नृचक्षा असि सोम विश्वतः पवमान वृषभ ता वि धावसि ।
स नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवद्वयं स्याम भुवनेषु जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nrichaksha asi soma vishvatah pavamana vrishabha ta vi dhavasi |
sa nah pavasva vasumaddhiranyavadvayam syama bhuvaneshu jivase ||
verses.en:
O Soma, thou beholdest men from every side: O Pavamana, Steer, thou wanderest through these.
Pour out upon us wealth in treasure and in gold: may we have strength to live among the things that be.

verses.sa:
गोवित्पवस्व वसुविद्धिरण्यविद्रेतोधा इन्दो भुवनेष्वर्पितः ।
त्वं सुवीरो असि सोम विश्ववित्तं त्वा विप्रा उप गिरेम आसते ॥
verses.rom:
govitpavasva vasuviddhiranyavidretodha indo bhuvaneshvarpitah |
tvam suviro asi soma vishvavittam tva vipra upa girema asate ||
verses.en:
Winner of gold and goods and cattle flow thou on, set as impregner, Indu, mid the worlds of life.
Rich in brave men art thou, Soma, who winnest all: these holy singers wait upon thee with the song.

verses.sa:
उन्मध्व ऊर्मिर्वनना अतिष्ठिपदपो वसानो महिषो वि गाहते ।
राजा पवित्ररथो वाजमारुहत्सहस्रभृष्टिर्जयति श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
unmadhva urmirvanana atishthipadapo vasano mahisho vi gahate |
raja pavitraratho vajamaruhatsahasrabhrishtirjayati shravo brihat ||
verses.en:
The wave of flowing meath hath wakened up desires: the Steer enrobed in milk plunges into the streams.
Borne on his chariot-sieve the King hath risen to war, and with a thousand rays hath won him high renown.

verses.sa:
स भन्दना उदियर्ति प्रजावतीर्विश्वायुर्विश्वाः सुभरा अहर्दिवि ।
ब्रह्म प्रजावद्रयिमश्वपस्त्यं पीत इन्दविन्द्रमस्मभ्यं याचतात् ॥
verses.rom:
sa bhandana udiyarti prajavatirvishvayurvishvah subhara ahardivi |
brahma prajavadrayimashvapastyam pita indavindramasmabhyam yachatat ||
verses.en:
Dear to all life, he sends triumphant praises forth, abundant, bringing offspring, each succeeding day.
From Indra crave for us, Indu, when thou art quaffed, the blessing that gives children, wealth that harbours steeds.

verses.sa:
सो अग्रे अह्नां हरिर्हर्यतो मदः प्र चेतसा चेतयते अनु द्युभिः ।
द्वा जना यातयन्नन्तरीयते नरा च शंसं दैव्यं च धर्तरि ॥
verses.rom:
so agre ahnam harirharyato madah pra chetasa chetayate anu dyubhih |
dva jana yatayannantariyate nara cha shamsam daivyam cha dhartari ||
verses.en:
When days begin, the strong juice, lovely, golden-hued, is recognized by wisdom more and more each day,
He, stirring both the Races, goes between the two, the bearer of the word of men and word of Gods.

verses.sa:
अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुं रिहन्ति मधुनाभ्यञ्जते ।
सिन्धोरुच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणं हिरण्यपावाः पशुमासु गृभ्णते ॥
verses.rom:
anjate vyanjate samanjate kratum rihanti madhunabhyanjate |
sindhoruchchhvase patayantamukshanam hiranyapavah pashumasu gribhnate ||
verses.en:
They balm him, balm him over balm him thoroughly, caress the mighty strength and balm it with the meath.
They seize the flying Steer at the stream's breathing-place: cleansing with gold they grasp the Animal herein.

verses.sa:
विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत मही न धारात्यन्धो अर्षति ।
अहिर्न जूर्णामति सर्पति त्वचमत्यो न क्रीळन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
vipashchite pavamanaya gayata mahi na dharatyandho arshati |
ahirna jurnamati sarpati tvachamatyo na krilannasaradvrisha harih ||
verses.en:
Sing forth to Pavamana skilled in holy song: the juice is flowing onward like a mighty stream.
He glideth like a serpent from his ancient skin, and like a playful horse the Tawny Steer hath run.

verses.sa:
अग्रेगो राजाप्यस्तविष्यते विमानो अह्नां भुवनेष्वर्पितः ।
हरिर्घृतस्नुः सुदृशीको अर्णवो ज्योतीरथः पवते राय ओक्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agrego rajapyastavishyate vimano ahnam bhuvaneshvarpitah |
harirghritasnuh sudrishiko arnavo jyotirathah pavate raya okyah ||
verses.en:
Dweller in floods, King, foremost, he displays his might, set among living things as measurer of days.
Distilling oil he flows, fair, billowy, golden-hued, borne on a car of light, sharing one home with wealth.

verses.sa:
असर्जि स्कम्भो दिव उद्यतो मदः परि त्रिधातुर्भुवनान्यर्षति ।
अंशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतं गिरा यदि निर्णिजमृग्मिणो ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
asarji skambho diva udyato madah pari tridhaturbhuvananyarshati |
amshum rihanti matayah panipnatam gira yadi nirnijamrigmino yayuh ||
verses.en:
Loosed is the heavens! support, the uplifted cheering juice: the triply-mingled draught flows round into the worlds.
The holy hymns caress the stalk that claims our praise, when singers have approached his beauteous robe with song.

verses.sa:
प्र ते धारा अत्यण्वानि मेष्यः पुनानस्य संयतो यन्ति रंहयः ।
यद्गोभिरिन्दो चम्वोः समज्यस आ सुवानः सोम कलशेषु सीदसि ॥
verses.rom:
pra te dhara atyanvani meshyah punanasya samyato yanti ramhayah |
yadgobhirindo chamvoh samajyasa a suvanah soma kalasheshu sidasi ||
verses.en:
Thy streams that flow forth rapidly collected run over the fine fleece of the sheep as thou art cleansed.
When, Indu, thou art balmed with milk within the bowl, thou sinkest in the jars, O Soma, when expressed.

verses.sa:
पवस्व सोम क्रतुविन्न उक्थ्योऽव्यो वारे परि धाव मधु प्रियम् ।
जहि विश्वान्रक्षस इन्दो अत्रिणो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva soma kratuvinna ukthyo'vyo vare pari dhava madhu priyam |
jahi vishvanrakshasa indo atrino brihadvadema vidathe suvirah ||
verses.en:
Winner of' power, flow, Soma, worthy of our laud: run onward to the fleece as well-beloved meath.
Destroy, O Indu, all voracious Raksasas. With brave sons in the assembly let our speech be bold.

verses.sa:
प्र तु द्रव परि कोशं नि षीद नृभिः पुनानो अभि वाजमर्ष ।
अश्वं न त्वा वाजिनं मर्जयन्तोऽच्छा बर्ही रशनाभिर्नयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
pra tu drava pari kosham ni shida nribhih punano abhi vajamarsha |
ashvam na tva vajinam marjayanto'chchha barhi rashanabhirnayanti ||
verses.en:
RUN onward to the reservoir and seat thee: cleansed by the men speed forward to the battle.
Making thee beauteous like an able courser, forth to the sacred grass with reins they lead thee.

verses.sa:
स्वायुधः पवते देव इन्दुरशस्तिहा वृजनं रक्षमाणः ।
पिता देवानां जनिता सुदक्षो विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.rom:
svayudhah pavate deva indurashastiha vrijanam rakshamanah |
pita devanam janita sudaksho vishtambho divo dharunah prithivyah ||
verses.en:
Indu, the well-armed God, is flowing onward, who quells the curse and guards from treacherous onslaught,
Father, begetter of the Gods, most skillful, the buttress of the heavens and earth's supporter.

verses.sa:
ऋषिर्विप्रः पुरएता जनानामृभुर्धीर उशना काव्येन ।
स चिद्विवेद निहितं यदासामपीच्यं गुह्यं नाम गोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
rishirviprah puraeta jananamribhurdhira ushana kavyena |
sa chidviveda nihitam yadasamapichyam guhyam nama gonam ||
verses.en:
Rsi and Sage, the Champion of the people, cleft and sagacious, Usana in wisdom,
He hath discovered even their hidden nature, the Cows' concealed and most mysterious title.

verses.sa:
एष स्य ते मधुमाँ इन्द्र सोमो वृषा वृष्णे परि पवित्रे अक्षाः ।
सहस्रसाः शतसा भूरिदावा शश्वत्तमं बर्हिरा वाज्यस्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya te madhuman indra somo vrisha vrishne pari pavitre akshah |
sahasrasah shatasa bhuridava shashvattamam barhira vajyasthat ||
verses.en:
This thine own Soma rich in meath, O Indra, Steer for the Steer, hath flowed into the filter.
The strong Free-giver, winning hundreds, thousands, hath reached the holy grass that never fails him.

verses.sa:
एते सोमा अभि गव्या सहस्रा महे वाजायामृताय श्रवांसि ।
पवित्रेभिः पवमाना असृग्रञ्छ्रवस्यवो न पृतनाजो अत्याः ॥
verses.rom:
ete soma abhi gavya sahasra mahe vajayamritaya shravamsi |
pavitrebhih pavamana asrigranchhravasyavo na pritanajo atyah ||
verses.en:
These Somas are for wealth of countless cattle, renown therefor, and mighty strength immortal.
These have been sent forth, purified by strainers, like steeds who rush to battle fain for glory.

verses.sa:
परि हि ष्मा पुरुहूतो जनानां विश्वासरद्भोजना पूयमानः ।
अथा भर श्येनभृत प्रयांसि रयिं तुञ्जानो अभि वाजमर्ष ॥
verses.rom:
pari hi shma puruhuto jananam vishvasaradbhojana puyamanah |
atha bhara shyenabhrita prayamsi rayim tunjano abhi vajamarsha ||
verses.en:
He, while he cleanses him, invoked of many, hath flowed to give the people all enjoyment.
Thou whom the Falcon brought, bring, dainty viands, bestir thyself and send us wealth and booty.

verses.sa:
एष सुवानः परि सोमः पवित्रे सर्गो न सृष्टो अदधावदर्वा ।
तिग्मे शिशानो महिषो न शृङ्गे गा गव्यन्नभि शूरो न सत्वा ॥
verses.rom:
esha suvanah pari somah pavitre sargo na srishto adadhavadarva |
tigme shishano mahisho na shringe ga gavyannabhi shuro na satva ||
verses.en:
This Soma, pressed into the cleansing filter, hath run as 'twere a host let loose, the Courser;
Like a strong bull who whets his horns pen-pointed, like a brave warrior in the fray for cattle.

verses.sa:
एषा ययौ परमादन्तरद्रेः कूचित्सतीरूर्वे गा विवेद ।
दिवो न विद्युत्स्तनयन्त्यभ्रैः सोमस्य ते पवत इन्द्र धारा ॥
verses.rom:
esha yayau paramadantaradreh kuchitsatirurve ga viveda |
divo na vidyutstanayantyabhraih somasya te pavata indra dhara ||
verses.en:
He issued forth from out the loftiest mountain, and found kine hidden somewhere in a stable.
Soma's stream clears itself for thee, O Indra, like lightning thundering through the clouds of heaven,

verses.sa:
उत स्म राशिं परि यासि गोनामिन्द्रेण सोम सरथं पुनानः ।
पूर्वीरिषो बृहतीर्जीरदानो शिक्षा शचीवस्तव ता उपष्टुत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta sma rashim pari yasi gonamindrena soma saratham punanah |
purvirisho brihatirjiradano shiksha shachivastava ta upashtut ||
verses.en:
Cleansing thyself, and borne along with Indra, Soma, thou goest round the herd of cattle.
May thy praise help us, Mighty One, prompt Giver, to the full ample food which thou bestowest.

verses.sa:
अयं सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यं सुन्वे तुभ्यं पवते त्वमस्य पाहि ।
त्वं ह यं चकृषे त्वं ववृष इन्दुं मदाय युज्याय सोमम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam soma indra tubhyam sunve tubhyam pavate tvamasya pahi |
tvam ha yam chakrishe tvam vavrisha indum madaya yujyaya somam ||
verses.en:
FOR thee this Soma is effused, O Indra: drink of this juice; for thee the stream is flowing-
Soma, which thou thyself hast made and chosen, even Indu, for thy special drink to cheer thee.

verses.sa:
स ईं रथो न भुरिषाळयोजि महः पुरूणि सातये वसूनि ।
आदीं विश्वा नहुष्याणि जाता स्वर्षाता वन ऊर्ध्वा नवन्त ॥
verses.rom:
sa im ratho na bhurishalayoji mahah puruni sataye vasuni |
adim vishva nahushyani jata svarshata vana urdhva navanta ||
verses.en:
Like a capacious car hath it been harnessed, the Mighty; to acquire abundant treasures.
Then in the sacrifice they celebrated all triumphs won by Nahusa in the battle.

verses.sa:
वायुर्न यो नियुत्वाँ इष्टयामा नासत्येव हव आ शम्भविष्ठः ।
विश्ववारो द्रविणोदा इव त्मन्पूषेव धीजवनोऽसि सोम ॥
verses.rom:
vayurna yo niyutvan ishtayama nasatyeva hava a shambhavishthah |
vishvavaro dravinoda iva tmanpusheva dhijavano'si soma ||
verses.en:
Like Vayu with his team, moving at pleasure, most gracious when invoked like both Nasatyas,
Thou art thyself like the Wealth-Giver, Soma! who grants all boons, like song-inspiring Pusan.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो न यो महा कर्माणि चक्रिर्हन्ता वृत्राणामसि सोम पूर्भित् ।
पैद्वो न हि त्वमहिनाम्नां हन्ता विश्वस्यासि सोम दस्योः ॥
verses.rom:
indro na yo maha karmani chakrirhanta vritranamasi soma purbhit |
paidvo na hi tvamahinamnam hanta vishvasyasi soma dasyoh ||
verses.en:
Like Indra who hath done great deeds, thou, Soma, art slayer of the Vrtras, Fort-destroyer.
Like Pedu's horse who killed the brood of serpents, thus thou, O Soma, slayest every Dasyu.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्न यो वन आ सृज्यमानो वृथा पाजांसि कृणुते नदीषु ।
जनो न युध्वा महत उपब्दिरियर्ति सोमः पवमान ऊर्मिम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirna yo vana a srijyamano vritha pajamsi krinute nadishu |
jano na yudhva mahata upabdiriyarti somah pavamana urmim ||
verses.en:
Like Agni loosed amid the forest, fiercely he winneth splendour in the running waters.
Like one who fights, the roaring of the mighty, thus Soma Pavamana sends his current.

verses.sa:
एते सोमा अति वाराण्यव्या दिव्या न कोशासो अभ्रवर्षाः ।
वृथा समुद्रं सिन्धवो न नीचीः सुतासो अभि कलशाँ असृग्रन् ॥
verses.rom:
ete soma ati varanyavya divya na koshaso abhravarshah |
vritha samudram sindhavo na nichih sutaso abhi kalashan asrigran ||
verses.en:
These Somas passing through the fleecy filter, like rain descending from the clouds of heaven,
Have been effused and poured into the beakers, swiftly like rivers running lowly seaward.

verses.sa:
शुष्मी शर्धो न मारुतं पवस्वानभिशस्ता दिव्या यथा विट् ।
आपो न मक्षू सुमतिर्भवा नः सहस्राप्साः पृतनाषाण्न यज्ञः ॥
verses.rom:
shushmi shardho na marutam pavasvanabhishasta divya yatha vit |
apo na makshu sumatirbhava nah sahasrapsah pritanashanna yajnah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward like the potent band of Maruts, like that Celestial Host whom none revileth.
Quickly be gracious unto us like waters, like sacrifice victorious, thousand-fashioned.

verses.sa:
राज्ञो नु ते वरुणस्य व्रतानि बृहद्गभीरं तव सोम धाम ।
शुचिष्ट्वमसि प्रियो न मित्रो दक्षाय्यो अर्यमेवासि सोम ॥
verses.rom:
rajno nu te varunasya vratani brihadgabhiram tava soma dhama |
shuchishtvamasi priyo na mitro dakshayyo aryamevasi soma ||
verses.en:
Thine are King Varuna's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory.
All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma.

verses.sa:
प्रो स्य वह्निः पथ्याभिरस्यान्दिवो न वृष्टिः पवमानो अक्षाः ।
सहस्रधारो असदन्न्यस्मे मातुरुपस्थे वन आ च सोमः ॥
verses.rom:
pro sya vahnih pathyabhirasyandivo na vrishtih pavamano akshah |
sahasradharo asadannyasme maturupasthe vana a cha somah ||
verses.en:
THIS Chariot-horse hath moved along the pathways, and Pavamana flowed like rain from heaven.
With us hath Soma with a thousand currents sunk in the wood, upon his Mother's bosom.

verses.sa:
राजा सिन्धूनामवसिष्ट वास ऋतस्य नावमारुहद्रजिष्ठाम् ।
अप्सु द्रप्सो वावृधे श्येनजूतो दुह ईं पिता दुह ईं पितुर्जाम् ॥
verses.rom:
raja sindhunamavasishta vasa ritasya navamaruhadrajishtham |
apsu drapso vavridhe shyenajuto duha im pita duha im piturjam ||
verses.en:
King, he hath clothed him in the robe of rivers, mounted the straightest-going ship of Order.
Sped by the Hawk the drop hath waxed in waters: the father drains it, drains the Father's offspring.

verses.sa:
सिंहं नसन्त मध्वो अयासं हरिमरुषं दिवो अस्य पतिम् ।
शूरो युत्सु प्रथमः पृच्छते गा अस्य चक्षसा परि पात्युक्षा ॥
verses.rom:
simham nasanta madhvo ayasam harimarusham divo asya patim |
shuro yutsu prathamah prichchhate ga asya chakshasa pari patyuksha ||
verses.en:
They come to him, red, tawny, Lord of Heaven, the watchful Guardian of the meath, the Lion.
First, Hero in the fight, he seeks the cattle, and with his eye the Steer is our protector.

verses.sa:
मधुपृष्ठं घोरमयासमश्वं रथे युञ्जन्त्युरुचक्र ऋष्वम् ।
स्वसार ईं जामयो मर्जयन्ति सनाभयो वाजिनमूर्जयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
madhuprishtham ghoramayasamashvam rathe yunjantyuruchakra rishvam |
svasara im jamayo marjayanti sanabhayo vajinamurjayanti ||
verses.en:
They harness to the broad-wheeled car the mighty Courser whose back bears meath, unwearied, awful.
The twins, the sisters brighten him, and strengthen-these children of one dame the vigorous Racer.

verses.sa:
चतस्र ईं घृतदुहः सचन्ते समाने अन्तर्धरुणे निषत्ताः ।
ता ईमर्षन्ति नमसा पुनानास्ता ईं विश्वतः परि षन्ति पूर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
chatasra im ghritaduhah sachante samane antardharune nishattah |
ta imarshanti namasa punanasta im vishvatah pari shanti purvih ||
verses.en:
Four pouring out the holy oil attend him, sitting together in the same container.
To him they flow, when purified, with homage, and still, from every side, are first about him.

verses.sa:
विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्या विश्वा उत क्षितयो हस्ते अस्य ।
असत्त उत्सो गृणते नियुत्वान्मध्वो अंशुः पवत इन्द्रियाय ॥
verses.rom:
vishtambho divo dharunah prithivya vishva uta kshitayo haste asya |
asatta utso grinate niyutvanmadhvo amshuh pavata indriyaya ||
verses.en:
He is the buttress of the heavens, supporter of earth, and in his hand are all the people.
Be the team's Lord a well to thee the singer: cleansed is the sweet plant's stalk for deed of glory.

verses.sa:
वन्वन्नवातो अभि देववीतिमिन्द्राय सोम वृत्रहा पवस्व ।
शग्धि महः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य रायः सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
vanvannavato abhi devavitimindraya soma vritraha pavasva |
shagdhi mahah purushchandrasya rayah suviryasya patayah syama ||
verses.en:
Fighting, uninjured come where Gods are feasted; Soma, as Vitra-slayer flow for Indra.
Vouchsafe us ample riches very splendid may we be masters of heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
प्र हिन्वानो जनिता रोदस्यो रथो न वाजं सनिष्यन्नयासीत् ।
इन्द्रं गच्छन्नायुधा संशिशानो विश्वा वसु हस्तयोरादधानः ॥
verses.rom:
pra hinvano janita rodasyo ratho na vajam sanishyannayasit |
indram gachchhannayudha samshishano vishva vasu hastayoradadhanah ||
verses.en:
URGED On, the Father of the Earth and Heaven hath gone forth like a car to gather booty,
Going to Indra, sharpening his weapons, and in his hand containing every treasure.

verses.sa:
अभि त्रिपृष्ठं वृषणं वयोधामाङ्गूषाणामवावशन्त वाणीः ।
वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धून्वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi triprishtham vrishanam vayodhamangushanamavavashanta vanih |
vana vasano varuno na sindhunvi ratnadha dayate varyani ||
verses.en:
To him the tones of sacred song have sounded, Steer of the triple height, the Life-bestower.
Dwelling in wood as Varuna in rivers, lavishing treasure he distributes blessings

verses.sa:
शूरग्रामः सर्ववीरः सहावाञ्जेता पवस्व सनिता धनानि ।
तिग्मायुधः क्षिप्रधन्वा समत्स्वषाळ्हः साह्वान्पृतनासु शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
shuragramah sarvavirah sahavanjeta pavasva sanita dhanani |
tigmayudhah kshipradhanva samatsvashalhah sahvanpritanasu shatrun ||
verses.en:
Great Conqueror, warrior-girt, Lord of all heroes, flow on thy way as he who winneth riches;
With sharpened. arms, with swift bow, never vanquished in battle, vanquishing in fight the foemen.

verses.sa:
उरुगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन्समीचीने आ पवस्वा पुरंधी ।
अपः सिषासन्नुषसः स्वर्गाः सं चिक्रदो महो अस्मभ्यं वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
urugavyutirabhayani krinvansamichine a pavasva puramdhi |
apah sishasannushasah svargah sam chikrado maho asmabhyam vajan ||
verses.en:
Giving security, Lord of wide dominion, send us both earth and heaven with all their fulness.
Striving to win the Dawns, the light, the waters, and cattle, call to us abundant vigour.

verses.sa:
मत्सि सोम वरुणं मत्सि मित्रं मत्सीन्द्रमिन्दो पवमान विष्णुम् ।
मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि महामिन्द्रमिन्दो मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
matsi soma varunam matsi mitram matsindramindo pavamana vishnum |
matsi shardho marutam matsi devanmatsi mahamindramindo madaya ||
verses.en:
O Soma, gladden Varuna and Mitra; cheer, Indu Pavamana! Indra, Visnu.
Cheer thou the Gods, the Company of Maruts: Indu, cheer mighty Indra to rejoicing.

verses.sa:
एवा राजेव क्रतुमाँ अमेन विश्वा घनिघ्नद्दुरिता पवस्व ।
इन्दो सूक्ताय वचसे वयो धा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
eva rajeva kratuman amena vishva ghanighnaddurita pavasva |
indo suktaya vachase vayo dha yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Thus like a wise and potent King flow onward, destroying with thy vigour all misfortunes.
For our well-spoken hymn give life, O Indu. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
असर्जि वक्वा रथ्ये यथाजौ धिया मनोता प्रथमो मनीषी ।
दश स्वसारो अधि सानो अव्येऽजन्ति वह्निं सदनान्यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
asarji vakva rathye yathajau dhiya manota prathamo manishi |
dasha svasaro adhi sano avye'janti vahnim sadananyachchha ||
verses.en:
As for a chariot-race, the skillful Speaker, Chief, Sage, Inventor, hath, with song, been started.
The sisters ten upon the fleecy summit drive on the Car-horse to the resting places.

verses.sa:
वीती जनस्य दिव्यस्य कव्यैरधि सुवानो नहुष्येभिरिन्दुः ।
प्र यो नृभिरमृतो मर्त्येभिर्मर्मृजानोऽविभिर्गोभिरद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
viti janasya divyasya kavyairadhi suvano nahushyebhirinduh |
pra yo nribhiramrito martyebhirmarmrijano'vibhirgobhiradbhih ||
verses.en:
The drop of Soma, pressed by wise Nahusyas, becomes the banquet of the Heavenly People-
Indu, by hands of mortal men made beauteous, immortal, with the sheep and cows and waters.

verses.sa:
वृषा वृष्णे रोरुवदंशुरस्मै पवमानो रुशदीर्ते पयो गोः ।
सहस्रमृक्वा पथिभिर्वचोविदध्वस्मभिः सूरो अण्वं वि याति ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha vrishne roruvadamshurasmai pavamano rushadirte payo goh |
sahasramrikva pathibhirvachovidadhvasmabhih suro anvam vi yati ||
verses.en:
Steer roaring unto Steer, this Pavamana, this juice runs to the white milk of the milch-cow.
Through thousand fine hairs goes the tuneful Singer, like Sura by his fair and open pathways.

verses.sa:
रुजा दृळ्हा चिद्रक्षसः सदांसि पुनान इन्द ऊर्णुहि वि वाजान् ।
वृश्चोपरिष्टात्तुजता वधेन ये अन्ति दूरादुपनायमेषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ruja drilha chidrakshasah sadamsi punana inda urnuhi vi vajan |
vrishchoparishtattujata vadhena ye anti duradupanayamesham ||
verses.en:
Break down the, strong seats even of the demons: cleansing thee, Indu, robe thyself in vigour.
Rend with thy swift bolt, coming from above them, those who are near and those who yet are distant.

verses.sa:
स प्रत्नवन्नव्यसे विश्ववार सूक्ताय पथः कृणुहि प्राचः ।
ये दुःषहासो वनुषा बृहन्तस्ताँस्ते अश्याम पुरुकृत्पुरुक्षो ॥
verses.rom:
sa pratnavannavyase vishvavara suktaya pathah krinuhi prachah |
ye duhshahaso vanusha brihantastanste ashyama purukritpuruksho ||
verses.en:
Prepare the forward paths in ancient manner for the new hymn, thou Giver of all bounties.
Those which are high and hard for foes to conquer may we gain from thee, Active! Food-bestower!

verses.sa:
एवा पुनानो अपः स्वर्गा अस्मभ्यं तोका तनयानि भूरि ।
शं नः क्षेत्रमुरु ज्योतींषि सोम ज्योङ्नः सूर्यं दृशये रिरीहि ॥
verses.rom:
eva punano apah svarga asmabhyam toka tanayani bhuri |
sham nah kshetramuru jyotimshi soma jyonnah suryam drishaye ririhi ||
verses.en:
So purifying thee vouchsafe us waters, heaven's light, and cows, offspring and many children.
Give us health, ample land, and lights, O Soma, and grant us long to look upon the sunshine.

verses.sa:
परि सुवानो हरिरंशुः पवित्रे रथो न सर्जि सनये हियानः ।
आपच्छ्लोकमिन्द्रियं पूयमानः प्रति देवाँ अजुषत प्रयोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pari suvano hariramshuh pavitre ratho na sarji sanaye hiyanah |
apachchhlokamindriyam puyamanah prati devan ajushata prayobhih ||
verses.en:
THE gold-hued juice, poured out upon the filter, is started like a car sent forth to conquer.
He hath gained song and vigour while they cleansed him, and hath rejoiced the Gods with entertainments.

verses.sa:
अच्छा नृचक्षा असरत्पवित्रे नाम दधानः कविरस्य योनौ ।
सीदन्होतेव सदने चमूषूपेमग्मन्नृषयः सप्त विप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha nrichaksha asaratpavitre nama dadhanah kavirasya yonau |
sidanhoteva sadane chamushupemagmannrishayah sapta viprah ||
verses.en:
He who beholdeth man hath reached the filter: bearing his name, the Sage hath sought his dwelling.
The Rsis came to him, seven holy singers, when in the bowls he settled as Invoker.

verses.sa:
प्र सुमेधा गातुविद्विश्वदेवः सोमः पुनानः सद एति नित्यम् ।
भुवद्विश्वेषु काव्येषु रन्तानु जनान्यतते पञ्च धीरः ॥
verses.rom:
pra sumedha gatuvidvishvadevah somah punanah sada eti nityam |
bhuvadvishveshu kavyeshu rantanu jananyatate pancha dhirah ||
verses.en:
Shared by all Gods, most wise, propitious, Soma goes, while they cleanse him, to his constant station.
Let him rejoice in all his lofty wisdom to the Five Tribes the Sage attains with labour.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये सोम पवमान निण्ये विश्वे देवास्त्रय एकादशासः ।
दश स्वधाभिरधि सानो अव्ये मृजन्ति त्वा नद्यः सप्त यह्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tye soma pavamana ninye vishve devastraya ekadashasah |
dasha svadhabhiradhi sano avye mrijanti tva nadyah sapta yahvih ||
verses.en:
In thy mysterious place, O Pavamana Soma, are all the Gods, the Thrice-Eleven.
Ten on the fleecy height, themselves, self-prompted, and seven fresh rivers, brighten and adorn thee.

verses.sa:
तन्नु सत्यं पवमानस्यास्तु यत्र विश्वे कारवः संनसन्त ।
ज्योतिर्यदह्ने अकृणोदु लोकं प्रावन्मनुं दस्यवे करभीकम् ॥
verses.rom:
tannu satyam pavamanasyastu yatra vishve karavah samnasanta |
jyotiryadahne akrinodu lokam pravanmanum dasyave karabhikam ||
verses.en:
Now let this be the truth of Pavamana, there where all singers gather them together,
That he hath given us room and made the daylight, hath holpen Manu and repelled the Dasyu.

verses.sa:
परि सद्मेव पशुमान्ति होता राजा न सत्यः समितीरियानः ।
सोमः पुनानः कलशाँ अयासीत्सीदन्मृगो न महिषो वनेषु ॥
verses.rom:
pari sadmeva pashumanti hota raja na satyah samitiriyanah |
somah punanah kalashan ayasitsidanmrigo na mahisho vaneshu ||
verses.en:
As the priest seeks the station rich in cattle, like a true King who goes to great assemblies,
Soma hath sought the beakers while they cleansed him, and like a wild bull, in the wood hath settled.

verses.sa:
साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त स्वसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः ।
हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य द्रोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी ॥
verses.rom:
sakamuksho marjayanta svasaro dasha dhirasya dhitayo dhanutrih |
harih paryadravajjah suryasya dronam nanakshe atyo na vaji ||
verses.en:
TEN sisters, pouring out the rain together, swift-moving thinkers of the sage, adorn him.
Hither hath run the gold-hued Child of Surya and reached the vat like a fleet vigorous courser.

verses.sa:
सं मातृभिर्न शिशुर्वावशानो वृषा दधन्वे पुरुवारो अद्भिः ।
मर्यो न योषामभि निष्कृतं यन्सं गच्छते कलश उस्रियाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sam matribhirna shishurvavashano vrisha dadhanve puruvaro adbhih |
maryo na yoshamabhi nishkritam yansam gachchhate kalasha usriyabhih ||
verses.en:
Even as a youngling crying to his mothers, the bounteous Steer hath flowed along to waters.
As youth to damsel, so with milk he hastens on to the. chose meeting-place, the beaker.

verses.sa:
उत प्र पिप्य ऊधरघ्न्याया इन्दुर्धाराभिः सचते सुमेधाः ।
मूर्धानं गावः पयसा चमूष्वभि श्रीणन्ति वसुभिर्न निक्तैः ॥
verses.rom:
uta pra pipya udharaghnyaya indurdharabhih sachate sumedhah |
murdhanam gavah payasa chamushvabhi shrinanti vasubhirna niktaih ||
verses.en:
Yea, swollen is the udder of the milch-cow: thither in streams goes very sapient Indu.
The kine make ready, as with new-washed treasures, the Head and Chief with milk within the vessels.

verses.sa:
स नो देवेभिः पवमान रदेन्दो रयिमश्विनं वावशानः ।
रथिरायतामुशती पुरंधिरस्मद्र्यगा दावने वसूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no devebhih pavamana radendo rayimashvinam vavashanah |
rathirayatamushati puramdhirasmadryaga davane vasunam ||
verses.en:
With all the Gods, O Indu Pavamana, while thou art roaring send us wealth in horses.
Hither upon her car come willing Plenty, inclined to us, to give us of her treasures.

verses.sa:
नू नो रयिमुप मास्व नृवन्तं पुनानो वाताप्यं विश्वश्चन्द्रम् ।
प्र वन्दितुरिन्दो तार्यायुः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
nu no rayimupa masva nrivantam punano vatapyam vishvashchandram |
pra vanditurindo taryayuh pratarmakshu dhiyavasurjagamyat ||
verses.en:
Now unto us mete riches, while they cleanse thee, all-glorious, swelling wealth, with store of heroes.
Long be his life who worships, thee, O Indu. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
अधि यदस्मिन्वाजिनीव शुभ स्पर्धन्ते धियः सूर्ये न विशः ।
अपो वृणानः पवते कवीयन्व्रजं न पशुवर्धनाय मन्म ॥
verses.rom:
adhi yadasminvajiniva shubha spardhante dhiyah surye na vishah |
apo vrinanah pavate kaviyanvrajam na pashuvardhanaya manma ||
verses.en:
WHEN beauties strive for him as for a charger, then strive the songs like soldiers for the sunlight.
Acting the Sage, he flows enrobed in waters and song as 'twere a stall that kine may prosper.

verses.sa:
द्विता व्यूर्ण्वन्नमृतस्य धाम स्वर्विदे भुवनानि प्रथन्त ।
धियः पिन्वानाः स्वसरे न गाव ऋतायन्तीरभि वावश्र इन्दुम् ॥
verses.rom:
dvita vyurnvannamritasya dhama svarvide bhuvanani prathanta |
dhiyah pinvanah svasare na gava ritayantirabhi vavashra indum ||
verses.en:
The worlds expand to him who from aforetime found light to spread the law of life eternal.
The swelling songs, like kine within the stable, in deep devotion call aloud on Indu.

verses.sa:
परि यत्कविः काव्या भरते शूरो न रथो भुवनानि विश्वा ।
देवेषु यशो मर्ताय भूषन्दक्षाय रायः पुरुभूषु नव्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pari yatkavih kavya bharate shuro na ratho bhuvanani vishva |
deveshu yasho martaya bhushandakshaya rayah purubhushu navyah ||
verses.en:
When the sage bears his holy wisdom round him, like a car visiting all worlds, the Hero,
Becoming fame, mid Gods, unto the mortal, wealth to the skilled, worth praise mid the Ever-present,

verses.sa:
श्रिये जातः श्रिय आ निरियाय श्रियं वयो जरितृभ्यो दधाति ।
श्रियं वसाना अमृतत्वमायन्भवन्ति सत्या समिथा मितद्रौ ॥
verses.rom:
shriye jatah shriya a niriyaya shriyam vayo jaritribhyo dadhati |
shriyam vasana amritatvamayanbhavanti satya samitha mitadrau ||
verses.en:
For glory born be hath come forth to glory: he giveth life and glory to the singers.
They, clothed in glory, have become immortal. He, measured in his course, makes frays successful.

verses.sa:
इषमूर्जमभ्यर्षाश्वं गामुरु ज्योतिः कृणुहि मत्सि देवान् ।
विश्वानि हि सुषहा तानि तुभ्यं पवमान बाधसे सोम शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
ishamurjamabhyarshashvam gamuru jyotih krinuhi matsi devan |
vishvani hi sushaha tani tubhyam pavamana badhase soma shatrun ||
verses.en:
Stream to us food and vigour, kine and horses: give us broad lights and fill the Gods with rapture.
All there are easy things for thee to master thou, Pavamana Soma, quellest foemen.

verses.sa:
कनिक्रन्ति हरिरा सृज्यमानः सीदन्वनस्य जठरे पुनानः ।
नृभिर्यतः कृणुते निर्णिजं गा अतो मतीर्जनयत स्वधाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
kanikranti harira srijyamanah sidanvanasya jathare punanah |
nribhiryatah krinute nirnijam ga ato matirjanayata svadhabhih ||
verses.en:
Loud neighs the Tawny Steed when started, settling deep in the wooden vessel while they cleanse him.
Led by the men he takes the milk for raiment: then shall he, through his powers, engender praise-songs.

verses.sa:
हरिः सृजानः पथ्यामृतस्येयर्ति वाचमरितेव नावम् ।
देवो देवानां गुह्यानि नामाविष्कृणोति बर्हिषि प्रवाचे ॥
verses.rom:
harih srijanah pathyamritasyeyarti vachamariteva navam |
devo devanam guhyani namavishkrinoti barhishi pravache ||
verses.en:
As one who rows drives on his boat, he, Gold-hued, sends forth his voice, loosed on the path of Order.
As God, the secret names of Gods he utters, to be declared on sacred grass more widely.

verses.sa:
अपामिवेदूर्मयस्तर्तुराणाः प्र मनीषा ईरते सोममच्छ ।
नमस्यन्तीरुप च यन्ति सं चा च विशन्त्युशतीरुशन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
apamivedurmayastarturanah pra manisha irate somamachchha |
namasyantirupa cha yanti sam cha cha vishantyushatirushantam ||
verses.en:
Hastening onward like the waves of waters, our holy hymns are pressing nigh to Soma.
To him they come with lowly adoration, and, longing, enter him who longs to meet them.

verses.sa:
तं मर्मृजानं महिषं न सानावंशुं दुहन्त्युक्षणं गिरिष्ठाम् ।
तं वावशानं मतयः सचन्ते त्रितो बिभर्ति वरुणं समुद्रे ॥
verses.rom:
tam marmrijanam mahisham na sanavamshum duhantyukshanam girishtham |
tam vavashanam matayah sachante trito bibharti varunam samudre ||
verses.en:
They drain the stalk, the Steer who dwells on mountains, even as a Bull who decks him on the upland.
Hymns follow and attend him as he bellows: Trita bears Varuna aloft in ocean.

verses.sa:
इष्यन्वाचमुपवक्तेव होतुः पुनान इन्दो वि ष्या मनीषाम् ।
इन्द्रश्च यत्क्षयथः सौभगाय सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
ishyanvachamupavakteva hotuh punana indo vi shya manisham |
indrashcha yatkshayathah saubhagaya suviryasya patayah syama ||
verses.en:
Sending thy voice out as Director, loosen the Invoker's thought, O Indu, as they cleanse thee.
While thou and Indra rule for our advantage, may we be masters of heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
प्र सेनानीः शूरो अग्रे रथानां गव्यन्नेति हर्षते अस्य सेना ।
भद्रान्कृण्वन्निन्द्रहवान्सखिभ्य आ सोमो वस्त्रा रभसानि दत्ते ॥
verses.rom:
pra senanih shuro agre rathanam gavyanneti harshate asya sena |
bhadrankrinvannindrahavansakhibhya a somo vastra rabhasani datte ||
verses.en:
IN forefront of the cars forth goes the Hero, the Leader, winning spoil: his host rejoices.
Soma endues his robes of lasting colours, and blesses, for his friends, their calls on Indra.

verses.sa:
समस्य हरिं हरयो मृजन्त्यश्वहयैरनिशितं नमोभिः ।
आ तिष्ठति रथमिन्द्रस्य सखा विद्वाँ एना सुमतिं यात्यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
samasya harim harayo mrijantyashvahayairanishitam namobhih |
a tishthati rathamindrasya sakha vidvan ena sumatim yatyachchha ||
verses.en:
Men decked with gold adorn his golden tendril, incessantly with steed-impelling homage.
The Friend of Indra mounts his car well-knowing, he comes thereon to meet the prayer we offer.

verses.sa:
स नो देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम प्सरस इन्द्रपानः ।
कृण्वन्नपो वर्षयन्द्यामुतेमामुरोरा नो वरिवस्या पुनानः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no deva devatate pavasva mahe soma psarasa indrapanah |
krinvannapo varshayandyamutemamurora no varivasya punanah ||
verses.en:
O God, for service of the Gods flow onward, for food sublime, as Indra's drink, O Soma.
Making the floods, bedewing earth and heaven, come from the vast, comfort us while we cleanse thee

verses.sa:
अजीतयेऽहतये पवस्व स्वस्तये सर्वतातये बृहते ।
तदुशन्ति विश्व इमे सखायस्तदहं वश्मि पवमान सोम ॥
verses.rom:
ajitaye'hataye pavasva svastaye sarvatataye brihate |
tadushanti vishva ime sakhayastadaham vashmi pavamana soma ||
verses.en:
Flow for prosperity and constant Vigour, flow on for happiness and high perfection.
This is the wish of these friends assembled: this is my wish, O Soma Pavamana.

verses.sa:
सोमः पवते जनिता मतीनां जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः ।
जनिताग्नेर्जनिता सूर्यस्य जनितेन्द्रस्य जनितोत विष्णोः ॥
verses.rom:
somah pavate janita matinam janita divo janita prithivyah |
janitagnerjanita suryasya janitendrasya janitota vishnoh ||
verses.en:
Father of holy hymns, Soma flows onward the Father of the earth, Father of heaven:
Father of Agni, Surya's generator, the Father who begat Indra and Visnu.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनामृषिर्विप्राणां महिषो मृगाणाम् ।
श्येनो गृध्राणां स्वधितिर्वनानां सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन् ॥
verses.rom:
brahma devanam padavih kavinamrishirvipranam mahisho mriganam |
shyeno gridhranam svadhitirvananam somah pavitramatyeti rebhan ||
verses.en:
Brahman of Gods, the Leader of the poets, Rsi of sages, Bull of savage creatures,
Falcon amid the vultures, Axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes Soma singing.

verses.sa:
प्रावीविपद्वाच ऊर्मिं न सिन्धुर्गिरः सोमः पवमानो मनीषाः ।
अन्तः पश्यन्वृजनेमावराण्या तिष्ठति वृषभो गोषु जानन् ॥
verses.rom:
pravivipadvacha urmim na sindhurgirah somah pavamano manishah |
antah pashyanvrijanemavaranya tishthati vrishabho goshu janan ||
verses.en:
He, Soma Pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises.
Beholding these inferior powers in cattle, he rests among them as a Steer well-knowing.

verses.sa:
स मत्सरः पृत्सु वन्वन्नवातः सहस्ररेता अभि वाजमर्ष ।
इन्द्रायेन्दो पवमानो मनीष्यंशोरूर्मिमीरय गा इषण्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa matsarah pritsu vanvannavatah sahasrareta abhi vajamarsha |
indrayendo pavamano manishyamshorurmimiraya ga ishanyan ||
verses.en:
As Gladdener, Warrior never harmed in battle, with thousand genial streams, pour strength and vigour.
As thoughtful Pavamana, urge O Indu, speeding the kine, the plant's wave on to Indra.

verses.sa:
परि प्रियः कलशे देववात इन्द्राय सोमो रण्यो मदाय ।
सहस्रधारः शतवाज इन्दुर्वाजी न सप्तिः समना जिगाति ॥
verses.rom:
pari priyah kalashe devavata indraya somo ranyo madaya |
sahasradharah shatavaja indurvaji na saptih samana jigati ||
verses.en:
Dear, grateful to the Gods, on to the beaker moves Soma, sweet to Indra, to delight him.
With hundred powers, with thousand currents, Indu, like a strong car-horse, goes to the assembly.

verses.sa:
स पूर्व्यो वसुविज्जायमानो मृजानो अप्सु दुदुहानो अद्रौ ।
अभिशस्तिपा भुवनस्य राजा विदद्गातुं ब्रह्मणे पूयमानः ॥
verses.rom:
sa purvyo vasuvijjayamano mrijano apsu duduhano adrau |
abhishastipa bhuvanasya raja vidadgatum brahmane puyamanah ||
verses.en:
Born in old time as finder-out of treasures, drained with the stone, decking himself in waters,
Warding off curses, King of all existence, he shall find way for prayer the while they cleanse him.

verses.sa:
त्वया हि नः पितरः सोम पूर्वे कर्माणि चक्रुः पवमान धीराः ।
वन्वन्नवातः परिधीँरपोर्णु वीरेभिरश्वैर्मघवा भवा नः ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya hi nah pitarah soma purve karmani chakruh pavamana dhirah |
vanvannavatah paridhinrapornu virebhirashvairmaghava bhava nah ||
verses.en:
For our sage fathers, Soma Pavamana, of old performed, by thee, their sacred duties.
Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.

verses.sa:
यथापवथा मनवे वयोधा अमित्रहा वरिवोविद्धविष्मान् ।
एवा पवस्व द्रविणं दधान इन्द्रे सं तिष्ठ जनयायुधानि ॥
verses.rom:
yathapavatha manave vayodha amitraha varivoviddhavishman |
eva pavasva dravinam dadhana indre sam tishtha janayayudhani ||
verses.en:
As thou didst flow for Manu Life-bestowing, Foe-queller, Comforter, rich in oblations,
Even thus flow onward now conferring riches: combine with Indra, and bring forth thy weapons.

verses.sa:
पवस्व सोम मधुमाँ ऋतावापो वसानो अधि सानो अव्ये ।
अव द्रोणानि घृतवान्ति सीद मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रपानः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva soma madhuman ritavapo vasano adhi sano avye |
ava dronani ghritavanti sida madintamo matsara indrapanah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward, Soma, rich in sweets and holy,. enrobed in waters on the fleecy summit.
Settle in vessels that are full of fatness, as cheering and most gladdening drink for Indra.

verses.sa:
वृष्टिं दिवः शतधारः पवस्व सहस्रसा वाजयुर्देववीतौ ।
सं सिन्धुभिः कलशे वावशानः समुस्रियाभिः प्रतिरन्न आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishtim divah shatadharah pavasva sahasrasa vajayurdevavitau |
sam sindhubhih kalashe vavashanah samusriyabhih pratiranna ayuh ||
verses.en:
Pour, hundred-streamed, winner of thousands, mighty at the Gods' banquet, Pour the rain of heaven,
While thou with rivers roarest in the beaker, and blent with milk prolongest our existence.

verses.sa:
एष स्य सोमो मतिभिः पुनानोऽत्यो न वाजी तरतीदरातीः ।
पयो न दुग्धमदितेरिषिरमुर्विव गातुः सुयमो न वोळ्हा ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya somo matibhih punano'tyo na vaji taratidaratih |
payo na dugdhamaditerishiramurviva gatuh suyamo na volha ||
verses.en:
Purified with our holy hymns, this Soma o'ertakes malignities like some strong charger,
Like fresh milk poured by Aditi, like passage in ample room, or like a docile car-horse.

verses.sa:
स्वायुधः सोतृभिः पूयमानोऽभ्यर्ष गुह्यं चारु नाम ।
अभि वाजं सप्तिरिव श्रवस्याभि वायुमभि गा देव सोम ॥
verses.rom:
svayudhah sotribhih puyamano'bhyarsha guhyam charu nama |
abhi vajam saptiriva shravasyabhi vayumabhi ga deva soma ||
verses.en:
Cleansed by the pressers, armed with noble weapons, stream to us the fair secret name thou bearest.
Pour booty, like a horse, for love of glory God, Soma, send us kine, and send us Vayu.

verses.sa:
शिशुं जज्ञानं हर्यतं मृजन्ति शुम्भन्ति वह्निं मरुतो गणेन ।
कविर्गीर्भिः काव्येना कविः सन्सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन् ॥
verses.rom:
shishum jajnanam haryatam mrijanti shumbhanti vahnim maruto ganena |
kavirgirbhih kavyena kavih sansomah pavitramatyeti rebhan ||
verses.en:
They deck him at his birth, the lovely Infant, the Maruts with their troop adorn the Car-horse.
By songs a Poet and a Sage by wisdom, Soma joes singing through the cleansing filter.

verses.sa:
ऋषिमना य ऋषिकृत्स्वर्षाः सहस्रणीथः पदवीः कवीनाम् ।
तृतीयं धाम महिषः सिषासन्सोमो विराजमनु राजति ष्टुप् ॥
verses.rom:
rishimana ya rishikritsvarshah sahasranithah padavih kavinam |
tritiyam dhama mahishah sishasansomo virajamanu rajati shtup ||
verses.en:
Light-winner, Rsi-minded, Rsi-maker, hymned in a thousand hymns, Leader of sages,
A Steer who strives to gain his third form, Soma is, like Viraj, resplendent as a Singer.

verses.sa:
चमूषच्छ्येनः शकुनो विभृत्वा गोविन्दुर्द्रप्स आयुधानि बिभ्रत् ।
अपामूर्मिं सचमानः समुद्रं तुरीयं धाम महिषो विवक्ति ॥
verses.rom:
chamushachchhyenah shakuno vibhritva govindurdrapsa ayudhani bibhrat |
apamurmim sachamanah samudram turiyam dhama mahisho vivakti ||
verses.en:
Hawk seated in the bowls, Bird wide-extended, the Banner seeking kine and wielding weapons,
Following close the sea, the wave of waters, the great Bull tells his fourth form and declares it.

verses.sa:
मर्यो न शुभ्रस्तन्वं मृजानोऽत्यो न सृत्वा सनये धनानाम् ।
वृषेव यूथा परि कोशमर्षन्कनिक्रदच्चम्वोरा विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
maryo na shubhrastanvam mrijano'tyo na sritva sanaye dhananam |
vrisheva yutha pari koshamarshankanikradachchamvora vivesha ||
verses.en:
Like a fair youth who decorates his body, a courser rushing to the gain of riches,
A steer to herds, so, flowing to the pitcher, he with a roar hath passed into the beakers.

verses.sa:
पवस्वेन्दो पवमानो महोभिः कनिक्रदत्परि वाराण्यर्ष ।
क्रीळञ्चम्वोरा विश पूयमान इन्द्रं ते रसो मदिरो ममत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
pavasvendo pavamano mahobhih kanikradatpari varanyarsha |
krilanchamvora visha puyamana indram te raso madiro mamattu ||
verses.en:
Flow on with might as Pavamana, Indu flow loudly roaring through the fleecy filter.
Enter the beakers sporting, as they cleanse thee, and let thy gladdening juice make Indra joyful.

verses.sa:
प्रास्य धारा बृहतीरसृग्रन्नक्तो गोभिः कलशाँ आ विवेश ।
साम कृण्वन्सामन्यो विपश्चित्क्रन्दन्नेत्यभि सख्युर्न जामिम् ॥
verses.rom:
prasya dhara brihatirasrigrannakto gobhih kalashan a vivesha |
sama krinvansamanyo vipashchitkrandannetyabhi sakhyurna jamim ||
verses.en:
His streams have been effused in all their fulness, and he hath entered, balmed with milk, the goblets.
Singing his psalm, well-skilled in song, a Chanter, be comes as 'twere to his friend's sister roaring.

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्नेषि पवमान शत्रून्प्रियां न जारो अभिगीत इन्दुः ।
सीदन्वनेषु शकुनो न पत्वा सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सत्ता ॥
verses.rom:
apaghnanneshi pavamana shatrunpriyam na jaro abhigita induh |
sidanvaneshu shakuno na patva somah punanah kalasheshu satta ||
verses.en:
Chasing our foes thou comest, Pavamana Indu, besting, as lover to his darling.
As a bird flies and settles in the forest, thus Soma settles, purified, in goblets.

verses.sa:
आ ते रुचः पवमानस्य सोम योषेव यन्ति सुदुघाः सुधाराः ।
हरिरानीतः पुरुवारो अप्स्वचिक्रदत्कलशे देवयूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
a te ruchah pavamanasya soma yosheva yanti sudughah sudharah |
hariranitah puruvaro apsvachikradatkalashe devayunam ||
verses.en:
With full stream and abundant milk, O Soma, thy beams come, like a woman, as they cleanse thee.
He, gold-hued, rich in boons, brought to the waters, hath roared within the goblet of the pious.

verses.sa:
अस्य प्रेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समपृक्त रसम् ।
सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन्मितेव सद्म पशुमान्ति होता ॥
verses.rom:
asya presha hemana puyamano devo devebhih samaprikta rasam |
sutah pavitram paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma pashumanti hota ||
verses.en:
MADE pure by this man's urgent zeal and impulse the God hath to the Gods his juice imparted.
He goes, effused and singing, to the filter, like priest to measured seats supplied with cattle.

verses.sa:
भद्रा वस्त्रा समन्या वसानो महान्कविर्निवचनानि शंसन् ।
आ वच्यस्व चम्वोः पूयमानो विचक्षणो जागृविर्देववीतौ ॥
verses.rom:
bhadra vastra samanya vasano mahankavirnivachanani shamsan |
a vachyasva chamvoh puyamano vichakshano jagrivirdevavitau ||
verses.en:
Robed in fair raiment meet to wear in battle, a mighty Sage pronouncing invocations.
Roll onward to the beakers as they cleanse thee, far-seeing at the feast of Gods, and watchful.

verses.sa:
समु प्रियो मृज्यते सानो अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां क्षैतो अस्मे ।
अभि स्वर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
samu priyo mrijyate sano avye yashastaro yashasam kshaito asme |
abhi svara dhanva puyamano yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Dear, he is brightened on the fleecy summit, a Prince among us, nobler than the noble.
Roar out as thou art purified, run forward. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र गायताभ्यर्चाम देवान्सोमं हिनोत महते धनाय ।
स्वादुः पवाते अति वारमव्यमा सीदाति कलशं देवयुर्नः ॥
verses.rom:
pra gayatabhyarchama devansomam hinota mahate dhanaya |
svaduh pavate ati varamavyama sidati kalasham devayurnah ||
verses.en:
Let us sing praises to the Gods: sing loudly, send ye the Soma forth for mighty riches.
Let him flow, sweetly-flavoured, through the filter, and let our pious one rest in the pitcher.

verses.sa:
इन्दुर्देवानामुप सख्यमायन्सहस्रधारः पवते मदाय ।
नृभि स्तवानो अनु धाम पूर्वमगन्निन्द्रं महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.rom:
indurdevanamupa sakhyamayansahasradharah pavate madaya |
nribhi stavano anu dhama purvamagannindram mahate saubhagaya ||
verses.en:
Winning the friendship of the Deities, Indu flows in a thousand streams to make them joyful.
Praised by the men after the ancient statute, he hath come nigh, for our great bliss, to Indra.

verses.sa:
स्तोत्रे राये हरिरर्षा पुनान इन्द्रं मदो गच्छतु ते भराय ।
देवैर्याहि सरथं राधो अच्छा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
stotre raye harirarsha punana indram mado gachchhatu te bharaya |
devairyahi saratham radho achchha yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Flow, Gold-hued, cleansing thee, to enrich the singer: let thy juice go to Indra to support him.
Come nigh, together with the Gods, for bounty. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र काव्यमुशनेव ब्रुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति ।
महिव्रतः शुचिबन्धुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन् ॥
verses.rom:
pra kavyamushaneva bruvano devo devanam janima vivakti |
mahivratah shuchibandhuh pavakah pada varaho abhyeti rebhan ||
verses.en:
The God declares the Deities' generations, like Usana, proclaiming lofty wisdom.
With brilliant kin, far-ruling, sanctifying, the Boar advances, singing, to the places.

verses.sa:
प्र हंसासस्तृपलं मन्युमच्छामादस्तं वृषगणा अयासुः ।
आङ्गूष्यं पवमानं सखायो दुर्मर्षं साकं प्र वदन्ति वाणम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra hamsasastripalam manyumachchhamadastam vrishagana ayasuh |
angushyam pavamanam sakhayo durmarsham sakam pra vadanti vanam ||
verses.en:
The Swans, the Vrsaganas from anear us have brought their restless spirit to our dwelling.
Friends come to Pavamana meet for praises, and sound in concert their resistless music.

verses.sa:
स रंहत उरुगायस्य जूतिं वृथा क्रीळन्तं मिमते न गावः ।
परीणसं कृणुते तिग्मशृङ्गो दिवा हरिर्ददृशे नक्तमृज्रः ॥
verses.rom:
sa ramhata urugayasya jutim vritha krilantam mimate na gavah |
parinasam krinute tigmashringo diva harirdadrishe naktamrijrah ||
verses.en:
He follows the Wide-strider's rapid movement: cows low, as 'twere, to him who sports at pleasure.
He with the sharpened horns brings forth abundance: the Silvery shines by night, by day the Golden.

verses.sa:
इन्दुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इन्द्रे सोमः सह इन्वन्मदाय ।
हन्ति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातीर्वरिवः कृण्वन्वृजनस्य राजा ॥
verses.rom:
indurvaji pavate gonyogha indre somah saha invanmadaya |
hanti raksho badhate paryaratirvarivah krinvanvrijanasya raja ||
verses.en:
Strong Indu, bathed in milk, flows on for Indra, Soma exciting strength, to make him joyful.
He quells malignities and slays the demons, the King of mighty power who brings us comfort.

verses.sa:
अध धारया मध्वा पृचानस्तिरो रोम पवते अद्रिदुग्धः ।
इन्दुरिन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणो देवो देवस्य मत्सरो मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
adha dharaya madhva prichanastiro roma pavate adridugdhah |
indurindrasya sakhyam jushano devo devasya matsaro madaya ||
verses.en:
Then in a stream he flows, milked out with press-stones, mingled with sweetness, through the fleecy filter-
Indu rejoicing in the love of Indra, the God who gladdens, for the God's enjoyment.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रियाणि पवते पुनानो देवो देवान्स्वेन रसेन पृञ्चन् ।
इन्दुर्धर्माण्यृतुथा वसानो दश क्षिपो अव्यत सानो अव्ये ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priyani pavate punano devo devansvena rasena princhan |
indurdharmanyritutha vasano dasha kshipo avyata sano avye ||
verses.en:
As he is purified he pours out treasures, a God bedewing Gods with his own juices.
Indu hath, wearing qualities by seasons, on the raised fleece engaged, the ten swift fingers.

verses.sa:
वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद्गा नदयन्नेति पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
इन्द्रस्येव वग्नुरा शृण्व आजौ प्रचेतयन्नर्षति वाचमेमाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha shono abhikanikradadga nadayanneti prithivimuta dyam |
indrasyeva vagnura shrinva ajau prachetayannarshati vachamemam ||
verses.en:
The Red Bull bellowing to the kine advances, causing the heavens and earth to roar and thunder.
Well is he beard like Indra's shout in battle: letting this voice be known he hastens hither.

verses.sa:
रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमन्तमंशुम् ।
पवमानः संतनिमेषि कृण्वन्निन्द्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः ॥
verses.rom:
rasayyah payasa pinvamana irayanneshi madhumantamamshum |
pavamanah samtanimeshi krinvannindraya soma parishichyamanah ||
verses.en:
Swelling with milk, abounding in sweet flavours, urging the meath-rich plant thou goest onward.
Raising a shout thou flowest as they cleanse thee, when thou, O Soma, art effused for Indra.

verses.sa:
एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन्वधस्नैः ।
परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशन्तं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः ॥
verses.rom:
eva pavasva madiro madayodagrabhasya namayanvadhasnaih |
pari varnam bharamano rushantam gavyurno arsha pari soma siktah ||
verses.en:
So flow thou on inspiriting, for rapture, aiming death-shafts at him who stays the waters,
Flow to us wearing thy resplendent colour, effused and eager for the kine, O Soma.

verses.sa:
जुष्ट्वी न इन्दो सुपथा सुगान्युरौ पवस्व वरिवांसि कृण्वन् ।
घनेव विष्वग्दुरितानि विघ्नन्नधि ष्णुना धन्व सानो अव्ये ॥
verses.rom:
jushtvi na indo supatha suganyurau pavasva varivamsi krinvan |
ghaneva vishvagduritani vighnannadhi shnuna dhanva sano avye ||
verses.en:
Pleased with us, Indu, send us as thou flowest good easy paths in ample space and comforts.
Dispelling, as 'twere with a club, misfortunes, run o'er the height, run o'er the fleecy summit.

verses.sa:
वृष्टिं नो अर्ष दिव्यां जिगत्नुमिळावतीं शंगयीं जीरदानुम् ।
स्तुकेव वीता धन्वा विचिन्वन्बन्धूँरिमाँ अवराँ इन्दो वायून् ॥
verses.rom:
vrishtim no arsha divyam jigatnumilavatim shamgayim jiradanum |
stukeva vita dhanva vichinvanbandhunriman avaran indo vayun ||
verses.en:
Pour on us rain celestial, quickly streaming, refreshing, fraught with health and ready bounty.
Flow, Indu, send these Winds thy lower kinsmen, setting them free like locks of hair unbraided.

verses.sa:
ग्रन्थिं न वि ष्य ग्रथितं पुनान ऋजुं च गातुं वृजिनं च सोम ।
अत्यो न क्रदो हरिरा सृजानो मर्यो देव धन्व पस्त्यावान् ॥
verses.rom:
granthim na vi shya grathitam punana rijum cha gatum vrijinam cha soma |
atyo na krado harira srijano maryo deva dhanva pastyavan ||
verses.en:
Part, like a knotted tangle, while they cleanse thee, O Soma, righteous and unrighteous conduct.
Neigh like a tawny courser who is loosened, come like a youth, O God, a house-possessor.

verses.sa:
जुष्टो मदाय देवतात इन्दो परि ष्णुना धन्व सानो अव्ये ।
सहस्रधारः सुरभिरदब्धः परि स्रव वाजसातौ नृषह्ये ॥
verses.rom:
jushto madaya devatata indo pari shnuna dhanva sano avye |
sahasradharah surabhiradabdhah pari srava vajasatau nrishahye ||
verses.en:
For the God's service, for delight, O Indu, run o'er the height, run o'ver the fleecy summit.
With thousand streams, inviolate, sweet-scented, flow on for gain of strength that conquers heroes.

verses.sa:
अरश्मानो येऽरथा अयुक्ता अत्यासो न ससृजानास आजौ ।
एते शुक्रासो धन्वन्ति सोमा देवासस्ताँ उप याता पिबध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
arashmano ye'ratha ayukta atyaso na sasrijanasa ajau |
ete shukraso dhanvanti soma devasastan upa yata pibadhyai ||
verses.en:
Without a car, without a rein to guide them, unyoked, like coursers started in the contest,
These brilliant drops of Soma juice run forward. Do ye, O Deities, come nigh to drink them.

verses.sa:
एवा न इन्दो अभि देववीतिं परि स्रव नभो अर्णश्चमूषु ।
सोमो अस्मभ्यं काम्यं बृहन्तं रयिं ददातु वीरवन्तमुग्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva na indo abhi devavitim pari srava nabho arnashchamushu |
somo asmabhyam kamyam brihantam rayim dadatu viravantamugram ||
verses.en:
So for our banquet of the Gods, O Indu, pour down the rain of heaven into the vessels.
May Soma grant us riches sought with longing, mighty, exceeding strong, with store of heroes.

verses.sa:
तक्षद्यदी मनसो वेनतो वाग्ज्येष्ठस्य वा धर्मणि क्षोरनीके ।
आदीमायन्वरमा वावशाना जुष्टं पतिं कलशे गाव इन्दुम् ॥
verses.rom:
takshadyadi manaso venato vagjyeshthasya va dharmani kshoranike |
adimayanvarama vavashana jushtam patim kalashe gava indum ||
verses.en:
What time the loving spirit's word had formed him Chief of all food, by statute of the Highest,
Then loudly lowing came the cows to Indu, the chosen, well-loved Master in the beaker.

verses.sa:
प्र दानुदो दिव्यो दानुपिन्व ऋतमृताय पवते सुमेधाः ।
धर्मा भुवद्वृजन्यस्य राजा प्र रश्मिभिर्दशभिर्भारि भूम ॥
verses.rom:
pra danudo divyo danupinva ritamritaya pavate sumedhah |
dharma bhuvadvrijanyasya raja pra rashmibhirdashabhirbhari bhuma ||
verses.en:
The Sage, Celestial, liberal, raining bounties, pours as he flows the Genuine for the Truthful.
The King shall be effectual strength's upholder: he by the ten bright reins is mostly guided.

verses.sa:
पवित्रेभिः पवमानो नृचक्षा राजा देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् ।
द्विता भुवद्रयिपती रयीणामृतं भरत्सुभृतं चार्विन्दुः ॥
verses.rom:
pavitrebhih pavamano nrichaksha raja devanamuta martyanam |
dvita bhuvadrayipati rayinamritam bharatsubhritam charvinduh ||
verses.en:
He who beholds mankind, made pure with filters, the King supreme of Deities and mortals,
From days of old is Treasure-Lord of riches: he, Indu, cherishes fair well-kept Order.

verses.sa:
अर्वाँ इव श्रवसे सातिमच्छेन्द्रस्य वायोरभि वीतिमर्ष ।
स नः सहस्रा बृहतीरिषो दा भवा सोम द्रविणोवित्पुनानः ॥
verses.rom:
arvan iva shravase satimachchhendrasya vayorabhi vitimarsha |
sa nah sahasra brihatirisho da bhava soma dravinovitpunanah ||
verses.en:
Haste, like a steed, to victory for glory, to Indra's and to Vayu's entertainment.
Give us food ample, thousandfold: be, Soma, the finder-out of riches when they cleanse thee.

verses.sa:
देवाव्यो नः परिषिच्यमानाः क्षयं सुवीरं धन्वन्तु सोमाः ।
आयज्यवः सुमतिं विश्ववारा होतारो न दिवियजो मन्द्रतमाः ॥
verses.rom:
devavyo nah parishichyamanah kshayam suviram dhanvantu somah |
ayajyavah sumatim vishvavara hotaro na diviyajo mandratamah ||
verses.en:
Effused by us let God-delighting Somas bring as they flow a home with noble heroes.
Rich in all boons like priests acquiring favour, the worshippers of heaven, the best of Cheerers.

verses.sa:
एवा देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम प्सरसे देवपानः ।
महश्चिद्धि ष्मसि हिताः समर्ये कृधि सुष्ठाने रोदसी पुनानः ॥
verses.rom:
eva deva devatate pavasva mahe soma psarase devapanah |
mahashchiddhi shmasi hitah samarye kridhi sushthane rodasi punanah ||
verses.en:
So, God, for service of the Gods flow onward, flow, drink of Gods, for ample food, O Soma.
For we go forth to war against the mighty make heaven and earth well stablished by thy cleansing.

verses.sa:
अश्वो नो क्रदो वृषभिर्युजानः सिंहो न भीमो मनसो जवीयान् ।
अर्वाचीनैः पथिभिर्ये रजिष्ठा आ पवस्व सौमनसं न इन्दो ॥
verses.rom:
ashvo no krado vrishabhiryujanah simho na bhimo manaso javiyan |
arvachinaih pathibhirye rajishtha a pavasva saumanasam na indo ||
verses.en:
Thou, yoked by strong men, neighest like a courser, swifter than thought is, like an awful lion.
By paths directed hitherward, the straightest, send thou us happiness, Indu, while they cleanse thee.

verses.sa:
शतं धारा देवजाता असृग्रन्सहस्रमेनाः कवयो मृजन्ति ।
इन्दो सनित्रं दिव आ पवस्व पुरएतासि महतो धनस्य ॥
verses.rom:
shatam dhara devajata asrigransahasramenah kavayo mrijanti |
indo sanitram diva a pavasva puraetasi mahato dhanasya ||
verses.en:
Sprung from the Gods, a hundred streams, a thousand, have been effused: sages prepare and purge them.
Bring us from heaven the means of winning, Indu; thou art-forerunnner of abundant riches.

verses.sa:
दिवो न सर्गा अससृग्रमह्नां राजा न मित्रं प्र मिनाति धीरः ।
पितुर्न पुत्रः क्रतुभिर्यतान आ पवस्व विशे अस्या अजीतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
divo na sarga asasrigramahnam raja na mitram pra minati dhirah |
piturna putrah kratubhiryatana a pavasva vishe asya ajitim ||
verses.en:
The streams of days, were poured as 'twere from heaven: the wise King doth not treat his friend unkindly.
Like a son following his father's wishes, grant to this family success and safety.

verses.sa:
प्र ते धारा मधुमतीरसृग्रन्वारान्यत्पूतो अत्येष्यव्यान् ।
पवमान पवसे धाम गोनां जज्ञानः सूर्यमपिन्वो अर्कैः ॥
verses.rom:
pra te dhara madhumatirasrigranvaranyatputo atyeshyavyan |
pavamana pavase dhama gonam jajnanah suryamapinvo arkaih ||
verses.en:
Now are thy streams poured forth with all their sweetness, when, purified. thou goest through the filter.
The race of kine is thy gift, Pavarridna: when born thou madest Surya rich with brightness.

verses.sa:
कनिक्रददनु पन्थामृतस्य शुक्रो वि भास्यमृतस्य धाम ।
स इन्द्राय पवसे मत्सरवान्हिन्वानो वाचं मतिभिः कवीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
kanikradadanu panthamritasya shukro vi bhasyamritasya dhama |
sa indraya pavase matsaravanhinvano vacham matibhih kavinam ||
verses.en:
Bright, bellowing aiong the path of Order, thou shinest as the form of life eternal.
Thou flowest on as gladdening drink for Indra, sending thy voice out with the hymns of sages.

verses.sa:
दिव्यः सुपर्णोऽव चक्षि सोम पिन्वन्धाराः कर्मणा देववीतौ ।
एन्दो विश कलशं सोमधानं क्रन्दन्निहि सूर्यस्योप रश्मिम् ॥
verses.rom:
divyah suparno'va chakshi soma pinvandharah karmana devavitau |
endo visha kalasham somadhanam krandannihi suryasyopa rashmim ||
verses.en:
Pouring out streams at the Gods' feast with service, thou, Soma, lookest down, a heavenly Eagle.
Enter the Soma-holding beaker, Indu, and with a roar approach the ray of Sarya.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निरृतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषाम् ।
गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः ॥
verses.rom:
tisro vacha irayati pra vahnirritasya dhitim brahmano manisham |
gavo yanti gopatim prichchhamanah somam yanti matayo vavashanah ||
verses.en:
Three are the voices that the Courser utters: he speaks the thought of prayer, the law of Order.
To the Cow's Master come the Cows inquiring: the hymns with eager longing come to Soma.

verses.sa:
सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पृच्छमानाः ।
सोमः सुतः पूयते अज्यमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभः सं नवन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
somam gavo dhenavo vavashanah somam vipra matibhih prichchhamanah |
somah sutah puyate ajyamanah some arkastrishtubhah sam navante ||
verses.en:
To Soma come the Cows, the Milch-kine longing, to Soma sages with their hymns inquiring.
Soma, effused, is purified and blended our hymns and Trstup songs unite in Soma.

verses.sa:
एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः स्वस्ति ।
इन्द्रमा विश बृहता रवेण वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरंधिम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva nah soma parishichyamana a pavasva puyamanah svasti |
indrama visha brihata ravena vardhaya vacham janaya puramdhim ||
verses.en:
Thus, Soma, as we pour thee into vessels, while thou art purified flow for our welfare.
Pass into Indra with a mighty roaring make the voice swell, and generate abundance.

verses.sa:
आ जागृविर्विप्र ऋता मतीनां सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु ।
सपन्ति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
a jagrivirvipra rita matinam somah punano asadachchamushu |
sapanti yam mithunaso nikama adhvaryavo rathirasah suhastah ||
verses.en:
Singer of true songs, ever-watchful, Soma hath settled in the ladles when they cleanse him.
Him the Adhvaryus, paired and eager, follow, leaders of sacrifice and skilful-handed.

verses.sa:
स पुनान उप सूरे न धातोभे अप्रा रोदसी वि ष आवः ।
प्रिया चिद्यस्य प्रियसास ऊती स तू धनं कारिणे न प्र यंसत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa punana upa sure na dhatobhe apra rodasi vi sha avah |
priya chidyasya priyasasa uti sa tu dhanam karine na pra yamsat ||
verses.en:
Cleansed near the Sun as 'twere he as Creator hath filled full heaven and earth, and hath disclosed them.
He by whose dear help men gain all their wishes shall yield the precious meed as to a victor.

verses.sa:
स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वाँ अभि नो ज्योतिषावीत् ।
येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः स्वर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमुष्णन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vardhita vardhanah puyamanah somo midhvan abhi no jyotishavit |
yena nah purve pitarah padajnah svarvido abhi ga adrimushnan ||
verses.en:
He, being cleansed, the Strengthener and Increaser, Soma the Bounteous, helped us with his lustre,
Wherewith our sires of old who knew the footsteps found light and stole the cattle from the mountain.

verses.sa:
अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मञ्जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य राजा ।
वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे सुवान इन्दुः ॥
verses.rom:
akrantsamudrah prathame vidharmanjanayanpraja bhuvanasya raja |
vrisha pavitre adhi sano avye brihatsomo vavridhe suvana induh ||
verses.en:
In the first vault of heaven loud roared the Ocean, King of all being, generating creatures.
Steer, in the filter, on the fleecy summit, Soma, the Drop effused, hath waxen mighty.

verses.sa:
महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद्गर्भोऽवृणीत देवान् ।
अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजोऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिन्दुः ॥
verses.rom:
mahattatsomo mahishashchakarapam yadgarbho'vrinita devan |
adadhadindre pavamana ojo'janayatsurye jyotirinduh ||
verses.en:
Soma the Steer, in that as Child of Waters he chose the Gods, performed that great achievement.
He, Pavamana, granted strength to Indra; he, Indu, generated light in Surya.

verses.sa:
मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे च मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः ।
मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि द्यावापृथिवी देव सोम ॥
verses.rom:
matsi vayumishtaye radhase cha matsi mitravaruna puyamanah |
matsi shardho marutam matsi devanmatsi dyavaprithivi deva soma ||
verses.en:
Make Vayu glad,, for furtherance and bounty: cheer Varuna and Mitra, as they cleanse thee.
Gladden the Gods, gladden the host of Maruts: make Heaven and Earth rejoice, O God, O Soma.

verses.sa:
ऋजुः पवस्व वृजिनस्य हन्तापामीवां बाधमानो मृधश्च ।
अभिश्रीणन्पयः पयसाभि गोनामिन्द्रस्य त्वं तव वयं सखायः ॥
verses.rom:
rijuh pavasva vrijinasya hantapamivam badhamano mridhashcha |
abhishrinanpayah payasabhi gonamindrasya tvam tava vayam sakhayah ||
verses.en:
Flow onward righteous slayer of the wicked, driving away our enemies and sickness,
Blending thy milk with milk which cows afford us. We are thy friends, thou art the Friend of Indra.

verses.sa:
मध्वः सूदं पवस्व वस्व उत्सं वीरं च न आ पवस्वा भगं च ।
स्वदस्वेन्द्राय पवमान इन्दो रयिं च न आ पवस्वा समुद्रात् ॥
verses.rom:
madhvah sudam pavasva vasva utsam viram cha na a pavasva bhagam cha |
svadasvendraya pavamana indo rayim cha na a pavasva samudrat ||
verses.en:
Pour us a fount of meath, a spring of treasure; send us a hero son and happy fortune.
Be sweet to India when they cleanse thee, Indu, and pour down riches on us from the ocean.

verses.sa:
सोमः सुतो धारयात्यो न हित्वा सिन्धुर्न निम्नमभि वाज्यक्षाः ।
आ योनिं वन्यमसदत्पुनानः समिन्दुर्गोभिरसरत्समद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
somah suto dharayatyo na hitva sindhurna nimnamabhi vajyakshah |
a yonim vanyamasadatpunanah samindurgobhirasaratsamadbhih ||
verses.en:
Strong Soma, pressed, like an impetuous courser, hath flowed in stream as a flood speeding downward.
Cleansed, he hath settled in his wooden dwelling: Indu hath flowed with milk and with the waters.

verses.sa:
एष स्य ते पवत इन्द्र सोमश्चमूषु धीर उशते तवस्वान् ।
स्वर्चक्षा रथिरः सत्यशुष्मः कामो न यो देवयतामसर्जि ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya te pavata indra somashchamushu dhira ushate tavasvan |
svarchaksha rathirah satyashushmah kamo na yo devayatamasarji ||
verses.en:
Strong, wise, for thee who longest for his coming this Soma here flows to the bowls, O Indra.
He, chariot-borne, sun-bright, and truly potent, was poured forth like the longing of the pious.

verses.sa:
एष प्रत्नेन वयसा पुनानस्तिरो वर्पांसि दुहितुर्दधानः ।
वसानः शर्म त्रिवरूथमप्सु होतेव याति समनेषु रेभन् ॥
verses.rom:
esha pratnena vayasa punanastiro varpamsi duhiturdadhanah |
vasanah sharma trivaruthamapsu hoteva yati samaneshu rebhan ||
verses.en:
He, purified with ancient vital vigour, pervading all his Daughter's forms and figures,
Finding his threefold refuge in the waters, goes singing, as a priest, to the assemblies.

verses.sa:
नू नस्त्वं रथिरो देव सोम परि स्रव चम्वोः पूयमानः।
अप्सु स्वादिष्ठो मधुमाँ ऋतावा देवो न यः सविता सत्यमन्मा ॥
verses.rom:
nu nastvam rathiro deva soma pari srava chamvoh puyamanah|
apsu svadishtho madhuman ritava devo na yah savita satyamanma ||
verses.en:
Now, chariot-borne, flow unto us, God Soma, as thou art purified flow to the saucers,
Sweetest in waters, rich in meath, and holy, as Savitar the God is, truthful minded.

verses.sa:
अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गृणानोऽभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः ।
अभी नरं धीजवनं रथेष्ठामभीन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vayum vityarsha grinano'bhi mitravaruna puyamanah |
abhi naram dhijavanam ratheshthamabhindram vrishanam vajrabahum ||
verses.en:
To feast him, flow mid song and hymn, to Vayu, flow purified to Varuna and Mitra.
Flow to the song-inspiring car-borne Hero, to mighty Indra, him who wields the thunder.

verses.sa:
अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः ।
अभि चन्द्रा भर्तवे नो हिरण्याभ्यश्वान्रथिनो देव सोम ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vastra suvasananyarshabhi dhenuh sudughah puyamanah |
abhi chandra bhartave no hiranyabhyashvanrathino deva soma ||
verses.en:
Pour on us garments that shall clothe us meetly, send, purified, milch-kine, abundant yielders.
God Soma, send us chariot-drawing horses that they may bring us treasures bright and golden.

verses.sa:
अभी नो अर्ष दिव्या वसून्यभि विश्वा पार्थिवा पूयमानः ।
अभि येन द्रविणमश्नवामाभ्यार्षेयं जमदग्निवन्नः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi no arsha divya vasunyabhi vishva parthiva puyamanah |
abhi yena dravinamashnavamabhyarsheyam jamadagnivannah ||
verses.en:
Send to us in a stream celestial riches, send us, when thou art cleansed, what earth containeth,
So that thereby we may acquire possessions and Rsihood in Jamadagni's manner.

verses.sa:
अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि माँश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि प्र धन्व ।
ब्रध्नश्चिदत्र वातो न जूतः पुरुमेधश्चित्तकवे नरं दात् ॥
verses.rom:
aya pava pavasvaina vasuni manshchatva indo sarasi pra dhanva |
bradhnashchidatra vato na jutah purumedhashchittakave naram dat ||
verses.en:
Pour forth this wealth with this purification: flow onward to the yellow lake, O Indu.
Here, too, the Ruddy, wind-swift, full of wisdom, Shall give a son to him who cometh quickly.

verses.sa:
उत न एना पवया पवस्वाधि श्रुते श्रवाय्यस्य तीर्थे ।
षष्टिं सहस्रा नैगुतो वसूनि वृक्षं न पक्वं धूनवद्रणाय ॥
verses.rom:
uta na ena pavaya pavasvadhi shrute shravayyasya tirthe |
shashtim sahasra naiguto vasuni vriksham na pakvam dhunavadranaya ||
verses.en:
Flow on for us with this purification to the famed ford of thee whose due is glory.
May the Foe-queller shake us down, for triumph, like a tree's ripe fruit, sixty thousand treasures.

verses.sa:
महीमे अस्य वृषनाम शूषे माँश्चत्वे वा पृशने वा वधत्रे ।
अस्वापयन्निगुतः स्नेहयच्चापामित्राँ अपाचितो अचेतः ॥
verses.rom:
mahime asya vrishanama shushe manshchatve va prishane va vadhatre |
asvapayannigutah snehayachchapamitran apachito achetah ||
verses.en:
Eagerly do we pray for those two exploits, at the blue lake and Prsana, wrought in battle.
He sent our enemies to sleep and slew them, and turned away the foolish and unfriendly.

verses.sa:
सं त्री पवित्रा विततान्येष्यन्वेकं धावसि पूयमानः ।
असि भगो असि दात्रस्य दातासि मघवा मघवद्भ्य इन्दो ॥
verses.rom:
sam tri pavitra vitatanyeshyanvekam dhavasi puyamanah |
asi bhago asi datrasya datasi maghava maghavadbhya indo ||
verses.en:
Thou comest unto three extended filters, and hasteriest through each one as they cleanse thee.
Thou art the giver of the gift, a Bhaga, a Maghavan for liberal lords, O Indu.

verses.sa:
एष विश्ववित्पवते मनीषी सोमो विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा ।
द्रप्साँ ईरयन्विदथेष्विन्दुर्वि वारमव्यं समयाति याति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vishvavitpavate manishi somo vishvasya bhuvanasya raja |
drapsan irayanvidatheshvindurvi varamavyam samayati yati ||
verses.en:
This Soma here, the Wise, the All-obtainer, flows on his way as King of all existence.
Driving the drops at our assemblies, Indu completely traverses the fleecy filter.

verses.sa:
इन्दुं रिहन्ति महिषा अदब्धाः पदे रेभन्ति कवयो न गृध्राः ।
हिन्वन्ति धीरा दशभिः क्षिपाभिः समञ्जते रूपमपां रसेन ॥
verses.rom:
indum rihanti mahisha adabdhah pade rebhanti kavayo na gridhrah |
hinvanti dhira dashabhih kshipabhih samanjate rupamapam rasena ||
verses.en:
The Great Inviolate are kissing Indu, and singing in his place like eager sages.
The wise men send him forth with ten swift fingers, and balm his form with essence of the waters.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं पवमानेन सोम भरे कृतं वि चिनुयाम शश्वत् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya vayam pavamanena soma bhare kritam vi chinuyama shashvat |
tanno mitro varuno mamahantamaditih sindhuh prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Soma, may we, with thee as Pavamana, pile up together all our spoil in battle.
This boon vouchsafe us Varuna and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अभि नो वाजसातमं रयिमर्ष पुरुस्पृहम् ।
इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभ्वासहम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi no vajasatamam rayimarsha puruspriham |
indo sahasrabharnasam tuvidyumnam vibhvasaham ||
verses.en:
STREAM on us riches that are sought by many, best at winning strength
Riches, O Indu, thousand fold, glorious, conquering the great.

verses.sa:
परि ष्य सुवानो अव्ययं रथे न वर्माव्यत ।
इन्दुरभि द्रुणा हितो हियानो धाराभिरक्षाः ॥
verses.rom:
pari shya suvano avyayam rathe na varmavyata |
indurabhi druna hito hiyano dharabhirakshah ||
verses.en:
Effused, he hath, as on a car, invested him in fleecy mail:
Onward hath Indu flowed in streams, impelled, surrounded by the wood.

verses.sa:
परि ष्य सुवानो अक्षा इन्दुरव्ये मदच्युतः ।
धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भ्राजा नैति गव्ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
pari shya suvano aksha induravye madachyutah |
dhara ya urdhvo adhvare bhraja naiti gavyayuh ||
verses.en:
Effused, this Indu hath flowed on, distilling rapture, to the fleece:
He goes erect, as seeking kine in stream, with light, to sacrifice.

verses.sa:
स हि त्वं देव शश्वते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे ।
इन्दो सहस्रिणं रयिं शतात्मानं विवाससि ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi tvam deva shashvate vasu martaya dashushe |
indo sahasrinam rayim shatatmanam vivasasi ||
verses.en:
For thou thyself, O Indu, God, to every mortal worshipper
Attractest riches thousand fold, made manifest in hundred forms.

verses.sa:
वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्वसो वस्वः पुरुस्पृहः ।
नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः स्याम सुम्नस्याध्रिगो ॥
verses.rom:
vayam te asya vritrahanvaso vasvah purusprihah |
ni nedishthatama ishah syama sumnasyadhrigo ||
verses.en:
Good Vrtra-slayer, may we be still nearest to this wealth of thine
Which many crave, nearest to food and happiness, Resistless One!

verses.sa:
द्विर्यं पञ्च स्वयशसं स्वसारो अद्रिसंहतम् ।
प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं प्रस्नापयन्त्यूर्मिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
dviryam pancha svayashasam svasaro adrisamhatam |
priyamindrasya kamyam prasnapayantyurminam ||
verses.en:
Whom, bright with native splendour, crushed between the pair of pressing stones
The wavy Friend whom Indra loves-the twice-five sisters dip and bathe,

verses.sa:
परि त्यं हर्यतं हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण ।
यो देवान्विश्वाँ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
pari tyam haryatam harim babhrum punanti varena |
yo devanvishvan itpari madena saha gachchhati ||
verses.en:
Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all,
Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the Deities.

verses.sa:
अस्य वो ह्यवसा पान्तो दक्षसाधनम् ।
यः सूरिषु श्रवो बृहद्दधे स्वर्ण हर्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
asya vo hyavasa panto dakshasadhanam |
yah surishu shravo brihaddadhe svarna haryatah ||
verses.en:
Through longing for this sap of yours ye drink what brings ability,
Even him who, dear as heaven's own light, gives to our princes high renown.

verses.sa:
स वां यज्ञेषु मानवी इन्दुर्जनिष्ट रोदसी ।
देवो देवी गिरिष्ठा अस्रेधन्तं तुविष्वणि ॥
verses.rom:
sa vam yajneshu manavi indurjanishta rodasi |
devo devi girishtha asredhantam tuvishvani ||
verses.en:
Indu at holy rites produced you, Heaven and Earth, the Friends of men,
Hill-haunting God the Goddesses. They bruised him where the roar was loud.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे ।
नरे च दक्षिणावते देवाय सदनासदे ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma patave vritraghne pari shichyase |
nare cha dakshinavate devaya sadanasade ||
verses.en:
For Vrtra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink,
Poured for the guerdon-giving man, poured for the God who sitteth there.

verses.sa:
ते प्रत्नासो व्युष्टिषु सोमाः पवित्रे अक्षरन् ।
अपप्रोथन्तः सनुतर्हुरश्चितः प्रातस्ताँ अप्रचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
te pratnaso vyushtishu somah pavitre aksharan |
apaprothantah sanutarhurashchitah pratastan aprachetasah ||
verses.en:
These ancient Somas, at the break of day, have flowed into the sieve,
Snorting away at early morn these foolish evil-hearted ones.

verses.sa:
तं सखायः पुरोरुचं यूयं वयं च सूरयः ।
अश्याम वाजगन्ध्यं सनेम वाजपस्त्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam sakhayah purorucham yuyam vayam cha surayah |
ashyama vajagandhyam sanema vajapastyam ||
verses.en:
Friends, may the princes, ye and we, obtain this Most Resplendent One.
Gain him who hath the smell of strength, win him whose home is very strength.

verses.sa:
आ हर्यताय धृष्णवे धनुस्तन्वन्ति पौंस्यम् ।
शुक्रां वयन्त्यसुराय निर्णिजं विपामग्रे महीयुवः ॥
verses.rom:
a haryataya dhrishnave dhanustanvanti paumsyam |
shukram vayantyasuraya nirnijam vipamagre mahiyuvah ||
verses.en:
THEY for the Bold and Lovely One ply manly vigour like a bow:
joyous, in front of songs they weave bright raiment for the Lord Divine.

verses.sa:
अध क्षपा परिष्कृतो वाजाँ अभि प्र गाहते ।
यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिं हिन्वन्ति यातवे ॥
verses.rom:
adha kshapa parishkrito vajan abhi pra gahate |
yadi vivasvato dhiyo harim hinvanti yatave ||
verses.en:
And he, made beautiful by night, dips forward into strengthening food',
What time the sacrificer's thoughts speed on his way the Golden-hued.

verses.sa:
तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इन्द्रपातमः ।
यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः ॥
verses.rom:
tamasya marjayamasi mado ya indrapatamah |
yam gava asabhirdadhuh pura nunam cha surayah ||
verses.en:
We cleanse this gladdening drink of his the juice which Indra chiefly drinks---
That which kine took into their mouths, of old, and princes take it now.

verses.sa:
तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत ।
उतो कृपन्त धीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः ॥
verses.rom:
tam gathaya puranya punanamabhyanushata |
uto kripanta dhitayo devanam nama bibhratih ||
verses.en:
To him, while purifying, they have raised the ancient psalm of praise:
And sacred songs which bear the names of Gods have supplicated him.

verses.sa:
तमुक्षमाणमव्यये वारे पुनन्ति धर्णसिम् ।
दूतं न पूर्वचित्तय आ शासते मनीषिणः ॥
verses.rom:
tamukshamanamavyaye vare punanti dharnasim |
dutam na purvachittaya a shasate manishinah ||
verses.en:
They purify him as he drops, courageous, in the fleecy sieve.
Him they instruct as messenger to bear the sage's morning prayer.

verses.sa:
स पुनानो मदिन्तमः सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ।
पशौ न रेत आदधत्पतिर्वचस्यते धियः ॥
verses.rom:
sa punano madintamah somashchamushu sidati |
pashau na reta adadhatpatirvachasyate dhiyah ||
verses.en:
Soma, best Cheerer, takes his seat, the while they cleanse him in the bowls.
He as it were impregns the cow, and babbles on, the Lord of Song.

verses.sa:
स मृज्यते सुकर्मभिर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।
विदे यदासु संददिर्महीरपो वि गाहते ॥
verses.rom:
sa mrijyate sukarmabhirdevo devebhyah sutah |
vide yadasu samdadirmahirapo vi gahate ||
verses.en:
He is effused and beautified, a God for Gods, by skillful men.
He penetrates the mighty floods collecting all he knows therein.

verses.sa:
सुत इन्दो पवित्र आ नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ।
इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमश्चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ॥
verses.rom:
suta indo pavitra a nribhiryato vi niyase |
indraya matsarintamashchamushva ni shidasi ||
verses.en:
Pressed, Indu, guided by the men, thou art led to the cleaning sieve.
