Thou, yielding Indra highest joy, takest thy seat within the bowls.

verses.sa:
अभी नवन्ते अद्रुहः प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् ।
वत्सं न पूर्व आयुनि जातं रिहन्ति मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi navante adruhah priyamindrasya kamyam |
vatsam na purva ayuni jatam rihanti matarah ||
verses.en:
THE Guileless Ones are singing praise to Indra's well beloved Friend,
As, in the morning of its life, the mothers lick the new-born calf.

verses.sa:
पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् ।
त्वं वसूनि पुष्यसि विश्वानि दाशुषो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
punana indava bhara soma dvibarhasam rayim |
tvam vasuni pushyasi vishvani dashusho grihe ||
verses.en:
O Indu, while they cleanse thee bring, O Soma, doubly-waxing wealth
Thou in the worshipper's abode causest all treasures to increase.

verses.sa:
त्वं धियं मनोयुजं सृजा वृष्टिं न तन्यतुः ।
त्वं वसूनि पार्थिवा दिव्या च सोम पुष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam dhiyam manoyujam srija vrishtim na tanyatuh |
tvam vasuni parthiva divya cha soma pushyasi ||
verses.en:
Set free the. song which mind hath yoked, even as thunder frees the rain:
All treasures of the earth and heaven, O Soma, thou dost multiply.

verses.sa:
परि ते जिग्युषो यथा धारा सुतस्य धावति ।
रंहमाणा व्यव्ययं वारं वाजीव सानसिः ॥
verses.rom:
pari te jigyusho yatha dhara sutasya dhavati |
ramhamana vyavyayam varam vajiva sanasih ||
verses.en:
Thy stream when thou art pressed runs on like some victorious warrior's steed
Hastening onward through the fleece like a fierce horse who wins the prize.

verses.sa:
क्रत्वे दक्षाय नः कवे पवस्व सोम धारया ।
इन्द्राय पातवे सुतो मित्राय वरुणाय च ॥
verses.rom:
kratve dakshaya nah kave pavasva soma dharaya |
indraya patave suto mitraya varunaya cha ||
verses.en:
Flow on, Sage Soma, with thy stream to give us mental power and strength,
Effused for Indra, for his drink, for Mitra and for Varuna.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वाजसातमः पवित्रे धारया सुतः ।
इन्द्राय सोम विष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vajasatamah pavitre dharaya sutah |
indraya soma vishnave devebhyo madhumattamah ||
verses.en:
Flow to the filter with thy stream, effused, best winner, thou, of spoil,
O Soma, as most rich in sweets for Indra, Visnu, and the Gods.

verses.sa:
त्वां रिहन्ति मातरो हरिं पवित्रे अद्रुहः ।
वत्सं जातं न धेनवः पवमान विधर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam rihanti mataro harim pavitre adruhah |
vatsam jatam na dhenavah pavamana vidharmani ||
verses.en:
The mothers, void of guiles, caress thee Golden-coloured, in the sieve,
As cows, O Pavamana, lick the new-born calf, as Law commands.

verses.sa:
पवमान महि श्रवश्चित्रेभिर्यासि रश्मिभिः ।
शर्धन्तमांसि जिघ्नसे विश्वानि दाशुषो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana mahi shravashchitrebhiryasi rashmibhih |
shardhantamamsi jighnase vishvani dashusho grihe ||
verses.en:
Thou, Pavamana, movest on with wondrous rays to great renown.
Striving within the votary's house thou drivest all the glooms away.

verses.sa:
त्वं द्यां च महिव्रत पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे ।
प्रति द्रापिममुञ्चथाः पवमान महित्वना ॥
verses.rom:
tvam dyam cha mahivrata prithivim chati jabhrishe |
prati drapimamunchathah pavamana mahitvana ||
verses.en:
Lord of great sway, thou liftest thee above the heavens, above the earth.
Thou, Pavamana hast assumed thy coat of mail in majesty.

verses.sa:
पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः सुताय मादयित्नवे ।
अप श्वानं श्नथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
purojiti vo andhasah sutaya madayitnave |
apa shvanam shnathishtana sakhayo dirghajihvyam ||
verses.en:
FOR first possession of your juice, for the exhilarating drink,
Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away.

verses.sa:
यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यन्दते सुतः ।
इन्दुरश्वो न कृत्व्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yo dharaya pavakaya pariprasyandate sutah |
indurashvo na kritvyah ||
verses.en:
He who with purifying stream, effused, comes flowing hitherward,
Indu, is like an able steed.

verses.sa:
तं दुरोषमभी नरः सोमं विश्वाच्या धिया ।
यज्ञं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tam duroshamabhi narah somam vishvachya dhiya |
yajnam hinvantyadribhih ||
verses.en:
The men with all-pervading song send unassailable Soma forth,
By pressing-stones, to sacrifice.

verses.sa:
सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः ।
पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरन्देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः ॥
verses.rom:
sutaso madhumattamah soma indraya mandinah |
pavitravanto aksharandevangachchhantu vo madah ||
verses.en:
The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is destined, flow,
Effused, the source of Indra's joy: may your strong juices reach the Gods.

verses.sa:
इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन् ।
वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
indurindraya pavata iti devaso abruvan |
vachaspatirmakhasyate vishvasyeshana ojasa ||
verses.en:
Indu flows on for Indra's sake: thus have the Deities declared.
The Lord of Speech exerts himself, Ruler of all, because of might.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङ्खयः ।
सोमः पती रयीणां सखेन्द्रस्य दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradharah pavate samudro vachaminkhayah |
somah pati rayinam sakhendrasya divedive ||
verses.en:
Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows,
Even Soma, Lord of opulence, the Friend of Indra, day by day.

verses.sa:
अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ।
पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam pusha rayirbhagah somah punano arshati |
patirvishvasya bhumano vyakhyadrodasi ubhe ||
verses.en:
As Pusan, Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure.
He, Lord of the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
समु प्रिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घृष्वयः ।
सोमासः कृण्वते पथः पवमानास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
samu priya anushata gavo madaya ghrishvayah |
somasah krinvate pathah pavamanasa indavah ||
verses.en:
The dear cows lowed in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink.
The drops as they were purified, the Soma juices, made then paths.

verses.sa:
य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमान श्रवाय्यम् ।
यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहै ॥
verses.rom:
ya ojishthastama bhara pavamana shravayyam |
yah pancha charshanirabhi rayim yena vanamahai ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed,
Which the Five Tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence.

verses.sa:
सोमाः पवन्त इन्दवोऽस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमाः ।
मित्राः सुवाना अरेपसः स्वाध्यः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
somah pavanta indavo'smabhyam gatuvittamah |
mitrah suvana arepasah svadhyah svarvidah ||
verses.en:
For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of our weal,
Effused as friends without a spot, benevolent, finders of the light.

verses.sa:
सुष्वाणासो व्यद्रिभिश्चिताना गोरधि त्वचि ।
इषमस्मभ्यमभितः समस्वरन्वसुविदः ॥
verses.rom:
sushvanaso vyadribhishchitana goradhi tvachi |
ishamasmabhyamabhitah samasvaranvasuvidah ||
verses.en:
Effused by means of pressing-stones, upon the ox-hide visible,
They, treasure-finders, have announced food unto us from every side.

verses.sa:
एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।
सूर्यासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो ध्रुवा घृते ॥
verses.rom:
ete puta vipashchitah somaso dadhyashirah |
suryaso na darshataso jigatnavo dhruva ghrite ||
verses.en:
These Soma juices, skilled in song, purified, blent with milk and curd,
When moving and when firmly laid in oil, resemble lovely Suns.

verses.sa:
प्र सुन्वानस्यान्धसो मर्तो न वृत तद्वचः ।
अप श्वानमराधसं हता मखं न भृगवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra sunvanasyandhaso marto na vrita tadvachah |
apa shvanamaradhasam hata makham na bhrigavah ||
verses.en:
Let not the power of men restrain the voice of the outpouring juice:
As Bhrgu's sons chased Makha, so drive ye the greedy hound away.

verses.sa:
आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः ।
सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
a jamiratke avyata bhuje na putra onyoh |
sarajjaro na yoshanam varo na yonimasadam ||
verses.en:
The Friend hath wrapped him in his robe, as in his parents arms, a son.
He went, as lover to a dame, to take his station suitor-like.

verses.sa:
स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी ।
हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa viro dakshasadhano vi yastastambha rodasi |
harih pavitre avyata vedha na yonimasadam ||
verses.en:
That Hero who produces strength, he who hath propped both worlds apart,
Gold-hued, hath wrapped him in the sieve, to settle, priest-like, in his place.

verses.sa:
अव्यो वारेभिः पवते सोमो गव्ये अधि त्वचि ।
कनिक्रदद्वृषा हरिरिन्द्रस्याभ्येति निष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
avyo varebhih pavate somo gavye adhi tvachi |
kanikradadvrisha haririndrasyabhyeti nishkritam ||
verses.en:
Soma upon the ox's skin through the sheep's wool flows purified.
Bellowing out, the Tawny Steer goes on to Indra's special place.

verses.sa:
क्राणा शिशुर्महीनां हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिम् ।
विश्वा परि प्रिया भुवदध द्विता ॥
verses.rom:
krana shishurmahinam hinvannritasya didhitim |
vishva pari priya bhuvadadha dvita ||
verses.en:
THE Child, when blended with the streams, speeding the plan of sacrifice,
Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old.

verses.sa:
उप त्रितस्य पाष्योरभक्त यद्गुहा पदम् ।
यज्ञस्य सप्त धामभिरध प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa tritasya pashyorabhakta yadguha padam |
yajnasya sapta dhamabhiradha priyam ||
verses.en:
The place, near the two pressing-stones of Trita, hath he occupied,
Secret and dear through seven lights of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि त्रितस्य धारया पृष्ठेष्वेरया रयिम् ।
मिमीते अस्य योजना वि सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
trini tritasya dharaya prishtheshveraya rayim |
mimite asya yojana vi sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Urge to three courses, on the heights of Trita, riches in a stream.
He who is passing wise measures his courses out.

verses.sa:
जज्ञानं सप्त मातरो वेधामशासत श्रिये ।
अयं ध्रुवो रयीणां चिकेत यत् ॥
verses.rom:
jajnanam sapta mataro vedhamashasata shriye |
ayam dhruvo rayinam chiketa yat ||
verses.en:
Even at his birth the Mothers Seven taught him, for glory, like a sage,
So that he, firm and sure, hath set his mind on wealth.

verses.sa:
अस्य व्रते सजोषसो विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः ।
स्पार्हा भवन्ति रन्तयो जुषन्त यत् ॥
verses.rom:
asya vrate sajoshaso vishve devaso adruhah |
sparha bhavanti rantayo jushanta yat ||
verses.en:
Under his sway, of one accord, are all the guileless Deities:
Warriors to be envied, they, when they are pleased.

verses.sa:
यमी गर्भमृतावृधो दृशे चारुमजीजनन् ।
कविं मंहिष्ठमध्वरे पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
yami garbhamritavridho drishe charumajijanan |
kavim mamhishthamadhvare puruspriham ||
verses.en:
The Babe whom they who strengthen Law have generated fair to see,
Much longed for at the sacrifice, most liberal Sage,

verses.sa:
समीचीने अभि त्मना यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा ।
तन्वाना यज्ञमानुषग्यदञ्जते ॥
verses.rom:
samichine abhi tmana yahvi ritasya matara |
tanvana yajnamanushagyadanjate ||
verses.en:
To him, united, of themselves, come the young Parents of the rite,
When they adorn him, duly weaving sacrifice.

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा शुक्रेभिरक्षभिरृणोरप व्रजं दिवः ।
हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिं प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
kratva shukrebhirakshabhirrinorapa vrajam divah |
hinvannritasya didhitim pradhvare ||
verses.en:
With wisdom and with radiant eyes unbar to us the stall of heaven,
Speeding at solemn rite the plan of Holy Law.

verses.sa:
प्र पुनानाय वेधसे सोमाय वच उद्यतम् ।
भृतिं न भरा मतिभिर्जुजोषते ॥
verses.rom:
pra punanaya vedhase somaya vacha udyatam |
bhritim na bhara matibhirjujoshate ||
verses.en:
To Soma who is purified as ordering Priest the song is raised:
Bring meed, as 'twere, to one who makes thee glad with hymns.

verses.sa:
परि वाराण्यव्यया गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षति ।
त्री षधस्था पुनानः कृणुते हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
pari varanyavyaya gobhiranjano arshati |
tri shadhastha punanah krinute harih ||
verses.en:
Blended with milk and curds he flows on through the long wool of the sheep.
The Gold-hued, purified, makes him three seats for rest.

verses.sa:
परि कोशं मधुश्चुतमव्यये वारे अर्षति ।
अभि वाणीरृषीणां सप्त नूषत ॥
verses.rom:
pari kosham madhushchutamavyaye vare arshati |
abhi vanirrishinam sapta nushata ||
verses.en:
On through the long wool of the sheep to the meath-dropping vat he flows:
The Rsis' sevenfold quire hath sung aloud to him.

verses.sa:
परि णेता मतीनां विश्वदेवो अदाभ्यः ।
सोमः पुनानश्चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः ॥
verses.rom:
pari neta matinam vishvadevo adabhyah |
somah punanashchamvorvishaddharih ||
verses.en:
Shared by all Gods, Infallible, the Leader of our holy hymns,
Golden-hued Soma, being cleansed, hath reached the bowls.

verses.sa:
परि दैवीरनु स्वधा इन्द्रेण याहि सरथम् ।
पुनानो वाघद्वाघद्भिरमर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pari daiviranu svadha indrena yahi saratham |
punano vaghadvaghadbhiramartyah ||
verses.en:
After thy Godlike qualities, associate with Indra, go,
As a Priest purified by priests, Immortal One.

verses.sa:
परि सप्तिर्न वाजयुर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः ।
व्यानशिः पवमानो वि धावति ॥
verses.rom:
pari saptirna vajayurdevo devebhyah sutah |
vyanashih pavamano vi dhavati ||
verses.en:
Like a car-horse who shows his strength, a God effused for Deities.
The penetrating Pavamana flows along.

verses.sa:
सखाय आ नि षीदत पुनानाय प्र गायत ।
शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत श्रिये ॥
verses.rom:
sakhaya a ni shidata punanaya pra gayata |
shishum na yajnaih pari bhushata shriye ||
verses.en:
SIT down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself:
Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites.

verses.sa:
समी वत्सं न मातृभिः सृजता गयसाधनम् ।
देवाव्यं मदमभि द्विशवसम् ॥
verses.rom:
sami vatsam na matribhih srijata gayasadhanam |
devavyam madamabhi dvishavasam ||
verses.en:
Unite him bringing household wealth, even as a calf, with mother kine,
Him who hath double strength, the God, delighting juice.

verses.sa:
पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये ।
यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शंतमः ॥
verses.rom:
punata dakshasadhanam yatha shardhaya vitaye |
yatha mitraya varunaya shamtamah ||
verses.en:
Purify him who gives us power, that he, most Blessed One, may be
A banquet for the Troop, Mitra, and Varuna.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं त्वा वसुविदमभि वाणीरनूषत ।
गोभिष्टे वर्णमभि वासयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyam tva vasuvidamabhi vaniranushata |
gobhishte varnamabhi vasayamasi ||
verses.en:
Voices have sung aloud to thee as finder out of wealth for us:
We clothe the hue thou wearest with a robe of milk.

verses.sa:
स नो मदानां पत इन्दो देवप्सरा असि ।
सखेव सख्ये गातुवित्तमो भव ॥
verses.rom:
sa no madanam pata indo devapsara asi |
sakheva sakhye gatuvittamo bhava ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indu, art the food of Gods, O Sovran of all gladdening drinks:
As Friend for friend, be thou best finder of success.

verses.sa:
सनेमि कृध्यस्मदा रक्षसं कं चिदत्रिणम् ।
अपादेवं द्वयुमंहो युयोधि नः ॥
verses.rom:
sanemi kridhyasmada rakshasam kam chidatrinam |
apadevam dvayumamho yuyodhi nah ||
verses.en:
Drive utterly away from us each demon, each voracious fiend,
The godless and the false: keep sorrow far away.

verses.sa:
तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत ।
शिशुं न यज्ञैः स्वदयन्त गूर्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tam vah sakhayo madaya punanamabhi gayata |
shishum na yajnaih svadayanta gurtibhih ||
verses.en:
SING; ye aloud, O friends, to him who makes him pure for gladdening drink:
They shall make sweet the Child with sacrifice and laud.

verses.sa:
सं वत्स इव मातृभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते ।
देवावीर्मदो मतिभिः परिष्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
sam vatsa iva matribhirindurhinvano ajyate |
devavirmado matibhih parishkritah ||
verses.en:
Like as a calf with mother cows, so Indu is urged forth and sent,
Glorified by our hymns, the God-delighting juice.

verses.sa:
अयं दक्षाय साधनोऽयं शर्धाय वीतये ।
अयं देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam dakshaya sadhano'yam shardhaya vitaye |
ayam devebhyo madhumattamah sutah ||
verses.en:
Effectual means of power is he, he is a banquet for the Troop,
He who hath been effused, most rich in meath, for Gods.

verses.sa:
गोमन्न इन्दो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धन्व ।
शुचिं ते वर्णमधि गोषु दीधरम् ॥
verses.rom:
gomanna indo ashvavatsutah sudaksha dhanva |
shuchim te varnamadhi goshu didharam ||
verses.en:
Flow to us, Indu, passing, strong, effused, with wealth of kine and steeds:
I will spread forth above the milk thy radiant hue.

verses.sa:
स नो हरीणां पत इन्दो देवप्सरस्तमः ।
सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव ॥
verses.rom:
sa no harinam pata indo devapsarastamah |
sakheva sakhye naryo ruche bhava ||
verses.en:
Lord of the tawny, Indu thou who art the God's most special food,
As Friend to friend, for splendour be thou good to men.

verses.sa:
सनेमि त्वमस्मदाँ अदेवं कं चिदत्रिणम् ।
साह्वाँ इन्दो परि बाधो अप द्वयुम् ॥
verses.rom:
sanemi tvamasmadan adevam kam chidatrinam |
sahvan indo pari badho apa dvayum ||
verses.en:
Drive utterly, far away from us each godless, each voracious foe.
O Indu, overcome and drive the false afar.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमच्छ सुता इमे वृषणं यन्तु हरयः ।
श्रुष्टी जातास इन्दवः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
indramachchha suta ime vrishanam yantu harayah |
shrushti jatasa indavah svarvidah ||
verses.en:
To Indra, to the Mighty Steer, may these gold-coloured juices go,
Drops rapidly produced, that find the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
अयं भराय सानसिरिन्द्राय पवते सुतः ।
सोमो जैत्रस्य चेतति यथा विदे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam bharaya sanasirindraya pavate sutah |
somo jaitrasya chetati yatha vide ||
verses.en:
Effused, this juice victorious flows for Indra, for his maintenance.
Soma bethinks him of the Conqueror, as he knows.

verses.sa:
अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा ग्राभं गृभ्णीत सानसिम् ।
वज्रं च वृषणं भरत्समप्सुजित् ॥
verses.rom:
asyedindro madeshva grabham gribhnita sanasim |
vajram cha vrishanam bharatsamapsujit ||
verses.en:
May Indra in his raptures gain from him the grasp that gathers spoil,
And, winning waters, wield the steer strong thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
प्र धन्वा सोम जागृविरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ।
द्युमन्तं शुष्ममा भरा स्वर्विदम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra dhanva soma jagrivirindrayendo pari srava |
dyumantam shushmama bhara svarvidam ||
verses.en:
Flow vigilant for Indra, thou Soma, yea, Indu, run thou on:
Bring hither splendid strength that finds the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय वृषणं मदं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः ।
सहस्रयामा पथिकृद्विचक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya vrishanam madam pavasva vishvadarshatah |
sahasrayama pathikridvichakshanah ||
verses.en:
Do thou, all-beautiful, purify for Indra's sake the mighty juice,
Path-maker thou, far seeing, with a thousand ways.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमो देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः ।
सहस्रं याहि पथिभिः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyam gatuvittamo devebhyo madhumattamah |
sahasram yahi pathibhih kanikradat ||
verses.en:
Best finder of prosperity for us, most rich in sweets for Gods,
Proceed thou loudly roaring on a thousand paths.

verses.sa:
पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा ।
आ कलशं मधुमान्सोम नः सदः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva devavitaya indo dharabhirojasa |
a kalasham madhumansoma nah sadah ||
verses.en:
O Indu, with thy streams, in might, flow for the banquet of the Gods:
Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy place.

verses.sa:
तव द्रप्सा उदप्रुत इन्द्रं मदाय वावृधुः ।
त्वां देवासो अमृताय कं पपुः ॥
verses.rom:
tava drapsa udapruta indram madaya vavridhuh |
tvam devaso amritaya kam papuh ||
verses.en:
Thy drops that swim in water have exalted Indra to delight:
The Gods have drunk thee up for immortality.

verses.sa:
आ नः सुतास इन्दवः पुनाना धावता रयिम् ।
वृष्टिद्यावो रीत्यापः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
a nah sutasa indavah punana dhavata rayim |
vrishtidyavo rityapah svarvidah ||
verses.en:
Stream opulence to us, ye drops of Soma, pressed and purified,
Pouring down rain from heaven in hoods, and finding light.

verses.sa:
सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाव्यो वारं वि धावति ।
अग्रे वाचः पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
verses.rom:
somah punana urminavyo varam vi dhavati |
agre vachah pavamanah kanikradat ||
verses.en:
Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep,
Shouting while purified before the voice of song.

verses.sa:
धीभिर्हिन्वन्ति वाजिनं वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् ।
अभि त्रिपृष्ठं मतयः समस्वरन् ॥
verses.rom:
dhibhirhinvanti vajinam vane krilantamatyavim |
abhi triprishtham matayah samasvaran ||
verses.en:
With songs they send the Mighty forth, sporting in wood, above the fleece:
Our psalms have glorified him of the triple height.

verses.sa:
असर्जि कलशाँ अभि मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः ।
पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यदत् ॥
verses.rom:
asarji kalashan abhi milhe saptirna vajayuh |
punano vacham janayannasishyadat ||
verses.en:
Into the jars hath he been loosed, like an impetuous steed for war,
And lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on.

verses.sa:
पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वरांसि रंह्या ।
अभ्यर्षन्स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.rom:
pavate haryato harirati hvaramsi ramhya |
abhyarshanstotribhyo viravadyashah ||
verses.en:
Gold-hued and lovely in his course, through tangles of the wool he flows,
And pours heroic fame upon the worshippers.

verses.sa:
अया पवस्व देवयुर्मधोर्धारा असृक्षत ।
रेभन्पवित्रं पर्येषि विश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
aya pavasva devayurmadhordhara asrikshata |
rebhanpavitram paryeshi vishvatah ||
verses.en:
Flow thus, a faithful votary: the streams of meath have been effused.
Thou comest to the filter, singing, from each side.

verses.sa:
परीतो षिञ्चता सुतं सोमो य उत्तमं हविः ।
दधन्वाँ यो नर्यो अप्स्वन्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
parito shinchata sutam somo ya uttamam havih |
dadhanvan yo naryo apsvantara sushava somamadribhih ||
verses.en:
HENCE sprinkle forth the juice effused, Soma, the best of sacred gifts,
Who, friend of man, hath run amid the water-streams. He hath pressed Soma out with stones.

verses.sa:
नूनं पुनानोऽविभिः परि स्रवादब्धः सुरभिन्तरः ।
सुते चित्त्वाप्सु मदामो अन्धसा श्रीणन्तो गोभिरुत्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
nunam punano'vibhih pari sravadabdhah surabhintarah |
sute chittvapsu madamo andhasa shrinanto gobhiruttaram ||
verses.en:
Now, being purified, flow hither through the fleece inviolate and most odorous.
We ladden thee in waters when thou art effused, blending thee still with juice and milk.

verses.sa: परि सुवानश्चक्षसे देवमादनः क्रतुरिन्दुर्विचक्षणः ॥
verses.rom: pari suvanashchakshase devamadanah kraturindurvichakshanah ||
verses.en:
Pressed out for all to see, delighting Gods, Indu,
Far-sighted One, is mental power.

verses.sa:
पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि ।
आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
punanah soma dharayapo vasano arshasi |
a ratnadha yonimritasya sidasyutso deva hiranyayah ||
verses.en:
Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in a watery robe:
Giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold.

verses.sa:
दुहान ऊधर्दिव्यं मधु प्रियं प्रत्नं सधस्थमासदत् ।
आपृच्छ्यं धरुणं वाज्यर्षति नृभिर्धूतो विचक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
duhana udhardivyam madhu priyam pratnam sadhasthamasadat |
aprichchhyam dharunam vajyarshati nribhirdhuto vichakshanah ||
verses.en:
Milking the heavenly udder for dear meath, he hath sat in the ancient gathering place.
Washed by the men, the Strong Farseeing One streams forth nutritious food that all desire.

verses.sa:
पुनानः सोम जागृविरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः ।
त्वं विप्रो अभवोऽङ्गिरस्तमो मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्ष नः ॥
verses.rom:
punanah soma jagriviravyo vare pari priyah |
tvam vipro abhavo'ngirastamo madhva yajnam mimiksha nah ||
verses.en:
O Soma, while they cleanse thee, dear and watchful in the sheep's long wool,
Thou hast become a Singer most like Angiras: thou madest Surya mount to heaven.

verses.sa:
सोमो मीढ्वान्पवते गातुवित्तम ऋषिर्विप्रो विचक्षणः ।
त्वं कविरभवो देववीतम आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
somo midhvanpavate gatuvittama rishirvipro vichakshanah |
tvam kavirabhavo devavitama a suryam rohayo divi ||
verses.en:
Bountiful, best of furtherers, Soma floweth on, Rsi and Singer, keen of sight.
Thou hast become a Sage most welcome to the Gods: thou madest Surya mount to heaven.

verses.sa:
सोम उ षुवाणः सोतृभिरधि ष्णुभिरवीनाम् ।
अश्वयेव हरिता याति धारया मन्द्रया याति धारया ॥
verses.rom:
soma u shuvanah sotribhiradhi shnubhiravinam |
ashvayeva harita yati dharaya mandraya yati dharaya ||
verses.en:
Pressed out by pressers, Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep,
Goes, even as with a mare, in tawny coloured stream, goes in exhilarating stream.

verses.sa:
अनूपे गोमान्गोभिरक्षाः सोमो दुग्धाभिरक्षाः ।
समुद्रं न संवरणान्यग्मन्मन्दी मदाय तोशते ॥
verses.rom:
anupe gomangobhirakshah somo dugdhabhirakshah |
samudram na samvarananyagmanmandi madaya toshate ||
verses.en:
Down to the water-Soma, rich in kine hath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked.
They have approached the mixing-vessel as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse.

verses.sa:
आ सोम सुवानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया ।
जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दधिषे ॥
verses.rom:
a soma suvano adribhistiro varanyavyaya |
jano na puri chamvorvishaddharih sado vaneshu dadhishe ||
verses.en:
Effused by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep,
Thou, entering the saucers as a man the fort, gold-hued hast settled in the wood.

verses.sa:
स मामृजे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः ।
अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिरृक्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa mamrije tiro anvani meshyo milhe saptirna vajayuh |
anumadyah pavamano manishibhih somo viprebhirrikvabhih ||
verses.en:
He beautifies himself through the sheep's long fine wool, like an impetuous steed in war,
Even Soma Pavamana who shall be the joy of sages and of holy bards.

verses.sa:
प्र सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा ।
अंशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra soma devavitaye sindhurna pipye arnasa |
amshoh payasa madiro na jagrivirachchha kosham madhushchutam ||
verses.en:
O Soma,-for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge,
With the stalk's juice, exhilarating, resting not, into the vat that drops with meath.

verses.sa:
आ हर्यतो अर्जुने अत्के अव्यत प्रियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः ।
तमीं हिन्वन्त्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.rom:
a haryato arjune atke avyata priyah sunurna marjyah |
tamim hinvantyapaso yatha ratham nadishva gabhastyoh ||
verses.en:
Like a dear son who must be decked, the Lovely One hath clad him in a shining robe.
Men skillful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their bands.

verses.sa:
अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् ।
समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि मनीषिणो मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi somasa ayavah pavante madyam madam |
samudrasyadhi vishtapi manishino matsarasah svarvidah ||
verses.en:
The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow, the gladdening drink,
Intelligent drops above the basin of the sea, exhilarating, finding light.

verses.sa:
तरत्समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ।
अर्षन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा प्र हिन्वान ऋतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
taratsamudram pavamana urmina raja deva ritam brihat |
arshanmitrasya varunasya dharmana pra hinvana ritam brihat ||
verses.en:
May Pavamana, King and God, speed with his wave over the sea the lofty rite:
May he by Mitra's and by Varuna's decree flow furthering the lofty rite.

verses.sa: नृभिर्येमानो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्रियः ॥
verses.rom: nribhiryemano haryato vichakshano raja devah samudriyah ||
verses.en: Far-seeing, lovely, guided by the men, the God whose home is in the sea-

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय पवते मदः सोमो मरुत्वते सुतः ।
सहस्रधारो अत्यव्यमर्षति तमी मृजन्त्यायवः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya pavate madah somo marutvate sutah |
sahasradharo atyavyamarshati tami mrijantyayavah ||
verses.en:
Soma, the gladdening juice, flows pressed for Indra with his Marut host:
He hastens o'er the fleece with all his thousand streams: men make him bright and beautiful.

verses.sa:
पुनानश्चमू जनयन्मतिं कविः सोमो देवेषु रण्यति ।
अपो वसानः परि गोभिरुत्तरः सीदन्वनेष्वव्यत ॥
verses.rom:
punanashchamu janayanmatim kavih somo deveshu ranyati |
apo vasanah pari gobhiruttarah sidanvaneshvavyata ||
verses.en:
Purified in the bowl and gendering the hymn, wise Soma joys among the Gods.
Robed in the flood, the Mighty One hath clad himself with milk and settled in the vats.

verses.sa:
तवाहं सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवेदिवे ।
पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरन्ति मामव परिधीँरति ताँ इहि ॥
verses.rom:
tavaham soma rarana sakhya indo divedive |
puruni babhro ni charanti mamava paridhinrati tan ihi ||
verses.en:
O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight.
Many fiends follow me; help me, thou Tawny-hued; pass on beyond these barriers.

verses.sa:
उताहं नक्तमुत सोम ते दिवा सख्याय बभ्र ऊधनि ।
घृणा तपन्तमति सूर्यं परः शकुना इव पप्तिम ॥
verses.rom:
utaham naktamuta soma te diva sakhyaya babhra udhani |
ghrina tapantamati suryam parah shakuna iva paptima ||
verses.en:
Close to thy bosom am I, Soma, day and night. O Tawny-hued, for friendship sake.
Surya himself refulgent with his glow have we o'ertaken in his course like birds.

verses.sa:
मृज्यमानः सुहस्त्य समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि ।
रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि ॥
verses.rom:
mrijyamanah suhastya samudre vachaminvasi |
rayim pishangam bahulam puruspriham pavamanabhyarshasi ||
verses.en:
Deft-handcd! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea.
Thou, Pavamana, makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much-desired.

verses.sa:
मृजानो वारे पवमानो अव्यये वृषाव चक्रदो वने ।
देवानां सोम पवमान निष्कृतं गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षसि ॥
verses.rom:
mrijano vare pavamano avyaye vrishava chakrado vane |
devanam soma pavamana nishkritam gobhiranjano arshasi ||
verses.en:
Making thee pure and bright in the sheep's long wool, tbou hast bellowed, steer like, in the wood.
Thou flowest, Soma Pavamana, balmed with milk unto the special place of Gods.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वाजसातयेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या ।
त्वं समुद्रं प्रथमो वि धारयो देवेभ्यः सोम मत्सरः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva vajasataye'bhi vishvani kavya |
tvam samudram prathamo vi dharayo devebhyah soma matsarah ||
verses.en:
Flow on to win us strength, flow on to lofty lore of every kind.
Thou, Soma, as Exhilarator wast the first to spread the sea abroad for Gods.

verses.sa:
स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रजो दिव्या च सोम धर्मभिः ।
त्वां विप्रासो मतिभिर्विचक्षण शुभ्रं हिन्वन्ति धीतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu pavasva pari parthivam rajo divya cha soma dharmabhih |
tvam vipraso matibhirvichakshana shubhram hinvanti dhitibhih ||
verses.en:
Flow to the realm of earth, flow to the realm of heaven, O Soma, in thy righteous ways.
Fair art thou whom the sages, O Far-seeing One, urge onward with their songs and hymns.

verses.sa:
पवमाना असृक्षत पवित्रमति धारया ।
मरुत्वन्तो मत्सरा इन्द्रिया हया मेधामभि प्रयांसि च ॥
verses.rom:
pavamana asrikshata pavitramati dharaya |
marutvanto matsara indriya haya medhamabhi prayamsi cha ||
verses.en:
Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Pavamanas in a stream,
Girt by the Maruts, gladdening, Steeds with Indra's strength, for wisdom and for dainty food.

verses.sa:
अपो वसानः परि कोशमर्षतीन्दुर्हियानः सोतृभिः ।
जनयञ्ज्योतिर्मन्दना अवीवशद्गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजम् ॥
verses.rom:
apo vasanah pari koshamarshatindurhiyanah sotribhih |
janayanjyotirmandana avivashadgah krinvano na nirnijam ||
verses.en:
Urged onward by the pressers, clad in watery robes, Indu is speeding to the vat.
He gendering light, hath made the glad Cows low, while he takes them as his garb of state.

verses.sa:
पवस्व मधुमत्तम इन्द्राय सोम क्रतुवित्तमो मदः ।
महि द्युक्षतमो मदः ॥
verses.rom:
pavasva madhumattama indraya soma kratuvittamo madah |
mahi dyukshatamo madah ||
verses.en:
FOR Indra, flow thou Soma on, as gladdening juice most sweet, intelligent,
Great, cheering, dwelling most in heaven.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते पीत्वा वृषभो वृषायतेऽस्य पीता स्वर्विदः ।
स सुप्रकेतो अभ्यक्रमीदिषोऽच्छा वाजं नैतशः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te pitva vrishabho vrishayate'sya pita svarvidah |
sa supraketo abhyakramidisho'chchha vajam naitashah ||
verses.en:
Thou, of whom having drunk the Steer acts like a steer. drinking of this that finds the light,
He, Excellently Wise, is come to strengthening food, to spoil and wealth like Etasa.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्यङ्ग दैव्या पवमान जनिमानि द्युमत्तमः ।
अमृतत्वाय घोषयः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyanga daivya pavamana janimani dyumattamah |
amritatvaya ghoshayah ||
verses.en:
For, verily, Pavamana, thou bast, splendidest, called all the generations of
The Gods to immortality.

verses.sa:
येना नवग्वो दध्यङ्ङपोर्णुते येन विप्रास आपिरे ।
देवानां सुम्ने अमृतस्य चारुणो येन श्रवांस्यानशुः ॥
verses.rom:
yena navagvo dadhyannapornute yena viprasa apire |
devanam sumne amritasya charuno yena shravamsyanashuh ||
verses.en:
By whom Dadhyac Navagva opens fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish,
By whom they won the fame of lovely Amrta in the felicity of Gods.

verses.sa:
एष स्य धारया सुतोऽव्यो वारेभिः पवते मदिन्तमः ।
क्रीळन्नूर्मिरपामिव ॥
verses.rom:
esha sya dharaya suto'vyo varebhih pavate madintamah |
krilannurmirapamiva ||
verses.en:
Effused, he floweth in a stream, best rapture-giver, in the long wool of the sheep,
Sporting, as 'twere the waters' wave.

verses.sa:
य उस्रिया अप्या अन्तरश्मनो निर्गा अकृन्तदोजसा ।
अभि व्रजं तत्निषे गव्यमश्व्यं वर्मीव धृष्णवा रुज ॥
verses.rom:
ya usriya apya antarashmano nirga akrintadojasa |
abhi vrajam tatnishe gavyamashvyam varmiva dhrishnava ruja ||
verses.en:
He who from out the rocky cavern took with might the red refulgent watery Cows,
Thou masterest the stable full of kine and steeds: burst it, brave Lord, like one in mail.

verses.sa:
आ सोता परि षिञ्चताश्वं न स्तोममप्तुरं रजस्तुरम् ।
वनक्रक्षमुदप्रुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
a sota pari shinchatashvam na stomamapturam rajasturam |
vanakrakshamudaprutam ||
verses.en:
Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laudworthy, speeding through the region and the flood,
Who swims in water, roan in wood;

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारं वृषभं पयोवृधं प्रियं देवाय जन्मने ।
ऋतेन य ऋतजातो विवावृधे राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradharam vrishabham payovridham priyam devaya janmane |
ritena ya ritajato vivavridhe raja deva ritam brihat ||
verses.en:
Increaser of the water, Steer with thousand streams, dear to the race of Deities;
Who born in Law hath waxen mighty by the Law, King, God, and lofty Ordinance.

verses.sa:
अभि द्युम्नं बृहद्यश इषस्पते दिदीहि देव देवयुः ।
वि कोशं मध्यमं युव ॥
verses.rom:
abhi dyumnam brihadyasha ishaspate didihi deva devayuh |
vi kosham madhyamam yuva ||
verses.en:
Make splendid glory shine on us, thou Lord of strengthening food, God, as the Friend of Gods:
Unclose the fount of middle air.

verses.sa:
आ वच्यस्व सुदक्ष चम्वोः सुतो विशां वह्निर्न विश्पतिः ।
वृष्टिं दिवः पवस्व रीतिमपां जिन्वा गविष्टये धियः ॥
verses.rom:
a vachyasva sudaksha chamvoh suto visham vahnirna vishpatih |
vrishtim divah pavasva ritimapam jinva gavishtaye dhiyah ||
verses.en:
Roll onward to the bowls, O Mighty One, effused, as Prince supporter of the tribes.
Pour on us rain from heaven, send us the waters' flow: incite our thoughts to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
एतमु त्यं मदच्युतं सहस्रधारं वृषभं दिवो दुहुः ।
विश्वा वसूनि बिभ्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
etamu tyam madachyutam sahasradharam vrishabham divo duhuh |
vishva vasuni bibhratam ||
verses.en:
They have drained him the Steer of heaven, him with a thousand streams, distilling rapturous joy,
Him who brings all things excellent.

verses.sa:
वृषा वि जज्ञे जनयन्नमर्त्यः प्रतपञ्ज्योतिषा तमः ।
स सुष्टुतः कविभिर्निर्णिजं दधे त्रिधात्वस्य दंससा ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha vi jajne janayannamartyah pratapanjyotisha tamah |
sa sushtutah kavibhirnirnijam dadhe tridhatvasya damsasa ||
verses.en:
The Mighty One was born Immortal, giving life, lightening darkness with his shine.
Well-praised by. sages he hath. by his wondrous power assumed the Threefold as his robe.

verses.sa:
स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इळानाम् ।
सोमो यः सुक्षितीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa sunve yo vasunam yo rayamaneta ya ilanam |
somo yah sukshitinam ||
verses.en:
Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us bounteous gifts and sweet refreshing food,
Soma who brings us quiet homes:

verses.sa:
यस्य न इन्द्रः पिबाद्यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः ।
आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एन्द्रमवसे महे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya na indrah pibadyasya maruto yasya varyamana bhagah |
a yena mitravaruna karamaha endramavase mahe ||
verses.en:
He whom our Indra and the Marut host shall drink, Bhaga shall drink with Aryaman,
By whom we bring to us Mitra and Varuna and Indra for our great defence.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम पातवे नृभिर्यतः स्वायुधो मदिन्तमः ।
पवस्व मधुमत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya soma patave nribhiryatah svayudho madintamah |
pavasva madhumattamah ||
verses.en:
Soma, for Indra's drink do thou, led by the men, well-weaponed and most gladdening,
Flow on with greatest store of sweets.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः ।
जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे दिवो विष्टम्भ उत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya hardi somadhanama visha samudramiva sindhavah |
jushto mitraya varunaya vayave divo vishtambha uttamah ||
verses.en:
Enter the Soma-holder, even Indra's heart, as rivers pass into the sea,
Acceptable to Mitra, Vayu, Varuna, the noblest Pillar of the heavens.

verses.sa: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय ॥
verses.rom: pari pra dhanvendraya soma svadurmitraya pushne bhagaya ||
verses.en: PLEASANT to Indra's Mitra's, Pusan's Bhaga's taste, sped onward, Soma, with thy flowing stream.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्ते सोम सुतस्य पेयाः क्रत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः ॥
verses.rom: indraste soma sutasya peyah kratve dakshaya vishve cha devah ||
verses.en: Let Indra drink, O Soma, of thy juice for wisdom, and all Deities for strength.

verses.sa: एवामृताय महे क्षयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः ॥
verses.rom: evamritaya mahe kshayaya sa shukro arsha divyah piyushah ||
verses.en: So flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast, immortal dwelling-place.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma mahantsamudrah pita devanam vishvabhi dhama ||
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods to every form.

verses.sa: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पृथिव्यै शं च प्रजायै ॥
verses.rom: shukrah pavasva devebhyah soma dive prithivyai sham cha prajayai ||
verses.en: Flow on, O Soma, radiant for the Gods and Heaven and Earth and bless our progeny.

verses.sa: दिवो धर्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन्वाजी पवस्व ॥
verses.rom: divo dhartasi shukrah piyushah satye vidharmanvaji pavasva ||
verses.en: Thou, bright Juice, art Sustainer of the sky: flow, mighty, in accordance with true Law.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम द्युम्नी सुधारो महामवीनामनु पूर्व्यः ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma dyumni sudharo mahamavinamanu purvyah ||
verses.en: Soma, flow splendid with thy copious stream through the great fleece as in the olden time.

verses.sa: नृभिर्येमानो जज्ञानः पूतः क्षरद्विश्वानि मन्द्रः स्वर्वित् ॥
verses.rom: nribhiryemano jajnanah putah ksharadvishvani mandrah svarvit ||
verses.en: Bom, led by men, joyous, and purified, let the Light-finder make all blessings flow:

verses.sa: इन्दुः पुनानः प्रजामुराणः करद्विश्वानि द्रविणानि नः ॥
verses.rom: induh punanah prajamuranah karadvishvani dravinani nah ||
verses.en: Indu, while cleansed, keeping the people safe, shall give us all possessions for our own.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम क्रत्वे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ॥
verses.rom: pavasva soma kratve dakshayashvo na nikto vaji dhanaya ||
verses.en: Flow on for wisdom, Soma, and for power, as a strong courser bathed, to win the prize.

verses.sa: तं ते सोतारो रसं मदाय पुनन्ति सोमं महे द्युम्नाय ॥
verses.rom: tam te sotaro rasam madaya punanti somam mahe dyumnaya ||
verses.en: The pressers purify this juice of thine, the Soma, for delight, and lofty fame

verses.sa: शिशुं जज्ञानं हरिं मृजन्ति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इन्दुम् ॥
verses.rom: shishum jajnanam harim mrijanti pavitre somam devebhya indum ||
verses.en: They deck the Gold-hued Infant, newly born, even Soma, Indu, in the sieve for Gods.

verses.sa: इन्दुः पविष्ट चारुर्मदायापामुपस्थे कविर्भगाय ॥
verses.rom: induh pavishta charurmadayapamupasthe kavirbhagaya ||
verses.en: Fair Indu hath flowed on for rapturous joy, Sage for good fortune in the waters' lap.

verses.sa: बिभर्ति चार्विन्द्रस्य नाम येन विश्वानि वृत्रा जघान ॥
verses.rom: bibharti charvindrasya nama yena vishvani vritra jaghana ||
verses.en: He bears the beauteous name of Indra, that wherewith he overcame all demon foes.

verses.sa: पिबन्त्यस्य विश्वे देवासो गोभिः श्रीतस्य नृभिः सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom: pibantyasya vishve devaso gobhih shritasya nribhih sutasya ||
verses.en: All Deities are wont to drink of him, pressed by the men and blent with milk and curds.

verses.sa: प्र सुवानो अक्षाः सहस्रधारस्तिरः पवित्रं वि वारमव्यम् ॥
verses.rom: pra suvano akshah sahasradharastirah pavitram vi varamavyam ||
verses.en: He hath flowed forth with thousand streams effused, flowed through the filter and the sheep's long wool.

verses.sa: स वाज्यक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर्मृजानो गोभिः श्रीणानः ॥
verses.rom: sa vajyakshah sahasrareta adbhirmrijano gobhih shrinanah ||
verses.en: With endless genial flow the Strong hath run, purified by the waters, blent with milk.

verses.sa: प्र सोम याहीन्द्रस्य कुक्षा नृभिर्येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः ॥
verses.rom: pra soma yahindrasya kuksha nribhiryemano adribhih sutah ||
verses.en: Pressed out with stones, directed by the men, go forth, O Soma, into Indra's throat.

verses.sa: असर्जि वाजी तिरः पवित्रमिन्द्राय सोमः सहस्रधारः ॥
verses.rom: asarji vaji tirah pavitramindraya somah sahasradharah ||
verses.en: The mighty Soma with a thousand streams is poured to Indra through the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa: अञ्जन्त्येनं मध्वो रसेनेन्द्राय वृष्ण इन्दुं मदाय ॥
verses.rom: anjantyenam madhvo rasenendraya vrishna indum madaya ||
verses.en: Indu they balm with pleasant milky juice for Indra, for the Steer, for his delight.

verses.sa: देवेभ्यस्त्वा वृथा पाजसेऽपो वसानं हरिं मृजन्ति ॥
verses.rom: devebhyastva vritha pajase'po vasanam harim mrijanti ||
verses.en: Lightly, for sheen, they cleanse thee for the Gods, gold-coloured, wearing water as thy robe.

verses.sa: इन्दुरिन्द्राय तोशते नि तोशते श्रीणन्नुग्रो रिणन्नपः ॥
verses.rom: indurindraya toshate ni toshate shrinannugro rinannapah ||
verses.en: Indu to Indra streams, yea, downward streams, Strong, flowing to the floods, and mingling -there.

verses.sa:
पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः ।
द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईयसे ॥
verses.rom:
paryu shu pra dhanva vajasataye pari vritrani sakshanih |
dvishastaradhya rinaya na iyase ||
verses.en:
O'ERPOWERING Vrtras, forward run to win great strength:
Thou speedest to subdue like one exacting debts.

verses.sa:
अनु हि त्वा सुतं सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये ।
वाजाँ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे ॥
verses.rom:
anu hi tva sutam soma madamasi mahe samaryarajye |
vajan abhi pavamana pra gahase ||
verses.en:
In thee, effused, O Soma, we rejoice ourselves for great supremacy in fight.
Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds,

verses.sa:
अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः ।
गोजीरया रंहमाणः पुरंध्या ॥
verses.rom:
ajijano hi pavamana suryam vidhare shakmana payah |
gojiraya ramhamanah puramdhya ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, thou didst generate the Sun, and spread the moisture out with power,
Hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.

verses.sa:
अजीजनो अमृत मर्त्येष्वाँ ऋतस्य धर्मन्नमृतस्य चारुणः ।
सदासरो वाजमच्छा सनिष्यदत् ॥
verses.rom:
ajijano amrita martyeshvan ritasya dharmannamritasya charunah |
sadasaro vajamachchha sanishyadat ||
verses.en:
Thou didst produce him, Deathless God mid mortal men for maintenance of Law and lovely Amrta:
Thou evermore hast moved making strength flow to us.

verses.sa:
अभ्यभि हि श्रवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितम् ।
शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः ॥
verses.rom:
abhyabhi hi shravasa tatardithotsam na kam chijjanapanamakshitam |
sharyabhirna bharamano gabhastyoh ||
verses.en:
All round about hast thou with glory pierced for us as 'twere a never-failing well for men to drink,
Borne on thy way in fragments from the presser's arms.

verses.sa:
आदीं के चित्पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत ।
वारं न देवः सविता व्यूर्णुते ॥
verses.rom:
adim ke chitpashyamanasa apyam vasurucho divya abhyanushata |
varam na devah savita vyurnute ||
verses.en:
Then, beautifully radiant, certain Heavenly Ones, have sung to him their kinship as they looked thereon,
And Savitar the God opens as 'twere a stall.

verses.sa:
त्वे सोम प्रथमा वृक्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय श्रवसे धियं दधुः ।
स त्वं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
tve soma prathama vriktabarhisho mahe vajaya shravase dhiyam dadhuh |
sa tvam no vira viryaya chodaya ||
verses.en:
Soma, the men of old whose grass was trimmed addressed the hymn to thee for mighty strength and for renown:
So, Hero, urge us onward to heroic power.

verses.sa:
दिवः पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहाद्दिव आ निरधुक्षत ।
इन्द्रमभि जायमानं समस्वरन् ॥
verses.rom:
divah piyusham purvyam yadukthyam maho gahaddiva a niradhukshata |
indramabhi jayamanam samasvaran ||
verses.en:
They have drained forth from out the great depth of the sky the old primeval milk of heaven that claims the laud:
They lifted up their voice to Indra at his birth.

verses.sa:
अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना ।
यूथे न निष्ठा वृषभो वि तिष्ठसे ॥
verses.rom:
adha yadime pavamana rodasi ima cha vishva bhuvanabhi majmana |
yuthe na nishtha vrishabho vi tishthase ||
verses.en:
As long as thou, O Pavamana, art above this earth and heaven and all existence in thy might,
Thou standest like a Bull the chief amid the herd.

verses.sa:
सोमः पुनानो अव्यये वारे शिशुर्न क्रीळन्पवमानो अक्षाः ।
सहस्रधारः शतवाज इन्दुः ॥
verses.rom:
somah punano avyaye vare shishurna krilanpavamano akshah |
sahasradharah shatavaja induh ||
verses.en:
In the sheep's wool hath Soma Pavamana flowed, while they cleanse him, like a playful infant,
Indu with hundred powers and hundred currents.

verses.sa:
एष पुनानो मधुमाँ ऋतावेन्द्रायेन्दुः पवते स्वादुरूर्मिः ।
वाजसनिर्वरिवोविद्वयोधाः ॥
verses.rom:
esha punano madhuman ritavendrayenduh pavate svadururmih |
vajasanirvarivovidvayodhah ||
verses.en:
Holy and sweet, while purified, this Indu flows on, a wave of pleasant taste, to Indra,-
Strength-winner, Treasure-finder, Life. bestower.

verses.sa:
स पवस्व सहमानः पृतन्यून्सेधन्रक्षांस्यप दुर्गहाणि ।
स्वायुधः सासह्वान्सोम शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
sa pavasva sahamanah pritanyunsedhanrakshamsyapa durgahani |
svayudhah sasahvansoma shatrun ||
verses.en:
So flow thou on, subduing our assailants, chasing the demons hard to been countered,
Well-armed and conquering our foes, O Soma.

verses.sa:
अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि तरति स्वयुग्वभिः सूरो न स्वयुग्वभिः ।
धारा सुतस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः ।
विश्वा यद्रूपा परियात्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिरृक्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
aya rucha harinya punano vishva dveshamsi tarati svayugvabhih suro na svayugvabhih |
dhara sutasya rochate punano arusho harih |
vishva yadrupa pariyatyrikvabhih saptasyebhirrikvabhih ||
verses.en:
WITH this his golden splendour purifying him, he with his own allies subdues all enemies, as Sara with his own allies.
Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with the praisers he encompasses all forms, with praisers having seven mouths.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्यत्पणीनां विदो वसु सं मातृभिर्मर्जयसि स्व आ दम ऋतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे ।
परावतो न साम तद्यत्रा रणन्ति धीतयः ।
त्रिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tyatpaninam vido vasu sam matribhirmarjayasi sva a dama ritasya dhitibhirdame |
paravato na sama tadyatra rananti dhitayah |
tridhatubhirarushibhirvayo dadhe rochamano vayo dadhe ||
verses.en:
That treasure of the Panis thou discoveredst; thou with thy mothers deckest thee in thine abode, with songs of worship in thine home.
As 'twere from far, the hymn is heard, where holy songs resound in joy. He with the ruddy-hued, threefold hath won life-power, he, glittering, hath won life-power.

verses.sa:
पूर्वामनु प्रदिशं याति चेकितत्सं रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः ।
अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौंस्येन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षयन् ।
वज्रश्च यद्भवथो अनपच्युता समत्स्वनपच्युता ॥
verses.rom:
purvamanu pradisham yati chekitatsam rashmibhiryatate darshato ratho daivyo darshato rathah |
agmannukthani paumsyendram jaitraya harshayan |
vajrashcha yadbhavatho anapachyuta samatsvanapachyuta ||
verses.en:
He moves intelligent, directed to the East. The very beauteous car rivals the beams of light, the beautiful celestial car.
Hymns, lauding manly valour, came, inciting Indra to success, that ye may be unconquered, both thy bolt and thou, both be unconquered in the war.

verses.sa:
नानानं वा उ नो धियो वि व्रतानि जनानाम् ।
तक्षा रिष्टं रुतं भिषग्ब्रह्मा सुन्वन्तमिच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
nananam va u no dhiyo vi vratani jananam |
taksha rishtam rutam bhishagbrahma sunvantamichchhatindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
WE all have various thoughts and plans, and diverse are the ways of men.
The Brahman seeks the worshipper, wright seeks the cracked, and leech the maimed. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
जरतीभिरोषधीभिः पर्णेभिः शकुनानाम् ।
कार्मारो अश्मभिर्द्युभिर्हिरण्यवन्तमिच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
jaratibhiroshadhibhih parnebhih shakunanam |
karmaro ashmabhirdyubhirhiranyavantamichchhatindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
The smith with ripe and seasoned plants, with feathers of the birds of air,
With stones, and with enkindled flames, seeks him who hath a store of gold. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
कारुरहं ततो भिषगुपलप्रक्षिणी नना ।
नानाधियो वसूयवोऽनु गा इव तस्थिमेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
karuraham tato bhishagupalaprakshini nana |
nanadhiyo vasuyavo'nu ga iva tasthimendrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
A bard am I, my dad's a leech, mammy lays corn upon the stones.
Striving for wealth, with varied plans, we follow our desires like kine. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
अश्वो वोळ्हा सुखं रथं हसनामुपमन्त्रिणः ।
शेपो रोमण्वन्तौ भेदौ वारिन्मण्डूक इच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
ashvo volha sukham ratham hasanamupamantrinah |
shepo romanvantau bhedau varinmanduka ichchhatindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
The horse would draw an easy car, gay hosts attract the laugh and jest.
The male desires his mate's approach, the frog is eager for the flood, Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
शर्यणावति सोममिन्द्रः पिबतु वृत्रहा ।
बलं दधान आत्मनि करिष्यन्वीर्यं महदिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
sharyanavati somamindrah pibatu vritraha |
balam dadhana atmani karishyanviryam mahadindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
LET Vrtra-slaying Indra drink Soma by Saryanavan's side,
Storing up vigour in his heart, prepared to do heroic deeds. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व दिशां पत आर्जीकात्सोम मीढ्वः ।
ऋतवाकेन सत्येन श्रद्धया तपसा सुत इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
a pavasva disham pata arjikatsoma midhvah |
ritavakena satyena shraddhaya tapasa suta indrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Lord of the Quarters, flow thou on, boon Soma, from Arjika land,
Effused with ardour and with faith, and the true hymn of sacrifice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्यवृद्धं महिषं तं सूर्यस्य दुहिताभरत् ।
तं गन्धर्वाः प्रत्यगृभ्णन्तं सोमे रसमादधुरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
parjanyavriddham mahisham tam suryasya duhitabharat |
tam gandharvah pratyagribhnantam some rasamadadhurindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Hither hath Surya's Daughter brought the wild Steer whom Parjanya nursed.
Gandharvas have seized bold of him, and in the Soma laid the juice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
ऋतं वदन्नृतद्युम्न सत्यं वदन्सत्यकर्मन् ।
श्रद्धां वदन्सोम राजन्धात्रा सोम परिष्कृत इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
ritam vadannritadyumna satyam vadansatyakarman |
shraddham vadansoma rajandhatra soma parishkrita indrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Splendid by Law! declaring Law, truth speaking, truthful in thy works,
Enouncing faith, King Soma! thou, O Soma, whom thy maker decks. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
सत्यमुग्रस्य बृहतः सं स्रवन्ति संस्रवाः ।
सं यन्ति रसिनो रसाः पुनानो ब्रह्मणा हर इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
satyamugrasya brihatah sam sravanti samsravah |
sam yanti rasino rasah punano brahmana hara indrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Together flow the meeting streams of him the Great and truly Strong.
The juices of the juicy meet. Made pure by prayer, O Golden-hued, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मा पवमान छन्दस्यां वाचं वदन् ।
ग्राव्णा सोमे महीयते सोमेनानन्दं जनयन्निन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
yatra brahma pavamana chhandasyam vacham vadan |
gravna some mahiyate somenanandam janayannindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
O Pavamana, where the priest, as he recites the rhythmic prayer,
Lords it o'er Soma with the stone, with Soma bringing forth delight, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्र ज्योतिरजस्रं यस्मिँल्लोके स्वर्हितम् ।
तस्मिन्मां धेहि पवमानामृते लोके अक्षित इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
yatra jyotirajasram yasminlloke svarhitam |
tasminmam dhehi pavamanamrite loke akshita indrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
O Pavarnana, place me in that deathless, undecaying world
Wherein the light of heaven is set, and everlasting lustre shines. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्र राजा वैवस्वतो यत्रावरोधनं दिवः ।
यत्रामूर्यह्वतीरापस्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
yatra raja vaivasvato yatravarodhanam divah |
yatramuryahvatirapastatra mamamritam kridhindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Make me immortal in that realm where dwells the King, Vivasvan's Son,
Where is the secret shrine of heaven, where are those waters young and fresh. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्रानुकामं चरणं त्रिनाके त्रिदिवे दिवः ।
लोका यत्र ज्योतिष्मन्तस्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
yatranukamam charanam trinake tridive divah |
loka yatra jyotishmantastatra mamamritam kridhindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Make me immortal in that realm where they move even as they list,
In the third sphere of inmost heaven where lucid worlds are full of light. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्र कामा निकामाश्च यत्र ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् ।
स्वधा च यत्र तृप्तिश्च तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
yatra kama nikamashcha yatra bradhnasya vishtapam |
svadha cha yatra triptishcha tatra mamamritam kridhindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Make me immortal in that realm of eager wish and strong desire,
The region of the radiant Moon, where food and full delight are found. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake:

verses.sa:
यत्रानन्दाश्च मोदाश्च मुदः प्रमुद आसते ।
कामस्य यत्राप्ताः कामास्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
yatranandashcha modashcha mudah pramuda asate |
kamasya yatraptah kamastatra mamamritam kridhindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Make me immortal in that realm where happiness and transports, where
Joys and felicities combine, and longing wishes are fulfilled. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
य इन्दोः पवमानस्यानु धामान्यक्रमीत् ।
तमाहुः सुप्रजा इति यस्ते सोमाविधन्मन इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
ya indoh pavamanasyanu dhamanyakramit |
tamahuh supraja iti yaste somavidhanmana indrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
THE man who walketh as the Laws of Indu Pavamana bid,
Men call him rich in children, him, O Soma, who hath met thy thought. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
ऋषे मन्त्रकृतां स्तोमैः कश्यपोद्वर्धयन्गिरः ।
सोमं नमस्य राजानं यो जज्ञे वीरुधां पतिरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
rishe mantrakritam stomaih kashyapodvardhayangirah |
somam namasya rajanam yo jajne virudham patirindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Kasyapa, Rsi, lifting up thy voice with hymn-composers' lauds,
Pav reverence to King Soma born the Sovran Ruler of the plants. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
सप्त दिशो नानासूर्याः सप्त होतार ऋत्विजः ।
देवा आदित्या ये सप्त तेभिः सोमाभि रक्ष न इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
sapta disho nanasuryah sapta hotara ritvijah |
deva aditya ye sapta tebhih somabhi raksha na indrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Seven regions have their several Suns; the ministering priests are seven;
Seven are the Aditya Deities,-with these, O Soma, guard thou us. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्ते राजञ्छृतं हविस्तेन सोमाभि रक्ष नः ।
अरातीवा मा नस्तारीन्मो च नः किं चनाममदिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
yatte rajanchhritam havistena somabhi raksha nah |
arativa ma nastarinmo cha nah kim chanamamadindrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en: Guard us with this oblation which, King Soma, hath been dressed for thee.
